<en id="wh53513">Then the LORD</en> ... <en id="wh53514">to</en> <en id="wh53515">Moses</en>,
<en id="wh53517">said</en>

<en id="wh62309">and</en>

<en id="wh62316">Then</en> <en id="wh62317">he shall take</en> <en id="wh62320">the</en> <en id="wh62319">two</en> <en id="wh62321">goats</en>

<en id="wh62325">and</en> <en id="wh62323">present</en> <en id="wh62322">them</en> <en id="wh62326">before</en> <en id="wh62327">the LORD</en> <en id="wh62328">at the entrance</en> <en id="wh62329">to the Tent</en> <en id="wh62330">of Meeting</en>.
<en id="wh62333">After Aaron</en> <en id="wh62332">casts</en> <en id="wh62338">lots</en> <en id="wh62331">for</en> <en id="wh62336">the</en> <en id="wh62335">two</en> <en id="wh62337">goats</en>,
<en id="wh62340">one</en> <en id="wh62342">for the LORD</en>
<en id="wh62343">and</en> <en id="wh62345">the other</en> <en id="wh62347">for the scapegoat</en>,

<en id="wh62851">must wash</en> <en id="wh62852">his clothes</en>
<en id="wh62853">and</en> <en id="wh62854">bathe</en> <en id="wh62856">himself</en> <en id="wh62857">with</en> <en id="wh62859">water</en>,
<en id="wh62860">and</en> <en id="wh62861">afterward</en> <en id="wh62863">he may reenter</en> <en id="wh62865">the</en> <en id="wh62866">camp</en>.

<en id="wh62921">It</en> <en id="wh62919">is a Sabbath</en> <en id="wh62920">of complete rest</en> <en id="wh62922">for you</en>,
<en id="wh62924">that you may humble</en> <en id="wh62926">yourselves</en>;
<en id="wh62928">it is a permanent</en> <en id="wh62927">statute</en>.
<en id="wh62931">The</en> <en id="wh62932">priest</en> ... <en id="wh62930">shall make atonement</en>.

<en id="wh76767">Whenever</en>
<en id="wh76770">the</en> <en id="wh76771">ark</en> <en id="wh76769">set out</en>,

<en id="wh76795">Soon</en>

<en id="wh76974">of family</en> ... <en id="wh76972">weeping</en>

— <en id="wh77100">and</en> <en id="wh77101">let me not</en> <en id="wh77102">see</en> <en id="wh77104">my own wretchedness</en>.”
<en id="wh77107">Then the LORD</en> <en id="wh77106">said</en> <en id="wh77108">to</en> <en id="wh77109">Moses</en>,

<en id="wh77251">But Moses</en> <en id="wh77250">replied</en>,
<en id="wh77252">600,000</en> <en id="wh77257">men</en> <en id="wh77255">on foot</en>,
“<en id="wh77259">Here I am</en> <en id="wh77261">among</en>

<en id="wh86831">no</en> <en id="wh86834">inheritance</en> <en id="wh86832">was given</en> <en id="wh86833">to</en> <en id="wh86836">them among</en> <en id="wh86837">the Israelites</en>.

<en id="wh86953">to</en> ... <en id="wh86954">and said</en>,

<en id="wh86960">but</en> <en id="wh86961">he</en> <en id="wh86963">was</en> <en id="wh86962">not</en> <en id="wh86965">among</en> <en id="wh86966">the</en> <en id="wh86967">followers</en>

<en id="wh86975">Instead</en>, <en id="wh86978">he died</en> <en id="wh86977">because of his own sin</en>,

<en id="wh87004">So Moses</en> <en id="wh87003">brought</en> <en id="wh87006">their case</en> <en id="wh87008">before</en> <en id="wh87009">the LORD</en>,

<en id="wh87036">Furthermore</en>, <en id="wh87040">you shall say</en> <en id="wh87037">to</en> <en id="wh87038">the Israelites</en>,
<en id="wh87043">a man</en>

<en id="wh87046">and</en> <en id="wh87048">leaves no</en> <en id="wh87047">son</en>,

<en id="wh87115">Then the LORD</en> <en id="wh87114">said</en> <en id="wh87116">to</en> <en id="wh87117">Moses</en>,

<en id="wh87136">After you have seen it</en>,

<en id="wh87144">as</en> <en id="wh87148">your brother</en> <en id="wh87147">Aaron</en> <en id="wh87146">was</en>;

<en id="wh87207">so</en> <en id="wh87210">that the congregation</en> <en id="wh87211">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh87208">will not</en> <en id="wh87209">be</en> <en id="wh87212">like</en> <en id="wh87214">sheep</en>
<en id="wh87216">without</en> <en id="wh87218">a shepherd</en>.”
<en id="wh87219">And</en> <en id="wh87221">the LORD</en> <en id="wh87220">replied</en> <en id="wh87222">to</en> <en id="wh87223">Moses</en>,
“<en id="wh87224">Take</en> <en id="wh87227">Joshua</en> <en id="wh87228">son</en> <en id="wh87229">of Nun</en>, <en id="wh87230">a man with</en>
<en id="wh87232">the Spirit</en> <en id="wh87233">in him</en>,
<en id="wh87234">and</en> <en id="wh87235">lay</en> <en id="wh87237">your hands</en> <en id="wh87238">on him</en>.

<en id="wh87240">Have him stand</en> <en id="wh87243">before</en> <en id="wh87244">Eleazar</en> <en id="wh87245">the</en> <en id="wh87246">priest</en> <en id="wh87248">and</en> <en id="wh87251">the</en> <en id="wh87250">whole</en> <en id="wh87252">congregation</en>,

<en id="wh96934">you are not</en> <en id="wh96935">to turn aside</en> <en id="wh96936">to the right</en> <en id="wh96937">or</en> <en id="wh96938">to the left</en>.
<en id="wh96939">in</en> <en id="wh96940">all</en> <en id="wh96941">the</en> <en id="wh96942">ways</en>
<en id="wh96943">that</en> <en id="wh96945">the LORD</en> <en id="wh96946">your God</en> <en id="wh96944">has commanded you</en>,
<en id="wh96948">You must walk</en>
<en id="wh96949">that</en> <en id="wh96950">you may live</en>
<en id="wh96951">so</en> ... <en id="wh96953">and</en> <en id="wh96952">prosper</en>
<en id="wh96954">and</en> <en id="wh96955">prolong</en> <en id="wh96956">your days</en> <en id="wh96957">in</en> <en id="wh96958">the</en> <en id="wh96959">land</en>
<en id="wh96960">that</en> <en id="wh96961">you will possess</en>.

<en id="wh96963">These are</en> <en id="wh96964">the</en> <en id="wh96965">commandments</en> <en id="wh96968">and</en> <en id="wh96967">statutes</en> <en id="wh96970">and ordinances</en> ... <en id="wh96969">the</en>
<en id="wh96971">that</en> ... <en id="wh96973">LORD</en> <en id="wh96974">your God</en> <en id="wh96972">has instructed me</en>
<en id="wh96975">to</en> <en id="wh96976">teach you</en>
<en id="wh96978">to</en> <en id="wh96979">follow</en> <en id="wh96980">in</en> <en id="wh96981">the</en> <en id="wh96982">land</en>
<en id="wh96983">that</en> <en id="wh96984">you</en> <en id="wh96985">are about to enter</en>
<en id="wh96987">and</en> <en id="wh96988">possess</en>,

<en id="wh96997">all</en> ... <en id="wh96995">by keeping</en> ... <en id="wh96998">His statutes</en> <en id="wh96999">and</en> <en id="wh97000">commandments</en>
<en id="wh97001">that</en> <en id="wh97002">I</en> <en id="wh97003">give</en>

<en id="wh97005">and</en> <en id="wh97006">your children</en> <en id="wh97007">and</en> <en id="wh97008">grandchildren</en> ... <en id="wh97011">the days</en> <en id="wh97012">of your lives</en> ... <en id="wh97010">all</en> ... <en id="wh97004">you</en>,
<en id="wh97013">and</en> <en id="wh97014">so that</en> <en id="wh97016">your days</en> <en id="wh97015">may be prolonged</en>.
<en id="wh97018">Hear</en>,
<en id="wh97019">O Israel</en>,
<en id="wh97020">and</en> <en id="wh97021">be careful</en>
<en id="wh97022">to</en> <en id="wh97023">observe them</en>,
<en id="wh97026">so</en> <en id="wh97024">that</en> <en id="wh97025">you may prosper</en>
<en id="wh97027">and</en> <en id="wh97029">multiply</en> <en id="wh97030">greatly</en>

<en id="wh97032">just</en> <en id="wh97031">as</en> <en id="wh97034">the LORD</en>, <en id="wh97035">the God</en> <en id="wh97036">of your fathers</en>, <en id="wh97033">has promised</en> <en id="wh97037">you</en>.
<en id="wh97038">in a land</en> <en id="wh97039">flowing</en> <en id="wh97040">with milk</en> <en id="wh97041">and</en> <en id="wh97042">honey</en>,
<en id="wh97043">Hear</en>,
<en id="wh97044">O Israel</en>:
<en id="wh97045">The LORD</en> <en id="wh97046">our God</en>,
<en id="wh97047">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97048">is One</en>.

<en id="wh97049">And</en> <en id="wh97050">you shall love</en> <en id="wh97052">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97053">your God</en> <en id="wh97054">with</en> <en id="wh97055">all</en> <en id="wh97056">your heart</en> <en id="wh97057">and</en> <en id="wh97058">with</en> <en id="wh97059">all</en> <en id="wh97060">your soul</en> <en id="wh97061">and</en> <en id="wh97062">with</en> <en id="wh97063">all</en> <en id="wh97064">your strength</en>.
<en id="wh97070">These</en> <en id="wh97068">words</en> ... <en id="wh97066">are to be</en>
<en id="wh97072">I</en> <en id="wh97073">am commanding you</en> <en id="wh97075">today</en>
<en id="wh97076">upon</en> <en id="wh97077">your hearts</en>.
<en id="wh97078">And</en> <en id="wh97079">you shall teach them diligently</en> <en id="wh97080">to</en> <en id="wh97081">your children</en>
<en id="wh97082">and</en> <en id="wh97083">speak</en> <en id="wh97084">of them</en>
<en id="wh97085">when</en> <en id="wh97086">you sit</en> <en id="wh97087">at</en> <en id="wh97088">home</en>
<en id="wh97089">and</en> <en id="wh97090">when</en> <en id="wh97091">you walk</en> <en id="wh97094">along the road</en>,
<en id="wh97096">when</en> <en id="wh97097">you lie down</en>
<en id="wh97098">and</en> <en id="wh97099">when</en> <en id="wh97100">you get up</en>.
<en id="wh97102">Tie them</en> <en id="wh97104">as reminders</en> <en id="wh97105">on</en> <en id="wh97106">your hands</en>
<en id="wh97107">and</en> <en id="wh97108">bind them</en> <en id="wh97111">on your foreheads</en>.
<en id="wh97114">Write them</en> <en id="wh97115">on</en> <en id="wh97116">the doorposts</en> <en id="wh97117">of your houses</en>
<en id="wh97118">and</en> <en id="wh97119">on</en> <en id="wh97120">your gates</en>.
<en id="wh97121">And</en>

<en id="wh97123">when</en> <en id="wh97125">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97126">your God</en> <en id="wh97124">brings</en> <en id="wh97127">you into</en> <en id="wh97128">the</en> <en id="wh97129">land</en>

<en id="wh97131">He swore</en> <en id="wh97132">to</en> <en id="wh97133">your fathers</en>, <en id="wh97134">to</en> <en id="wh97135">Abraham</en>, <en id="wh97137">Isaac</en>, <en id="wh97139">and</en> <en id="wh97140">Jacob</en>,
<en id="wh97142">that He would give</en> <en id="wh97143">you</en>—
<en id="wh97145">a land with great</en> <en id="wh97146">and</en> <en id="wh97147">splendid</en> <en id="wh97144">cities</en>
<en id="wh97148">that</en> <en id="wh97149">you did not</en> <en id="wh97150">build</en>,
<en id="wh97152">with houses</en>
<en id="wh97153">full of</en> <en id="wh97154">every</en> <en id="wh97155">good</en>
<en id="wh97156">thing with which</en> <en id="wh97157">you did not</en> <en id="wh97158">fill them</en>,
<en id="wh97160">with wells</en>
<en id="wh97162">that</en> <en id="wh97163">you did not</en> <en id="wh97164">dig</en>,
<en id="wh97166">and</en> <en id="wh97165">with vineyards</en> <en id="wh97167">and olive groves</en>
<en id="wh97168">that</en> <en id="wh97169">you did not</en> <en id="wh97170">plant</en>—
<en id="wh97171">and</en> <en id="wh97172">when you eat</en>
<en id="wh97173">and</en> <en id="wh97174">are satisfied</en>,
<en id="wh97175">be careful</en> ... <en id="wh97176">to</en>
<en id="wh97177">not</en> ... <en id="wh97178">forget</en> <en id="wh97180">the LORD</en>

<en id="wh97181">who</en> <en id="wh97182">brought you out</en> <en id="wh97184">of the land</en> <en id="wh97185">of Egypt</en>, <en id="wh97187">out of the house</en> <en id="wh97188">of slavery</en>.
<en id="wh97192">Fear</en> <en id="wh97190">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97191">your God</en>,
<en id="wh97195">serve Him only</en>,
<en id="wh97196">and</en> <en id="wh97199">take your oaths</en> <en id="wh97197">in</en> <en id="wh97198">His name</en>.

<en id="wh97200">Do not</en> <en id="wh97201">follow</en> <en id="wh97204">other</en> <en id="wh97203">gods</en>, <en id="wh97207">the</en> <en id="wh97206">gods</en> <en id="wh97208">of the peoples</en>
<en id="wh97210">around you</en>.
<en id="wh97211">For</en> <en id="wh97214">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97215">your God</en>, <en id="wh97217">who is among you</en>, <en id="wh97213">is a jealous</en> <en id="wh97212">God</en>.
<en id="wh97218">Otherwise</en> <en id="wh97220">the anger</en> <en id="wh97221">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh97222">your God</en> <en id="wh97219">will be kindled</en>
<en id="wh97224">against you</en>, <en id="wh97225">and He will wipe you</en> <en id="wh97227">off</en> <en id="wh97229">the</en> <en id="wh97228">face</en> <en id="wh97230">of the earth</en>.
<en id="wh97231">Do not</en> <en id="wh97232">test</en> <en id="wh97234">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97235">your God</en>
<en id="wh97236">as</en> <en id="wh97238">you tested Him</en> <en id="wh97239">at</en> <en id="wh97241">Massah</en>.

<en id="wh97242">You are to diligently keep</en> <en id="wh97245">the commandments</en> <en id="wh97246">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh97247">your God</en> <en id="wh97248">and</en> <en id="wh97249">the testimonies</en> <en id="wh97250">and</en> <en id="wh97251">statutes</en>
<en id="wh97253">He has given you</en>.

<en id="wh97255">Do</en> <en id="wh97257">what is right</en> <en id="wh97258">and</en> <en id="wh97260">good</en> <en id="wh97261">in</en> <en id="wh97259">the</en> <en id="wh97262">sight</en> <en id="wh97263">of the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh97264">so that</en> <en id="wh97265">it may be well</en> <en id="wh97266">with you</en>
<en id="wh97267">and</en> <en id="wh97268">that you may enter</en>
<en id="wh97269">and</en> <en id="wh97270">possess</en> <en id="wh97274">the</en> <en id="wh97275">good</en> <en id="wh97273">land</en>
<en id="wh97276">that</en> <en id="wh97278">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97277">your God swore</en> <en id="wh97279">to</en> <en id="wh97280">give your fathers</en>,
<en id="wh97282">driving out</en> <en id="wh97284">all</en> <en id="wh97285">your enemies</en> <en id="wh97287">before you</en>,
<en id="wh97288">as</en> <en id="wh97291">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97290">has said</en>.
<en id="wh97295">In the future</en>, <en id="wh97292">when</en> <en id="wh97294">your son</en> <en id="wh97293">asks</en>,

“<en id="wh97298">What</en> <en id="wh97300">is the meaning of the decrees</en> <en id="wh97301">and</en> <en id="wh97303">statutes</en> <en id="wh97304">and</en> <en id="wh97306">ordinances</en> ... <en id="wh97305">the</en>
<en id="wh97307">that</en> ... <en id="wh97309">LORD</en> <en id="wh97310">our God</en> <en id="wh97308">has commanded you</en>?”
<en id="wh97312">then</en> <en id="wh97313">you are to tell</en>
“<en id="wh97317">We were</en> <en id="wh97316">slaves</en> <en id="wh97319">of Pharaoh</en> <en id="wh97320">in</en> <en id="wh97321">Egypt</en>,

<en id="wh97322">him</en>, ... <en id="wh97324">but the LORD</en> <en id="wh97323">brought us out</en> <en id="wh97326">of Egypt</en> <en id="wh97327">with</en> <en id="wh97329">a mighty</en> <en id="wh97328">hand</en>.

<en id="wh97348">Before our eyes</en> <en id="wh97332">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97331">inflicted</en> <en id="wh97336">great</en> <en id="wh97337">and</en> <en id="wh97338">devastating</en> <en id="wh97333">signs</en> <en id="wh97334">and</en> <en id="wh97335">wonders</en> <en id="wh97339">on</en> <en id="wh97340">Egypt</en>, <en id="wh97341">on</en> <en id="wh97342">Pharaoh</en>, <en id="wh97343">and</en> <en id="wh97344">on</en> <en id="wh97345">all</en> <en id="wh97346">his household</en>.
<en id="wh97349">But</en> <en id="wh97351">He brought</en> ... <en id="wh97352">from</en> <en id="wh97353">there</en>
<en id="wh97354">us out</en> ... <en id="wh97355">lead us in</en>
<en id="wh97357">to</en> ... <en id="wh97358">and give</en> <en id="wh97359">us</en> <en id="wh97361">the</en> <en id="wh97362">land</en>
<en id="wh97363">that</en> <en id="wh97364">He had sworn</en> <en id="wh97365">to</en> <en id="wh97366">our fathers</en>.
<en id="wh97367">And</en> <en id="wh97369">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97368">commanded us</en>
<en id="wh97370">to</en> <en id="wh97371">observe</en> <en id="wh97373">all</en> <en id="wh97377">these</en> <en id="wh97375">statutes</en>
<en id="wh97378">and</en> <en id="wh97379">to fear</en> <en id="wh97381">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97382">our God</en>,
<en id="wh97384">that we may always be prosperous</en>
<en id="wh97389">and</en> <en id="wh97390">preserved</en>,
<en id="wh97391">as</en> <en id="wh97393">we are</en> <en id="wh97395">to</en> <en id="wh97393">this day</en>.
<en id="wh97396">then</en> ... <en id="wh97398">will be</en> <en id="wh97399">our</en> <en id="wh97397">righteousness</en>.”
<en id="wh97401">if we are careful</en> ... <en id="wh97400">that</en>

<en id="wh97402">And</en> ... <en id="wh97403">to observe</en> <en id="wh97405">every</en> <en id="wh97409">one of these</en> <en id="wh97407">commandments</en> <en id="wh97411">before</en> <en id="wh97408">the</en> <en id="wh97412">LORD</en> <en id="wh97413">our God</en>,
<en id="wh97414">as</en> <en id="wh97416">He has commanded us</en>,

<en id="wh97417">When</en> <en id="wh97419">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97420">your God</en> <en id="wh97418">brings</en> <en id="wh97421">you into</en> <en id="wh97422">the</en> <en id="wh97423">land</en>
<en id="wh97424">that</en> <en id="wh97425">you</en> <en id="wh97426">are entering</en>
<en id="wh97428">to</en> <en id="wh97429">possess</en>,

<en id="wh97430">and</en> <en id="wh97431">He drives out</en> <en id="wh97434">before</en> <en id="wh97435">you</en> <en id="wh97433">many</en> <en id="wh97432">nations</en>— <en id="wh97436">the</en> <en id="wh97437">Hittites</en>, <en id="wh97440">Girgashites</en>, <en id="wh97443">Amorites</en>, <en id="wh97446">Canaanites</en>, <en id="wh97449">Perizzites</en>, <en id="wh97452">Hivites</en>, <en id="wh97453">and</en> <en id="wh97455">Jebusites</en>, <en id="wh97456">seven</en> <en id="wh97457">nations</en>
<en id="wh97458">larger</en> <en id="wh97459">and</en> <en id="wh97460">stronger</en> <en id="wh97461">than you</en>—
<en id="wh97462">and</en> <en id="wh97464">when the LORD</en> <en id="wh97465">your God</en> <en id="wh97463">has delivered them over</en> <en id="wh97466">to</en> <en id="wh97467">you</en>
<en id="wh97469">to defeat them</en>, <en id="wh97468">then</en>
<en id="wh97470">you must devote them to complete destruction</en>.
<en id="wh97474">Make</en> <en id="wh97473">no</en> <en id="wh97476">treaty</en> <en id="wh97475">with them</en>
<en id="wh97477">and</en> <en id="wh97478">show them no</en> <en id="wh97479">mercy</en>.
<en id="wh97481">Do not</en> <en id="wh97482">intermarry</en> <en id="wh97483">with them</en>.
<en id="wh97485">Do not</en> <en id="wh97486">give</en> <en id="wh97484">your daughters</en> <en id="wh97487">to</en> <en id="wh97488">their sons</en>
<en id="wh97491">or</en> <en id="wh97492">take</en> <en id="wh97490">their daughters</en> <en id="wh97494">for your sons</en>,
<en id="wh97495">because</en> <en id="wh97498">they will turn your sons</en> <en id="wh97496">away</en> <en id="wh97499">from</en> <en id="wh97500">following Me</en>
<en id="wh97502">to serve</en> <en id="wh97504">other</en> <en id="wh97503">gods</en>.
<en id="wh97505">Then</en> <en id="wh97507">the anger</en> <en id="wh97508">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh97506">will burn</en>
<en id="wh97510">against you</en>, <en id="wh97512">and He will swiftly</en> <en id="wh97511">destroy you</en>.
<en id="wh97513">Instead</en>, <en id="wh97515">this is what</en> <en id="wh97516">you are to do to them</en>:
<en id="wh97519">tear down</en> <en id="wh97518">their altars</en>,
<en id="wh97522">smash</en> <en id="wh97521">their sacred pillars</en>,
<en id="wh97525">cut down</en> <en id="wh97524">their Asherah poles</en>,
<en id="wh97526">and</en> <en id="wh97528">burn</en> <en id="wh97527">their idols</en> <en id="wh97529">in</en> <en id="wh97530">the</en> <en id="wh97531">fire</en>.

<en id="wh97532">For</en> <en id="wh97535">you</en> <en id="wh97533">are a people</en> <en id="wh97534">holy</en> <en id="wh97536">to</en> <en id="wh97537">the LORD</en> <en id="wh97538">your God</en>.
<en id="wh97541">The LORD</en> <en id="wh97542">your God</en> <en id="wh97540">has chosen</en> <en id="wh97539">you</en>
<en id="wh97543">to</en> <en id="wh97544">be</en> <en id="wh97547">a people</en> for His <en id="wh97548">prized possession</en>
<en id="wh97550">out of all</en> <en id="wh97552">peoples</en> ... <en id="wh97551">the</en>
<en id="wh97554">on</en> ... <en id="wh97555">face</en> <en id="wh97557">of the earth</en>.
<en id="wh97558">did not</en>
<en id="wh97563">The</en> ... <en id="wh97560">because you were more numerous</en> <en id="wh97562">than the other</en> <en id="wh97564">peoples</en>,
<en id="wh97566">LORD</en> ... <en id="wh97565">set His affection</en> ... <en id="wh97567">you</en>
<en id="wh97570">on you</en> <en id="wh97568">and</en> <en id="wh97569">choose</en>
<en id="wh97571">for</en> <en id="wh97572">you</en> <en id="wh97574">were the fewest</en> <en id="wh97576">of all</en> <en id="wh97578">peoples</en>.
<en id="wh97579">But</en>
<en id="wh97582">because the LORD</en> <en id="wh97581">loved</en>
<en id="wh97584">and</en> <en id="wh97586">kept</en> <en id="wh97588">the</en> <en id="wh97589">oath</en>
<en id="wh97592">you</en> ... <en id="wh97591">He swore</en> <en id="wh97593">to your fathers</en>,
<en id="wh97594">brought you out</en> <en id="wh97597">with</en> <en id="wh97599">a mighty</en> <en id="wh97598">hand</en>

<en id="wh97600">He</en> ... <en id="wh97601">and redeemed you</en> <en id="wh97602">from</en> <en id="wh97603">the house</en> <en id="wh97604">of slavery</en>, <en id="wh97605">from</en> <en id="wh97606">the hand</en> <en id="wh97607">of Pharaoh</en> <en id="wh97608">king</en> <en id="wh97609">of Egypt</en>.
<en id="wh97611">Know therefore</en>
<en id="wh97612">that</en> <en id="wh97613">the LORD</en> ... <en id="wh97614">is God</en>,
<en id="wh97617">your God</en> ... <en id="wh97620">the</en> <en id="wh97621">faithful</en> <en id="wh97619">God</en>

<en id="wh97622">who keeps</en> <en id="wh97624">His covenant</en> <en id="wh97627">of loving devotion</en> <en id="wh97635">for a thousand</en> <en id="wh97636">generations</en> <en id="wh97629">of those who love Him</en> <en id="wh97631">and</en> <en id="wh97632">keep</en> <en id="wh97633">His commandments</en>.
<en id="wh97639">But</en> <en id="wh97640">those who hate Him</en> <en id="wh97638">He repays</en> <en id="wh97641">to</en> <en id="wh97642">their faces</en>
<en id="wh97644">with destruction</en>;
<en id="wh97645">He will not</en> <en id="wh97646">hesitate</en> <en id="wh97647">to</en> ... <en id="wh97648">the one who hates Him</en>.

<en id="wh111533">Ask</en> <en id="wh111534">your father</en>,
<en id="wh111535">and</en> <en id="wh111536">he will tell you</en>,
<en id="wh111537">your elders</en>,
<en id="wh111538">and</en> <en id="wh111539">they will inform</en> <en id="wh111540">you</en>.
<en id="wh111541">When</en> <en id="wh111543">the Most High</en> <en id="wh111544">gave the nations</en> <en id="wh111542">their inheritance</en>,
<en id="wh111545">when</en> <en id="wh111546">He divided</en> <en id="wh111547">the sons</en> <en id="wh111548">of man</en>,

<en id="wh111549">He set</en> <en id="wh111550">the boundaries</en> <en id="wh111551">of the peoples</en> <en id="wh111553">according to the number</en> <en id="wh111554">of the sons</en> <en id="wh111555">of God</en>.
<en id="wh111556">But</en> <en id="wh111558">the LORD’s</en> <en id="wh111557">portion</en> <en id="wh111559">is His people</en>,

<en id="wh111599">He made him ride</en> <en id="wh111600">on</en> <en id="wh111601">the heights</en> ... <en id="wh111602">the land</en>
<en id="wh111603">of</en> ... <en id="wh111604">and fed him</en> <en id="wh111605">the produce</en> ... <en id="wh111606">the field</en>.
<en id="wh111607">of</en> ... <en id="wh111608">He nourished him</en> <en id="wh111609">with honey</en> <en id="wh111610">from</en> <en id="wh111611">the rock</en>
<en id="wh111612">and</en> <en id="wh111613">oil</en> <en id="wh111614">from</en> <en id="wh111615">the flinty</en> <en id="wh111616">crag</en>,

<en id="wh111642">But Jeshurun</en> <en id="wh111641">grew fat</en>
<en id="wh111643">and</en> <en id="wh111644">kicked</en>—
<en id="wh111645">becoming fat</en>,
<en id="wh111646">bloated</en>,
<en id="wh111647">gorged</en>.
<en id="wh111648">and</en> ... <en id="wh111649">He abandoned</en> <en id="wh111650">the God</en>
<en id="wh111651">who made him</en>
<en id="wh111652">and</en> <en id="wh111653">scorned</en> <en id="wh111654">the Rock</en> <en id="wh111655">of his salvation</en>.
<en id="wh111656">They provoked His jealousy</en> <en id="wh111657">with</en> <en id="wh111658">foreign gods</en>;
<en id="wh111661">they enraged Him</en> <en id="wh111659">with</en> <en id="wh111660">abominations</en>.
<en id="wh111662">They sacrificed</en> <en id="wh111663">to</en> <en id="wh111665">demons</en>,
<en id="wh111666">not</en> <en id="wh111667">to God</en>,
<en id="wh111668">to gods</en>
<en id="wh111669">they had not</en> <en id="wh111670">known</en>,
<en id="wh111671">to newly arrived gods</en>,
<en id="wh111677">which your fathers</en> <en id="wh111675">did not</en> <en id="wh111676">fear</en>.
<en id="wh111678">the Rock</en>
<en id="wh111679">who brought you forth</en>;
<en id="wh111680">You ignored</en>
<en id="wh111682">you forgot</en> <en id="wh111683">the God</en>
<en id="wh111684">who gave you birth</en>.
<en id="wh111687">When the LORD</en> <en id="wh111686">saw this</en>,
<en id="wh111689">He rejected them</en>, <en id="wh111691">provoked to anger</en> <en id="wh111692">by His sons</en> <en id="wh111693">and</en> <en id="wh111694">daughters</en>.
<en id="wh111696">He said</en>:
“<en id="wh111697">I will hide</en> <en id="wh111698">My face from them</en>;
<en id="wh111700">I will see</en>

<en id="wh111703">For</en> <en id="wh111706">they</en> <en id="wh111705">are a perverse</en> <en id="wh111704">generation</en>—
<en id="wh111707">children</en>
<en id="wh111709">of unfaithfulness</en>.
<en id="wh111711">They</en> <en id="wh111712">have provoked My jealousy</en> <en id="wh111713">by</en> <en id="wh111714">that which is not</en> <en id="wh111715">God</en>;
<en id="wh111716">they have enraged Me</en> <en id="wh111717">with</en> <en id="wh111718">their worthless idols</en>.
<en id="wh111720">So I</en> <en id="wh111721">will make them jealous</en> <en id="wh111722">by</en> <en id="wh111723">those who are not</en> <en id="wh111724">a people</en>;
<en id="wh111728">I will make them angry</en> <en id="wh111725">by</en> <en id="wh111726">a nation</en> <en id="wh111727">without understanding</en>.
<en id="wh111729">For</en> <en id="wh111730">a fire</en> <en id="wh111731">has been kindled</en> <en id="wh111732">by</en> <en id="wh111733">My anger</en>,
<en id="wh111735">and it burns</en> <en id="wh111734">to</en> <en id="wh111738">the depths</en> ... <en id="wh111737">Sheol</en>;
<en id="wh111739">of</en> ... <en id="wh111740">it consumes</en> <en id="wh111741">the earth</en> <en id="wh111742">and</en> <en id="wh111743">its produce</en>,

<en id="wh111765">I will send</en> <en id="wh111763">the fangs</en> <en id="wh111764">of wild beasts</en> <en id="wh111766">against them</en>, <en id="wh111767">with</en> <en id="wh111768">the venom</en> <en id="wh111769">of vipers that slither</en> <en id="wh111770">in the dust</en>.

<en id="wh111787">I would have said that</en>

<en id="wh111789">and blot out</en> <en id="wh111792">their memory</en> <en id="wh111790">from</en> <en id="wh111791">mankind</en>,
<en id="wh111793">if I had not</en> <en id="wh111796">dreaded</en> <en id="wh111794">the taunt</en> <en id="wh111795">of the enemy</en>,
<en id="wh111797">lest</en> <en id="wh111799">their adversaries</en> <en id="wh111798">misunderstand</en>
<en id="wh111801">and say</en>:

<en id="wh111814">Israel</en> <en id="wh111811">is a nation</en> <en id="wh111812">devoid</en> <en id="wh111813">of counsel</en>,

<en id="wh111821">they would understand</en> <en id="wh111822">it</en>;
<en id="wh111823">they would comprehend</en> <en id="wh111825">their fate</en>.
<en id="wh111826">How</en> <en id="wh111828">could one man</en> <en id="wh111827">pursue</en> <en id="wh111829">a thousand</en>,
<en id="wh111830">or</en> <en id="wh111831">two</en> <en id="wh111833">put ten thousand</en> <en id="wh111832">to flight</en>,
<en id="wh111834">unless</en>

<en id="wh111842">For</en> <en id="wh111845">their rock</en> <en id="wh111843">is not</en> <en id="wh111844">like</en> <en id="wh111846">our Rock</en>,

<en id="wh111850">But</en> <en id="wh111854">their vine is</en> <en id="wh111851">from</en> <en id="wh111852">the vine</en> <en id="wh111853">of Sodom</en>

<en id="wh111859">Their grapes</en> <en id="wh111861">are poisonous</en>;

<en id="wh111871">the deadly</en> <en id="wh111869">poison</en> <en id="wh111870">of cobras</en>.

<en id="wh111881">Vengeance</en> <en id="wh111880">is Mine</en>; <en id="wh111883">I will repay</en>. <en id="wh111885">In due time</en>

<en id="wh111894">their doom</en>

<en id="wh111906">that</en> <en id="wh111908">their strength</en> <en id="wh111907">is gone</en>

<en id="wh111915">He will say</en>:

<en id="wh112124">said</en>

<en id="wh112218">that</en> <en id="wh112219">I</en> <en id="wh112220">am giving</en> <en id="wh112222">the Israelites</en>,

<en id="wh112251">He shone forth</en> <en id="wh112252">from</en> <en id="wh112253">Mount</en> <en id="wh112254">Paran</en>

<en id="wh112263">with flaming fire</en> <en id="wh112261">at His right hand</en>.
<en id="wh112265">Surely</en> <en id="wh112266">You love</en> <en id="wh112267">the people</en>;
<en id="wh112268">all</en> <en id="wh112269">the holy ones are</en> <en id="wh112270">in</en> <en id="wh112271">Your hand</en>,
<en id="wh112272">and</en> <en id="wh112273">they</en> <en id="wh112274">sit down</en> <en id="wh112276">at Your feet</en>;
<en id="wh112277">each receives</en> <en id="wh112279">Your words</en> —
<en id="wh112280">the law</en> <en id="wh112283">that Moses</en> <en id="wh112281">gave</en> <en id="wh112282">us</en>,
<en id="wh112284">the possession</en> <en id="wh112285">of the assembly</en> <en id="wh112286">of Jacob</en>.
<en id="wh112288">So the LORD became</en> <en id="wh112291">King</en> <en id="wh112289">in</en> <en id="wh112290">Jeshurun</en>

<en id="wh112292">when</en> <en id="wh112294">the leaders</en> <en id="wh112295">of the people</en> <en id="wh112293">gathered</en>, <en id="wh112297">when the tribes</en> <en id="wh112298">of Israel</en> <en id="wh112296">came together</en>.
<en id="wh112300">Let Reuben</en> <en id="wh112299">live</en>
<en id="wh112301">and</en> <en id="wh112302">not</en> <en id="wh112303">die</en>,
<en id="wh112305">nor</en> <en id="wh112306">his men</en> <en id="wh112307">be few</en>.”
<en id="wh112308">And</en> <en id="wh112311">concerning Judah</en>
<en id="wh112313">he said</en>:
<en id="wh112314">hear</en>
“<en id="wh112315">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh112316">the cry</en> <en id="wh112317">of Judah</en>
<en id="wh112318">and</en> <en id="wh112321">bring him</en> <en id="wh112319">to</en> <en id="wh112320">his people</en>.
<en id="wh112322">With his own hands</en> <en id="wh112323">he defends his cause</en>,
<en id="wh112325">but</en> <en id="wh112329">may You be</en> <en id="wh112326">a help</en> <en id="wh112328">against his foes</en>.”
<en id="wh112332">Concerning Levi</en> <en id="wh112333">he said</en>:
“<en id="wh112334">Give Your Thummim to Levi</en> <en id="wh112335">and</en> <en id="wh112336">Your Urim</en> <en id="wh112337">to</en> <en id="wh112339">Your godly</en> <en id="wh112338">one</en>,
<en id="wh112340">whom</en> <en id="wh112341">You tested</en> <en id="wh112342">at</en> <en id="wh112343">Massah</en>
<en id="wh112344">and contested</en> <en id="wh112345">at</en> <en id="wh112346">the waters</en> <en id="wh112347">of Meribah</en>.
<en id="wh112349">He said</en> <en id="wh112351">of his father</en> <en id="wh112353">and</en> <en id="wh112354">mother</en>,
‘<en id="wh112355">I do not</en> <en id="wh112356">consider them</en>.’
<en id="wh112360">He disregarded</en> <en id="wh112359">his brothers</en>
<en id="wh112362">and</en> <en id="wh112365">did not</en> <en id="wh112366">know</en> <en id="wh112364">his own sons</en>,
<en id="wh112367">for</en> <en id="wh112368">he kept</en> <en id="wh112369">Your word</en>
<en id="wh112370">and</en> <en id="wh112372">maintained</en> <en id="wh112371">Your covenant</en>.
<en id="wh112373">He will teach</en> <en id="wh112374">Your ordinances</en> <en id="wh112375">to</en> <en id="wh112376">Jacob</en>
<en id="wh112377">and</en> <en id="wh112378">Your law</en> <en id="wh112379">to</en> <en id="wh112380">Israel</en>;
<en id="wh112381">he will set</en> <en id="wh112382">incense</en> <en id="wh112384">before You</en>
<en id="wh112385">and</en> <en id="wh112386">whole burnt offerings</en> <en id="wh112387">on</en> <en id="wh112388">Your altar</en>.
<en id="wh112389">Bless</en>
<en id="wh112390">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh112391">his substance</en>,
<en id="wh112392">and</en> <en id="wh112395">accept</en> <en id="wh112393">the work</en> <en id="wh112394">of his hands</en>.
<en id="wh112396">Smash</en> <en id="wh112397">the loins</en> <en id="wh112398">of those who rise against him</en>, <en id="wh112399">and</en> <en id="wh112400">of his foes</en>
<en id="wh112401">so they can</en> <en id="wh112402">rise no more</en>.”
<en id="wh112404">Concerning Benjamin</en> <en id="wh112405">he said</en>:
“<en id="wh112406">May the beloved</en> <en id="wh112407">of the LORD</en>
<en id="wh112408">rest</en> <en id="wh112410">secure</en> <en id="wh112411">in Him</en>; ... <en id="wh112409">him</en>
<en id="wh112412">God shields</en> ... <en id="wh112414">all</en> <en id="wh112416">day long</en>,

<en id="wh112423">Concerning Joseph</en> <en id="wh112424">he said</en>:

“<en id="wh112427">May his land</en> <en id="wh112425">be blessed</en> <en id="wh112426">by the LORD</en> with the precious <en id="wh112432">dew</en> <en id="wh112428">from</en> <en id="wh112430">heaven above</en> <en id="wh112429">and the deep waters</en>
<en id="wh112436">that lie</en> <en id="wh112437">beneath</en>,
<en id="wh112440">with the bountiful</en> <en id="wh112441">harvest</en> <en id="wh112439">from</en> <en id="wh112442">the sun</en>
<en id="wh112443">and</en> <en id="wh112445">the abundant</en> <en id="wh112446">yield</en> <en id="wh112447">of the seasons</en>,
<en id="wh112450">with the best</en> <en id="wh112452">of the ancient</en> <en id="wh112451">mountains</en>
<en id="wh112453">and</en> <en id="wh112455">the bounty</en> <en id="wh112457">of the everlasting</en> <en id="wh112456">hills</en>,
<en id="wh112460">with the choice gifts</en> <en id="wh112461">of the land</en> <en id="wh112462">and</en> <en id="wh112463">everything in it</en>,

<en id="wh112468">May these rest</en> <en id="wh112470">on the head</en> <en id="wh112471">of Joseph</en> <en id="wh112473">and</en> <en id="wh112474">crown the brow</en> <en id="wh112475">of the prince</en> <en id="wh112476">of his brothers</en>.
<en id="wh112477">a firstborn</en> <en id="wh112478">bull</en>,
<en id="wh112480">His</en> <en id="wh112479">majesty is like</en>
<en id="wh112481">and</en> <en id="wh112482">his horns</en> <en id="wh112484">are like those</en> <en id="wh112483">of a wild ox</en>.
<en id="wh112485">With</en> <en id="wh112487">them he will gore</en> <en id="wh112486">the nations</en>, <en id="wh112489">even to the ends</en> <en id="wh112490">of the earth</en>.
<en id="wh112492">Such</en> <en id="wh112493">are the myriads</en> <en id="wh112494">of Ephraim</en>,
<en id="wh112495">and</en> <en id="wh112496">such</en> <en id="wh112497">are the thousands</en> <en id="wh112498">of Manasseh</en>.”
<en id="wh112501">Concerning Zebulun</en> <en id="wh112502">he said</en>:
“<en id="wh112503">Rejoice</en>,
<en id="wh112504">Zebulun</en>,
<en id="wh112505">in</en> <en id="wh112506">your journeys</en>,
<en id="wh112507">and</en>
<en id="wh112508">Issachar</en>,
<en id="wh112509">in</en> <en id="wh112510">your tents</en>.
<en id="wh112513">They will call</en> <en id="wh112511">the peoples</en> <en id="wh112512">to a mountain</en>;
<en id="wh112514">there</en> <en id="wh112515">they will offer</en> <en id="wh112516">sacrifices</en> <en id="wh112517">of righteousness</en>.
<en id="wh112518">For</en> <en id="wh112521">they will feast on</en> <en id="wh112519">the abundance</en> <en id="wh112520">of the seas</en>
<en id="wh112522">and</en> <en id="wh112523">the hidden</en> <en id="wh112524">treasures</en> <en id="wh112525">of the sand</en>.”
<en id="wh112528">Concerning Gad</en> <en id="wh112529">he said</en>:
“<en id="wh112530">Blessed is</en> <en id="wh112531">he who enlarges</en> <en id="wh112532">the domain of Gad</en>!
<en id="wh112535">He lies down</en> <en id="wh112533">like</en> <en id="wh112534">a lion</en>
<en id="wh112536">and</en> <en id="wh112537">tears off</en> <en id="wh112538">an arm</en>
<en id="wh112539">or</en> <en id="wh112540">a head</en>.

<en id="wh112545">because</en> <en id="wh112548">a ruler’s</en> <en id="wh112547">portion</en> <en id="wh112549">was reserved for him</en> <en id="wh112546">there</en>.
<en id="wh112551">He came</en> <en id="wh112552">with the leaders</en> <en id="wh112550">of</en> <en id="wh112553">the people</en>;

<en id="wh112563">Concerning Dan</en> <en id="wh112564">he said</en>:

<en id="wh112574">Concerning Naphtali</en> <en id="wh112575">he said</en>:

<en id="wh112588">And</en> <en id="wh112589">concerning Asher</en> <en id="wh112590">he said</en>:

<en id="wh112616">of Jeshurun</en>,

<en id="wh112661">a people</en>
<en id="wh112662">saved</en> <en id="wh112663">by</en> <en id="wh112664">the LORD</en>? <en id="wh112665">He is the shield</en> <en id="wh112666">that protects you</en>,

<en id="wh112673">Your enemies</en> <en id="wh112672">will cower before you</en>,

<en id="wh112682">Then Moses</en> <en id="wh112681">went up</en> <en id="wh112683">from</en> <en id="wh112684">the plains</en> <en id="wh112685">of Moab</en> <en id="wh112686">to</en> <en id="wh112687">Mount</en> <en id="wh112688">Nebo</en>, <en id="wh112689">to the top</en> <en id="wh112691">of Pisgah</en>,

<en id="wh112743">And</en> <en id="wh112745">the LORD</en> <en id="wh112744">said</en> <en id="wh112746">to him</en>,

<en id="wh112760">when I said</en>,

<en id="wh112767">but</en> <en id="wh112769">you will not</en> <en id="wh112770">cross into it</en>.”

<en id="wh112774">So Moses</en> <en id="wh112775">the servant</en> <en id="wh112776">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh112772">died</en> <en id="wh112773">there</en> <en id="wh112777">in</en> <en id="wh112778">the land</en> <en id="wh112779">of Moab</en>, <en id="wh112771">as</en> <en id="wh112782">the LORD</en> <en id="wh112781">had said</en>.

<en id="wh112784">And He buried</en> <en id="wh112783">him</en> <en id="wh112786">in</en> <en id="wh112788">a valley</en> <en id="wh112789">in</en> <en id="wh112787">the</en> <en id="wh112790">land</en> <en id="wh112791">of Moab</en> <en id="wh112792">facing</en> <en id="wh112793">Beth-peor</en>,

<en id="wh112794">and</en> <en id="wh112795">no</en> <en id="wh112797">one</en> <en id="wh112800">to</en> <en id="wh112804">this</en> <en id="wh112802">day</en> <en id="wh112796">knows</en> <en id="wh112801">the</en> <en id="wh112799">location of his grave</en>.

<en id="wh112806">Moses was</en> <en id="wh112808">a hundred</en> <en id="wh112809">and</en> <en id="wh112810">twenty</en> <en id="wh112811">years old</en> <en id="wh112812">when</en> <en id="wh112813">he died</en>,
<en id="wh112816">yet his eyes</en> <en id="wh112814">were not</en> <en id="wh112815">weak</en>,
<en id="wh112817">and</en> <en id="wh112820">his vitality</en> <en id="wh112818">had not</en> <en id="wh112819">diminished</en>.

<en id="wh112823">The Israelites</en> <en id="wh112822">grieved</en> <en id="wh112826">for Moses</en> <en id="wh112827">in</en> <en id="wh112828">the plains</en> <en id="wh112829">of Moab</en> <en id="wh112830">thirty</en> <en id="wh112831">days</en>,

<en id="wh112834">until the time</en> <en id="wh112832">of</en> <en id="wh112835">weeping</en> <en id="wh112836">and mourning</en> <en id="wh112837">for Moses</en> <en id="wh112833">came to an end</en>.

<en id="wh125571">The Israelites</en> <en id="wh125570">sent</en> <en id="wh125590">Phinehas</en> <en id="wh125574">son of</en> <en id="wh125592">Eleazar</en> <en id="wh125593">the</en> <en id="wh125594">priest</en> <en id="wh125581">to</en> <en id="wh125587">the</en> <en id="wh125586">land</en> <en id="wh125588">of Gilead</en>, <en id="wh125585">to</en> <en id="wh125578">the Reubenites</en>, <en id="wh125579">the Gadites</en>, <en id="wh125580">and</en> <en id="wh125582">the half-tribe</en> <en id="wh125584">of Manasseh</en>.
<en id="wh125598">With him</en> <en id="wh125596">they sent ten</en> <en id="wh125597">chiefs</en>
— <en id="wh125600">one</en> <en id="wh125604">family</en> <en id="wh125599">leader</en> <en id="wh125607">from each</en> <en id="wh125608">tribe</en> <en id="wh125609">of Israel</en>,

‘<en id="wh125647">What</en> <en id="wh125651">is this</en> ... <en id="wh125649">you have committed</en>

<en id="wh125689">to</en> ... <en id="wh125690">It even brought</en> <en id="wh125692">a plague</en> <en id="wh125694">upon the congregation</en> <en id="wh125695">of the LORD</en>.

<en id="wh125696">And</en> <en id="wh125700">now</en>, <en id="wh125697">would you</en> <en id="wh125698">turn away</en> <en id="wh125701">from</en> <en id="wh125699">the</en> <en id="wh125703">LORD</en>?

<en id="wh125787">Then</en> <en id="wh125785">the Reubenites</en>, <en id="wh125788">the Gadites</en>, <en id="wh125790">and</en> <en id="wh125793">the</en> <en id="wh125791">half-tribe</en> ... <en id="wh125794">Manasseh</en> <en id="wh125784">answered</en>

“<en id="wh125803">The LORD</en>, <en id="wh125804">the Mighty One</en>, <en id="wh125805">is God</en>! <en id="wh125806">The LORD</en>, <en id="wh125801">the Mighty One</en>, <en id="wh125802">is God</en>!

<en id="wh125822">do not</en> <en id="wh125823">spare us</en> <en id="wh125825">today</en>.

<en id="wh125855">But</en> <en id="wh125856">in fact</en> <en id="wh125862">we have done</en> <en id="wh125864">this</en> <en id="wh125859">for fear</en>

‘<en id="wh125874">What</en> <en id="wh125875">have you to do</en> <en id="wh125878">with the LORD</en>, <en id="wh125879">the God</en> <en id="wh125880">of Israel</en>?
<en id="wh125884">For the LORD</en> <en id="wh125883">has made</en> ... <en id="wh125882">a border</en> <en id="wh125885">between us</en> <en id="wh125886">and</en> <en id="wh125887">you</en>
<en id="wh125889">Reubenites</en> <en id="wh125890">and</en> <en id="wh125892">Gadites</en>.
<en id="wh125894">the</en> <en id="wh125895">Jordan</en>
<en id="wh125896">You have no</en> <en id="wh125898">share</en> <en id="wh125899">in</en> <en id="wh125900">the LORD</en>!’
<en id="wh125901">So</en> <en id="wh125903">your descendants could cause</en> <en id="wh125905">ours</en> <en id="wh125902">to stop</en>

<en id="wh125912">That is why we said</en>,
‘<en id="wh125913">Let us take action</en>
<en id="wh125916">and</en> <en id="wh125917">build</en> <en id="wh125920">an altar for ourselves</en>,

<en id="wh125928">Rather</en>, <en id="wh125930">let it be</en> <en id="wh125929">a witness</en> <en id="wh125931">between us</en> <en id="wh125932">and</en> <en id="wh125933">you</en> <en id="wh125934">and</en> <en id="wh125936">the generations</en> ... <en id="wh125937">come</en>,

<en id="wh125953">Then</en> <en id="wh125957">in the future</en>, <en id="wh125956">your descendants</en> <en id="wh125954">cannot</en> <en id="wh125955">say</en> <en id="wh125958">to</en> <en id="wh125959">ours</en>,
‘<en id="wh125960">You have no</en> <en id="wh125962">share</en> <en id="wh125963">in</en> <en id="wh125964">the LORD</en>!’
<en id="wh125966">Therefore we said</en>,
‘<en id="wh125969">If they ever</en> <en id="wh125970">say this</en> <en id="wh125973">to</en> <en id="wh125971">us</en> <en id="wh125972">or</en> <en id="wh125974">to our descendants</en>,
<en id="wh125977">we will answer</en>:

<en id="wh125999">Far be it</en> <en id="wh126001">from us</en>

<en id="wh126036">When Phinehas</en> <en id="wh126037">the</en> <en id="wh126038">priest</en> <en id="wh126039">and</en> <en id="wh126040">the chiefs</en> <en id="wh126042">of the congregation</en> — <en id="wh126041">the</en> <en id="wh126044">heads</en> <en id="wh126046">of Israel’s</en> <en id="wh126045">clans</en> ... — <en id="wh126035">heard</en>
<en id="wh126047">who</en> <en id="wh126048">were with him</en>
<en id="wh126050">the</en>

<en id="wh126110">Then Phinehas</en> <en id="wh126111">son</en> <en id="wh126108">of</en> <en id="wh126112">Eleazar</en> <en id="wh126113">the</en> <en id="wh126114">priest</en>, <en id="wh126119">together with the other</en> <en id="wh126117">leaders</en>, <en id="wh126109">returned</en> <en id="wh126131">to</en> <en id="wh126135">the Israelites</en> <en id="wh126134">in</en> <en id="wh126129">the</en> <en id="wh126128">land</en> <en id="wh126133">of Canaan</en> ... <en id="wh126116">the</en> <en id="wh126120">Reubenites</en> <en id="wh126122">and</en> <en id="wh126125">Gadites</en> <en id="wh126132">in the land</en> <en id="wh126130">of Gilead</en>.

<en id="wh126143">The</en> <en id="wh126147">Israelites</en> <en id="wh126142">were satisfied</en> <en id="wh126145">with</en> <en id="wh126144">the report</en>,

<en id="wh126268">I have allotted</en> <en id="wh126278">as an inheritance</en> <en id="wh126279">to</en> <en id="wh126280">your tribes</en> <en id="wh126276">these</en> <en id="wh126274">remaining</en> <en id="wh126272">nations</en>, ... <en id="wh126281">from</en> <en id="wh126282">the</en> <en id="wh126283">Jordan</en>

<en id="wh126302">will push them</en> <en id="wh126304">out of your way</en>

<en id="wh126315">as</en> <en id="wh126318">the LORD</en> <en id="wh126319">your God</en> <en id="wh126317">promised</en> <en id="wh126320">you</en>.

<en id="wh126324">so</en> <en id="wh126325">that you can keep</en>
<en id="wh126327">and</en> <en id="wh126328">obey</en> <en id="wh126330">all</en>

<en id="wh133286">But</en> <en id="wh133287">if</en> <en id="wh133288">not</en>,

<en id="wh133318">Then Jotham</en> <en id="wh133317">ran away</en>,
<en id="wh133320">escaping</en>

<en id="wh133324">and</en> <en id="wh133325">he lived</en> <en id="wh133326">there</en> <en id="wh133328">for fear</en> <en id="wh133330">of his brother</en> <en id="wh133329">Abimelech</en>.

<en id="wh133409">Meanwhile, Gaal</en> <en id="wh133410">son</en> <en id="wh133407">of</en> <en id="wh133411">Ebed</en> <en id="wh133408">came</en> <en id="wh133413">with his brothers</en>

<en id="wh133850">On hearing of this</en>, <en id="wh133851">all</en> <en id="wh133852">the leaders</en> <en id="wh133849">in</en> <en id="wh133853">the tower</en> ... <en id="wh133854">Shechem</en>
<en id="wh133855">of</en> ... <en id="wh133856">entered</en> <en id="wh133858">the inner chamber</en> <en id="wh133859">of the temple</en> <en id="wh133860">of El-berith</en>.

<en id="wh157478">She arose</en>,
<en id="wh157480">bowed</en>
<en id="wh157481">facedown</en>,
<en id="wh157483">and</en> <en id="wh157484">said</en>,
“<en id="wh157485">Here is</en> ... <en id="wh157488">ready to serve</en> ... <en id="wh157487">to</en>
<en id="wh157492">your servant</en>, ... <en id="wh157489">and</en> ... <en id="wh157490">wash</en> <en id="wh157491">the feet</en> <en id="wh157493">of my lord’s</en> servants.”
<en id="wh157495">hurried</en>
<en id="wh157498">So Abigail</en>
<en id="wh157499">and</en> <en id="wh157500">got on</en> <en id="wh157503">a donkey</en>,
<en id="wh157504">and</en> ... <en id="wh157505">by five</en> <en id="wh157506">of her maidens</en>,
<en id="wh157508">attended</en>
<en id="wh157512">she followed</en> <en id="wh157515">David’s</en> <en id="wh157514">messengers</en>
<en id="wh157516">and</en> <en id="wh157517">became</en> <en id="wh157518">his</en> <en id="wh157520">wife</en>.
<en id="wh157525">David</en> <en id="wh157522">had also</en> <en id="wh157524">married</en> <en id="wh157523">Ahinoam</en> ... <en id="wh157527">Jezreel</en>.
<en id="wh157528">of</en> ... <en id="wh157533">So</en> <en id="wh157531">she and Abigail were both</en> <en id="wh157532">his</en> <en id="wh157534">wives</en>.

<en id="wh157535">But</en> <en id="wh157536">Saul</en> <en id="wh157537">had given</en> <en id="wh157540">his daughter</en> <en id="wh157539">Michal</en>, <en id="wh157542">David’s</en> <en id="wh157541">wife</en>, <en id="wh157543">to</en> <en id="wh157544">Palti</en> <en id="wh157545">son</en> <en id="wh157546">of Laish</en>,
<en id="wh157547">who was</en> <en id="wh157548">from</en> <en id="wh157549">Gallim</en>.
<en id="wh157553">Then the Ziphites</en> <en id="wh157551">came</en> <en id="wh157554">to</en> <en id="wh157555">Saul</en> <en id="wh157557">at Gibeah</en>
<en id="wh157558">and</en> <en id="wh157559">said</en>,

“<en id="wh157561">Is not</en> <en id="wh157562">David</en> <en id="wh157563">hiding</en> <en id="wh157564">on</en> <en id="wh157566">the</en> <en id="wh157565">hill</en> <en id="wh157567">of Hachilah</en>, <en id="wh157568">opposite</en> <en id="wh157571">Jeshimon</en>?”
<en id="wh157574">So Saul</en>,
<en id="wh157576">went down</en> <en id="wh157577">to</en> <en id="wh157578">the Wilderness</en>
<en id="wh157581">accompanied by</en> <en id="wh157582">three</en> <en id="wh157583">thousand</en> <en id="wh157585">chosen</en> <en id="wh157584">men</en> <en id="wh157586">of Israel</en>,
<en id="wh157593">of Ziph</en> <en id="wh157587">to</en> <en id="wh157588">search for</en> <en id="wh157590">David</en> <en id="wh157592">there</en>.
<en id="wh157596">Saul</en> <en id="wh157595">camped</en> ... <en id="wh157597">at</en> <en id="wh157599">the</en> <en id="wh157598">hill</en> <en id="wh157600">of Hachilah</en>
<en id="wh157602">beside</en> <en id="wh157607">the</en> <en id="wh157608">road</en> ... <en id="wh157606">opposite</en> <en id="wh157605">Jeshimon</en>,
<en id="wh157609">but</en> <en id="wh157610">David</en> <en id="wh157611">was living</en> <en id="wh157612">in</en> <en id="wh157613">the</en> <en id="wh157614">wilderness</en>.
<en id="wh157616">When he realized</en> ... <en id="wh157615">him</en>
<en id="wh157617">that</en> <en id="wh157619">Saul</en> <en id="wh157618">had followed</en> ... <en id="wh157622">there</en>,
<en id="wh157625">David</en> <en id="wh157624">sent out</en> <en id="wh157626">spies</en>
<en id="wh157627">to</en> <en id="wh157628">verify</en>
<en id="wh157629">that</en> <en id="wh157631">Saul</en> <en id="wh157630">had arrived</en>.
<en id="wh157636">Then David</en> <en id="wh157635">set out</en>
<en id="wh157637">and</en> <en id="wh157638">went</en> <en id="wh157639">to</en> <en id="wh157640">the</en> <en id="wh157641">place</en>
<en id="wh157642">where</en> <en id="wh157645">Saul</en> <en id="wh157643">had camped</en>.
<en id="wh157646">He</en> <en id="wh157647">saw</en> <en id="wh157650">the</en> <en id="wh157651">place</en>

<en id="wh157652">where</en> <en id="wh157655">Saul</en> <en id="wh157656">and</en> <en id="wh157657">Abner</en> <en id="wh157658">son</en> <en id="wh157659">of Ner</en>, <en id="wh157660">the general</en> <en id="wh157661">of his army</en>, <en id="wh157653">had lain down</en>.
<en id="wh157663">Saul</en> <en id="wh157664">was lying</en> <en id="wh157667">inside the inner circle of the camp</en>,
<en id="wh157670">with the troops</en> <en id="wh157671">camped</en> <en id="wh157672">around him</en>.
<en id="wh157673">And</en> <en id="wh157675">David</en> ... <en id="wh157674">answered</en>

<en id="wh157677">asked</en> <en id="wh157679">Ahimelech</en> <en id="wh157680">the</en> <en id="wh157681">Hittite</en> <en id="wh157682">and</en> <en id="wh157684">Abishai</en> <en id="wh157685">son</en> <en id="wh157686">of Zeruiah</en>, <en id="wh157688">Joab’s</en> <en id="wh157687">brother</en>,

“<en id="wh157691">Who</en> <en id="wh157692">will go down</en> <en id="wh157693">with me</en> <en id="wh157694">to</en> <en id="wh157695">Saul</en> <en id="wh157696">in</en> <en id="wh157697">the</en> <en id="wh157698">camp</en>?”
<en id="wh157701">Abishai</en>.
“<en id="wh157702">I will</en> <en id="wh157703">go</en> <en id="wh157704">with you</en>,”

<en id="wh157713">That night</en> <en id="wh157707">David</en> <en id="wh157708">and</en> <en id="wh157709">Abishai</en> <en id="wh157706">came</en> <en id="wh157710">to</en> <en id="wh157711">the</en> <en id="wh157712">troops</en>,
<en id="wh157714">and</en> <en id="wh157716">Saul</en> <en id="wh157717">was lying</en> <en id="wh157715">there</en>
<en id="wh157718">asleep</en>
<en id="wh157719">in</en> <en id="wh157720">the</en> <en id="wh157721">inner circle of the camp</en>,
<en id="wh157725">with</en> <en id="wh157723">his spear</en> <en id="wh157724">stuck</en> <en id="wh157727">in the ground</en> <en id="wh157728">by his head</en>.

<en id="wh157729">And</en> <en id="wh157730">Abner</en> <en id="wh157731">and</en> <en id="wh157732">the</en> <en id="wh157733">troops</en> <en id="wh157734">were lying</en> <en id="wh157735">around him</en>.
<en id="wh157738">Abishai</en> <en id="wh157737">said</en> <en id="wh157739">to</en> <en id="wh157740">David</en>,
“<en id="wh157744">Today</en> <en id="wh157742">God</en> <en id="wh157741">has delivered</en> <en id="wh157746">your enemy</en> <en id="wh157747">into</en> <en id="wh157748">your hand</en>.
<en id="wh157750">Now, therefore</en>,

<en id="wh157752">please</en> <en id="wh157755">let me thrust the spear</en> <en id="wh157751">through him</en> <en id="wh157757">into</en> <en id="wh157758">the</en> <en id="wh157759">ground</en> <en id="wh157761">with one</en> <en id="wh157760">stroke</en>.
<en id="wh157763">I will not</en> <en id="wh157764">need to strike him twice</en>!”
<en id="wh157768">But David</en> <en id="wh157767">said</en> <en id="wh157769">to</en> <en id="wh157770">Abishai</en>,
“<en id="wh157771">Do not</en> <en id="wh157772">destroy him</en>,
<en id="wh157773">for</en> <en id="wh157774">who</en> <en id="wh157775">can extend</en> <en id="wh157776">a hand</en> <en id="wh157779">against the LORD’s</en> <en id="wh157778">anointed</en>
<en id="wh157780">and</en> <en id="wh157781">be guiltless</en>?”
<en id="wh157784">David</en> <en id="wh157783">added</en>, “<en id="wh157782">As</en>
<en id="wh157786">surely as the LORD</en> <en id="wh157785">lives</en>,
<en id="wh157789">the LORD Himself</en> <en id="wh157790">will strike him down</en>;
<en id="wh157791">either</en> <en id="wh157792">his day</en> <en id="wh157793">will come</en>
<en id="wh157794">and</en> <en id="wh157795">he will die</en>,
<en id="wh157796">or</en> <en id="wh157800">he will go</en> <en id="wh157797">into</en> <en id="wh157799">battle</en>
<en id="wh157801">and</en> <en id="wh157802">perish</en>.
<en id="wh157804">But</en> <en id="wh157806">the LORD</en> <en id="wh157803">forbid</en>
<en id="wh157808">should extend</en> <en id="wh157809">my hand</en> <en id="wh157812">against the LORD’s</en> <en id="wh157811">anointed</en>.
<en id="wh157813">Instead</en>,
<en id="wh157815">take</en> <en id="wh157818">the</en> <en id="wh157819">spear</en>
<en id="wh157821">by his head</en>,
<en id="wh157822">and</en> <en id="wh157826">water</en> <en id="wh157824">jug</en>
<en id="wh157827">and</en> <en id="wh157828">let us go</en>.”

<en id="wh157832">So David</en> <en id="wh157831">took</en> <en id="wh157834">the</en> <en id="wh157835">spear</en> <en id="wh157836">and</en> <en id="wh157840">water</en> <en id="wh157838">jug</en> <en id="wh157842">by Saul’s head</en>,
<en id="wh157843">and</en> <en id="wh157844">they departed</en>.
<en id="wh157847">No</en> <en id="wh157848">one saw them</en>
<en id="wh157849">or</en> <en id="wh157851">knew about it</en>,
that <en id="wh157852">I</en> [v12] <en id="wh157853">nor did anyone</en> <en id="wh157854">wake up</en>;
<en id="wh157856">they all</en> <en id="wh157857">remained asleep</en>,
<en id="wh157858">because</en> <en id="wh157859">a deep sleep</en> <en id="wh157860">from the LORD</en> <en id="wh157861">had fallen</en> <en id="wh157862">on them</en>.
<en id="wh157865">Then David</en> <en id="wh157864">crossed</en> <en id="wh157863">to</en> <en id="wh157866">the</en> <en id="wh157867">other side</en>
<en id="wh157868">and</en> <en id="wh157869">stood</en> <en id="wh157871">atop</en> <en id="wh157872">the</en> <en id="wh157873">mountain</en> <en id="wh157875">at a distance</en>;
<en id="wh157876">there was a wide</en> <en id="wh157878">gulf</en> <en id="wh157879">between them</en>.

<en id="wh157880">And</en> <en id="wh157882">David</en> <en id="wh157881">shouted</en> <en id="wh157883">to</en> <en id="wh157884">the</en> <en id="wh157885">troops</en> <en id="wh157886">and</en> <en id="wh157887">to</en> <en id="wh157888">Abner</en> <en id="wh157889">son</en> <en id="wh157890">of Ner</en>,
“<en id="wh157894">Will you not</en> <en id="wh157895">answer me</en>,
<en id="wh157896">Abner</en>?”
<en id="wh157899">Abner</en> <en id="wh157898">replied</en>.
“<en id="wh157902">Who</en> <en id="wh157903">are you</en>
<en id="wh157904">who calls</en> <en id="wh157905">to</en> <en id="wh157906">the</en> <en id="wh157907">king</en>?”
<en id="wh157910">So David</en> <en id="wh157909">said</en> <en id="wh157911">to</en> <en id="wh157912">Abner</en>,
“<en id="wh157916">You are</en> <en id="wh157915">a man</en>, <en id="wh157914">aren’t you</en>?
<en id="wh157917">And</en> <en id="wh157918">who</en> <en id="wh157920">in</en> <en id="wh157921">Israel</en> <en id="wh157919">is your equal</en>?
<en id="wh157923">Why then</en> <en id="wh157924">did you not</en> <en id="wh157925">protect</en> <en id="wh157927">your lord</en> <en id="wh157928">the</en> <en id="wh157929">king</en>
<en id="wh157930">when</en> <en id="wh157932">one</en> <en id="wh157934">of the people</en> <en id="wh157931">came</en>
<en id="wh157935">to</en> <en id="wh157936">destroy him</en>?
<en id="wh157946">This</en> <en id="wh157944">thing</en> ... <en id="wh157941">is not</en> <en id="wh157942">good</en>.
<en id="wh157948">you have done</en>
<en id="wh157950">As surely as the LORD</en> <en id="wh157949">lives</en>,
<en id="wh157952">all of you</en> <en id="wh157953">deserve to die</en>, <en id="wh157954">since you</en> ... <en id="wh157951">that</en>
<en id="wh157956">did not</en> <en id="wh157957">protect</en> <en id="wh157959">your lord</en>, <en id="wh157962">the LORD’s</en> <en id="wh157961">anointed</en>.
<en id="wh157964">Now</en> <en id="wh157965">look around</en>.
<en id="wh157966">Where</en> <en id="wh157969">are the king’s</en> <en id="wh157967">spear</en> <en id="wh157970">and</en> <en id="wh157974">water</en> <en id="wh157972">jug</en>
<en id="wh157976">were by his head</en>?”
<en id="wh157979">Then Saul</en> <en id="wh157978">recognized</en> <en id="wh157982">David’s</en> <en id="wh157981">voice</en>
<en id="wh157983">and</en> <en id="wh157984">asked</en>,
“<en id="wh157987">Is that</en> <en id="wh157986">your voice</en>,
<en id="wh157989">David</en> <en id="wh157988">my son</en>?”
<en id="wh157992">David</en> <en id="wh157991">said</en>.
“<en id="wh157993">It is my voice</en>,
<en id="wh157994">my lord</en> <en id="wh157996">and king</en>,”
<en id="wh157997">And</en> <en id="wh157998">he continued</en>,
“<en id="wh157999">Why</en> <en id="wh158001">is my lord</en> <en id="wh158002">pursuing</en> <en id="wh158004">his servant</en>?
<en id="wh158006">What</en> <en id="wh158007">have I done</en>?
<en id="wh158009">What</en> <en id="wh158012">evil</en> <en id="wh158011">is in my hand</en>?
<en id="wh158014">Now</en>

<en id="wh158016">please</en>, <en id="wh158017">may my lord</en> <en id="wh158018">the</en> <en id="wh158019">king</en> <en id="wh158015">hear</en> <en id="wh158021">the words</en> <en id="wh158022">of his servant</en>:
<en id="wh158023">If</en> <en id="wh158024">the LORD</en> <en id="wh158025">has stirred you up</en> <en id="wh158026">against me</en>,
<en id="wh158027">may He accept</en> <en id="wh158028">an offering</en>.
<en id="wh158029">then</en> ... <en id="wh158030">But if</en> <en id="wh158031">men have done it</en>,
<en id="wh158035">may they</en> <en id="wh158034">be cursed</en> <en id="wh158037">in the presence</en> <en id="wh158038">of the LORD</en>!
<en id="wh158039">For</en> <en id="wh158042">today</en> <en id="wh158040">they have driven me away</en>
<en id="wh158043">from</en> <en id="wh158044">sharing</en> <en id="wh158045">in</en> <en id="wh158046">the inheritance</en> <en id="wh158047">of the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh158049">saying</en>,
<en id="wh158051">serve</en> <en id="wh158053">other</en> <en id="wh158052">gods</en>.’
<en id="wh158055">So</en>

<en id="wh158056">do not</en> <en id="wh158058">let my blood</en> <en id="wh158057">fall</en> <en id="wh158059">to the ground</en> <en id="wh158061">far from</en> <en id="wh158062">the presence</en> <en id="wh158063">of the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh158064">For</en> <en id="wh158066">the king</en> <en id="wh158067">of Israel</en> <en id="wh158065">has come out</en>
<en id="wh158068">to</en> <en id="wh158069">look for</en> <en id="wh158072">a</en> <en id="wh158071">flea</en>,
<en id="wh158074">like</en> <en id="wh158075">one who hunts</en> <en id="wh158077">a partridge</en> <en id="wh158078">in</en> <en id="wh158079">the</en> <en id="wh158080">mountains</en>.”
<en id="wh158083">Then Saul</en> <en id="wh158082">replied</en>,
“<en id="wh158084">I have sinned</en>.
<en id="wh158085">Come back</en>,
<en id="wh158087">David</en> <en id="wh158086">my son</en>.
<en id="wh158089">I will never</en> <en id="wh158090">harm</en> <en id="wh158091">you</en> <en id="wh158092">again</en>, <en id="wh158088">because</en>
<en id="wh158100">today</en> <en id="wh158098">you considered</en> <en id="wh158096">my life</en> <en id="wh158095">precious</en>.
<en id="wh158104">I have played the fool</en>
<en id="wh158105">and</en> <en id="wh158107">have committed a grave</en> <en id="wh158106">error</en>!”
<en id="wh158111">David</en> <en id="wh158110">answered</en>.
“<en id="wh158114">Here</en> <en id="wh158117">is the king’s</en> <en id="wh158115">spear</en>,”
“<en id="wh158120">Let one of</en> <en id="wh158122">the</en> <en id="wh158123">young men</en> <en id="wh158119">come over</en>
<en id="wh158124">and</en> <en id="wh158125">get it</en>.

<en id="wh158127">May the LORD</en> <en id="wh158128">repay</en> <en id="wh158131">every man</en> <en id="wh158133">for his righteousness</en> <en id="wh158134">and</en> <en id="wh158136">faithfulness</en>.
<en id="wh158142">For</en> <en id="wh158140">the</en> <en id="wh158139">LORD</en> <en id="wh158138">delivered you</en> <en id="wh158143">into my hand</en> <en id="wh158141">today</en>,
<en id="wh158144">but</en> <en id="wh158146">I would not</en>
<en id="wh158148">extend</en> <en id="wh158149">my hand</en> <en id="wh158152">against the LORD’s</en> <en id="wh158151">anointed</en>.
<en id="wh158154">surely as</en>
<en id="wh158155">As</en> ... <en id="wh158164">I valued</en> <en id="wh158158">your life</en> <en id="wh158160">today</en>,
<en id="wh158165">so</en> <en id="wh158170">may the LORD</en> <en id="wh158169">value</en> <en id="wh158167">my life</en>
<en id="wh158171">and</en> <en id="wh158172">rescue me</en> <en id="wh158173">from</en> <en id="wh158174">all</en> <en id="wh158175">trouble</en>.”
<en id="wh158178">Saul</en> <en id="wh158177">said</en> <en id="wh158179">to</en> <en id="wh158176">him</en>,
“<en id="wh158182">May you</en> <en id="wh158181">be blessed</en>,
<en id="wh158184">David</en> <en id="wh158183">my son</en>.
<en id="wh158187">You</en> <en id="wh158185">will</en> <en id="wh158186">accomplish great things</en>
<en id="wh158188">and</en> <en id="wh158190">will surely prevail</en>.”
<en id="wh158195">So</en> <en id="wh158194">David</en> <en id="wh158193">went</en> <en id="wh158196">on his way</en>,
<en id="wh158197">and</en> <en id="wh158198">Saul</en> <en id="wh158199">returned</en> <en id="wh158201">home</en>.
<en id="wh158204">David, however</en>, <en id="wh158203">said</en> <en id="wh158205">to</en> <en id="wh158206">himself</en>,

“<en id="wh158210">One</en> <en id="wh158209">of these days</en> <en id="wh158207">now</en> <en id="wh158208">I will be swept away</en> <en id="wh158211">by</en> <en id="wh158212">the hand</en> <en id="wh158213">of Saul</en>.
<en id="wh158214">There is nothing</en> <en id="wh158216">better</en> <en id="wh158215">for me</en>
<en id="wh158217">than</en> <en id="wh158218">to</en> <en id="wh158219">escape</en> <en id="wh158220">to</en> <en id="wh158221">the land</en> <en id="wh158222">of the Philistines</en>.
<en id="wh158223">Then</en> <en id="wh158226">Saul</en> <en id="wh158224">will stop</en> ... <en id="wh158225">for me</en>

<en id="wh160643">and</en> <en id="wh160644">kill me</en>,
<en id="wh160645">for</en> <en id="wh160648">agony</en> <en id="wh160646">has seized me</en>,
<en id="wh160649">but</en> <en id="wh160652">my life</en> <en id="wh160650">still</en> <en id="wh160651">lingers</en>.’
<en id="wh160654">So</en> <en id="wh160655">I stood</en> <en id="wh160656">over him</en>
<en id="wh160657">and</en> <en id="wh160658">killed him</en>,
<en id="wh160659">because</en> <en id="wh160660">I knew</en>
<en id="wh160661">that</en> ... <en id="wh160662">he could not</en> <en id="wh160663">survive</en>.
<en id="wh160664">after</en> <en id="wh160665">he had fallen</en>
<en id="wh160666">And</en> <en id="wh160667">I took</en> <en id="wh160668">the</en> <en id="wh160669">crown</en>
<en id="wh160670">that</en> <en id="wh160671">was on</en> <en id="wh160672">his head</en>
<en id="wh160673">and</en> <en id="wh160674">the band</en>
<en id="wh160675">that</en> <en id="wh160676">was on</en> <en id="wh160677">his arm</en>,
<en id="wh160678">and</en> <en id="wh160679">I have brought them</en> <en id="wh160682">here</en> <en id="wh160680">to</en> <en id="wh160681">my lord</en>.”
<en id="wh160685">Then David</en> <en id="wh160684">took hold</en> <en id="wh160683">of</en> <en id="wh160687">his own clothes</en>
<en id="wh160688">and</en> <en id="wh160689">tore them</en>,
<en id="wh160690">and</en> <en id="wh160692">all</en> <en id="wh160693">the</en> <en id="wh160694">men</en> ... <en id="wh160691">did the same</en>.
<en id="wh160695">who were</en> <en id="wh160696">with him</en>
<en id="wh160698">They mourned</en>
<en id="wh160699">and</en> <en id="wh160700">wept</en>

<en id="wh160701">and</en> <en id="wh160702">fasted</en> <en id="wh160703">until</en> <en id="wh160705">evening</en> <en id="wh160712">for</en> <en id="wh160707">Saul</en> <en id="wh160708">and</en> <en id="wh160711">his son</en> <en id="wh160710">Jonathan</en>, <en id="wh160716">and</en> <en id="wh160714">for the people</en> <en id="wh160715">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh160718">and the house</en> <en id="wh160719">of Israel</en>,
<en id="wh160720">because</en> <en id="wh160721">they had fallen</en> <en id="wh160722">by</en> <en id="wh160723">the</en> <en id="wh160724">sword</en>.
<en id="wh160725">And</en> <en id="wh160727">David</en> <en id="wh160726">inquired</en> <en id="wh160728">of</en> <en id="wh160729">the</en> <en id="wh160730">young man</en>
<en id="wh160732">who had brought him the report</en>,
“<en id="wh160734">Where</en> <en id="wh160737">are you from</en>?”
<en id="wh160738">of</en> ... <en id="wh160739">he answered</en>.
“<en id="wh160740">I am the son</en> ... <en id="wh160742">a foreigner</en>,” ... “<en id="wh160744">I am</en> <en id="wh160743">an Amalekite</en>.”
<en id="wh160748">So David</en> <en id="wh160746">asked</en> <en id="wh160747">him</en>,
“<en id="wh160749">Why</en> <en id="wh160750">were you not</en> <en id="wh160751">afraid</en>
<en id="wh160752">to</en> <en id="wh160753">lift</en> <en id="wh160754">your hand</en>
<en id="wh160755">to</en> <en id="wh160756">destroy</en> <en id="wh160759">the LORD’s</en> <en id="wh160758">anointed</en>?”
<en id="wh160763">Then</en> <en id="wh160762">David</en> <en id="wh160761">summoned</en> <en id="wh160764">one</en> ... <en id="wh160766">the</en> <en id="wh160767">young men</en>
<en id="wh160768">of</en> ... <en id="wh160769">and said</en>,
<en id="wh160771">execute</en> <en id="wh160772">him</en>!”
<en id="wh160774">So the young man struck him down</en>,
<en id="wh160775">and</en> <en id="wh160776">he died</en>.
<en id="wh160777">For</en> <en id="wh160780">David</en> <en id="wh160778">had said</en> <en id="wh160779">to the Amalekite</en>,
“<en id="wh160781">Your blood</en> <en id="wh160782">be on</en> <en id="wh160783">your own head</en>
<en id="wh160784">because</en> <en id="wh160785">your own mouth</en> <en id="wh160786">has testified</en> <en id="wh160787">against you</en>,
<en id="wh160789">saying</en>,
‘<en id="wh160790">I</en> <en id="wh160791">killed</en> <en id="wh160794">the LORD’s</en> <en id="wh160793">anointed</en>.’”

<en id="wh160797">Then David</en> <en id="wh160796">took up</en> <en id="wh160802">this</en> <en id="wh160800">lament</en> <en id="wh160805">for</en> <en id="wh160804">Saul</en> <en id="wh160808">and his son</en> <en id="wh160807">Jonathan</en>,
<en id="wh160809">and</en> <en id="wh160810">he ordered</en>
<en id="wh160813">that the sons</en> <en id="wh160814">of Judah</en> <en id="wh160812">be taught</en> <en id="wh160815">the Song of the Bow</en>.
<en id="wh160817">It is written</en> <en id="wh160818">in</en> <en id="wh160820">the</en> <en id="wh160819">Book</en> <en id="wh160821">of Jashar</en>:
“<en id="wh160823">Your glory</en>,
<en id="wh160824">O Israel</en>,
<en id="wh160827">lies slain</en> <en id="wh160825">on</en> <en id="wh160826">your heights</en>.
<en id="wh160828">How</en> <en id="wh160830">the mighty</en> <en id="wh160829">have fallen</en>!
<en id="wh160832">Tell it</en> <en id="wh160831">not</en> <en id="wh160833">in</en> <en id="wh160834">Gath</en>;
<en id="wh160836">proclaim it</en> <en id="wh160835">not</en> <en id="wh160837">in</en> <en id="wh160838">the streets</en> <en id="wh160839">of Ashkelon</en>,
<en id="wh160840">lest</en> <en id="wh160842">the daughters</en> <en id="wh160843">of the Philistines</en> <en id="wh160841">rejoice</en>,
<en id="wh160846">and the daughters</en> <en id="wh160848">of the uncircumcised</en> <en id="wh160845">exult</en>.
<en id="wh160849">O mountains</en> <en id="wh160852">of Gilboa</en>,
<en id="wh160853">no</en> <en id="wh160854">dew</en>
<en id="wh160858">may you have</en> ... <en id="wh160855">or</en> <en id="wh160857">rain</en>,
<en id="wh160860">no fields</en> <en id="wh160861">yielding offerings of grain</en>.
<en id="wh160862">For</en> <en id="wh160863">there</en> <en id="wh160865">the shield</en> <en id="wh160866">of the mighty</en> <en id="wh160864">was defiled</en>,
<en id="wh160867">the shield</en> <en id="wh160868">of Saul</en>, <en id="wh160869">no longer</en> <en id="wh160870">anointed</en> <en id="wh160871">with</en> <en id="wh160873">oil</en>.

<en id="wh160874">From</en> <en id="wh160875">the blood</en> <en id="wh160876">of the slain</en>, <en id="wh160877">from</en> <en id="wh160878">the fat</en> <en id="wh160879">of the mighty</en>, <en id="wh160880">the bow</en> <en id="wh160881">of Jonathan</en> <en id="wh160882">did not</en> <en id="wh160883">retreat</en>,
<en id="wh160885">and</en> <en id="wh160886">the sword</en> <en id="wh160887">of Saul</en> <en id="wh160888">did not</en> <en id="wh160889">return</en> <en id="wh160890">empty</en>.
<en id="wh160891">Saul</en> <en id="wh160892">and</en> <en id="wh160893">Jonathan</en>, <en id="wh160895">beloved</en> <en id="wh160896">and</en> <en id="wh160898">delightful</en>
<en id="wh160899">in</en> <en id="wh160900">life</en>, <en id="wh160904">were not</en> <en id="wh160905">divided</en> <en id="wh160902">in</en> <en id="wh160903">death</en>.
<en id="wh160908">They were swifter</en> <en id="wh160907">than eagles</en>;
<en id="wh160911">they were stronger</en> <en id="wh160910">than lions</en>.
<en id="wh160912">O daughters</en> <en id="wh160913">of Israel</en>,
<en id="wh160916">weep</en> <en id="wh160914">for</en> <en id="wh160915">Saul</en>,
<en id="wh160918">who clothed you</en> <en id="wh160919">in scarlet</en> <en id="wh160917">and</en> <en id="wh160921">luxury</en>, ... <en id="wh160920">with</en>
<en id="wh160923">who decked</en> <en id="wh160927">your garments</en> ... <en id="wh160924">ornaments</en> <en id="wh160925">of gold</en>.

<en id="wh160928">How</en> <en id="wh160930">the mighty</en> <en id="wh160929">have fallen</en> <en id="wh160931">in</en> <en id="wh160933">the</en> <en id="wh160932">thick</en> <en id="wh160934">of battle</en>!
<en id="wh160935">Jonathan</en> <en id="wh160938">lies slain</en> <en id="wh160936">on</en> <en id="wh160937">your heights</en>.
<en id="wh160939">I grieve</en> <en id="wh160941">for</en> <en id="wh160940">you</en>,
<en id="wh160943">Jonathan</en>, <en id="wh160942">my brother</en>.
<en id="wh160944">You were delightful</en> <en id="wh160945">to me</en>;
<en id="wh160948">your love</en> <en id="wh160949">to me</en> <en id="wh160947">was extraordinary</en>, <en id="wh160951">surpassing the love</en> <en id="wh160952">of women</en>.
<en id="wh160953">How</en> <en id="wh160955">the mighty</en> <en id="wh160954">have fallen</en>,
<en id="wh160956">and</en> <en id="wh160958">the weapons</en> <en id="wh160959">of war</en> <en id="wh160957">have perished</en>!”
<en id="wh160962">Some time later</en>,
<en id="wh160966">David</en> <en id="wh160965">inquired</en> <en id="wh160964">of</en> <en id="wh160968">the LORD</en>,
“<en id="wh160972">Should I go up</en> <en id="wh160974">to one</en> ... <en id="wh160975">the towns</en> <en id="wh160976">of Judah</en>?”
<en id="wh160977">of</en> ... <en id="wh160979">the LORD</en> <en id="wh160978">answered</en>.
“<en id="wh160981">Go up</en>,”
<en id="wh160984">Then David</en> <en id="wh160983">asked</en>,
“<en id="wh160985">Where</en> <en id="wh160986">should I go</en>?”
“<en id="wh160987">To</en> ... <en id="wh160988">replied the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh160989">Hebron</en>,”

<en id="wh160994">So</en> <en id="wh160993">David</en> <en id="wh160991">went</en> <en id="wh160992">there</en> <en id="wh160996">with his two</en> <en id="wh160997">wives</en>, <en id="wh160998">Ahinoam</en> <en id="wh161001">of</en> <en id="wh161000">Jezreel</en> <en id="wh161002">and Abigail</en> <en id="wh160999">the</en> <en id="wh161003">widow</en> <en id="wh161004">of Nabal</en> <en id="wh161006">of Carmel</en>.
<en id="wh161008">the men</en>
<en id="wh161009">who</en> <en id="wh161010">were with him</en>,
<en id="wh161012">David also</en> <en id="wh161011">took</en>
<en id="wh161013">each</en> <en id="wh161015">with his household</en>,
<en id="wh161016">and</en> <en id="wh161017">they settled</en> <en id="wh161018">in</en> <en id="wh161019">the towns</en> <en id="wh161020">near Hebron</en>.
<en id="wh161023">Then the men</en> <en id="wh161021">of</en> <en id="wh161024">Judah</en> <en id="wh161022">came to Hebron</en>,

<en id="wh161025">and</en> <en id="wh161027">there</en> <en id="wh161026">they anointed</en> <en id="wh161029">David</en> <en id="wh161031">king</en> <en id="wh161032">over</en> <en id="wh161033">the house</en> ... <en id="wh161034">Judah</en>.
<en id="wh161035">of</en> ... <en id="wh161037">And</en> <en id="wh161036">they told</en> <en id="wh161038">David</en>,
“<en id="wh161041">It was the men</en> <en id="wh161042">of Jabesh-gilead</en>
<en id="wh161045">who buried</en> <en id="wh161047">Saul</en>.”
<en id="wh161050">So David</en> <en id="wh161049">sent</en> <en id="wh161051">messengers</en> <en id="wh161052">to</en> <en id="wh161053">the men</en> ... <en id="wh161054">Jabesh-gilead</en>
<en id="wh161056">of</en> ... <en id="wh161057">to tell</en> ... <en id="wh161058">to</en>
<en id="wh161061">them</en>, “<en id="wh161062">The LORD</en> <en id="wh161059">bless</en> <en id="wh161060">you</en>,
<en id="wh161063">because</en> <en id="wh161064">you showed</en> <en id="wh161068">this</en> <en id="wh161066">kindness</en> ... <en id="wh161072">Saul</en> <en id="wh161070">your lord</en>
<en id="wh161074">when you buried him</en>.
<en id="wh161077">Now</en>
<en id="wh161079">may the LORD</en> <en id="wh161078">show</en> <en id="wh161080">you</en> <en id="wh161081">loving devotion</en> <en id="wh161082">and</en> <en id="wh161083">faithfulness</en>,

<en id="wh161086">and I</en> <en id="wh161085">will also</en> <en id="wh161087">show</en> <en id="wh161084">you</en> <en id="wh161091">the</en> <en id="wh161092">same</en> <en id="wh161090">favor</en>
<en id="wh161093">because</en> <en id="wh161094">you have done</en> <en id="wh161098">this</en>.
<en id="wh161099">Now</en> <en id="wh161100">then</en>,
<en id="wh161101">be strong</en>
<en id="wh161105">and</en> <en id="wh161106">courageous</en>,
<en id="wh161108">for</en> <en id="wh161111">though Saul</en> <en id="wh161110">your lord</en> <en id="wh161109">is dead</en>,
<en id="wh161116">the house</en> <en id="wh161117">of Judah</en> <en id="wh161115">has anointed me</en> <en id="wh161119">as their king</en>.”
<en id="wh161122">Meanwhile, Abner</en> <en id="wh161123">son</en> <en id="wh161124">of Ner</en>, <en id="wh161125">the commander</en> ... <en id="wh161126">army</en>,
<en id="wh161129">Saul’s</en>
<en id="wh161134">Saul’s</en> ... <en id="wh161130">took</en> ... <en id="wh161133">son</en> <en id="wh161132">Ish-bosheth</en>,
<en id="wh161135">of</en> ... <en id="wh161136">moved him</en> <en id="wh161137">to Mahanaim</en>,

<en id="wh161138">and</en> <en id="wh161139">made him king</en> <en id="wh161140">over</en> <en id="wh161142">Gilead</en>, <en id="wh161146">Asher</en>, <en id="wh161149">Jezreel</en>, <en id="wh161152">Ephraim</en>, <en id="wh161153">and</en> <en id="wh161155">Benjamin</en>— <en id="wh161151">over</en> <en id="wh161159">all</en> <en id="wh161158">Israel</en>.
<en id="wh161165">Saul’s</en> <en id="wh161160">son</en> <en id="wh161163">Ish-bosheth</en> <en id="wh161161">was forty</en> <en id="wh161162">years</en> <en id="wh161164">old</en>
<en id="wh161166">when</en> <en id="wh161167">he began to reign</en> <en id="wh161168">over</en> <en id="wh161169">Israel</en>,
<en id="wh161170">and</en> <en id="wh161173">he reigned</en> <en id="wh161171">for two</en> <en id="wh161172">years</en>.
<en id="wh161175">The house</en> <en id="wh161176">of Judah</en>, <en id="wh161174">however</en>, <en id="wh161177">followed</en> <en id="wh161179">David</en>.
<en id="wh161180">And</en> <en id="wh161183">the</en> <en id="wh161182">length</en> <en id="wh161184">of time</en> ... <en id="wh161181">was</en>

<en id="wh161185">that</en> <en id="wh161187">David</en> ... <en id="wh161188">king</en> <en id="wh161189">in</en> <en id="wh161190">Hebron</en> <en id="wh161191">over</en> <en id="wh161192">the house</en> <en id="wh161193">of Judah</en>
<en id="wh161194">was seven</en> <en id="wh161195">years</en> <en id="wh161196">and</en> <en id="wh161197">six</en> <en id="wh161198">months</en>.

<en id="wh161201">One day Abner</en> <en id="wh161202">son</en> <en id="wh161199">of</en> <en id="wh161203">Ner</en> <en id="wh161204">and</en> <en id="wh161205">the servants</en> <en id="wh161206">of Ish-bosheth</en> <en id="wh161207">son</en> <en id="wh161208">of Saul</en> <en id="wh161200">marched out</en> <en id="wh161209">from</en> <en id="wh161210">Mahanaim</en> <en id="wh161211">to Gibeon</en>.

<en id="wh161212">So</en> <en id="wh161213">Joab</en> <en id="wh161214">son</en> <en id="wh161215">of Zeruiah</en> <en id="wh161216">and</en> <en id="wh161217">the servants</en> ... <en id="wh161218">David</en> <en id="wh161219">marched out</en>
<en id="wh161220">of</en> ... <en id="wh161221">and met them</en> ... <en id="wh161224">Gibeon</en>.

<en id="wh161229">by</en> <en id="wh161230">the</en> <en id="wh161231">pool</en> <en id="wh161226">of</en> ... <en id="wh161228">And the two groups</en> <en id="wh161227">took up positions</en> ... <en id="wh161233">opposite sides</en>
<en id="wh161236">on</en> ... <en id="wh161238">of the pool</en>.
<en id="wh161243">Then Abner</en> <en id="wh161242">said</en> <en id="wh161244">to</en> <en id="wh161245">Joab</en>,
