<en id="wh161259">So they got up</en>

<en id="wh161260">and</en> <en id="wh161263">were counted off</en> — <en id="wh161264">twelve</en> <en id="wh161267">for Benjamin</en> <en id="wh161269">and</en> <en id="wh161270">Ish-bosheth</en> <en id="wh161271">son</en> <en id="wh161272">of Saul</en>, <en id="wh161273">and</en> <en id="wh161274">twelve</en> <en id="wh161278">for David</en>.
<en id="wh161280">grabbed</en>
<en id="wh161281">Then each man</en> ... <en id="wh161284">his opponent</en> <en id="wh161282">by</en> <en id="wh161283">the head</en>
<en id="wh161285">and</en> <en id="wh161286">thrust his sword</en> <en id="wh161287">into</en> <en id="wh161289">his opponent’s</en> <en id="wh161288">side</en>,
<en id="wh161290">and</en> <en id="wh161291">they all fell</en> <en id="wh161292">together</en>.
<en id="wh161295">So</en> <en id="wh161299">this</en> <en id="wh161297">place</en>, ... <en id="wh161294">is called</en> <en id="wh161300">Helkath-hazzurim</en>.
<en id="wh161301">which</en> <en id="wh161303">is in Gibeon</en>,
<en id="wh161306">The</en> <en id="wh161307">battle</en> <en id="wh161315">that</en> <en id="wh161313">day</en> <en id="wh161305">was</en> <en id="wh161308">intense</en>,

<en id="wh161316">and</en> <en id="wh161318">Abner</en> <en id="wh161319">and</en> <en id="wh161320">the men</en> <en id="wh161321">of Israel</en> <en id="wh161317">were defeated</en> <en id="wh161322">by</en> <en id="wh161324">the servants</en> <en id="wh161325">of David</en>.

<en id="wh161329">The three</en> <en id="wh161330">sons</en> <en id="wh161333">of</en> <en id="wh161331">Zeruiah</en> <en id="wh161327">were</en> <en id="wh161328">there</en>: <en id="wh161332">Joab</en>, <en id="wh161334">Abishai</en>, ... <en id="wh161336">Now Asahel</en>

<en id="wh161337">and</en> <en id="wh161338">Asahel</en>. ... <en id="wh161339">was fleet</en> <en id="wh161341">of foot</en> <en id="wh161342">like</en> <en id="wh161343">a</en> ... <en id="wh161345">gazelle</en>,
<en id="wh161349">wild</en>

<en id="wh164335">And</en> <en id="wh164337">as if</en> <en id="wh164338">this</en> <en id="wh164336">was a small thing</en> <en id="wh164339">in</en> <en id="wh164340">Your eyes</en>,
<en id="wh164341">O Lord</en> <en id="wh164342">GOD</en>,

<en id="wh164345">You have also</en> <en id="wh164344">spoken</en> <en id="wh164346">about</en> <en id="wh164351">the future</en> <en id="wh164343">of</en> <en id="wh164347">the house</en> <en id="wh164348">of Your servant</en>.
<en id="wh164353">Is this</en> <en id="wh164354">Your custom</en> <en id="wh164356">with man</en>,

<en id="wh164365">say</en> <en id="wh164364">to</en> <en id="wh164366">You</en>?
<en id="wh164368">For You</en> <en id="wh164369">know</en> <en id="wh164371">Your servant</en>,
<en id="wh164372">O Lord</en> <en id="wh164373">GOD</en>.

<en id="wh164375">For the sake</en> <en id="wh164376">of Your word</en> <en id="wh164377">and</en> <en id="wh164379">according to Your own heart</en>, <en id="wh164380">You have accomplished</en> <en id="wh164386">this</en> <en id="wh164384">great thing</en>
<en id="wh164387">and</en> <en id="wh164388">revealed it</en> <en id="wh164390">to Your servant</en>.

<en id="wh164406">we have heard</en> <en id="wh164407">with</en> <en id="wh164408">our own ears</en>.

<en id="wh164409">And</en> <en id="wh164410">who</en> <en id="wh164412">is like Your people</en> <en id="wh164414">Israel</en> — <en id="wh164418">the</en> <en id="wh164416">one</en> <en id="wh164415">nation</en> <en id="wh164417">on</en> <en id="wh164419">earth</en>

<en id="wh164429">and</en> <en id="wh164430">to make</en> <en id="wh164432">a name</en> <en id="wh164431">for Himself</en>?

<en id="wh164436">You</en> <en id="wh164435">performed</en> <en id="wh164438">great</en> <en id="wh164439">and</en> <en id="wh164440">awesome wonders</en> ... <en id="wh164443">from</en> <en id="wh164444">before</en> <en id="wh164445">Your people</en>,

<en id="wh164451">by driving out nations</en> <en id="wh164452">and</en> <en id="wh164453">their gods</en> ... <en id="wh164446">whom</en> <en id="wh164447">You redeemed</en> <en id="wh164448">for Yourself</en> <en id="wh164449">from</en> <en id="wh164450">Egypt</en>.

<en id="wh164454">For</en> <en id="wh164455">You have established</en> <en id="wh164458">Your people</en> <en id="wh164459">Israel</en> <en id="wh164460">as Your very own</en> <en id="wh164464">forever</en>,
<en id="wh164465">and</en> <en id="wh164466">You</en>,
<en id="wh164467">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh164468">have become</en> <en id="wh164469">their</en> <en id="wh164471">God</en>.
<en id="wh164472">And</en> <en id="wh164473">now</en>,
<en id="wh164474">O LORD</en> <en id="wh164475">God</en>,
<en id="wh164476">the</en> <en id="wh164477">word</en>
<en id="wh164479">You have spoken</en> <en id="wh164480">concerning</en> <en id="wh164481">Your servant</en> <en id="wh164482">and</en> <en id="wh164484">his house</en>.
<en id="wh164485">confirm</en> <en id="wh164487">forever</en>
<en id="wh164489">Do</en>
<en id="wh164490">as</en> <en id="wh164492">You have promised</en>,
<en id="wh164493">so</en> <en id="wh164495">that Your name</en> <en id="wh164494">will be magnified</en> <en id="wh164497">forever</en>
<en id="wh164499">when it is said</en>,
‘<en id="wh164500">The LORD</en> <en id="wh164501">of Hosts</en> <en id="wh164502">is God</en> <en id="wh164503">over</en> <en id="wh164504">Israel</en>.’

<en id="wh164505">And</en> <en id="wh164506">the house</en> <en id="wh164507">of Your servant</en> <en id="wh164508">David</en> <en id="wh164509">will be</en> <en id="wh164510">established</en> <en id="wh164512">before You</en>.
<en id="wh164513">For</en> <en id="wh164514">You</en>,
<en id="wh164515">O LORD</en> <en id="wh164516">of Hosts</en>, <en id="wh164517">the God</en> <en id="wh164518">of Israel</en>,
<en id="wh164519">have revealed this</en> ... <en id="wh164522">Your servant</en>
<en id="wh164523">to</en> ... <en id="wh164524">when You said</en>,
‘<en id="wh164526">I will build</en> <en id="wh164525">a house</en> ... <en id="wh164527">to You</en>.
<en id="wh164529">Therefore</en> <en id="wh164531">Your servant</en> <en id="wh164530">has found</en> <en id="wh164533">the courage</en>
<en id="wh164536">for you</en>.’ ... <en id="wh164534">to</en> <en id="wh164535">offer</en> <en id="wh164541">this</en> <en id="wh164539">prayer</en>
<en id="wh164542">And</en> <en id="wh164543">now</en>,
<en id="wh164544">O Lord</en> <en id="wh164545">GOD</en>,
<en id="wh164546">You</en> <en id="wh164547">are</en> <en id="wh164549">God</en>!
<en id="wh164551">Your words</en> <en id="wh164552">are</en> <en id="wh164553">true</en>,
<en id="wh164554">and</en> <en id="wh164555">You have promised</en> <en id="wh164562">this</en> <en id="wh164560">goodness</en> <en id="wh164556">to</en> <en id="wh164557">Your servant</en>.
<en id="wh164563">Now</en> <en id="wh164564">therefore</en>, <en id="wh164565">may it please You</en>
<en id="wh164567">to bless</en> <en id="wh164569">the house</en> <en id="wh164570">of Your servant</en>,
<en id="wh164572">that it may continue</en> <en id="wh164574">forever</en> <en id="wh164576">before You</en>.
<en id="wh164577">For</en> <en id="wh164578">You</en>,
<en id="wh164579">O Lord</en> <en id="wh164580">GOD</en>,
<en id="wh164581">have spoken</en>,
<en id="wh164582">and</en> <en id="wh164584">with Your blessing</en> <en id="wh164586">the house</en> <en id="wh164587">of Your servant</en> <en id="wh164585">will be blessed forever</en>.”
<en id="wh164591">Some time later</en>,
<en id="wh164596">David</en> <en id="wh164595">defeated</en> <en id="wh164598">the Philistines</en>,
<en id="wh164600">subdued them</en>,

<en id="wh164601">and</en> <en id="wh164602">took</en> <en id="wh164607">Metheg-ammah</en> <en id="wh164608">from</en> <en id="wh164606">the</en> <en id="wh164609">hand</en> <en id="wh164610">of the Philistines</en>.

<en id="wh164624">He measured off</en> <en id="wh164625">with two</en> <en id="wh164626">lengths</en>
<en id="wh164628">those to be put to death</en>,
<en id="wh164629">and</en> <en id="wh164630">with one</en> <en id="wh164632">length</en>
<en id="wh164634">those to be spared</en>. <en id="wh164633">So</en>

<en id="wh164637">the Moabites</en> <en id="wh164636">became</en> <en id="wh164641">subject</en> <en id="wh164638">to</en> <en id="wh164639">David</en> <en id="wh164640">and</en> <en id="wh164642">brought him</en> <en id="wh164643">tribute</en>.

<en id="wh164646">David</en> <en id="wh164645">also defeated</en> <en id="wh164648">Hadadezer</en> <en id="wh164649">son</en> <en id="wh164650">of Rehob</en>, <en id="wh164651">king</en> <en id="wh164652">of Zobah</en>,

<en id="wh164663">David</en> <en id="wh164662">captured</en> <en id="wh164664">from him</en> <en id="wh164668">a thousand chariots</en>, <en id="wh164667">seven</en> <en id="wh164665">thousand</en> <en id="wh164669">charioteers</en>, <en id="wh164670">and</en> <en id="wh164671">twenty</en> <en id="wh164672">thousand</en> <en id="wh164674">foot</en> <en id="wh164673">soldiers</en>,

<en id="wh164689">When the Arameans</en> <en id="wh164687">of</en> <en id="wh164690">Damascus</en> <en id="wh164688">came</en>
<en id="wh164691">to</en> <en id="wh164692">help</en> <en id="wh164695">King</en> <en id="wh164694">Hadadezer</en> ... <en id="wh164696">Zobah</en>,

<en id="wh164697">of</en> ... <en id="wh164699">David</en> <en id="wh164698">struck down</en> <en id="wh164702">twenty-two</en> <en id="wh164705">thousand</en> <en id="wh164701">of their</en> <en id="wh164706">men</en>.
<en id="wh164709">Then he</en> <en id="wh164708">placed</en> <en id="wh164710">garrisons</en> <en id="wh164711">in</en> <en id="wh164712">Aram</en> ... <en id="wh164713">Damascus</en>,

<en id="wh164714">of</en> ... <en id="wh164717">and</en> <en id="wh164716">the Arameans</en> <en id="wh164715">became</en> <en id="wh164720">subject</en> <en id="wh164719">to</en> <en id="wh164718">David</en> ... <en id="wh164721">brought him</en> <en id="wh164722">tribute</en>.
<en id="wh164723">and</en> ... <en id="wh164725">So the LORD</en> <en id="wh164727">made David</en> <en id="wh164724">victorious</en> <en id="wh164729">wherever</en>
<en id="wh164731">he went</en>.
<en id="wh164732">And</en> <en id="wh164734">David</en> <en id="wh164733">took</en> <en id="wh164737">the</en> <en id="wh164738">gold</en> <en id="wh164736">shields</en>
<en id="wh164739">that</en> <en id="wh164740">belonged</en> <en id="wh164741">to</en> <en id="wh164742">the officers</en> ... <en id="wh164743">Hadadezer</en>

<en id="wh164747">And</en> <en id="wh164748">from</en> <en id="wh164749">Betah</en> <en id="wh164750">and</en> <en id="wh164752">Berothai</en>, <en id="wh164753">cities</en> <en id="wh164754">of Hadadezer</en>, <en id="wh164757">King</en> <en id="wh164758">David</en> <en id="wh164755">took</en> <en id="wh164761">a large</en> <en id="wh164760">amount</en> <en id="wh164759">of bronze</en>.
<en id="wh164765">When King</en> <en id="wh164764">Toi</en> <en id="wh164762">of</en> <en id="wh164766">Hamath</en> <en id="wh164763">heard</en>
<en id="wh164767">that</en> <en id="wh164769">David</en> <en id="wh164768">had defeated</en> <en id="wh164771">the entire</en> <en id="wh164772">army</en> <en id="wh164773">of Hadadezer</en>,

<en id="wh164862">And</en> <en id="wh164864">David</en> <en id="wh164863">made</en> <en id="wh164865">a name for himself</en>
<en id="wh164866">when</en> <en id="wh164867">he returned</en>

<en id="wh164868">from</en> <en id="wh164869">striking down</en> <en id="wh164874">eighteen</en> <en id="wh164876">thousand</en> <en id="wh164871">Edomites</en> <en id="wh164872">in</en> <en id="wh164873">the Valley of Salt</en>.
<en id="wh164878">He placed</en> <en id="wh164881">garrisons</en> ... <en id="wh164880">Edom</en>,

<en id="wh164960">Then David</en> <en id="wh164959">asked</en>,

<en id="wh164966">anyone left</en> <en id="wh164968">from the house</en> <en id="wh164969">of Saul</en> <en id="wh164967">to whom</en>

<en id="wh165004">So the king</en> <en id="wh165002">asked</en>, ... <en id="wh165001">left</en>

<en id="wh165056">had him brought</en> <en id="wh165057">from</en> <en id="wh165058">the house</en> <en id="wh165055">of</en> <en id="wh165059">Machir</en> <en id="wh165060">son</en> <en id="wh165061">of Ammiel</en> <en id="wh165063">in Lo-debar</en>.

<en id="wh165064">And</en> <en id="wh165066">when Mephibosheth</en> <en id="wh165067">son</en> <en id="wh165068">of Jonathan</en>, <en id="wh165069">the son</en> <en id="wh165070">of Saul</en>, <en id="wh165065">came</en> <en id="wh165071">to</en> <en id="wh165072">David</en>,
<en id="wh165074">he fell facedown</en>
<en id="wh165077">in</en> <en id="wh165078">reverence</en>.
<en id="wh165081">Then David</en> <en id="wh165080">said</en>,

<en id="wh174205">Once again</en> <en id="wh174204">there was</en> <en id="wh174207">a battle</en> <en id="wh174210">with</en> <en id="wh174211">the Philistines</en> <en id="wh174208">at</en> <en id="wh174209">Gob</en>,

<en id="wh174261">and</en> <en id="wh174262">when he taunted</en> <en id="wh174264">Israel</en>,
<en id="wh174267">Jonathan</en> <en id="wh174268">the son</en> <en id="wh174271">of David’s</en> <en id="wh174270">brother</en> <en id="wh174269">Shimei</en> <en id="wh174266">killed him</en>.

<en id="wh174276">So</en> <en id="wh174274">these</en> <en id="wh174273">four</en> <en id="wh174275">descendants</en> <en id="wh174278">of Rapha</en> <en id="wh174279">in</en> <en id="wh174280">Gath</en>

<en id="wh174282">fell</en> <en id="wh174283">at</en> <en id="wh174284">the hands</en> <en id="wh174281">of</en> <en id="wh174285">David</en> <en id="wh174286">and</en> <en id="wh174289">his servants</en>.

<en id="wh174293">And</en> <en id="wh174292">David</en> <en id="wh174291">sang</en> <en id="wh174300">this</en> <en id="wh174298">song</en> <en id="wh174294">to the LORD</en> <en id="wh174301">on</en> <en id="wh174299">the</en> <en id="wh174302">day</en> ... <en id="wh174290">him</en>

<en id="wh174304">the LORD</en> <en id="wh174303">had delivered</en> ... <en id="wh174306">from</en> <en id="wh174307">the hand</en> <en id="wh174308">of all</en> <en id="wh174309">his enemies</en> <en id="wh174310">and</en> <en id="wh174311">from</en> <en id="wh174312">the hand</en> <en id="wh174313">of Saul</en>.
<en id="wh174315">He said</en>:
“<en id="wh174316">The LORD</en> <en id="wh174317">is my rock</en>, <en id="wh174319">my fortress</en>, <en id="wh174320">and</en> <en id="wh174321">my deliverer</en>.
<en id="wh174323">My God is</en> <en id="wh174324">my rock</en>,
<en id="wh174326">in</en> <en id="wh174325">whom I take refuge</en>,
<en id="wh174327">my shield</en>, <en id="wh174328">and</en> <en id="wh174329">the horn</en> <en id="wh174330">of my salvation</en>.
<en id="wh174331">My stronghold</en>, <en id="wh174333">my refuge</en>, <en id="wh174332">and</en> <en id="wh174334">my Savior</en>,
<en id="wh174337">You save me</en> <en id="wh174335">from</en> <en id="wh174336">violence</en>.
<en id="wh174339">I will call upon</en> <en id="wh174340">the LORD</en>, <en id="wh174338">who is worthy to be praised</en>;
<en id="wh174341">so</en> <en id="wh174344">shall I be saved</en> <en id="wh174342">from</en> <en id="wh174343">my enemies</en>.
<en id="wh174345">For</en> <en id="wh174347">the waves</en> <en id="wh174348">of death</en> <en id="wh174346">engulfed me</en>;
<en id="wh174349">the torrents</en> <en id="wh174350">of chaos</en> <en id="wh174351">overwhelmed me</en>.
<en id="wh174352">The cords</en> <en id="wh174353">of Sheol</en> <en id="wh174354">entangled me</en>;
<en id="wh174356">the snares</en> <en id="wh174357">of death</en> <en id="wh174355">confronted me</en>.
<en id="wh174358">In</en> <en id="wh174360">my distress</en> <en id="wh174362">I called upon</en> <en id="wh174359">the</en> <en id="wh174363">LORD</en>;
<en id="wh174367">I cried out</en> <en id="wh174365">to</en> <en id="wh174366">my God</en>.
<en id="wh174368">And</en> <en id="wh174370">from</en> <en id="wh174371">His temple</en> <en id="wh174369">He heard</en> <en id="wh174372">my voice</en>,
<en id="wh174373">and</en> <en id="wh174374">my cry for help</en> <en id="wh174376">reached His ears</en>.
<en id="wh174378">shook</en>
<en id="wh174382">Then the earth</en> ... <en id="wh174379">and</en> <en id="wh174380">quaked</en>; <en id="wh174381">the</en>
<en id="wh174383">foundations</en> ... <en id="wh174384">the</en> <en id="wh174385">heavens</en> <en id="wh174386">trembled</en>;
<en id="wh174387">of</en> ... <en id="wh174388">they were shaken</en>
<en id="wh174389">because</en> <en id="wh174390">He burned with anger</en>.
<en id="wh174393">Smoke</en> <en id="wh174392">rose</en> <en id="wh174395">from His nostrils</en>,
<en id="wh174396">and</en> <en id="wh174400">consuming</en> <en id="wh174397">fire</en> <en id="wh174398">came from</en> <en id="wh174399">His mouth</en>;
<en id="wh174401">glowing coals</en> <en id="wh174402">blazed forth</en>.
<en id="wh174405">He parted</en> <en id="wh174406">the heavens</en>
<en id="wh174407">and</en> <en id="wh174408">came down</en>
<en id="wh174410">with dark clouds</en> <en id="wh174411">beneath</en> <en id="wh174412">His feet</en>.
<en id="wh174414">He mounted</en> <en id="wh174416">a cherub</en>

<en id="wh174420">He soared</en> <en id="wh174421">on</en> <en id="wh174422">the wings</en> <en id="wh174419">of</en> <en id="wh174423">the wind</en>.
<en id="wh174425">He made</en> <en id="wh174426">darkness</en> <en id="wh174428">a canopy</en> <en id="wh174427">around Him</en>,
<en id="wh174429">a gathering</en> <en id="wh174430">of water</en> <en id="wh174431">and thick clouds</en>.

<en id="wh174433">From</en> <en id="wh174434">the brightness</en> <en id="wh174435">of His presence</en> <en id="wh174437">coals</en> <en id="wh174438">of fire</en> <en id="wh174436">blazed forth</en>.
<en id="wh174442">The LORD</en> <en id="wh174439">thundered</en> <en id="wh174440">from</en> <en id="wh174441">heaven</en>;
<en id="wh174446">the voice</en> <en id="wh174444">of the Most High</en> <en id="wh174445">resounded</en>.
<en id="wh174448">He shot</en> <en id="wh174449">His arrows</en>
<en id="wh174450">and</en> <en id="wh174451">scattered the foes</en>;
<en id="wh174452">He hurled lightning</en>
<en id="wh174453">and</en> <en id="wh174454">routed them</en>.
<en id="wh174457">The channels</en> <en id="wh174455">of</en> <en id="wh174458">the sea</en> <en id="wh174456">appeared</en>,

<en id="wh174460">and the foundations</en> <en id="wh174461">of the world</en> <en id="wh174459">were exposed</en> <en id="wh174462">at</en> <en id="wh174463">the rebuke</en> <en id="wh174464">of the LORD</en>, at the blast <en id="wh174467">of</en> <en id="wh174466">the breath</en> <en id="wh174468">of His nostrils</en>.
<en id="wh174469">He reached down</en> <en id="wh174470">from</en> <en id="wh174471">on high</en>
<en id="wh174472">and took hold of me</en>;
<en id="wh174473">He drew me</en> <en id="wh174476">out of deep</en> <en id="wh174475">waters</en>.
<en id="wh174477">He rescued me</en> <en id="wh174478">from</en> <en id="wh174480">my powerful</en> <en id="wh174479">enemy</en>, <en id="wh174481">from</en> <en id="wh174482">foes</en>
<en id="wh174484">too mighty</en> <en id="wh174483">for</en> <en id="wh174485">me</en>.
<en id="wh174486">They confronted me</en> <en id="wh174487">in</en> <en id="wh174488">my day</en> ... <en id="wh174489">calamity</en>,
<en id="wh174490">of</en> ... <en id="wh174494">but</en> <en id="wh174492">the LORD</en> <en id="wh174491">was</en> <en id="wh174493">my support</en>.
<en id="wh174496">He brought me out</en> <en id="wh174499">into the open</en>;
<en id="wh174501">He rescued me</en>
<en id="wh174502">because</en> <en id="wh174503">He delighted</en> <en id="wh174504">in me</en>.
<en id="wh174506">The LORD</en> <en id="wh174505">has rewarded me</en> <en id="wh174508">according to my righteousness</en>;
<en id="wh174512">He has repaid</en> <en id="wh174513">me</en> <en id="wh174510">according to the cleanness</en> <en id="wh174511">of my hands</en>.
<en id="wh174514">For</en> <en id="wh174515">I have kept</en> <en id="wh174516">the ways</en> <en id="wh174517">of the LORD</en>
<en id="wh174518">and</en> <en id="wh174519">have not</en> <en id="wh174520">wickedly departed</en> <en id="wh174521">from</en> <en id="wh174522">my God</en>.
<en id="wh174523">For</en> <en id="wh174524">all</en> <en id="wh174525">His ordinances are</en> <en id="wh174527">before me</en>;
<en id="wh174529">His statutes</en>.
<en id="wh174530">I have not</en> <en id="wh174531">disregarded</en>
<en id="wh174533">And I</en> <en id="wh174535">have been blameless</en> <en id="wh174536">before Him</en>
<en id="wh174537">and</en> <en id="wh174538">kept myself</en> <en id="wh174539">from</en> <en id="wh174540">iniquity</en>.

<en id="wh174543">So the LORD</en> <en id="wh174542">has repaid</en> <en id="wh174544">me</en> <en id="wh174548">according to my righteousness</en>, <en id="wh174546">according to my cleanness</en> <en id="wh174549">in</en> <en id="wh174551">His sight</en>.
<en id="wh174552">To</en> <en id="wh174553">the faithful</en> <en id="wh174554">You show Yourself faithful</en>,
<en id="wh174555">to</en> <en id="wh174557">the blameless</en> <en id="wh174558">You show Yourself blameless</en>;
<en id="wh174559">to</en> <en id="wh174560">the pure</en> <en id="wh174561">You show Yourself pure</en>,
<en id="wh174562">but</en> <en id="wh174563">to</en> <en id="wh174564">the crooked</en> <en id="wh174565">You show Yourself shrewd</en>.
<en id="wh174570">You save</en> <en id="wh174569">an afflicted</en> <en id="wh174568">people</en>,
<en id="wh174571">but</en> <en id="wh174572">Your eyes</en> <en id="wh174573">are on</en> <en id="wh174574">the haughty</en>
<en id="wh174575">to bring them down</en>.
<en id="wh174576">For</en> <en id="wh174577">You</en>, ... <en id="wh174578">are my lamp</en>;
<en id="wh174579">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh174581">the LORD</en> <en id="wh174582">lights up</en> <en id="wh174583">my darkness</en>.
<en id="wh174584">For</en> <en id="wh174585">in You</en> <en id="wh174586">I can charge</en> <en id="wh174587">an army</en>;
<en id="wh174588">with</en> <en id="wh174589">my God</en> <en id="wh174590">I can scale</en> <en id="wh174591">a wall</en>.
<en id="wh174593">As for God</en>, ... <en id="wh174592">the</en>
<en id="wh174595">His way</en> <en id="wh174594">is perfect</en>;
<en id="wh174596">word</en> <en id="wh174597">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh174598">is flawless</en>.
<en id="wh174600">He</en> <en id="wh174599">is a shield</en> <en id="wh174601">to</en> <en id="wh174602">all</en>
<en id="wh174604">who take refuge</en> <en id="wh174605">in Him</en>.
<en id="wh174606">For</en> <en id="wh174607">who</en> <en id="wh174608">is God</en> <en id="wh174610">besides</en> <en id="wh174611">the LORD</en>?
<en id="wh174612">And</en> <en id="wh174613">who</en> <en id="wh174614">is the Rock</en> <en id="wh174616">except</en> <en id="wh174617">our God</en>?
<en id="wh174619">God</en> ... <en id="wh174620">fortress</en>,
<en id="wh174621">is my strong</en>
<en id="wh174622">and</en> <en id="wh174623">He makes</en> <en id="wh174625">my way</en> <en id="wh174624">clear</en>.

<en id="wh174631">and</en> <en id="wh174634">stations me</en> <en id="wh174632">upon</en> ... <en id="wh174633">heights</en>.
<en id="wh174635">He trains</en> <en id="wh174636">my hands</en> <en id="wh174639">for battle</en>;
<en id="wh174644">my arms</en> <en id="wh174641">can bend</en> <en id="wh174642">a bow</en> <en id="wh174643">of bronze</en>.
<en id="wh174646">You have given</en> <en id="wh174647">me</en> <en id="wh174648">Your shield</en> <en id="wh174645">of</en> <en id="wh174649">salvation</en>,
<en id="wh174650">and</en> <en id="wh174651">Your gentleness</en>
<en id="wh174652">exalts me</en>.
<en id="wh174653">You broaden</en> <en id="wh174654">the path</en> <en id="wh174655">beneath me</en>
<en id="wh174656">so</en> <en id="wh174659">that my ankles</en> <en id="wh174657">do not</en> <en id="wh174658">give way</en>.
<en id="wh174660">I pursued</en> <en id="wh174661">my enemies</en>
<en id="wh174662">and</en> <en id="wh174663">destroyed them</en>;
<en id="wh174665">I did not</en> <en id="wh174666">turn back</en>

<en id="wh174677">they have fallen</en> <en id="wh174678">under</en> <en id="wh174679">my feet</en>.
<en id="wh174681">You have armed me</en> <en id="wh174682">with strength</en> <en id="wh174685">for battle</en>;
<en id="wh174686">You have subdued</en> <en id="wh174687">my foes</en> <en id="wh174688">beneath me</en>.
<en id="wh174690">my enemies</en>
<en id="wh174691">You have made</en> ... <en id="wh174693">retreat</en> <en id="wh174692">before me</en>;
<en id="wh174694">those who hated me</en>.
<en id="wh174696">I destroyed</en>
<en id="wh174697">They looked</en>,
<en id="wh174698">but</en> <en id="wh174699">there was no one</en> <en id="wh174700">to save them</en>
— <en id="wh174701">to</en> <en id="wh174702">the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh174703">but</en> <en id="wh174704">He did not</en> <en id="wh174705">answer</en>.
<en id="wh174707">I ground them</en> <en id="wh174708">as</en> <en id="wh174709">the dust</en> <en id="wh174710">of the earth</en>;
<en id="wh174714">I crushed</en> ... <en id="wh174711">like</en> <en id="wh174712">mud</en> <en id="wh174713">in the streets</en>.
<en id="wh174715">and trampled them</en>
<en id="wh174717">You have delivered me</en> <en id="wh174718">from</en> <en id="wh174719">the strife</en> <en id="wh174716">of</en> <en id="wh174720">my people</en>;
<en id="wh174721">You have preserved me</en> <en id="wh174723">as the head</en> <en id="wh174724">of nations</en>;
<en id="wh174725">a people</en>
<en id="wh174726">I had not</en> <en id="wh174727">known</en>
<en id="wh174728">shall serve me</en>.
<en id="wh174730">Foreigners</en> <en id="wh174731">cower</en> <en id="wh174732">before me</en>;
<en id="wh174734">when they hear me</en>,

<en id="wh174739">Foreigners</en> <en id="wh174740">lose heart</en>
<en id="wh174741">and</en> <en id="wh174742">come trembling</en> <en id="wh174743">from</en> <en id="wh174744">their strongholds</en>.
<en id="wh174746">The LORD</en> <en id="wh174745">lives</en>,
<en id="wh174747">and</en> <en id="wh174748">blessed be</en> <en id="wh174749">my Rock</en>!
<en id="wh174750">And</en> <en id="wh174752">may God</en>, <en id="wh174753">the Rock</en> <en id="wh174754">of my salvation</en>, <en id="wh174751">be exalted</en>—

<en id="wh174761">and</en> <en id="wh174762">brings down</en> <en id="wh174763">nations</en> <en id="wh174764">beneath me</en>,
<en id="wh174766">who frees me from</en> <en id="wh174768">my enemies</en>.
<en id="wh174772">You exalt me</en> <en id="wh174771">above my foes</en>;
<en id="wh174776">You rescue me</en> <en id="wh174773">from</en> <en id="wh174775">violent</en> <en id="wh174774">men</en>.
<en id="wh174778">Therefore</en> <en id="wh174779">I will praise You</en>,
<en id="wh174780">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh174781">among</en> <en id="wh174782">the</en> <en id="wh174783">nations</en>;
<en id="wh174787">I will sing praises</en> <en id="wh174785">to</en> <en id="wh174786">Your name</en>.
<en id="wh174788">Great</en> <en id="wh174789">salvation</en> <en id="wh174790">He brings to His king</en>.

<en id="wh174792">He shows</en> <en id="wh174793">loving devotion</en> <en id="wh174794">to</en> <en id="wh174795">His anointed</en>, <en id="wh174796">to</en> <en id="wh174797">David</en> <en id="wh174799">and</en> <en id="wh174800">his descendants</en> <en id="wh174802">forever</en>.”
<en id="wh174804">These</en> <en id="wh174808">are the last</en> <en id="wh174805">words</en> <en id="wh174806">of David</en>: “<en id="wh174807">The</en>

<en id="wh174809">oracle</en> <en id="wh174810">of David</en> <en id="wh174811">son</en> <en id="wh174812">of Jesse</en>, <en id="wh174815">the</en> <en id="wh174814">oracle</en> <en id="wh174816">of the man</en>
<en id="wh174817">raised</en> <en id="wh174818">on high</en>,

<en id="wh174819">the one anointed</en> <en id="wh174820">by the God</en> <en id="wh174821">of Jacob</en>, <en id="wh174822">and</en> <en id="wh174823">the sweet</en> <en id="wh174824">psalmist</en> <en id="wh174825">of Israel</en>:

<en id="wh176441">But</en> <en id="wh176442">now</en>,

<en id="wh183322">O Lord</en> <en id="wh183323">GOD</en>,

<en id="wh183458">day</en> ... <en id="wh183447">so</en> <en id="wh183448">that He may uphold</en> <en id="wh183449">the cause</en> <en id="wh183450">of His servant</en> <en id="wh183451">and</en> <en id="wh183453">of His people</en> <en id="wh183454">Israel</en> <en id="wh183456">as each day</en> <en id="wh183455">requires</en>,
<en id="wh183459">so that</en> <en id="wh183461">all</en> <en id="wh183463">the</en> <en id="wh183462">peoples</en> <en id="wh183464">of the earth</en> <en id="wh183460">may know</en>

<en id="wh183484">and</en> <en id="wh183485">to keep</en> <en id="wh183486">His commandments</en>.”
<en id="wh183487">as it is</en> <en id="wh183489">this day</en>,

<en id="wh183492">Then</en> <en id="wh183493">the</en> <en id="wh183494">king</en> <en id="wh183495">and</en> <en id="wh183496">all</en> <en id="wh183497">Israel</en> <en id="wh183498">with him</en> <en id="wh183499">offered</en> <en id="wh183500">sacrifices</en> <en id="wh183502">before</en> <en id="wh183503">the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh183504">And</en> <en id="wh183506">Solomon</en> <en id="wh183505">offered as</en> <en id="wh183510">peace offerings</en>
<en id="wh183513">to</en> <en id="wh183514">the LORD</en>

<en id="wh183533">So</en> <en id="wh183532">the king</en> <en id="wh183534">and all</en> <en id="wh183531">the</en> <en id="wh183535">Israelites</en> <en id="wh183527">dedicated</en> <en id="wh183529">the house</en> <en id="wh183526">of</en> <en id="wh183530">the LORD</en>.

<en id="wh183537">On</en> <en id="wh183541">that same</en> <en id="wh183539">day</en> <en id="wh183543">the</en> <en id="wh183544">king</en> <en id="wh183542">consecrated</en> <en id="wh183547">the</en> <en id="wh183546">middle</en> <en id="wh183548">of the courtyard</en>
<en id="wh183551">in front</en> <en id="wh183552">of the house</en> <en id="wh183553">of the LORD</en>,

<en id="wh183560">and</en> <en id="wh183556">there</en> ... <en id="wh183558">the</en> <en id="wh183559">burnt offerings</en>, <en id="wh183562">the</en> <en id="wh183563">grain offerings</en>, <en id="wh183564">and</en> <en id="wh183567">the</en> <en id="wh183566">fat</en> <en id="wh183568">of the peace offerings</en>,
<en id="wh183569">since</en> <en id="wh183571">the</en> <en id="wh183572">bronze</en> <en id="wh183570">altar</en>
<en id="wh183575">before</en> <en id="wh183576">the LORD</en>
<en id="wh183577">was too small</en>

<en id="wh183599">So at that</en> <en id="wh183597">time</en> <en id="wh183594">Solomon</en> ... <en id="wh183593">kept</en> <en id="wh183601">the</en> <en id="wh183602">feast</en>
<en id="wh183603">and</en> <en id="wh183604">all</en> <en id="wh183605">Israel</en> <en id="wh183606">with him</en>—
<en id="wh183608">a great</en> <en id="wh183607">assembly of people</en>
<en id="wh183609">from</en> <en id="wh183612">Lebo-hamath</en> <en id="wh183610">to</en>
<en id="wh183614">the Brook</en> <en id="wh183615">of Egypt</en>—

<en id="wh183617">before</en> <en id="wh183618">the LORD</en> <en id="wh183619">our God</en> <en id="wh183620">for seven</en> <en id="wh183621">days</en> <en id="wh183622">and</en> <en id="wh183623">seven more</en> <en id="wh183624">days</en>— <en id="wh183625">fourteen</en> <en id="wh183627">days in all</en>.
<en id="wh183628">On</en> <en id="wh183631">the</en> <en id="wh183632">fifteenth</en> <en id="wh183630">day</en> <en id="wh183636">Solomon sent the people</en> <en id="wh183633">away</en>.
<en id="wh183638">So they blessed</en> <en id="wh183640">the</en> <en id="wh183641">king</en>
<en id="wh183642">and</en> <en id="wh183643">went</en> <en id="wh183645">home</en>, ... <en id="wh183644">and</en>

<en id="wh183646">joyful</en> ... <en id="wh183648">glad</en> <en id="wh183649">in heart</en> <en id="wh183647">for</en> <en id="wh183651">all</en> <en id="wh183652">the</en> <en id="wh183653">good things</en>

<en id="wh183654">that</en> <en id="wh183656">the LORD</en> <en id="wh183655">had done</en> <en id="wh183659">for His servant</en> <en id="wh183658">David</en> <en id="wh183661">and</en> <en id="wh183663">for His people</en> <en id="wh183662">Israel</en>.
<en id="wh183664">Now</en> ... <en id="wh183665">he</en>
<en id="wh183668">when Solomon</en> <en id="wh183667">had finished</en>

<en id="wh183670">building</en> <en id="wh183672">the house</en> <en id="wh183673">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh183674">and</en> <en id="wh183677">the</en> <en id="wh183678">royal</en> <en id="wh183676">palace</en>, ... <en id="wh183681">all</en> ... <en id="wh183682">had desired</en>
<en id="wh183684">that</en> ... <en id="wh183685">to do</en>,
<en id="wh183686">and</en> <en id="wh183687">had achieved</en>
<en id="wh183690">the LORD</en> <en id="wh183689">appeared</en> <en id="wh183691">to</en> <en id="wh183688">him</en> <en id="wh183693">a second time</en>,
<en id="wh183694">as</en> <en id="wh183696">He had appeared</en> <en id="wh183697">to him</en> <en id="wh183698">at</en> <en id="wh183699">Gibeon</en>.
<en id="wh183700">And</en> <en id="wh183702">the LORD</en> <en id="wh183701">said</en> <en id="wh183703">to him</en>:

<en id="wh183721">which you have built</en>,

<en id="wh183730">My eyes</en> <en id="wh183731">and</en> <en id="wh183732">My heart</en> <en id="wh183729">will be</en> <en id="wh183733">there</en> <en id="wh183734">for all</en> <en id="wh183736">time</en>.
<en id="wh183737">And</en> <en id="wh183738">as for you</en>,

<en id="wh183744">Me</en> <en id="wh183743">as</en> <en id="wh183747">your father</en> <en id="wh183746">David</en> <en id="wh183745">walked</en>, <en id="wh183748">with</en> <en id="wh183750">a heart</en> <en id="wh183749">of integrity</en> <en id="wh183751">and</en> <en id="wh183753">uprightness</en>,
<en id="wh183755">doing</en> <en id="wh183757">all</en>
<en id="wh183759">I have commanded you</en>,

<en id="wh183780">when I said</en>,

<en id="wh183797">and</en> <en id="wh183798">do not</en> <en id="wh183799">keep</en> <en id="wh183800">the commandments</en> <en id="wh183801">and statutes</en>
<en id="wh183803">I have set</en> <en id="wh183805">before you</en>,

<en id="wh183808">to</en> <en id="wh183809">serve</en> ... <en id="wh183811">other</en> <en id="wh183810">gods</en>,
<en id="wh183812">and</en> <en id="wh183813">worship</en>

<en id="wh183824">that</en> <en id="wh183825">I have given</en> <en id="wh183826">them</en>,
<en id="wh183830">temple</en>
<en id="wh183833">and</en> ... <en id="wh183832">I have sanctified</en> <en id="wh183834">for My Name</en>.

<en id="wh183839">this</en> ... <en id="wh183842">Then</en> <en id="wh183841">Israel</en> <en id="wh183840">will become</en> <en id="wh183843">an object of scorn</en> <en id="wh183845">and</en> <en id="wh183846">ridicule</en> <en id="wh183847">among</en> <en id="wh183848">all</en> <en id="wh183850">peoples</en>.
<en id="wh183851">And</en> <en id="wh183855">when this</en> <en id="wh183853">temple</en> <en id="wh183856">has become</en> <en id="wh183857">a heap of rubble</en>,
<en id="wh183858">all</en>
<en id="wh183859">who pass</en> <en id="wh183860">by it</en>
<en id="wh183861">will be appalled</en>
<en id="wh183862">and</en> <en id="wh183863">will hiss</en>
<en id="wh183864">and</en> <en id="wh183865">say</en>,

‘<en id="wh183867">Why</en> <en id="wh183869">has the LORD</en> <en id="wh183868">done</en> <en id="wh183870">such a thing</en> <en id="wh183871">to</en> <en id="wh183875">this</en> <en id="wh183873">land</en> <en id="wh183877">and</en> <en id="wh183881">to this</en> <en id="wh183879">temple</en>?’

<en id="wh183940">King</en> <en id="wh183944">Solomon</en> ... <en id="wh183941">of Tyre</en>, <en id="wh183942">who had supplied</en> <en id="wh183956">him</en> <en id="wh183945">with</en> <en id="wh183947">cedar</en> <en id="wh183948">and</en> <en id="wh183951">cypress</en> <en id="wh183946">logs</en> <en id="wh183952">and</en> <en id="wh183955">gold</en> <en id="wh183957">for his every</en> <en id="wh183958">desire</en>.

<en id="wh184033">to</en> <en id="wh184034">build</en> <en id="wh184036">the house</en> <en id="wh184037">of the LORD</en>, <en id="wh184040">his own palace</en>, <en id="wh184043">the</en> <en id="wh184044">supporting terraces</en>, <en id="wh184045">and</en> <en id="wh184047">the wall</en> <en id="wh184048">of Jerusalem</en>, <en id="wh184049">as well as</en> <en id="wh184051">Hazor</en>, <en id="wh184054">Megiddo</en>, <en id="wh184055">and</en> <en id="wh184057">Gezer</en>.

<en id="wh184062">of</en> ... <en id="wh184063">and captured</en> <en id="wh184065">Gezer</en>.
<en id="wh184067">He had set it</en> <en id="wh184068">on</en> <en id="wh184070">fire</en>,
<en id="wh184073">the</en> <en id="wh184074">Canaanites</en>

<en id="wh184080">killed</en>

<en id="wh184090">So Solomon</en> <en id="wh184089">rebuilt</en> <en id="wh184092">Gezer</en>, <en id="wh184096">Lower</en> <en id="wh184095">Beth-horon</en>,

<en id="wh184099">Baalath</en>, <en id="wh184100">and</en> <en id="wh184102">Tamar</en> <en id="wh184103">in</en> <en id="wh184104">the</en> <en id="wh184105">Wilderness</en> <en id="wh184108">of Judah</en>,

<en id="wh184115">that</en> <en id="wh184118">Solomon</en> <en id="wh184116">had</en>

<en id="wh184131">desired</en>

<en id="wh184204">because</en> <en id="wh184205">they were</en> <en id="wh184206">his men</en> <en id="wh184209">of</en> <en id="wh184208">war</en>, <en id="wh184210">his servants</en>, <en id="wh184212">his officers</en>, <en id="wh184214">his captains</en>, <en id="wh184215">and</en> <en id="wh184216">the commanders</en> <en id="wh184217">of his chariots</en> <en id="wh184218">and</en> <en id="wh184219">cavalry</en>.

<en id="wh184253">that</en> <en id="wh184254">Solomon had built</en> <en id="wh184255">for her</en>,
<en id="wh184257">built</en> <en id="wh184259">the</en> <en id="wh184260">supporting terraces</en>.

<en id="wh184264">Three</en> <en id="wh184265">times</en> <en id="wh184268">a year</en> <en id="wh184263">Solomon</en> <en id="wh184262">offered</en> <en id="wh184269">burnt offerings</en> <en id="wh184270">and</en> <en id="wh184271">peace offerings</en> <en id="wh184272">on</en> <en id="wh184273">the</en> <en id="wh184274">altar</en>
<en id="wh184276">he had built</en> <en id="wh184278">for the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh184280">burning incense</en> <en id="wh184281">with them</en>

<en id="wh184286">So</en> <en id="wh184287">he completed</en> <en id="wh184289">the</en> <en id="wh184290">temple</en>.

<en id="wh184295">King</en> <en id="wh184296">Solomon</en> <en id="wh184293">also assembled</en> <en id="wh184292">a fleet of ships</en> <en id="wh184298">at Ezion-geber</en>, ... <en id="wh184297">in</en>

<en id="wh184299">which</en> <en id="wh184300">is near</en> <en id="wh184301">Eloth</en> ... <en id="wh184308">Edom</en>, <en id="wh184302">on</en> <en id="wh184303">the shore</en> <en id="wh184305">of the Red</en> <en id="wh184304">Sea</en>.

<en id="wh184326">They sailed</en> <en id="wh184325">to</en> <en id="wh184327">Ophir</en>

<en id="wh184328">and</en> <en id="wh184329">imported</en> <en id="wh184332">gold</en> <en id="wh184330">from</en> <en id="wh184331">there</en>— <en id="wh184333">420</en> <en id="wh184337">talents</en>—

<en id="wh184344">Now</en> <en id="wh184345">when the queen</en> <en id="wh184346">of Sheba</en> <en id="wh184347">heard</en> <en id="wh184349">about the fame</en> <en id="wh184350">of Solomon</en> <en id="wh184352">concerning the name</en> ... <en id="wh184353">the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh184354">of</en> ... <en id="wh184355">she came</en>
<en id="wh184356">to</en> <en id="wh184357">test him</en> <en id="wh184358">with</en> <en id="wh184359">difficult questions</en>.

<en id="wh184360">in</en> <en id="wh184362">Jerusalem</en> <en id="wh184363">with</en> <en id="wh184366">a very</en> <en id="wh184365">large</en> <en id="wh184364">caravan</en>— ... <en id="wh184361">And she came</en>

<en id="wh184367">with camels</en> <en id="wh184368">bearing</en> <en id="wh184369">spices</en>, <en id="wh184371">gold</en> <en id="wh184373">in great</en> <en id="wh184372">abundance</en>, <en id="wh184374">and</en> <en id="wh184376">precious</en> <en id="wh184375">stones</en>.
<en id="wh184378">She arrived</en> ... <en id="wh184379">to</en> <en id="wh184380">Solomon</en>
<en id="wh184381">and</en> <en id="wh184382">spoke</en> <en id="wh184383">to him</en> <en id="wh184385">all</en>
<en id="wh184386">that</en> <en id="wh184387">was</en> <en id="wh184388">on</en> <en id="wh184389">her mind</en>.
<en id="wh184392">And</en> <en id="wh184393">Solomon</en> <en id="wh184391">answered</en> <en id="wh184395">all</en> <en id="wh184396">her questions</en>;
<en id="wh184397">nothing</en> <en id="wh184398">was</en> <en id="wh184400">too difficult</en> <en id="wh184401">for</en> <en id="wh184402">the</en> <en id="wh184403">king</en>
<en id="wh184407">to</en> <en id="wh184406">explain</en>.

<en id="wh184410">When the queen</en> <en id="wh184408">of</en> <en id="wh184411">Sheba</en> <en id="wh184409">saw</en> <en id="wh184413">all</en> <en id="wh184414">the wisdom</en> <en id="wh184415">of Solomon</en>, <en id="wh184417">the</en> <en id="wh184418">palace</en>
<en id="wh184420">he had built</en>,

<en id="wh184437">he presented</en> <en id="wh184438">at the house</en> <en id="wh184439">of the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh184445">it took her breath</en> <en id="wh184441">away</en>.
<en id="wh184447">She said</en> <en id="wh184448">to</en> <en id="wh184449">the</en> <en id="wh184450">king</en>,
“<en id="wh184453">The</en> <en id="wh184454">report</en> ... <en id="wh184452">is</en> <en id="wh184451">true</en>.

<en id="wh184456">I heard</en> <en id="wh184457">in</en> <en id="wh184458">my own country</en> <en id="wh184459">about</en> <en id="wh184460">your words</en> <en id="wh184461">and</en> <en id="wh184463">wisdom</en>
<en id="wh184464">But</en> <en id="wh184465">I did not</en> <en id="wh184466">believe</en> <en id="wh184469">these things</en>
<en id="wh184470">until</en> <en id="wh184472">I came</en>
<en id="wh184473">and</en> <en id="wh184474">saw</en> <en id="wh184475">with my own eyes</en>.
<en id="wh184477">Indeed</en>,
<en id="wh184478">not even</en> <en id="wh184482">half</en> <en id="wh184479">was told</en> <en id="wh184480">to me</en>.

<en id="wh184484">Your wisdom</en> <en id="wh184485">and</en> <en id="wh184486">prosperity</en> <en id="wh184487">have far</en> <en id="wh184483">exceeded</en> <en id="wh184488">the</en> <en id="wh184489">report</en>
<en id="wh184491">I heard</en>.
<en id="wh184492">How blessed</en> <en id="wh184493">are your men</en>!
<en id="wh184494">How blessed</en> <en id="wh184496">are these</en> <en id="wh184495">servants of yours</en>
<en id="wh184498">who stand</en> <en id="wh184501">continually</en> <en id="wh184500">before you</en> <en id="wh184499">and</en>
<en id="wh184503">hear</en> <en id="wh184505">your wisdom</en>!

<en id="wh184510">who</en> <en id="wh184511">has delighted</en> <en id="wh184512">in you</en>
<en id="wh184513">to</en> <en id="wh184514">set</en> <en id="wh184515">you on</en> <en id="wh184516">the throne</en> ... <en id="wh184517">for Israel</en>,
<en id="wh184522">Israel</en>. <en id="wh184520">Because of the LORD’s</en> <en id="wh184524">eternal</en> <en id="wh184519">love</en>
<en id="wh184525">of</en> ... <en id="wh184526">He has made you</en> <en id="wh184528">king</en>
<en id="wh184529">to</en> <en id="wh184530">carry out</en> <en id="wh184531">justice</en> <en id="wh184532">and</en> <en id="wh184533">righteousness</en>.”

<en id="wh184536">Then</en> <en id="wh184535">she gave</en> <en id="wh184537">the</en> <en id="wh184538">king</en> <en id="wh184541">120</en> <en id="wh184542">talents</en> <en id="wh184543">of gold</en>, <en id="wh184546">a great quantity of</en> <en id="wh184545">spices</en>, <en id="wh184548">and</en> <en id="wh184550">precious</en> <en id="wh184549">stones</en>.

<en id="wh184551">Never</en> <en id="wh184558">again</en> <en id="wh184555">were spices</en> <en id="wh184557">in such</en> <en id="wh184560">abundance</en> <en id="wh184552">brought in</en> <en id="wh184553">as those</en>
<en id="wh184563">the queen</en> <en id="wh184564">of Sheba</en> <en id="wh184562">gave</en> <en id="wh184565">to</en> <en id="wh184567">King</en> <en id="wh184568">Solomon</en>.
(<en id="wh184571">The fleet</en> <en id="wh184572">of Hiram</en> ... <en id="wh184570">also</en>
<en id="wh184573">that</en> <en id="wh184574">brought</en> <en id="wh184575">gold</en> <en id="wh184576">from</en> <en id="wh184577">Ophir</en>

<en id="wh184578">brought</en> <en id="wh184579">from</en> <en id="wh184580">Ophir</en> <en id="wh184583">a great cargo</en> <en id="wh184582">of almug</en> <en id="wh184581">wood</en> <en id="wh184585">and</en> <en id="wh184587">precious</en> <en id="wh184586">stones</en>.

<en id="wh184590">The</en> <en id="wh184591">king</en> <en id="wh184589">made</en> <en id="wh184594">the</en> <en id="wh184595">almug</en> <en id="wh184593">wood</en> <en id="wh184596">into steps</en> <en id="wh184598">for the house</en> <en id="wh184599">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh184601">and</en> <en id="wh184604">for the king’s</en> <en id="wh184602">palace</en>, <en id="wh184605">and</en> <en id="wh184606">into lyres</en> <en id="wh184607">and</en> <en id="wh184608">harps</en> <en id="wh184611">for the singers</en>. ... <en id="wh184609">to</en>
<en id="wh184612">Never</en> <en id="wh184614">before had such</en> <en id="wh184616">almug</en> <en id="wh184615">wood</en> <en id="wh184613">been brought in</en>,
<en id="wh184618">nor has such</en> <en id="wh184619">been seen</en> <en id="wh184620">again</en> ... <en id="wh184624">this</en> <en id="wh184622">day</en>.)

<en id="wh184627">King</en> <en id="wh184628">Solomon</en> <en id="wh184629">gave</en> <en id="wh184631">the queen</en> <en id="wh184632">of Sheba</en> <en id="wh184634">all</en> <en id="wh184635">she desired</en>

— <en id="wh184640">besides</en>

<en id="wh184653">Then</en> <en id="wh184655">she left</en> <en id="wh184651">and</en> <en id="wh184652">returned</en> <en id="wh184656">to</en> <en id="wh184654">her own country</en>, <en id="wh184657">along with her servants</en>.

<en id="wh184663">that</en> <en id="wh184664">came</en> <en id="wh184665">to</en> <en id="wh184666">Solomon</en> <en id="wh184668">each year</en>
<en id="wh184674">666</en> <en id="wh184675">talents</en>,

<en id="wh184678">not including</en> <en id="wh184681">the</en> <en id="wh184684">revenue</en> <en id="wh184679">from</en> <en id="wh184680">the merchants</en>, <en id="wh184686">traders</en>, <en id="wh184687">and</en> <en id="wh184688">all</en> <en id="wh184690">the</en> <en id="wh184691">Arabian</en> <en id="wh184689">kings</en> <en id="wh184692">and</en> <en id="wh184693">governors</en> <en id="wh184695">of the land</en>.

<en id="wh184699">King</en> <en id="wh184700">Solomon</en> <en id="wh184697">made</en> <en id="wh184701">two hundred</en> <en id="wh184702">large shields</en> <en id="wh184704">of hammered</en> <en id="wh184703">gold</en>;

<en id="wh184705">six</en> <en id="wh184706">hundred shekels</en> <en id="wh184707">of gold</en> <en id="wh184708">went</en> <en id="wh184709">into</en> <en id="wh184713">each</en> <en id="wh184711">shield</en>.
<en id="wh184715">He also made three</en> <en id="wh184716">hundred</en> <en id="wh184717">small shields</en> <en id="wh184719">of hammered</en> <en id="wh184718">gold</en>;

<en id="wh184720">three</en> <en id="wh184721">minas</en> <en id="wh184722">of gold</en> <en id="wh184723">went</en> <en id="wh184724">into</en> <en id="wh184728">each</en> <en id="wh184726">shield</en>.

<en id="wh184729">And</en> <en id="wh184731">the</en> <en id="wh184732">king</en> <en id="wh184730">put them</en> <en id="wh184733">in the House</en> <en id="wh184734">of the Forest</en> <en id="wh184736">of Lebanon</en>.
<en id="wh184740">Additionally, the king</en> <en id="wh184738">made</en> <en id="wh184743">a great</en> <en id="wh184741">throne</en> ... <en id="wh184742">ivory</en>

<en id="wh184780">Twelve</en> <en id="wh184782">lions</en> <en id="wh184783">stood</en> <en id="wh184785">on</en> <en id="wh184787">the</en> <en id="wh184786">six</en> <en id="wh184788">steps</en>, <en id="wh184790">one at either end</en> <en id="wh184793">of each step</en>.
<en id="wh184794">Nothing</en> <en id="wh184796">like this</en> <en id="wh184795">had ever been made</en> <en id="wh184798">for any</en> <en id="wh184799">kingdom</en>.
<en id="wh184801">All</en> <en id="wh184805">King</en> <en id="wh184806">Solomon’s</en> <en id="wh184803">drinking</en> <en id="wh184802">cups</en> <en id="wh184807">were gold</en>,

<en id="wh184808">and</en> <en id="wh184809">all</en> <en id="wh184810">the utensils</en> <en id="wh184811">of the House</en> <en id="wh184812">of the Forest</en> <en id="wh184814">of Lebanon</en> <en id="wh184816">were pure</en> <en id="wh184815">gold</en>.

<en id="wh184820">because it was accounted</en> <en id="wh184819">as nothing</en> <en id="wh184821">in</en> <en id="wh184822">the days</en> <en id="wh184823">of Solomon</en>.

<en id="wh184826">For</en> <en id="wh184830">the</en> <en id="wh184831">king had</en> <en id="wh184827">the ships</en> <en id="wh184828">of Tarshish</en> <en id="wh184832">at</en> <en id="wh184834">sea</en> <en id="wh184835">with</en> <en id="wh184837">Hiram’s</en> <en id="wh184836">fleet</en>,

<en id="wh188842">In his old age</en>, <en id="wh188839">however</en>, <en id="wh188843">he became diseased</en> <en id="wh188845">in his feet</en>.

<en id="wh214041">At the sound</en> <en id="wh214043">of their voices</en> <en id="wh214038">the</en> <en id="wh214037">doorposts</en> <en id="wh214035">and</en> <en id="wh214039">thresholds</en> <en id="wh214036">shook</en>,

<en id="wh214079">Then one</en> <en id="wh214080">of</en> <en id="wh214081">the</en> <en id="wh214082">seraphim</en> <en id="wh214077">flew</en> <en id="wh214076">to</en> <en id="wh214078">me</en>,

<en id="wh214424">Again</en> <en id="wh214425">the LORD</en>

<en id="wh214455">Then Isaiah said</en>,

<en id="wh214494">By</en> ... <en id="wh214493">reject</en> <en id="wh214496">evil</en>
<en id="wh214497">and</en> <en id="wh214498">choose</en> <en id="wh214501">good</en>,
<en id="wh214502">For</en>
<en id="wh214506">the</en> <en id="wh214507">boy</en> <en id="wh214505">knows enough</en>
<en id="wh214508">to reject</en> <en id="wh214511">evil</en>
<en id="wh214512">and</en> <en id="wh214513">choose</en> <en id="wh214516">good</en>,

<en id="wh223794">the</en> <en id="wh223795">palace</en> <en id="wh223793">administrator</en>,

<en id="wh223797">Shebna</en> <en id="wh223798">the</en> <en id="wh223799">scribe</en>, <en id="wh223800">and</en> <en id="wh223801">Joah</en> <en id="wh223802">son</en> <en id="wh223803">of Asaph</en> <en id="wh223804">the</en> <en id="wh223805">recorder</en>,
<en id="wh223809">The Rabshakeh</en> <en id="wh223807">said</en> <en id="wh223806">to</en> <en id="wh223808">them</en>,

<en id="wh249056">of that same</en> <en id="wh249054">year</en>, ... <en id="wh249058">near the beginning</en> <en id="wh249059">of the reign</en> <en id="wh249061">of King</en> <en id="wh249060">Zedekiah</en> <en id="wh249062">of Judah</en>,

<en id="wh249080">who</en> <en id="wh249082">was</en> <en id="wh249081">from</en> <en id="wh249082">Gibeon</en>,

<en id="wh249083">in</en> <en id="wh249084">the house</en> <en id="wh249085">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh249087">in the presence</en> <en id="wh249089">of the priests</en> <en id="wh249090">and</en> <en id="wh249091">all</en> <en id="wh249092">the</en> <en id="wh249093">people</en>:
“<en id="wh249096">This is what</en> <en id="wh249098">the LORD</en> <en id="wh249099">of Hosts</en>, <en id="wh249100">the God</en> <en id="wh249101">of Israel</en>,
<en id="wh249103">says</en>:

<en id="wh249135">and</en> <en id="wh249136">carried</en> <en id="wh249137">to Babylon</en>.

<en id="wh249138">And</en> ... <en id="wh249140">Jeconiah</en> <en id="wh249141">son</en> <en id="wh249142">of Jehoiakim</en> <en id="wh249143">king</en> <en id="wh249149">of Judah</en>, <en id="wh249145">along with</en> <en id="wh249147">all</en> ... <en id="wh249148">exiles</en> <en id="wh249144">from Judah</en>
<en id="wh249150">the</en> ... <en id="wh249151">who went</en> <en id="wh249152">to Babylon</en>,’

<en id="wh249172">Then the prophet</en> <en id="wh249170">Jeremiah</en> <en id="wh249169">replied</en> <en id="wh249173">to</en> <en id="wh249175">the</en> <en id="wh249176">prophet</en> <en id="wh249174">Hananiah</en> <en id="wh249178">in the presence</en> <en id="wh249180">of the priests</en> <en id="wh249182">and</en> <en id="wh249184">all</en> <en id="wh249185">the</en> <en id="wh249186">people</en>

<en id="wh249223">Nevertheless</en>, <en id="wh249224">listen</en> <en id="wh249225">now</en> <en id="wh249229">to this</en> <en id="wh249227">message</en>

<en id="wh249231">I</en> <en id="wh249232">am speaking</en> <en id="wh249233">in</en> <en id="wh249234">your hearing</en> <en id="wh249235">and</en> <en id="wh249236">in</en> <en id="wh249237">the hearing</en> <en id="wh249238">of all</en> <en id="wh249239">the</en> <en id="wh249240">people</en>.
<en id="wh249241">The</en> <en id="wh249242">prophets</en>
<en id="wh249252">old</en> <en id="wh249243">who</en> <en id="wh249244">preceded</en> <en id="wh249250">you</en> <en id="wh249248">and</en> <en id="wh249249">me</en>

<en id="wh249253">of</en> ... <en id="wh249254">prophesied</en> <en id="wh249263">war</en>, <en id="wh249266">disaster</en>, <en id="wh249268">and</en> <en id="wh249269">plague</en> <en id="wh249255">against</en> <en id="wh249257">many</en> <en id="wh249256">lands</en> <en id="wh249258">and</en> <en id="wh249261">great</en> <en id="wh249260">kingdoms</en>.
<en id="wh249271">As for the prophet</en>

<en id="wh249293">Then the prophet</en> <en id="wh249291">Hananiah</en> <en id="wh249290">took</en> <en id="wh249295">the</en> <en id="wh249296">yoke</en> <en id="wh249298">off</en> <en id="wh249301">the</en> <en id="wh249299">neck</en> <en id="wh249300">of Jeremiah</en> <en id="wh249302">the prophet</en>

“<en id="wh249315">This is what</en> <en id="wh249317">the LORD</en> <en id="wh249316">says</en>:

<en id="wh249335">At</en> <en id="wh249337">this, Jeremiah</en> <en id="wh249338">the</en> <en id="wh249339">prophet</en> <en id="wh249336">went</en> <en id="wh249341">on his way</en>.
<en id="wh249344">the word</en> <en id="wh249342">of</en> <en id="wh249345">the LORD</en> <en id="wh249343">came</en> <en id="wh249346">to</en>

<en id="wh249348">But shortly after</en> <en id="wh249350">Hananiah</en> <en id="wh249351">the</en> <en id="wh249352">prophet</en> <en id="wh249349">had broken</en> <en id="wh249354">the</en> <en id="wh249355">yoke</en> <en id="wh249357">off</en> <en id="wh249358">his neck</en>, ... <en id="wh249359">Jeremiah</en>:

<en id="wh249365">and</en> <en id="wh249366">tell</en> <en id="wh249368">Hananiah</en>
<en id="wh249371">that this is what</en> <en id="wh249373">the LORD</en> <en id="wh249372">says</en>:

<en id="wh249426">Hananiah</en>!

<en id="wh249440">Therefore</en> <en id="wh249441">this is what</en> <en id="wh249443">the LORD</en> <en id="wh249442">says</en>:
‘<en id="wh249445">I am about to remove you</en> <en id="wh249446">from</en> <en id="wh249449">the</en> <en id="wh249448">face</en> <en id="wh249450">of the earth</en>.

<en id="wh249455">because</en> <en id="wh249457">you have preached</en> <en id="wh249456">rebellion</en> <en id="wh249458">against</en> <en id="wh249459">the LORD</en>.’”

<en id="wh249474">And in the seventh</en> <en id="wh249472">month</en> <en id="wh249469">of that very</en> <en id="wh249467">year</en>, <en id="wh249463">the</en> <en id="wh249464">prophet</en> <en id="wh249462">Hananiah</en> <en id="wh249461">died</en>.
<en id="wh249476">This</en> <en id="wh249477">is the text</en> <en id="wh249479">of the letter</en>

<en id="wh249507">Nebuchadnezzar</en> <en id="wh249506">had carried into exile</en> <en id="wh249508">from</en> <en id="wh249509">Jerusalem</en> <en id="wh249510">to Babylon</en>.

(<en id="wh249511">This was after</en> <en id="wh249515">King</en> <en id="wh249513">Jeconiah</en>, <en id="wh249517">the</en> <en id="wh249518">queen mother</en>, <en id="wh249520">the</en> <en id="wh249521">court officials</en>, <en id="wh249522">the officials</en> <en id="wh249523">of Judah</en> <en id="wh249524">and</en> <en id="wh249525">Jerusalem</en>, <en id="wh249527">the</en> <en id="wh249528">craftsmen</en>, <en id="wh249529">and</en> <en id="wh249530">the</en> <en id="wh249531">metalsmiths</en> <en id="wh249512">had been exiled</en> <en id="wh249532">from</en> <en id="wh249533">Jerusalem</en>.)

<en id="wh249535">The letter was entrusted to</en> <en id="wh249536">Elasah</en> <en id="wh249537">son</en> <en id="wh249538">of Shaphan</en> <en id="wh249539">and</en> <en id="wh249540">Gemariah</en> <en id="wh249541">son</en> <en id="wh249542">of Hilkiah</en>,

<en id="wh249554">It stated</en>:

<en id="wh249555">This is what</en> <en id="wh249557">the LORD</en> <en id="wh249558">of Hosts</en>, <en id="wh249559">the God</en> <en id="wh249560">of Israel</en>, <en id="wh249556">says</en> <en id="wh249561">to</en> <en id="wh249562">all</en> <en id="wh249563">the</en> <en id="wh249564">exiles</en>
<en id="wh249566">who were carried away</en> <en id="wh249567">from</en> <en id="wh249568">Jerusalem</en> <en id="wh249569">to Babylon</en>:

<en id="wh249572">and</en> <en id="wh249573">settle down</en>.

<en id="wh249583">and</en> <en id="wh249584">have</en> <en id="wh249585">sons</en> <en id="wh249586">and</en> <en id="wh249587">daughters</en>.
<en id="wh249589">Take</en> <en id="wh249592">wives</en> <en id="wh249591">for your sons</en>
<en id="wh249593">and</en> <en id="wh249596">give</en> <en id="wh249595">your daughters</en> <en id="wh249598">in marriage</en>,

<en id="wh249631">For</en> <en id="wh249632">this is what</en> <en id="wh249634">the LORD</en> <en id="wh249635">of Hosts</en>, <en id="wh249636">the God</en> <en id="wh249637">of Israel</en>, <en id="wh249633">says</en>:
“<en id="wh249638">Do not</en> <en id="wh249639">be deceived</en> ... <en id="wh249641">the prophets</en>
<en id="wh249643">by</en> ... <en id="wh249644">among you</en>,
<en id="wh249645">and</en> <en id="wh249646">diviners</en>
<en id="wh249647">and</en> <en id="wh249648">do not</en> <en id="wh249649">listen</en> <en id="wh249650">to</en> <en id="wh249651">the dreams</en>
<en id="wh249653">you elicit from them</en>.
<en id="wh249655">For</en> <en id="wh249658">they</en> <en id="wh249659">are falsely prophesying</en> <en id="wh249660">to you</en> <en id="wh249661">in</en> <en id="wh249662">My name</en>;
<en id="wh249663">I have not</en> <en id="wh249664">sent them</en>,
<en id="wh249665">declares</en> <en id="wh249666">the LORD</en>.”
<en id="wh249667">For</en> <en id="wh249668">this is what</en> <en id="wh249670">the LORD</en> <en id="wh249669">says</en>:
“<en id="wh249671">When</en>
<en id="wh249676">Babylon’s</en> <en id="wh249677">seventy</en> <en id="wh249678">years</en> <en id="wh249674">are complete</en>, ... <en id="wh249675">you</en>

<en id="wh249681">and</en> <en id="wh249682">confirm</en> <en id="wh249685">My promise</en>
<en id="wh249689">to restore</en> <en id="wh249688">you</en> <en id="wh249691">to</en> <en id="wh249695">this</en> <en id="wh249693">place</en>.
<en id="wh249696">For</en> <en id="wh249697">I</en> <en id="wh249698">know</en> <en id="wh249700">the</en> <en id="wh249701">plans</en>
<en id="wh249703">I</en> <en id="wh249704">have</en>
<en id="wh249706">declares</en> <en id="wh249707">the LORD</en>,

<en id="wh249712">for you</en>, ... <en id="wh249710">and</en> <en id="wh249711">not</en> ... <en id="wh249713">harm you</en>,
<en id="wh249714">to</en> ... <en id="wh249715">to give</en> <en id="wh249716">you</en> <en id="wh249717">a future</en> <en id="wh249718">and</en> <en id="wh249719">a hope</en>.
<en id="wh249720">Then</en> <en id="wh249721">you will call</en> <en id="wh249722">upon Me</en>
<en id="wh249723">and</en> <en id="wh249724">come</en>
<en id="wh249725">and</en> <en id="wh249726">pray</en> <en id="wh249727">to Me</en>,
<en id="wh249728">and</en> <en id="wh249729">I will listen</en> <en id="wh249730">to you</en>.
<en id="wh249732">You will seek</en>
<en id="wh249734">and</en> <en id="wh249735">find Me</en>
<en id="wh249738">Me</en> ... <en id="wh249736">when</en> <en id="wh249737">you search for Me</en> <en id="wh249739">with all</en> <en id="wh249740">your heart</en>.
<en id="wh249742">I will be found</en> ... <en id="wh249743">you</en>
by you, <en id="wh249744">declares</en> <en id="wh249745">the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh249746">and</en> <en id="wh249747">I will restore you</en> <en id="wh249749">from captivity</en>

<en id="wh249750">and</en> <en id="wh249751">gather</en> ... <en id="wh249753">from</en> <en id="wh249754">all</en> <en id="wh249755">the</en> <en id="wh249756">nations</en> <en id="wh249761">and places</en> ... <en id="wh249757">you</en>

<en id="wh251154">and</en> <en id="wh251155">tear down</en>,
to demolish, <en id="wh251158">destroy</en>,
<en id="wh251160">and</en> <en id="wh251161">bring disaster</en>,
<en id="wh251162">so</en> <en id="wh251163">I will watch</en> <en id="wh251164">over them</en>
<en id="wh251165">to</en> <en id="wh251166">build</en>
<en id="wh251168">and</en> <en id="wh251169">to plant</en>,”

“<en id="wh251172">In</en> <en id="wh251176">those</en> <en id="wh251174">days</en>, <en id="wh251177">it will no</en> <en id="wh251179">longer</en> <en id="wh251178">be said</en>:
‘<en id="wh251180">The fathers</en> <en id="wh251181">have eaten</en> <en id="wh251182">sour grapes</en>,

<en id="wh251187">Instead</en>, <en id="wh251189">each</en> <en id="wh251192">will die</en> <en id="wh251191">for his own iniquity</en>.
<en id="wh251193">If anyone</en>
<en id="wh251197">eats</en> <en id="wh251198">the</en> <en id="wh251199">sour grapes</en>,
<en id="wh251201">his own teeth</en> <en id="wh251200">will be set on edge</en>.
<en id="wh251202">Behold</en>, <en id="wh251203">the days</en> <en id="wh251204">are coming</en>,
<en id="wh251205">declares</en> <en id="wh251206">the LORD</en>,

<en id="wh251208">when I will make</en> <en id="wh251217">a new</en> <en id="wh251216">covenant</en> <en id="wh251213">with</en> <en id="wh251214">the house</en> <en id="wh251211">of Israel</en> <en id="wh251212">and</en> <en id="wh251209">with</en> <en id="wh251210">the house</en> <en id="wh251215">of Judah</en>.
<en id="wh251218">It will not</en> <en id="wh251221">be like the covenant</en>
<en id="wh251223">I made</en> <en id="wh251224">with</en> <en id="wh251225">their fathers</en> <en id="wh251227">when</en>
<en id="wh251228">I took them</en> <en id="wh251229">by</en> <en id="wh251230">the hand</en>
to lead them <en id="wh251232">out</en> <en id="wh251234">of the land</en> <en id="wh251235">of Egypt</en>— ... <en id="wh251231">to them</en>,”
<en id="wh251240">a covenant</en> <en id="wh251237">they</en> <en id="wh251238">broke</en>,
<en id="wh251242">though I</en> <en id="wh251243">was a husband</en>
<en id="wh251245">declares</en> <en id="wh251246">the LORD</en>.
“<en id="wh251247">But</en> <en id="wh251248">this</en> <en id="wh251250">is the covenant</en>

<en id="wh251252">I will make</en> <en id="wh251253">with</en> <en id="wh251254">the house</en> <en id="wh251255">of Israel</en> <en id="wh251256">after</en> <en id="wh251260">those</en> <en id="wh251258">days</en>, ... <en id="wh251259">the</en>
<en id="wh251261">declares</en> ... <en id="wh251262">LORD</en>.
<en id="wh251263">I will put</en> <en id="wh251265">My law</en> <en id="wh251266">in</en> <en id="wh251267">their minds</en>
<en id="wh251268">and</en> <en id="wh251271">inscribe it</en> <en id="wh251269">on</en> <en id="wh251270">their hearts</en>.
<en id="wh251272">And</en> <en id="wh251273">I will be</en> <en id="wh251275">their</en> <en id="wh251276">God</en>,
<en id="wh251277">and</en> <en id="wh251278">they</en> <en id="wh251279">will be</en> <en id="wh251281">My</en> <en id="wh251282">people</en>.
<en id="wh251284">No</en> <en id="wh251286">longer</en> ... <en id="wh251285">teach</en>
<en id="wh251287">will each man</en> ... <en id="wh251289">his neighbor</en>
<en id="wh251290">or</en> <en id="wh251293">his brother</en>,
<en id="wh251295">saying</en>, ... <en id="wh251294">Me</en>,
‘<en id="wh251296">Know</en> <en id="wh251298">the LORD</en>,’

<en id="wh251299">because</en> <en id="wh251300">they will all</en> <en id="wh251301">know</en> ... <en id="wh251304">from</en> <en id="wh251305">the least of them</en> <en id="wh251303">to</en> <en id="wh251308">the greatest</en>,
<en id="wh251309">declares</en> <en id="wh251310">the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh251311">For</en> <en id="wh251312">I will forgive</en> <en id="wh251314">their iniquities</en>
<en id="wh251316">and</en> <en id="wh251319">will remember</en> <en id="wh251317">their sins</en> <en id="wh251318">no</en> <en id="wh251320">more</en>.”
<en id="wh251321">Thus</en> <en id="wh251322">says</en> <en id="wh251323">the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh251324">who gives</en> <en id="wh251325">the sun</en> <en id="wh251327">for light</en> <en id="wh251328">by day</en>,
<en id="wh251329">who sets in order</en> <en id="wh251330">the moon</en> <en id="wh251331">and</en> <en id="wh251332">stars</en> <en id="wh251334">for light</en> <en id="wh251335">by night</en>,
<en id="wh251336">who stirs up</en> <en id="wh251337">the</en> <en id="wh251338">sea</en>
<en id="wh251341">so that its waves</en> <en id="wh251340">roar</en> ... <en id="wh251339">of</en>
— <en id="wh251342">the LORD</en> ... <en id="wh251343">Hosts</en> <en id="wh251344">is His name</en>:
“<en id="wh251345">Only if</en> <en id="wh251350">this</en> <en id="wh251348">fixed order</en> <en id="wh251346">departed</en> <en id="wh251351">from</en> <en id="wh251353">My presence</en>,
<en id="wh251354">declares</en> <en id="wh251355">the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh251358">would Israel’s</en> <en id="wh251357">descendants</en> ... <en id="wh251359">cease</en>
<en id="wh251365">ever</en> ... <en id="wh251363">to</en> <en id="wh251361">be</en> <en id="wh251362">a nation</en> <en id="wh251364">before Me</en>.”
<en id="wh251368">This is what</en> <en id="wh251370">the LORD</en> <en id="wh251369">says</en>:
“<en id="wh251371">Only if</en> <en id="wh251373">the heavens</en> <en id="wh251376">above</en> <en id="wh251372">could be measured</en>
<en id="wh251377">and</en> <en id="wh251379">the foundations</en> <en id="wh251380">of the earth</en> <en id="wh251382">below</en> <en id="wh251378">searched out</en>

<en id="wh251384">would I</en> <en id="wh251385">reject</en> <en id="wh251387">all</en> <en id="wh251389">of Israel’s</en> <en id="wh251388">descendants</en> <en id="wh251390">because of</en> <en id="wh251391">all</en>
<en id="wh251393">they have done</en>,”
<en id="wh251394">declares</en> <en id="wh251395">the LORD</en>.
“<en id="wh251397">The days</en> <en id="wh251398">are coming</en>,”
<en id="wh251399">declares</en> <en id="wh251400">the LORD</en>,

“<en id="wh251404">when this city</en> <en id="wh251402">will be rebuilt</en> <en id="wh251406">for Me</en>, <en id="wh251407">from</en> <en id="wh251408">the tower</en> <en id="wh251409">of Hananel</en> <en id="wh251412">to the Corner</en> <en id="wh251410">Gate</en>.

<en id="wh251417">The</en> <en id="wh251418">measuring</en> <en id="wh251416">line</en> <en id="wh251415">will once again</en> <en id="wh251414">stretch out</en> <en id="wh251419">straight</en> ... <en id="wh251421">the hill</en> <en id="wh251422">of Gareb</en>
<en id="wh251423">to</en> ... <en id="wh251424">and then turn</en> <en id="wh251425">toward Goah</en>.

<en id="wh251428">The</en> <en id="wh251427">whole</en> <en id="wh251429">valley</en> <en id="wh251431">of the dead bodies</en> <en id="wh251432">and</en> <en id="wh251434">ashes</en>, <en id="wh251435">and</en> <en id="wh251436">all</en> <en id="wh251437">the</en> <en id="wh251438">fields</en> <en id="wh251439">as</en> <en id="wh251441">far as the Kidron</en> <en id="wh251440">Valley</en>, <en id="wh251449">to</en> <en id="wh251445">the</en> <en id="wh251443">corner</en> <en id="wh251446">of the Horse</en> <en id="wh251444">Gate</en> <en id="wh251447">to the east</en>, <en id="wh251448">will be holy</en> <en id="wh251450">to the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh251451">It will never</en> ... <en id="wh251452">be uprooted</en>
<en id="wh251456">again</en> ... <en id="wh251453">or</en> <en id="wh251455">demolished</en>.”
<en id="wh251460">This is the word</en>

<en id="wh251461">that</en> <en id="wh251462">came</en> <en id="wh251463">to</en> <en id="wh251464">Jeremiah</en> <en id="wh251465">from</en> <en id="wh251469">the</en> <en id="wh251467">LORD</en> <en id="wh251468">in</en> <en id="wh251471">the</en> <en id="wh251472">tenth</en> <en id="wh251470">year</en> <en id="wh251474">of Zedekiah</en> <en id="wh251475">king</en> <en id="wh251476">of Judah</en>,
<en id="wh251477">which</en> <en id="wh251480">was the eighteenth</en> <en id="wh251482">year</en> <en id="wh251484">of Nebuchadnezzar</en>.

<en id="wh251486">At that time</en> <en id="wh251487">the army</en> <en id="wh251488">of the king</en> <en id="wh251489">of Babylon</en> <en id="wh251490">was besieging</en> <en id="wh251492">Jerusalem</en>,

<en id="wh251493">and</en> <en id="wh251494">Jeremiah</en> <en id="wh251495">the</en> <en id="wh251496">prophet</en> <en id="wh251497">was</en> <en id="wh251498">imprisoned</en> <en id="wh251499">in</en> <en id="wh251501">the</en> <en id="wh251500">courtyard</en> <en id="wh251502">of the guard</en>,
<en id="wh251503">which was</en> <en id="wh251504">in the palace</en> <en id="wh251505">of the king</en> <en id="wh251506">of Judah</en>.
<en id="wh251509">Zedekiah</en> <en id="wh251510">king</en> <en id="wh251511">of Judah</en> <en id="wh251508">had imprisoned him</en>,
<en id="wh251513">saying</en>:
“<en id="wh251514">Why</en> <en id="wh251515">are you</en> <en id="wh251516">prophesying</en>
<en id="wh251518">You claim that</en>
<en id="wh251519">like this</en>? ... <en id="wh251521">the LORD</en> <en id="wh251520">says</en>,

‘<en id="wh251522">Behold</en>, <en id="wh251523">I am about to deliver</en> <en id="wh251528">this</en> <en id="wh251526">city</en> <en id="wh251529">into</en> <en id="wh251527">the</en> <en id="wh251530">hand</en> <en id="wh251531">of the king</en> <en id="wh251532">of Babylon</en>,
<en id="wh251533">For</en> ... <en id="wh251534">and he will capture it</en>.

<en id="wh251536">Zedekiah</en> <en id="wh251537">king</en> <en id="wh251538">of Judah</en> <en id="wh251539">will not</en> <en id="wh251540">escape</en> <en id="wh251541">from</en> <en id="wh251543">the</en> <en id="wh251542">hands</en> <en id="wh251544">of the Chaldeans</en>,

<en id="wh251545">but</en> <en id="wh251546">he will surely be delivered</en> <en id="wh251548">into</en> <en id="wh251549">the hand</en> <en id="wh251550">of the king</en> <en id="wh251551">of Babylon</en>,
<en id="wh251552">and</en> <en id="wh251553">will speak with him</en> <en id="wh251554">face</en> ... <en id="wh251556">face</en>
<en id="wh251557">to</en> ... <en id="wh251561">and see him</en> <en id="wh251560">eye</en> <en id="wh251558">to eye</en>.
<en id="wh251564">He will take</en> <en id="wh251566">Zedekiah</en> <en id="wh251563">to Babylon</en>,
<en id="wh251568">where</en> <en id="wh251569">he will stay</en> ... <en id="wh251567">him</en>,
<en id="wh251570">until</en> <en id="wh251571">I attend to</en>
<en id="wh251573">declares</en> <en id="wh251574">the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh251575">If</en> <en id="wh251576">you fight</en> <en id="wh251577">against</en> <en id="wh251578">the</en> <en id="wh251579">Chaldeans</en>,
<en id="wh251580">you will not</en> <en id="wh251581">succeed</en>.’”
<en id="wh251584">Jeremiah</en> <en id="wh251583">replied</en>,
“<en id="wh251586">The word</en> <en id="wh251587">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh251585">came</en> ... <en id="wh251588">me</en>,
<en id="wh251589">to</en> ... <en id="wh251590">saying</en>:

<en id="wh251591">Behold</en>! <en id="wh251592">Hanamel</en>, <en id="wh251593">the son</en> <en id="wh251595">of your uncle</en> <en id="wh251594">Shallum</en>, <en id="wh251596">is coming</en> <en id="wh251597">to</en>

<en id="wh251605">in</en> <en id="wh251606">Anathoth</en>,

<en id="wh251622">Then, as the LORD</en> <en id="wh251621">had said</en>, <en id="wh251618">my cousin</en> <en id="wh251617">Hanamel</en> <en id="wh251615">came</en> <en id="wh251614">to</en> <en id="wh251616">me</en> <en id="wh251624">in the courtyard</en> ... <en id="wh251625">the</en> <en id="wh251626">guard</en>
<en id="wh251627">of</en> ... <en id="wh251628">and urged me</en>,
‘<en id="wh251631">Please</en> <en id="wh251630">buy</en> <en id="wh251633">my field</en>
<en id="wh251635">in</en> <en id="wh251636">Anathoth</en>
<en id="wh251638">in</en> <en id="wh251639">the land</en> <en id="wh251640">of Benjamin</en>,
<en id="wh251641">for</en> you own <en id="wh251644">the</en> <en id="wh251643">right</en> <en id="wh251645">of inheritance</en>
<en id="wh251646">and</en> <en id="wh251649">redemption</en>.
<en id="wh251650">Buy it</en> <en id="wh251651">for yourself</en>.’”
<en id="wh251652">Then</en> <en id="wh251653">I knew</en>
<en id="wh251654">that</en> <en id="wh251657">this</en> <en id="wh251655">was the word</en> <en id="wh251656">of the LORD</en>.

<en id="wh251658">So</en> <en id="wh251659">I bought</en> <en id="wh251661">the</en> <en id="wh251662">field</en> ... <en id="wh251663">from</en> <en id="wh251666">my cousin</en> <en id="wh251665">Hanamel</en>,
<en id="wh251669">in</en> <en id="wh251670">Anathoth</en>
<en id="wh251671">and</en> <en id="wh251672">I weighed out</en>
<en id="wh251677">seventeen</en> <en id="wh251678">shekels</en> <en id="wh251679">of</en> <en id="wh251682">silver</en>.
<en id="wh251684">I signed</en> ... <en id="wh251686">the</en> <en id="wh251687">deed</en>,
<en id="wh251688">and</en> <en id="wh251689">sealed</en>
<en id="wh251691">called in witnesses</en>,
<en id="wh251693">and</en> <en id="wh251694">weighed out</en> <en id="wh251695">the</en> <en id="wh251696">silver</en> <en id="wh251697">on</en> <en id="wh251698">the scales</en>.

<en id="wh251699">Then</en> <en id="wh251700">I took</en> <en id="wh251703">the</en> <en id="wh251702">deed</en> <en id="wh251704">of purchase</en>— <en id="wh251706">the</en> <en id="wh251707">sealed</en> <en id="wh251709">copy with its terms</en> <en id="wh251710">and</en> <en id="wh251712">conditions</en>, <en id="wh251713">as well as</en> <en id="wh251715">the</en> <en id="wh251716">open copy</en>—

<en id="wh251717">and</en> <en id="wh251718">I gave</en> <en id="wh251721">this deed</en> <en id="wh251724">to</en> <en id="wh251725">Baruch</en> <en id="wh251726">son</en> <en id="wh251727">of Neriah</en>, <en id="wh251728">the son</en> <en id="wh251729">of Mahseiah</en>, <en id="wh251731">in the sight</en> <en id="wh251733">of my cousin</en> <en id="wh251732">Hanamel</en> <en id="wh251735">and</en> <en id="wh251737">the</en> <en id="wh251738">witnesses</en>
<en id="wh251740">who were signing</en> <en id="wh251743">the</en> <en id="wh251744">purchase</en> <en id="wh251742">agreement</en>
<en id="wh251745">and</en> <en id="wh251747">all</en> <en id="wh251748">the</en> <en id="wh251749">Jews</en>
<en id="wh251751">sitting</en> <en id="wh251752">in</en> <en id="wh251750">the</en> <en id="wh251753">courtyard</en> <en id="wh251755">of the guard</en>.
<en id="wh251761">In their sight</en> <en id="wh251757">I instructed</en> <en id="wh251759">Baruch</en>,
“<en id="wh251764">This is what</en> <en id="wh251766">the LORD</en> <en id="wh251767">of Hosts</en>, <en id="wh251768">the God</en> <en id="wh251769">of Israel</en>, <en id="wh251765">says</en>:

<en id="wh251770">Take</en> <en id="wh251775">these</en> <en id="wh251777">deeds</en>— <en id="wh251785">both the sealed copy</en> <en id="wh251792">and the</en> <en id="wh251790">open</en> <en id="wh251788">copy</en> <en id="wh251781">of the</en> <en id="wh251773">deed</en> <en id="wh251779">of purchase</en>—
<en id="wh251794">and put them</en> <en id="wh251795">in</en> <en id="wh251797">a clay</en> <en id="wh251796">jar</en> <en id="wh251793">to</en>
<en id="wh251799">preserve them</en> <en id="wh251801">for a long</en> <en id="wh251800">time</en>.

<en id="wh251802">For</en> <en id="wh251803">this is what</en> <en id="wh251805">the LORD</en> <en id="wh251806">of Hosts</en>, <en id="wh251807">the God</en> <en id="wh251808">of Israel</en>, <en id="wh251804">says</en>:

<en id="wh251811">Houses</en>, <en id="wh251813">fields</en>, <en id="wh251814">and</en> <en id="wh251815">vineyards</en> <en id="wh251809">will again</en> <en id="wh251810">be bought</en> <en id="wh251816">in</en> <en id="wh251820">this</en> <en id="wh251818">land</en>.”
<en id="wh251823">to</en> ... <en id="wh251822">I prayed</en> ... <en id="wh251824">the LORD</en>:

<en id="wh251825">After</en> <en id="wh251826">I had given</en> <en id="wh251829">the</en> <en id="wh251828">deed</en> <en id="wh251830">of purchase</en> ... <en id="wh251832">Baruch</en> <en id="wh251833">son</en> <en id="wh251834">of Neriah</en>, ... <en id="wh251831">to</en>
“<en id="wh251837">Oh</en>, <en id="wh251838">Lord</en> <en id="wh251839">GOD</en>!

<en id="wh251841">You</en> <en id="wh251842">have made</en> <en id="wh251844">the</en> <en id="wh251845">heavens</en> <en id="wh251846">and</en> <en id="wh251848">the</en> <en id="wh251849">earth</en> <en id="wh251850">by</en> <en id="wh251853">Your great</en> <en id="wh251851">power</en> <en id="wh251854">and</en> <en id="wh251858">outstretched</en> <en id="wh251856">arm</en>.
<en id="wh251859">Nothing</en> <en id="wh251860">is too difficult</en> <en id="wh251861">for You</en>!
