<en id="wh253345">in</en> <en id="wh253346">Jerusalem</en>
<en id="wh253347">to</en> <en id="wh253348">proclaim</en> <en id="wh253350">liberty</en>,
<en id="wh253352">should free</en>
<en id="wh253353">that each man</en> ... <en id="wh253355">slaves</en>,
<en id="wh253357">one</en>
<en id="wh253361">his Hebrew</en> ... <en id="wh253364">both male and female</en>,
<en id="wh253366">and</en> <en id="wh253367">no</en> ... <en id="wh253368">should hold</en> <en id="wh253372">his fellow</en> <en id="wh253371">Jew in bondage</en>.

<en id="wh253376">So all</en> <en id="wh253377">the</en> <en id="wh253378">officials</en> <en id="wh253379">and</en> <en id="wh253380">all</en> <en id="wh253381">the</en> <en id="wh253382">people</en> ... <en id="wh253375">agreed</en>
<en id="wh253383">who</en> <en id="wh253384">entered</en> <en id="wh253385">into</en> <en id="wh253387">this covenant</en>
<en id="wh253389">that they would free</en>
<en id="wh253392">their menservants</en>
<en id="wh253393">and</en> <en id="wh253396">maidservants</en> ... <en id="wh253394">and</en>
<en id="wh253397">released them</en>,
<en id="wh253398">and</en> <en id="wh253399">no longer</en> <en id="wh253400">hold them in bondage</en>.
<en id="wh253404">They obeyed</en>
<en id="wh253409">but later</en> <en id="wh253408">they changed their minds</en>
<en id="wh253411">and</en> <en id="wh253412">took back</en> <en id="wh253414">the</en> <en id="wh253415">menservants</en> <en id="wh253416">and</en> <en id="wh253419">maidservants</en>
<en id="wh253421">they had freed</en>,
<en id="wh253423">and</en> <en id="wh253424">they forced them</en> <en id="wh253425">to</en> <en id="wh253426">become slaves</en> <en id="wh253429">again</en>.

<en id="wh253432">Then the word</en> <en id="wh253430">of</en> <en id="wh253433">the LORD</en> <en id="wh253431">came</en> <en id="wh253434">to</en> <en id="wh253435">Jeremiah</en> <en id="wh253436">from</en> <en id="wh253438">the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh253440">saying</en>,
“<en id="wh253441">This is what</en> <en id="wh253443">the LORD</en>, <en id="wh253444">the God</en> <en id="wh253445">of Israel</en>, <en id="wh253442">says</en>:
<en id="wh253446">I</en> <en id="wh253447">made</en> <en id="wh253448">a covenant</en> <en id="wh253449">with</en> <en id="wh253450">your forefathers</en> <en id="wh253452">when</en>
<en id="wh253453">I brought them out</en> <en id="wh253456">of the land</en> <en id="wh253457">of Egypt</en>, <en id="wh253459">out of the house</en> <en id="wh253460">of slavery</en>,
<en id="wh253462">saying</en>:
<en id="wh253464">Every</en> <en id="wh253465">seventh</en> <en id="wh253466">year</en>, ... <en id="wh253467">of you must free</en>
<en id="wh253468">each</en> ... <en id="wh253470">brother</en>
<en id="wh253472">his Hebrew</en>
<en id="wh253473">who</en> <en id="wh253474">has sold himself</en> ... <en id="wh253475">you</en>.
<en id="wh253476">to</en> ... <en id="wh253477">He may serve</en> <en id="wh253478">you six</en> <en id="wh253479">years</en>,
<en id="wh253480">but</en> <en id="wh253481">then you must let him go</en> <en id="wh253482">free</en>.
<en id="wh253485">But</en> <en id="wh253488">your fathers</en> <en id="wh253486">did not</en> <en id="wh253487">listen</en>
<en id="wh253490">or</en> <en id="wh253492">incline</en> <en id="wh253494">their ear</en>.
<en id="wh253499">Recently</en> <en id="wh253497">you</en> <en id="wh253496">repented</en>
<en id="wh253500">and</en> <en id="wh253501">did</en> <en id="wh253504">what pleased</en> <en id="wh253506">Me</en>;
<en id="wh253508">of you proclaimed</en> <en id="wh253509">freedom</en>
<en id="wh253510">each</en> ... <en id="wh253512">his neighbor</en>.

<en id="wh253513">for</en> ... <en id="wh253514">You made</en> <en id="wh253515">a covenant</en> <en id="wh253517">before Me</en> <en id="wh253518">in</en> <en id="wh253519">the</en> <en id="wh253520">house</en>
<en id="wh253521">that</en> <en id="wh253522">bears</en> <en id="wh253523">My Name</en>.
<en id="wh253526">But now you have changed your minds</en>
<en id="wh253527">and</en> <en id="wh253528">profaned</en> <en id="wh253530">My name</en>.
<en id="wh253532">has taken back</en>
<en id="wh253533">Each of you</en> ... <en id="wh253535">the menservants and maidservants</en>
<en id="wh253540">whom</en> <en id="wh253541">you had set</en> <en id="wh253542">at liberty</en> <en id="wh253543">to</en> <en id="wh253544">go wherever they wanted</en>,
<en id="wh253545">and</en> <en id="wh253546">you have again forced</en>
<en id="wh253553">them</en> <en id="wh253548">to</en> <en id="wh253549">be</en> <en id="wh253554">your</en> <en id="wh253552">slaves</en>.
<en id="wh253556">Therefore</en> <en id="wh253557">this is what</en> <en id="wh253559">the LORD</en> <en id="wh253558">says</en>:
<en id="wh253560">You</en> <en id="wh253561">have not</en> <en id="wh253562">obeyed</en> <en id="wh253563">Me</en>;
<en id="wh253565">you have not proclaimed</en> <en id="wh253566">freedom</en>,
<en id="wh253567">each man</en> <en id="wh253569">for his brother</en>
<en id="wh253572">and</en> <en id="wh253573">for his neighbor</en>. <en id="wh253570">So</en>
<en id="wh253574">now</en> <en id="wh253575">I proclaim</en> <en id="wh253577">freedom</en> <en id="wh253576">for you</en>,
<en id="wh253578">declares</en> ... <en id="wh253579">LORD</en>

<en id="wh253581">the</en> ... — <en id="wh253580">freedom to fall</en> <en id="wh253583">by</en> <en id="wh253582">sword</en>, <en id="wh253587">by</en> <en id="wh253585">plague</en>, <en id="wh253586">and</en> ... <en id="wh253589">famine</en>!

<en id="wh253590">by</en> ... <en id="wh253591">I will make you</en> <en id="wh253594">a horror</en> <en id="wh253595">to</en> <en id="wh253596">all</en> <en id="wh253598">the</en> <en id="wh253597">kingdoms</en> <en id="wh253599">of the earth</en>.
<en id="wh253601">I will treat</en>
<en id="wh253606">And those who have transgressed</en> <en id="wh253608">My covenant</en>
<en id="wh253610">and have not</en> <en id="wh253611">fulfilled</en> <en id="wh253614">the</en> <en id="wh253613">terms</en> <en id="wh253615">of the covenant</en>
<en id="wh253617">they made</en> <en id="wh253619">before Me</en>,
<en id="wh253621">like the calf</en>
<en id="wh253623">they cut</en> ... <en id="wh253625">two</en>
<en id="wh253626">in</en> ... <en id="wh253627">in order to pass</en> <en id="wh253628">between</en> <en id="wh253629">its pieces</en>.

<en id="wh253630">The officials</en> <en id="wh253631">of Judah</en> <en id="wh253632">and</en> <en id="wh253634">Jerusalem</en>, <en id="wh253635">the</en> <en id="wh253636">court officials</en>, <en id="wh253638">the</en> <en id="wh253639">priests</en>, <en id="wh253640">and</en> <en id="wh253641">all</en> <en id="wh253643">the</en> <en id="wh253642">people</en> <en id="wh253644">of the land</en>
<en id="wh253646">who passed</en> <en id="wh253647">between</en> <en id="wh253645">the</en> <en id="wh253648">pieces</en> <en id="wh253650">of the calf</en>,

<en id="wh253652">I will deliver</en> <en id="wh253654">into</en> <en id="wh253655">the hands</en> <en id="wh253656">of their enemies</en> <en id="wh253660">who seek</en> <en id="wh253661">their lives</en>.

<en id="wh253664">Their corpses</en> <en id="wh253663">will become</en> <en id="wh253666">food</en> for the birds <en id="wh253670">of</en> <en id="wh253669">the</en> <en id="wh253668">air</en> <en id="wh253672">and</en> <en id="wh253674">the</en> <en id="wh253673">beasts</en> <en id="wh253675">of the earth</en>.

<en id="wh253676">And</en> <en id="wh253684">I will deliver</en> <en id="wh253678">Zedekiah</en> <en id="wh253679">king</en> <en id="wh253680">of Judah</en> <en id="wh253681">and</en> <en id="wh253683">his officials</en> <en id="wh253685">into</en> <en id="wh253686">the hands</en> <en id="wh253687">of their enemies</en> <en id="wh253691">who seek</en> <en id="wh253692">their lives</en>, <en id="wh253696">to the army</en> <en id="wh253697">of the king</en> <en id="wh253698">of Babylon</en>
<en id="wh253700">that had withdrawn</en> <en id="wh253701">from you</en>.
<en id="wh253703">Behold</en>, <en id="wh253704">I am going to give the command</en>,
<en id="wh253705">declares</en> <en id="wh253706">the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh253707">and</en> <en id="wh253708">I will bring them back</en> <en id="wh253709">to</en> <en id="wh253713">this</en> <en id="wh253711">city</en>.
<en id="wh253715">They will fight</en> <en id="wh253716">against it</en>,
<en id="wh253718">capture it</en>,
<en id="wh253719">and</en> <en id="wh253720">burn it down</en>. ... <en id="wh253722">the</en>

<en id="wh253724">And</en> <en id="wh253728">I will make</en> ... <en id="wh253726">cities</en> <en id="wh253727">of Judah</en> <en id="wh253729">a desolation</en>, <en id="wh253731">without</en> <en id="wh253732">inhabitant</en>.”
<en id="wh253734">This is the word</en>

<en id="wh253735">that</en> <en id="wh253736">came</en> <en id="wh253737">to</en> <en id="wh253738">Jeremiah</en> <en id="wh253739">from</en> <en id="wh253741">the LORD</en> <en id="wh253742">in</en> <en id="wh253743">the days</en> <en id="wh253744">of Jehoiakim</en> <en id="wh253745">son</en> <en id="wh253746">of Josiah</en> <en id="wh253747">king</en> <en id="wh253748">of Judah</en>:
“<en id="wh253751">Go</en> <en id="wh253752">to</en> <en id="wh253754">the</en> <en id="wh253753">house</en> <en id="wh253755">of the Rechabites</en>,
<en id="wh253757">speak</en> <en id="wh253758">to</en> <en id="wh253756">them</en>,

<en id="wh253759">and</en> <en id="wh253760">bring them</en> <en id="wh253763">to</en> <en id="wh253764">one</en> <en id="wh253766">of the chambers</en> <en id="wh253761">of the house</en> <en id="wh253762">of the LORD</en>
<en id="wh253768">to offer them a drink</en> <en id="wh253770">of wine</en>.”

<en id="wh253771">So</en> <en id="wh253772">I took</en> <en id="wh253774">Jaazaniah</en> <en id="wh253775">son</en> <en id="wh253776">of Jeremiah</en>, <en id="wh253777">the son</en> <en id="wh253778">of Habazziniah</en>, <en id="wh253779">and</en> <en id="wh253781">his brothers</en> <en id="wh253782">and</en> <en id="wh253784">all</en> <en id="wh253785">his sons</en>— <en id="wh253790">the</en> <en id="wh253788">entire</en> <en id="wh253789">house</en> <en id="wh253791">of the Rechabites</en>—

<en id="wh253793">and I brought</en> <en id="wh253792">them</en> <en id="wh253795">into the house</en> <en id="wh253796">of the LORD</en>, <en id="wh253797">to</en> <en id="wh253798">a chamber</en> <en id="wh253799">occupied by the sons</en> <en id="wh253800">of Hanan</en> <en id="wh253801">son</en> <en id="wh253802">of Igdaliah</en>, <en id="wh253803">a man</en> <en id="wh253805">of God</en>. ... <en id="wh253804">the</en>
<en id="wh253806">This room was</en> <en id="wh253807">near</en> ... <en id="wh253808">chamber</en> <en id="wh253810">of the officials</en>,

<en id="wh253811">which</en> <en id="wh253813">was above</en> <en id="wh253815">the chamber</en> <en id="wh253816">of Maaseiah</en> <en id="wh253817">son</en> <en id="wh253818">of Shallum</en> <en id="wh253820">the</en> <en id="wh253819">doorkeeper</en>.

<en id="wh253822">Then</en> <en id="wh253823">I set</en> <en id="wh253830">pitchers</en> ... <en id="wh253825">before</en> <en id="wh253828">the</en> <en id="wh253826">men</en> <en id="wh253827">of the house</en> <en id="wh253829">of the Rechabites</en>,
<en id="wh253831">full</en> <en id="wh253832">of wine</en>
<en id="wh253833">and</en> <en id="wh253834">some cups</en>
<en id="wh253835">and</en> <en id="wh253836">I said</en> <en id="wh253837">to them</en>,

<en id="wh253841">they replied</en>,
“<en id="wh253842">We do not</en> <en id="wh253843">drink</en> <en id="wh253844">wine</en>,”

<en id="wh253864">Nor are you ever</en> <en id="wh253865">to build</en> <en id="wh253863">a house</en>
<en id="wh253869">sow</en> <en id="wh253867">seed</en> <en id="wh253868">or</en>
<en id="wh253872">or</en> ... <en id="wh253873">plant</en> <en id="wh253871">a vineyard</en>.
<en id="wh253876">Those things are</en> <en id="wh253875">not</en> <en id="wh253877">for you</en>.
<en id="wh253878">Instead</en>, <en id="wh253881">you must live</en> <en id="wh253880">in tents</en> <en id="wh253882">all</en> <en id="wh253883">your lives</en>, ... <en id="wh253879">in</en>

<en id="wh253892">where</en> <en id="wh253893">you</en> <en id="wh253894">wander</en>.’

<en id="wh253896">And</en> <en id="wh253897">we have obeyed</en> <en id="wh253899">the voice</en> <en id="wh253903">of our forefather</en> <en id="wh253900">Jonadab</en> <en id="wh253901">son</en> <en id="wh253902">of Rechab</en> <en id="wh253905">in all</en>

<en id="wh253908">So</en> <en id="wh253909">we have not</en> <en id="wh253910">drunk</en> <en id="wh253911">wine</en> <en id="wh253912">all</en> <en id="wh253913">our lives</en>— <en id="wh253914">neither we</en> <en id="wh253915">nor our wives</en> <en id="wh253916">nor our sons</en> <en id="wh253917">and</en> <en id="wh253918">daughters</en>.

<en id="wh253925">in which</en> <en id="wh253924">to</en> <en id="wh253925">live</en>,

<en id="wh253936">But we have lived</en> <en id="wh253937">in</en> <en id="wh253939">tents</en>

<en id="wh253949">our forefather</en> <en id="wh253948">Jonadab</en> <en id="wh253947">commanded us</en>.
<en id="wh253951">So when</en>

<en id="wh253954">Nebuchadnezzar</en> <en id="wh253955">king</en> <en id="wh253956">of Babylon</en> <en id="wh253953">marched</en> <en id="wh253957">into</en> <en id="wh253958">the</en> <en id="wh253959">land</en>,
<en id="wh253961">we said</en>:

<en id="wh253964">let us go into</en> <en id="wh253965">Jerusalem</en> <en id="wh253967">to escape</en> <en id="wh253969">the</en> <en id="wh253968">armies</en> <en id="wh253970">of the Chaldeans</en> <en id="wh253971">and</en> <en id="wh253975">the Arameans</en>.’
<en id="wh253977">So we have remained</en> <en id="wh253978">in</en> <en id="wh253979">Jerusalem</en>.”
<en id="wh253982">Then the word</en> <en id="wh253980">of</en> <en id="wh253983">the LORD</en> <en id="wh253981">came</en> <en id="wh253984">to</en> <en id="wh253985">Jeremiah</en>:
“<en id="wh253988">This is what</en> <en id="wh253990">the LORD</en> <en id="wh253991">of Hosts</en>, <en id="wh253992">the God</en> <en id="wh253993">of Israel</en>, <en id="wh253989">says</en>:

<en id="wh253995">and</en> <en id="wh253996">tell</en> <en id="wh253998">the men</en> <en id="wh253999">of Judah</en> <en id="wh254001">and</en> <en id="wh254002">the residents</en> <en id="wh254003">of Jerusalem</en>:

<en id="wh254008">and</en> <en id="wh254009">obey</en> <en id="wh254011">My words</en>?’
<en id="wh254012">declares</en> <en id="wh254013">the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh254016">The words</en> <en id="wh254017">of Jonadab</en> <en id="wh254018">son</en> <en id="wh254019">of Rechab</en> <en id="wh254014">have been carried out</en>.
<en id="wh254021">commanded</en> <en id="wh254023">his sons</en>
<en id="wh254024">to</en> <en id="wh254026">drink</en> <en id="wh254027">wine</en>, <en id="wh254025">and they have not</en>
<en id="wh254028">He</en> ... <en id="wh254029">not</en> ... <en id="wh254030">drunk it</en> ... <en id="wh254035">this very</en> <en id="wh254033">day</en>
<en id="wh254036">because</en> <en id="wh254037">they have obeyed</en> <en id="wh254039">the command</en> <en id="wh254040">of their forefather</en>.
<en id="wh254041">But</en> <en id="wh254042">I</en> <en id="wh254043">have spoken</en> <en id="wh254044">to you</en> <en id="wh254045">again and again</en>,
<en id="wh254051">to</en> ... <en id="wh254048">and</en> <en id="wh254049">you have not</en> <en id="wh254050">obeyed Me</en>!

Again <en id="wh254061">and</en> <en id="wh254060">again</en> <en id="wh254062">I have sent</en> <en id="wh254054">you</en> <en id="wh254056">all</en> <en id="wh254057">My servants</en> <en id="wh254058">the</en> <en id="wh254059">prophets</en>,
<en id="wh254064">proclaiming</en>:
‘<en id="wh254065">Turn</en> <en id="wh254066">now</en>, <en id="wh254067">each of you</en>, <en id="wh254068">from</en> <en id="wh254071">your wicked</en> <en id="wh254069">ways</en>,
<en id="wh254072">and</en> <en id="wh254073">correct</en> <en id="wh254074">your actions</en>.

<en id="wh258591">that</en> <en id="wh258592">I have embedded</en>,

<en id="wh258599">He will come</en>
<en id="wh258600">and</en> <en id="wh258601">strike down</en> <en id="wh258603">the land</en> <en id="wh258604">of Egypt</en>,
<en id="wh258606">to</en> ... <en id="wh258608">destined for death</en>,
<en id="wh258611">bringing death</en> ... <en id="wh258609">those</en>
<en id="wh258614">to</en> ... <en id="wh258616">destined for captivity</en>,
<en id="wh258619">captivity</en> ... <en id="wh258617">those</en>
<en id="wh258622">to</en> ... <en id="wh258624">destined for the sword</en>.
<en id="wh258627">and the sword</en> ... <en id="wh258625">those</en>
<en id="wh258629">I will kindle</en> <en id="wh258630">a fire</en> <en id="wh258631">in</en> <en id="wh258632">the temples</en> <en id="wh258633">of the gods</en> <en id="wh258634">of Egypt</en>,
<en id="wh258635">and</en> <en id="wh258636">Nebuchadnezzar will burn those temples</en>

<en id="wh258640">So he will wrap himself</en> <en id="wh258639">with</en> <en id="wh258642">the land</en> <en id="wh258643">of Egypt</en>
<en id="wh258644">as</en> <en id="wh258648">a shepherd</en> <en id="wh258646">wraps himself</en> <en id="wh258650">in his garment</en>,

<en id="wh258667">and</en> <en id="wh258672">he will burn down</en> <en id="wh258669">the temples</en> <en id="wh258670">of the gods</en> <en id="wh258671">of Egypt</en>.’”
<en id="wh258677">This is the word</en>
<en id="wh258678">that</en> <en id="wh258679">came</en> <en id="wh258680">to</en> <en id="wh258681">Jeremiah</en>

“<en id="wh258707">This is what</en> <en id="wh258709">the LORD</en> <en id="wh258710">of Hosts</en>, <en id="wh258711">the God</en> <en id="wh258712">of Israel</en>, <en id="wh258708">says</en>:
<en id="wh258713">You</en> <en id="wh258714">have seen</en> <en id="wh258716">all</en> <en id="wh258717">the</en> <en id="wh258718">disaster</en>

<en id="wh258719">that</en> <en id="wh258720">I brought</en> <en id="wh258721">against</en> <en id="wh258722">Jerusalem</en> <en id="wh258723">and</en> <en id="wh258725">all</en> <en id="wh258726">the cities</en> <en id="wh258727">of Judah</en>;
<en id="wh258728">and</en> <en id="wh258729">behold</en>, <en id="wh258730">they lie today in ruins</en>

<en id="wh258745">They provoked Me to anger</en>
<en id="wh258747">by continuing</en>
<en id="wh258748">to</en> <en id="wh258749">burn incense</en>
<en id="wh258750">and</en> <en id="wh258752">to</en> <en id="wh258751">serve</en> <en id="wh258754">other</en> <en id="wh258753">gods</en>
<en id="wh258756">that neither</en> ... <en id="wh258757">ever knew</en>.
<en id="wh258758">they</en> <en id="wh258759">nor you</en> <en id="wh258761">nor your fathers</en>

<en id="wh258763">Yet I sent</en> <en id="wh258764">you</en> <en id="wh258766">all</en> <en id="wh258767">My servants</en> <en id="wh258768">the</en> <en id="wh258769">prophets</en> <en id="wh258770">again and again</en>,
<en id="wh258774">saying</en>:
‘<en id="wh258775">Do not</en> <en id="wh258777">do</en> <en id="wh258783">this</en> <en id="wh258781">detestable</en> <en id="wh258779">thing</en>
<en id="wh258784">that</en> <en id="wh258785">I hate</en>.’
<en id="wh258786">But</en> <en id="wh258787">they did not</en> <en id="wh258788">listen</en>
<en id="wh258789">or</en> <en id="wh258791">incline</en> <en id="wh258793">their ears</en>; <en id="wh258790">they did not</en>
<en id="wh258795">turn</en> <en id="wh258796">from</en> <en id="wh258797">their wickedness</en>
<en id="wh258799">or stop</en> <en id="wh258800">burning incense</en> <en id="wh258801">to</en> <en id="wh258803">other</en> <en id="wh258802">gods</en>.
<en id="wh258806">Therefore My wrath</en> <en id="wh258807">and</en> <en id="wh258808">anger</en> <en id="wh258805">poured out</en>

<en id="wh258809">and</en> <en id="wh258810">burned</en> <en id="wh258811">in</en> <en id="wh258812">the cities</en> <en id="wh258813">of Judah</en> <en id="wh258814">and</en> <en id="wh258815">in</en> <en id="wh258816">the streets</en> ... <en id="wh258817">Jerusalem</en>,
<en id="wh258818">of</en> ... <en id="wh258820">so</en> <en id="wh258819">that they have become</en> ... <en id="wh258821">ruin</en>
<en id="wh258825">the</en> <en id="wh258823">desolate</en> ... <en id="wh258826">they are today</en>.
<en id="wh258829">So</en> <en id="wh258830">now</en>,

<en id="wh258831">this is what</en> <en id="wh258833">the LORD</en> <en id="wh258834">God</en> <en id="wh258835">of Hosts</en>, <en id="wh258836">the God</en> <en id="wh258837">of Israel</en>, <en id="wh258832">says</en>:

<en id="wh258838">Why</en> <en id="wh258839">are you</en> <en id="wh258840">doing</en> <en id="wh258842">such great</en> <en id="wh258841">harm</en> <en id="wh258843">to</en> <en id="wh258844">yourselves</en>

<en id="wh258846">by cutting off</en> <en id="wh258854">from</en> <en id="wh258856">Judah</en> <en id="wh258848">man</en> <en id="wh258849">and</en> <en id="wh258850">woman</en>, <en id="wh258851">child</en> <en id="wh258852">and</en> <en id="wh258853">infant</en>,
<en id="wh258859">leaving</en> <en id="wh258860">yourselves</en> <en id="wh258858">without</en> <en id="wh258861">a remnant</en>?
<en id="wh258863">Why are you provoking Me to anger</en> <en id="wh258864">by</en> <en id="wh258865">the work</en> <en id="wh258866">of your hands</en>

<en id="wh258868">by burning incense</en> <en id="wh258869">to</en> <en id="wh258871">other</en> <en id="wh258870">gods</en> <en id="wh258872">in</en> <en id="wh258873">the land</en> <en id="wh258874">of Egypt</en>,
<en id="wh258875">where</en> <en id="wh258876">you</en> <en id="wh258877">have gone</en>
<en id="wh258878">to</en> <en id="wh258879">reside</en>?
<en id="wh258881">As a result</en>, <en id="wh258882">you will be cut off</en>

<en id="wh258884">and</en> <en id="wh258886">will become</en> <en id="wh258888">an object of cursing</en> <en id="wh258890">and</en> <en id="wh258891">reproach</en> <en id="wh258892">among</en> <en id="wh258893">all</en> <en id="wh258895">the</en> <en id="wh258894">nations</en> <en id="wh258896">of the earth</en>.

<en id="wh258898">Have you forgotten</en> <en id="wh258900">the wickedness</en> <en id="wh258901">of your fathers</en> <en id="wh258902">and</en> <en id="wh258905">of the kings</en> <en id="wh258906">of Judah</en> <en id="wh258907">and</en> <en id="wh258910">their wives</en>, <en id="wh258911">as well as</en> <en id="wh258913">the wickedness that</en> ... <en id="wh258914">and</en> <en id="wh258917">your wives</en>

<en id="wh258923">you</en> ... <en id="wh258919">committed</en> <en id="wh258920">in</en> <en id="wh258921">the land</en> <en id="wh258922">of Judah</en> <en id="wh258925">and in the streets</en> <en id="wh258926">of Jerusalem</en>?
<en id="wh258933">this</en> <en id="wh258931">day</en> <en id="wh258927">they have not</en> <en id="wh258928">humbled themselves</en>
<en id="wh258934">or</en> <en id="wh258936">shown reverence</en>,

<en id="wh258947">To</en> ... <en id="wh258945">that</en> <en id="wh258946">I set</en> <en id="wh258948">before you</en> <en id="wh258949">and</en> <en id="wh258952">your fathers</en>.

<en id="wh258953">Therefore</en> <en id="wh258954">this is what</en> <en id="wh258956">the LORD</en> <en id="wh258957">of Hosts</en>, <en id="wh258958">the God</en> <en id="wh258959">of Israel</en>, <en id="wh258955">says</en>:
<en id="wh258961">I will set</en> <en id="wh258962">My face</en> <en id="wh258964">to</en> <en id="wh258965">bring disaster</en>
<en id="wh258967">and</en> <en id="wh258968">to cut off</en> <en id="wh258970">all</en> <en id="wh258971">Judah</en>.
<en id="wh258972">And</en> <en id="wh258973">I will take away</en> <en id="wh258975">the remnant</en> <en id="wh258976">of Judah</en>
<en id="wh258977">who</en> <en id="wh258978">have resolved</en>
<en id="wh258980">to</en> <en id="wh258981">go</en> ... <en id="wh258982">the land</en> <en id="wh258983">of Egypt</en>
<en id="wh258984">to</en> ... <en id="wh258986">to reside there</en>;
<en id="wh258988">they will meet their end</en>. <en id="wh258989">They will all</en>
<en id="wh258993">fall</en> <en id="wh258994">by</en> <en id="wh258995">the</en> <en id="wh258996">sword</en>

<en id="wh259000">or be consumed</en> <en id="wh258997">by</en> <en id="wh258999">famine</en>. <en id="wh259001">From</en> <en id="wh258998">the</en> <en id="wh259002">least</en> ... <en id="wh259005">greatest</en>,
<en id="wh259007">the</en> ... <en id="wh259013">they will die</en> <en id="wh259006">by</en> <en id="wh259008">sword</en> <en id="wh259009">or</en> <en id="wh259012">famine</en>;

<en id="wh259016">to</en> ... <en id="wh259014">and</en> <en id="wh259015">they will become</en> <en id="wh259017">an object of cursing</en> <en id="wh259018">and</en> <en id="wh259019">horror</en>, <en id="wh259022">of vilification</en> <en id="wh259024">and</en> <en id="wh259025">reproach</en>.
<en id="wh259027">I will punish</en>
<en id="wh259030">those who live</en> <en id="wh259031">in</en> <en id="wh259029">the</en> <en id="wh259032">land</en> <en id="wh259033">of Egypt</en>,

<en id="wh259035">just</en> <en id="wh259034">as</en> <en id="wh259036">I punished</en> <en id="wh259038">Jerusalem</en>, <en id="wh259039">by</en> <en id="wh259041">sword</en> <en id="wh259045">and</en> <en id="wh259044">famine</en> <en id="wh259048">and plague</en>,

<en id="wh259049">so</en> <en id="wh259050">that none of</en> ... <en id="wh259056">remnant</en> <en id="wh259057">of Judah</en> ... <en id="wh259051">will</en> <en id="wh259052">escape</en> <en id="wh259053">or</en> <en id="wh259054">survive</en>
<en id="wh259058">the</en> ... <en id="wh259059">who have gone</en>
<en id="wh259060">to</en> <en id="wh259061">reside</en> <en id="wh259063">in</en> <en id="wh259065">Egypt</en>
<en id="wh259067">to</en> <en id="wh259068">return</en> <en id="wh259069">to the land</en> <en id="wh259070">of Judah</en>,
<en id="wh259071">where</en> <en id="wh259072">they</en> <en id="wh259073">long</en>
<en id="wh259076">to</en> <en id="wh259077">return</en>
<en id="wh259078">and</en> <en id="wh259079">live</en>;
<en id="wh259081">for</en> <en id="wh259082">none</en> <en id="wh259083">will return</en>
<en id="wh259084">except</en> <en id="wh259086">a few fugitives</en>.”
<en id="wh259091">Then all</en> <en id="wh259092">the</en> <en id="wh259093">men</en> ... <en id="wh259087">to</en> <en id="wh259090">Jeremiah</en>,
<en id="wh259095">who knew</en>
<en id="wh259096">that</en> <en id="wh259098">their wives</en> <en id="wh259097">were burning incense</en> <en id="wh259099">to</en> <en id="wh259101">other</en> <en id="wh259100">gods</en>,
<en id="wh259102">and</en> <en id="wh259103">all</en> <en id="wh259104">the</en> <en id="wh259105">women</en>
<en id="wh259107">standing by</en>—
<en id="wh259109">a great</en> <en id="wh259108">assembly</en>— <en id="wh259111">along with all</en> <en id="wh259112">the</en> <en id="wh259113">people</en>

<en id="wh259115">living</en> <en id="wh259116">in</en> <en id="wh259114">the</en> <en id="wh259117">land</en> <en id="wh259118">of Egypt</en> ... <en id="wh259119">in</en> <en id="wh259120">Pathros</en>,
<en id="wh259121">and</en> ... <en id="wh259122">said</en>
“<en id="wh259124">As for the word</en>
<en id="wh259126">you have spoken</en> <en id="wh259127">to us</en> <en id="wh259128">in</en> <en id="wh259129">the name</en> <en id="wh259130">of the LORD</en>,

<en id="wh259134">Instead</en>, <en id="wh259136">we will do</en> <en id="wh259138">everything</en> <en id="wh259140">we vowed</en> <en id="wh259135">to do</en>:
<en id="wh259146">We will burn incense</en> <en id="wh259147">to</en> <en id="wh259149">the</en> <en id="wh259148">Queen</en> <en id="wh259150">of Heaven</en>
<en id="wh259151">and</en> <en id="wh259152">offer</en> <en id="wh259154">drink offerings</en> <en id="wh259153">to her</en>,

<en id="wh259155">just as</en> <en id="wh259158">we</en>, <en id="wh259160">our fathers</en>, <en id="wh259161">our kings</en>, <en id="wh259162">and</en> <en id="wh259163">our officials</en> <en id="wh259157">did</en> <en id="wh259164">in</en> <en id="wh259165">the cities</en> <en id="wh259166">of Judah</en> <en id="wh259167">and</en> <en id="wh259169">in the streets</en> ... <en id="wh259170">Jerusalem</en>. <en id="wh259168">At</en>
<en id="wh259171">of</en> ... <en id="wh259172">that time we had plenty</en> ... <en id="wh259173">food</en>
<en id="wh259174">of</en> ... <en id="wh259176">good things</en>,
<en id="wh259177">and</en> ... <en id="wh259180">and we saw</en> <en id="wh259179">no</en> <en id="wh259178">disaster</en>.
<en id="wh259181">But</en> <en id="wh259182">from the time</en> <en id="wh259184">we stopped</en>
<en id="wh259186">burning incense</en> <en id="wh259187">to</en> <en id="wh259189">the</en> <en id="wh259188">Queen</en> <en id="wh259190">of Heaven</en>
<en id="wh259191">and</en> <en id="wh259192">pouring out</en> <en id="wh259194">drink offerings</en> <en id="wh259193">to her</en>,

“<en id="wh259207">Moreover,” said the women, “when</en> <en id="wh259208">we</en> <en id="wh259209">burned incense</en> <en id="wh259210">to</en> <en id="wh259212">the</en> <en id="wh259211">Queen</en> <en id="wh259213">of Heaven</en>
<en id="wh259215">and</en> <en id="wh259216">poured out</en> <en id="wh259218">drink offerings</en> <en id="wh259217">to her</en>,
<en id="wh259221">was it without</en> <en id="wh259222">our husbands’ knowledge</en> <en id="wh259223">that we made</en> <en id="wh259225">sacrificial cakes</en>
<en id="wh259227">in her image</en> ... <en id="wh259226">to</en>
<en id="wh259228">and</en> <en id="wh259229">poured out</en> <en id="wh259231">drink offerings</en> ... <en id="wh259230">her</en>?”

<en id="wh259234">Then Jeremiah</en> <en id="wh259233">said</en> <en id="wh259235">to</en> <en id="wh259236">all</en> <en id="wh259237">the</en> <en id="wh259238">people</en>, <en id="wh259241">both men</en> <en id="wh259246">and</en> <en id="wh259245">women</en>, ... <en id="wh259232">him</en>,
<en id="wh259252">who were answering</en>
<en id="wh259261">you burned</en> ... <en id="wh259258">not</en>

“<en id="wh259263">As for the incense</en> ... <en id="wh259264">in</en> <en id="wh259265">the cities</en> <en id="wh259266">of Judah</en> <en id="wh259267">and</en> <en id="wh259268">in</en> <en id="wh259269">the streets</en> <en id="wh259272">of</en> <en id="wh259270">Jerusalem</en>— <en id="wh259271">you</en>, <en id="wh259273">your fathers</en>, <en id="wh259274">your kings</en>, <en id="wh259276">your officials</en>, <en id="wh259277">and</en> <en id="wh259279">the</en> <en id="wh259278">people</en> <en id="wh259280">of the land</en>—
<en id="wh259283">did the LORD</en> ... <en id="wh259282">remember</en>
<en id="wh259284">and</en> <en id="wh259285">bring</en> <en id="wh259286">this to</en> <en id="wh259287">mind</en>?
<en id="wh259288">So</en> <en id="wh259291">the LORD</en> <en id="wh259290">could</en> <en id="wh259289">no</en> <en id="wh259292">longer</en>
<en id="wh259294">endure</en>
<en id="wh259297">the evil</en> <en id="wh259298">deeds</en> <en id="wh259302">and detestable acts</en>
<en id="wh259304">you committed</en>,

<en id="wh259305">and</en> <en id="wh259307">your land</en> <en id="wh259306">became</en> <en id="wh259309">a desolation</en>, <en id="wh259312">a horror</en>, <en id="wh259314">and</en> <en id="wh259315">an object of cursing</en>, <en id="wh259317">without</en> <en id="wh259318">inhabitant</en>, <en id="wh259319">as it is this</en> <en id="wh259321">day</en>.
<en id="wh259325">Because</en> <en id="wh259327">you burned incense</en>
and sinned <en id="wh259332">against</en> <en id="wh259330">the LORD</en>
<en id="wh259333">and</en> <en id="wh259334">did not</en> <en id="wh259335">obey</en> <en id="wh259337">the voice</en> <en id="wh259338">of the LORD</en>

<en id="wh259342">or</en> <en id="wh259349">walk</en> <en id="wh259346">in</en> <en id="wh259341">His instruction</en>, <en id="wh259344">His statutes</en>, <en id="wh259345">and</en> <en id="wh259347">His testimonies</en>,
<en id="wh259362">this</en> <en id="wh259355">disaster</en> <en id="wh259352">has befallen you</en>, <en id="wh259358">as</en> <en id="wh259360">you see today</en>.”

<en id="wh276366">to</en> <en id="wh276367">profane it</en>.
<en id="wh276369">Yes</en>, <en id="wh276371">they did</en> <en id="wh276368">this</en> <en id="wh276373">inside</en> <en id="wh276374">My house</en>.
<en id="wh276375">Furthermore</en>, <en id="wh276378">you sisters sent</en> ... <en id="wh276380">for men</en>

<en id="wh276530">and</en> <en id="wh276532">all</en> <en id="wh276533">the</en> <en id="wh276534">women</en> <en id="wh276531">will be admonished</en>
<en id="wh276536">not</en> <en id="wh276537">to imitate</en> <en id="wh276539">your behavior</en>.
<en id="wh276541">They will repay</en> <en id="wh276542">you for your indecency</en>,

<en id="wh276548">Then</en> <en id="wh276549">you will know</en>

<en id="wh276559">In</en> <en id="wh276562">the</en> <en id="wh276563">ninth</en> <en id="wh276561">year</en>, <en id="wh276569">on</en> <en id="wh276570">the</en> <en id="wh276571">tenth</en> <en id="wh276574">day</en> <en id="wh276568">of the tenth</en> <en id="wh276566">month</en>, <en id="wh276556">the word</en> <en id="wh276554">of</en> <en id="wh276557">the LORD</en> <en id="wh276555">came</en> <en id="wh276558">to me</en>,
<en id="wh276576">saying</en>,
“<en id="wh276577">Son</en> <en id="wh276578">of man</en>,
<en id="wh276579">write down</en> <en id="wh276584">today’s date</en>,
<en id="wh276590">on this</en> <en id="wh276586">very</en> <en id="wh276588">day</en> <en id="wh276589">the</en>
<en id="wh276596">for</en> ... <en id="wh276592">king</en> <en id="wh276593">of Babylon</en> <en id="wh276591">has laid siege</en> <en id="wh276594">to</en> <en id="wh276595">Jerusalem</en>.
<en id="wh276602">Now</en> <en id="wh276603">speak</en> <en id="wh276602">a parable</en> <en id="wh276604">to</en> <en id="wh276607">this rebellious</en> <en id="wh276605">house</en>
<en id="wh276609">and</en> <en id="wh276610">tell</en> <en id="wh276611">them</en>
<en id="wh276612">that this is what</en> <en id="wh276614">the Lord</en> <en id="wh276615">GOD</en> <en id="wh276613">says</en>:
‘<en id="wh276618">Put the pot</en> <en id="wh276616">on the fire</en>;
<en id="wh276619">put it on</en>
<en id="wh276620">and</en> <en id="wh276622">pour</en> <en id="wh276623">in</en> <en id="wh276624">the water</en>.

<en id="wh276625">Put in</en> <en id="wh276626">the pieces</en> <en id="wh276627">of meat</en>, <en id="wh276628">every</en> <en id="wh276630">good</en> <en id="wh276629">piece</en>— <en id="wh276631">thigh</en> <en id="wh276632">and</en> <en id="wh276633">shoulder</en>
— <en id="wh276636">fill</en> <en id="wh276634">it with choice</en> <en id="wh276635">bones</en>.
<en id="wh276640">Take</en> <en id="wh276638">the</en> <en id="wh276637">choicest</en> <en id="wh276639">of the flock</en>

<en id="wh276648">Bring it to a boil</en>

<en id="wh276654">Therefore</en>
<en id="wh276655">this is what</en> <en id="wh276657">the Lord</en> <en id="wh276658">GOD</en> <en id="wh276656">says</en>:

<en id="wh276663">to the pot</en>
<en id="wh276665">rusted</en>,
<en id="wh276667">now</en> ... <en id="wh276668">whose rust</en> <en id="wh276669">will not</en> <en id="wh276670">come off</en>!
<en id="wh276676">Empty</en> <en id="wh276673">it piece</en> <en id="wh276675">by piece</en>;
<en id="wh276678">cast</en> <en id="wh276677">no</en> <en id="wh276680">lots</en> <en id="wh276679">for its contents</en>.
<en id="wh276681">For</en> <en id="wh276682">the blood she shed</en> <en id="wh276685">is</en> <en id="wh276684">still within her</en>;
<en id="wh276689">she poured it out</en> <en id="wh276686">on</en> <en id="wh276687">the bare</en> <en id="wh276688">rock</en>;
<en id="wh276690">she did not</en> <en id="wh276691">pour</en> <en id="wh276692">it on</en> <en id="wh276693">the</en> <en id="wh276694">ground</en>
<en id="wh276695">to</en> <en id="wh276696">cover</en> <en id="wh276698">it with dust</en>.
<en id="wh276700">In order to stir up</en> <en id="wh276701">wrath</en>
<en id="wh276702">and</en> <en id="wh276703">take vengeance</en>,
<en id="wh276705">I have placed</en> <en id="wh276707">her blood</en> <en id="wh276708">on</en> <en id="wh276709">the bare</en> <en id="wh276710">rock</en>,
<en id="wh276711">so</en> <en id="wh276712">that it would not</en> <en id="wh276713">be covered</en>.’
<en id="wh276714">Yes</en>,
<en id="wh276715">this is what</en> <en id="wh276718">the Lord</en> <en id="wh276717">GOD</en> <en id="wh276716">says</en>:
‘<en id="wh276719">Woe</en> <en id="wh276720">to the city</en> <en id="wh276722">of bloodshed</en>!
<en id="wh276724">I, too</en>, <en id="wh276727">will pile the kindling</en> <en id="wh276725">high</en>.
<en id="wh276728">Pile on</en> <en id="wh276729">the</en> <en id="wh276730">logs</en>
<en id="wh276731">and kindle</en> <en id="wh276732">the</en> <en id="wh276733">fire</en>;
<en id="wh276734">cook</en> <en id="wh276735">the</en> <en id="wh276736">meat well</en>
<en id="wh276737">and</en> <en id="wh276738">mix in</en> <en id="wh276739">the</en> <en id="wh276740">spices</en>;
<en id="wh276743">let the bones</en> <en id="wh276744">be burned</en>.
<en id="wh276746">Set</en> <en id="wh276749">the empty</en> <en id="wh276747">pot on</en> <en id="wh276748">its coals</en>
<en id="wh276750">until</en> <en id="wh276751">it becomes hot</en>
<en id="wh276752">and</en> <en id="wh276754">its copper</en> <en id="wh276753">glows</en>.
<en id="wh276755">Then</en> <en id="wh276759">its impurity</en> <en id="wh276756">will melt</en> <en id="wh276758">within</en>;
<en id="wh276761">its rust</en> <en id="wh276760">will be consumed</en>.
<en id="wh276763">It has frustrated</en> <en id="wh276762">every effort</en>;
<en id="wh276768">its thick</en> <en id="wh276769">rust</en> <en id="wh276765">has not</en> <en id="wh276766">been removed</en>,
<en id="wh276771">even by the fire</en>.
<en id="wh276775">of the indecency</en> <en id="wh276774">of your uncleanness</en>
<en id="wh276776">Because</en> ... <en id="wh276777">I tried to cleanse you</en>,
<en id="wh276778">but</en> <en id="wh276779">you would not</en> <en id="wh276780">be purified</en> <en id="wh276781">from</en> <en id="wh276782">your filthiness</en>.
<en id="wh276783">You will not</en> <en id="wh276784">be pure</en> <en id="wh276785">again</en>

<en id="wh276842">quietly</en>;

<en id="wh276849">on</en> <en id="wh276847">your turban</en>
<en id="wh276852">Put</en> ... and strap <en id="wh276851">your sandals</en> <en id="wh276853">on</en> <en id="wh276854">your feet</en>;

<en id="wh276865">So</en> <en id="wh276866">I spoke</en> <en id="wh276867">to</en> <en id="wh276868">the</en> <en id="wh276869">people</en> <en id="wh276870">in</en> <en id="wh276871">the</en> <en id="wh276872">morning</en>,

<en id="wh276879">and</en> ... <en id="wh276883">And the next morning</en> <en id="wh276880">I did</en>
<en id="wh276884">as</en> <en id="wh276886">I had been commanded</en>.
<en id="wh276891">Then the people</en> <en id="wh276888">asked me</en>,
“<en id="wh276893">Won’t</en> <en id="wh276894">you tell</en> <en id="wh276895">us</en>

<en id="wh276900">you</en> <en id="wh276901">are doing</en>
<en id="wh276902">So</en> <en id="wh276903">I answered</en> <en id="wh276904">them</en>,

<en id="wh276955">Your turbans</en> <en id="wh276956">will remain on</en> <en id="wh276957">your heads</en>

<en id="wh276971">and</en> <en id="wh276972">you will groan</en>

<en id="wh276983">everything</en>

<en id="wh276990">you will know</en>
<en id="wh276991">that</en> <en id="wh276992">I</en> <en id="wh276993">am the Lord</en> <en id="wh276994">GOD</en>.’
<en id="wh276995">And</en> <en id="wh276996">you</en>,
<en id="wh276997">son</en> <en id="wh276998">of man</en>,
<en id="wh277002">know that on the day</en>

<en id="wh277003">I take</en> <en id="wh277004">away</en> <en id="wh277006">their stronghold</en>, <en id="wh277008">their pride</en> <en id="wh277007">and joy</en> — <en id="wh277010">the desire</en> <en id="wh277011">of their eyes</en> <en id="wh277014">which uplifted</en> <en id="wh277015">their souls</en> — <en id="wh277012">and</en> <en id="wh277016">their sons</en> <en id="wh277017">and</en> <en id="wh277018">daughters as well</en>,

<en id="wh280635">of</en> ... <en id="wh280636">They bear</en> <en id="wh280637">their disgrace</en> <en id="wh280638">with</en> <en id="wh280639">those who descend</en> <en id="wh280640">to the Pit</en>.

<en id="wh280764">Pharaoh</en> <en id="wh280765">and</en> <en id="wh280766">all</en> <en id="wh280767">his army</en>, <en id="wh280762">slain</en> <en id="wh280763">by the sword</en>,

<en id="wh280795">Again the word</en> <en id="wh280793">of</en> <en id="wh280796">the LORD</en> <en id="wh280794">came</en> ... <en id="wh280797">me</en>,

<en id="wh280892">coming</en>
<en id="wh280893">and</en> <en id="wh280894">fails</en> <en id="wh280895">to blow</en> <en id="wh280897">the</en> <en id="wh280898">horn</en>

<en id="wh280923">As for you</en>,
<en id="wh280924">O son</en> <en id="wh280925">of man</en>,

<en id="wh280989">Now</en> <en id="wh280990">as</en> <en id="wh280989">for you</en>,

<en id="wh281109">he will die</en>
<en id="wh281110">But</en>
<en id="wh281112">if I tell</en> <en id="wh281114">the</en> <en id="wh281115">wicked man</en>,

<en id="wh291141">For</en> <en id="wh291142">great will be</en> ... <en id="wh291143">day</en> <en id="wh291144">of Jezreel</en>.[’’]
“<en id="wh291145">Say</en> <en id="wh291147">of your brothers</en>,

<en id="wh291150">and</en> <en id="wh291151">of your sisters</en>,

<en id="wh291227">Therefore</en>,
<en id="wh291228">behold</en>, <en id="wh291229">I will hedge up</en> ... <en id="wh291231">path</en> <en id="wh291232">with</en> <en id="wh291234">thorns</en>;

<en id="wh291301">My grain</en> <en id="wh291302">in</en> <en id="wh291303">its time</en>

“<en id="wh291525">On</en> <en id="wh291529">that</en> <en id="wh291527">day</en> <en id="wh291530">I will respond</en> ... <en id="wh291528">the</en>
—” <en id="wh291531">declares</en> ... <en id="wh291532">LORD</en>
— “<en id="wh291533">I will respond</en> <en id="wh291536">to the heavens</en>,

<en id="wh291585">Then the LORD</en> <en id="wh291584">said</en> <en id="wh291583">to</en> <en id="wh291586">me</en>,
“<en id="wh291588">Go</en> ... <en id="wh291587">again</en>,

<en id="wh292918">They have deeply</en>

<en id="wh292933">I found</en> <en id="wh292934">Israel</en> <en id="wh292928">like</en> <en id="wh292929">grapes</en> <en id="wh292930">in</en> <en id="wh292931">the</en> <en id="wh292932">wilderness</en>.

<en id="wh292941">I saw</en> <en id="wh292942">your fathers</en> <en id="wh292935">as</en> <en id="wh292936">the firstfruits</en> <en id="wh292938">of the fig tree</en> <en id="wh292939">in</en> <en id="wh292940">its first season</en>.
<en id="wh292943">But they</en> <en id="wh292944">went</en> ... <en id="wh292945">Baal-peor</en>,
<en id="wh292946">to</en> ... <en id="wh292948">and</en> <en id="wh292947">consecrated</en> <en id="wh292950">themselves to Shame</en>;
<en id="wh292952">so they became</en> <en id="wh292951">as</en> <en id="wh292953">detestable</en> <en id="wh292954">as</en> <en id="wh292955">the thing they loved</en>.
<en id="wh292956">Ephraim’s</en>
<en id="wh292961">glory</en> <en id="wh292960">will fly away</en> <en id="wh292957">like</en> <en id="wh292959">a bird</en>,
<en id="wh292963">with no birth</en>, <en id="wh292966">no pregnancy</en>, <en id="wh292967">and</en> <en id="wh292969">no conception</en>.
<en id="wh292971">if</en> <en id="wh292972">they raise</en> <en id="wh292974">their children</en>,
<en id="wh292976">I will bereave them</en> <en id="wh292978">of each one</en>.
<en id="wh292980">Even</en> ... <en id="wh292979">Yes</en>, <en id="wh292981">woe be</en> <en id="wh292982">to them</en>
<en id="wh292983">when</en> <en id="wh292984">I turn away</en> <en id="wh292985">from them</en>!
<en id="wh292986">Ephraim</en>,
<en id="wh292989">I have seen</en> ... <en id="wh292988">like</en>
<en id="wh292991">Tyre</en>,
<en id="wh292992">planted</en> <en id="wh292993">in</en> <en id="wh292994">a meadow</en>.
<en id="wh292995">But</en> <en id="wh292996">Ephraim</en>
<en id="wh292998">will bring out</en> <en id="wh293001">his children</en> <en id="wh293000">for slaughter</en>.
<en id="wh293002">Give</en> <en id="wh293003">them</en>,
<en id="wh293004">O LORD</en>—
<en id="wh293005">what</en> <en id="wh293006">will You give</en>?

<en id="wh293007">Give</en> <en id="wh293008">them</en> <en id="wh293009">wombs</en> <en id="wh293010">that miscarry</en> <en id="wh293011">and</en> <en id="wh293012">breasts</en> <en id="wh293013">that dry up</en>!
<en id="wh293014">All</en> <en id="wh293015">their evil</en> <en id="wh293018">appears at Gilgal</en>, ... <en id="wh293016">for</en>
<en id="wh293019">for</en> <en id="wh293020">there</en> <en id="wh293021">I hated them</en>.
<en id="wh293027">I will drive them</en> <en id="wh293025">from</en> <en id="wh293026">My house</en> ... <en id="wh293023">the wickedness</en> <en id="wh293024">of their deeds</en>.
<en id="wh293028">I will no</en> <en id="wh293029">longer</en>
<en id="wh293030">love them</en>;
<en id="wh293031">all</en> <en id="wh293032">their leaders</en> <en id="wh293033">are rebellious</en>.
<en id="wh293035">Ephraim</en> <en id="wh293034">is struck down</en>;
<en id="wh293036">their root</en> <en id="wh293037">is withered</en>;

<en id="wh293041">Even</en> <en id="wh293042">if</en> <en id="wh293043">they bear children</en>,

<en id="wh293049">My God</en> <en id="wh293048">will reject them</en>
<en id="wh293050">because</en> <en id="wh293051">they have not</en> <en id="wh293052">obeyed</en> <en id="wh293053">Him</en>;
<en id="wh293054">and</en> <en id="wh293055">they shall be</en> <en id="wh293056">wanderers</en> <en id="wh293057">among</en> <en id="wh293058">the</en> <en id="wh293059">nations</en>.
<en id="wh293062">Israel</en> <en id="wh293061">was a luxuriant</en> <en id="wh293060">vine</en>,

<en id="wh293069">The more his fruit</en> <en id="wh293067">increased</en>, <en id="wh293072">the</en> <en id="wh293070">more he increased</en> <en id="wh293073">the altars</en>.

<en id="wh293081">Their hearts</en> <en id="wh293080">are devious</en>;

<en id="wh293084">The LORD</en> <en id="wh293085">will break down</en> <en id="wh293086">their altars</en>
<en id="wh293087">and demolish</en> <en id="wh293088">their sacred pillars</en>.
<en id="wh293089">Surely</en> <en id="wh293090">now</en> <en id="wh293091">they will say</en>,
“<en id="wh293094">We have</en> <en id="wh293092">no</en> <en id="wh293093">king</en>,
<en id="wh293095">for</en> <en id="wh293096">we do not</en> <en id="wh293097">revere</en> ... <en id="wh293099">LORD</en>.
<en id="wh293101">the</en> ... <en id="wh293102">can a king</en>
<en id="wh293103">What</en> ... <en id="wh293104">do</en> <en id="wh293105">for us</en>?”
<en id="wh293106">They speak</en> <en id="wh293107">mere words</en>;

<en id="wh293117">So judgment</en> <en id="wh293113">springs up</en> <en id="wh293114">like</en> <en id="wh293116">poisonous weeds</en> <en id="wh293118">in</en> <en id="wh293115">the</en> <en id="wh293119">furrows</en> <en id="wh293120">of a field</en>.
<en id="wh293126">of Samaria</en> <en id="wh293124">will fear</en> <en id="wh293122">for the calf</en> ... <en id="wh293123">Beth-aven</en>. ... <en id="wh293125">its people</en>

<en id="wh293135">in</en> <en id="wh293136">its glory</en>

<en id="wh293140">Yes</en>, <en id="wh293144">it will be carried</en> <en id="wh293142">to</en> <en id="wh293143">Assyria</en>
<en id="wh293145">as tribute</en> <en id="wh293146">to</en> <en id="wh293148">the great</en> <en id="wh293147">king</en>.
<en id="wh293150">Ephraim</en> <en id="wh293151">will be seized</en> <en id="wh293149">with shame</en>;

<en id="wh293159">with her king</en> <en id="wh293160">like</en> <en id="wh293161">a twig</en> <en id="wh293162">on</en> <en id="wh293163">the surface</en> <en id="wh293164">of the water</en>.
<en id="wh293167">The high places</en> <en id="wh293168">of Aven</en> <en id="wh293166">will be destroyed</en>— <en id="wh293169">it is the sin</en> <en id="wh293170">of Israel</en>;
<en id="wh293171">thorns</en> <en id="wh293172">and</en> <en id="wh293173">thistles</en> <en id="wh293174">will overgrow</en> <en id="wh293176">their altars</en>.
<en id="wh293177">Then</en> <en id="wh293178">they will say</en> <en id="wh293179">to</en> <en id="wh293180">the</en> <en id="wh293181">mountains</en>,
“<en id="wh293182">Cover us</en>!”
<en id="wh293184">and</en> <en id="wh293186">to the hills</en>,
“<en id="wh293187">Fall</en> <en id="wh293188">on us</en>!”
<en id="wh293190">Since the days</en> <en id="wh293192">of Gibeah</en> <en id="wh293193">you have sinned</en>,
<en id="wh293194">O Israel</en>,
<en id="wh293195">and there</en> <en id="wh293196">you have remained</en>.

<en id="wh293197">Did not</en> <en id="wh293200">the</en> <en id="wh293202">battle</en> <en id="wh293199">in</en> <en id="wh293201">Gibeah</en> <en id="wh293198">overtake</en> <en id="wh293204">the sons</en> <en id="wh293205">of iniquity</en>?
<en id="wh293206">when</en> <en id="wh293207">I please</en>;
<en id="wh293209">I will chasten them</en>
<en id="wh293213">nations</en> <en id="wh293211">will be gathered</en> <en id="wh293212">against them</en>
<en id="wh293216">to</en> <en id="wh293215">put them in bondage</en> <en id="wh293217">for their double</en> <en id="wh293218">transgression</en>.
<en id="wh293220">Ephraim</en> <en id="wh293222">is a well-trained</en> <en id="wh293221">heifer</en>
<en id="wh293223">that loves</en>
<en id="wh293224">to</en> <en id="wh293225">thresh</en>;
<en id="wh293227">but I</en> <en id="wh293228">will place a yoke</en> <en id="wh293229">on</en> <en id="wh293230">her fair</en> <en id="wh293231">neck</en>.
<en id="wh293232">I will harness</en> <en id="wh293233">Ephraim</en>,
<en id="wh293235">Judah</en> <en id="wh293234">will plow</en>,
<en id="wh293237">and</en> <en id="wh293238">Jacob</en> <en id="wh293236">will break the hard ground</en>.
<en id="wh293239">Sow</en> <en id="wh293240">for yourselves</en> <en id="wh293242">righteousness</en> <en id="wh293241">and</en>
<en id="wh293243">reap the fruit</en> <en id="wh293246">of loving devotion</en>;
<en id="wh293247">break up</en> <en id="wh293248">your</en> <en id="wh293249">unplowed ground</en>.
<en id="wh293251">For it is time</en>
<en id="wh293252">to</en> <en id="wh293253">seek</en> <en id="wh293255">the LORD</en>

<en id="wh293262">You have plowed</en> <en id="wh293263">wickedness</en>
<en id="wh293265">and reaped</en> <en id="wh293264">injustice</en>;
<en id="wh293266">you have eaten</en> <en id="wh293267">the fruit</en> <en id="wh293268">of lies</en>.

<en id="wh293269">Because</en> <en id="wh293270">you have trusted</en> <en id="wh293271">in</en> <en id="wh293272">your own way</en> <en id="wh293274">and in the multitude</en> <en id="wh293275">of your mighty men</en>,
<en id="wh293278">the roar of battle</en> <en id="wh293277">will rise</en> <en id="wh293280">against your people</en>,
<en id="wh293281">so</en> <en id="wh293282">that all</en> <en id="wh293283">your fortresses</en> <en id="wh293284">will be demolished</en>

<en id="wh293296">Thus</en> <en id="wh293297">it will be done</en> <en id="wh293298">to you</en>,
<en id="wh293299">O Bethel</en>,

<en id="wh293304">When</en> <en id="wh293306">the day dawns</en>, <en id="wh293305">the</en> <en id="wh293309">king</en> <en id="wh293310">of Israel</en> <en id="wh293307">will</en> <en id="wh293308">be utterly cut off</en>.
<en id="wh293311">When</en> <en id="wh293313">Israel</en> <en id="wh293312">was a child</en>,
<en id="wh293315">I loved him</en>,
<en id="wh293316">and</en> <en id="wh293318">out of Egypt</en> <en id="wh293319">I called</en> <en id="wh293321">My son</en>.
<en id="wh293322">But the more I called</en> <en id="wh293323">Israel</en>,
<en id="wh293324">the farther</en> <en id="wh293325">they departed</en> <en id="wh293326">from</en> <en id="wh293327">Me</en>.
<en id="wh293331">They sacrificed</en> <en id="wh293328">to</en> <en id="wh293329">the</en> <en id="wh293330">Baals</en>
<en id="wh293333">and</en> <en id="wh293336">burned incense</en> <en id="wh293335">to carved images</en>.
<en id="wh293338">It was I</en> <en id="wh293341">who taught Ephraim</en> <en id="wh293340">to</en> <en id="wh293339">walk</en>,

<en id="wh293345">but</en> <en id="wh293346">they never</en> <en id="wh293347">realized</en>

<en id="wh293361">I lifted</en> <en id="wh293362">the yoke</en> ... <en id="wh293364">their necks</en>

<en id="wh293368">feed them</en>.
<en id="wh293369">Will they not</en> <en id="wh293370">return</en> <en id="wh293371">to</en> <en id="wh293372">the land</en> <en id="wh293373">of Egypt</en>
<en id="wh293374">and</en> ... <en id="wh293375">by Assyria</en>
<en id="wh293377">be ruled</en>
<en id="wh293378">because</en> <en id="wh293379">they refused</en>
<en id="wh293380">to</en> <en id="wh293381">repent</en>?
<en id="wh293384">A sword</en> <en id="wh293383">will flash</en> <en id="wh293386">through their cities</en>;
<en id="wh293388">it will destroy</en> <en id="wh293389">the bars of their gates</en>
<en id="wh293390">and</en> <en id="wh293391">consume them</en> <en id="wh293393">in their own plans</en>.
<en id="wh293395">My people</en> <en id="wh293396">are bent</en> <en id="wh293398">on turning from Me</en>.
<en id="wh293402">Though they call</en> <en id="wh293400">to</en> <en id="wh293401">the Most High</en>,
<en id="wh293404">He will by no means</en> <en id="wh293405">exalt them</en>.
<en id="wh293406">How</en> <en id="wh293407">could I give you up</en>,
<en id="wh293408">O Ephraim</en>?
<en id="wh293409">How could I surrender you</en>,
<en id="wh293410">O Israel</en>?
<en id="wh293411">How</en> <en id="wh293412">could I make</en> <en id="wh293414">you like Admah</en>?
<en id="wh293415">How could I treat</en> <en id="wh293417">you like Zeboiim</en>?
<en id="wh293420">My heart</en> <en id="wh293418">is turned</en> <en id="wh293419">within Me</en>;
<en id="wh293423">My compassion</en> <en id="wh293422">is stirred</en>!
<en id="wh293424">I will not</en> <en id="wh293425">execute</en> <en id="wh293426">the full fury</en> <en id="wh293427">of My anger</en>;
<en id="wh293428">I will not</en> ... <en id="wh293429">again</en>.
<en id="wh293431">destroy</en> <en id="wh293432">Ephraim</en>
<en id="wh293433">For</en> <en id="wh293435">I</en> <en id="wh293434">am God</en>
<en id="wh293436">and</en> <en id="wh293437">not</en> <en id="wh293438">man</en>
— <en id="wh293441">the Holy</en> <en id="wh293440">One among you</en>
— <en id="wh293442">and</en> <en id="wh293443">I will not</en> <en id="wh293444">come</en> <en id="wh293445">in</en> <en id="wh293446">wrath</en>.
<en id="wh293447">They will walk after</en> <en id="wh293448">the LORD</en>;
<en id="wh293452">He will roar</en> <en id="wh293450">like</en> <en id="wh293451">a lion</en>.
<en id="wh293453">When</en> <en id="wh293454">He</en> <en id="wh293455">roars</en>,
<en id="wh293458">His children</en> <en id="wh293457">will come trembling</en> <en id="wh293459">from</en> <en id="wh293460">the west</en>.
<en id="wh293461">They will come trembling</en> <en id="wh293462">like</en> <en id="wh293463">birds</en> <en id="wh293464">from</en> <en id="wh293465">Egypt</en>
<en id="wh293466">and</en> <en id="wh293467">like</en> <en id="wh293468">doves</en> <en id="wh293469">from</en> <en id="wh293470">the land</en> <en id="wh293471">of Assyria</en>.
<en id="wh293472">Then</en> <en id="wh293473">I will settle them</en> <en id="wh293474">in</en> <en id="wh293475">their homes</en>,
<en id="wh293476">declares</en> <en id="wh293477">the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh293481">Ephraim</en> <en id="wh293478">surrounds Me</en> <en id="wh293479">with</en> <en id="wh293480">lies</en>,
<en id="wh293485">the house</en> <en id="wh293486">of Israel</en> <en id="wh293483">with</en> <en id="wh293484">deceit</en>;
<en id="wh293487">but</en> <en id="wh293488">Judah</en> <en id="wh293489">still</en> <en id="wh293490">walks</en> <en id="wh293491">with</en> <en id="wh293492">God</en>
<en id="wh293493">and</en> <en id="wh293496">is faithful</en> <en id="wh293494">to</en> <en id="wh293495">the Holy One</en>.
<en id="wh293497">Ephraim</en> <en id="wh293498">feeds on</en> <en id="wh293499">the wind</en>
<en id="wh293500">and</en> <en id="wh293501">pursues</en> <en id="wh293504">the</en> <en id="wh293502">east wind</en> <en id="wh293503">all</en> <en id="wh293505">day long</en>;

<en id="wh293523">The LORD</en> <en id="wh293521">has a charge</en> <en id="wh293522">to</en> <en id="wh293521">bring</en> <en id="wh293524">against</en> <en id="wh293525">Judah</en>.

<en id="wh293537">In</en> <en id="wh293538">the</en> <en id="wh293539">womb</en> <en id="wh293542">he grasped his brother’s</en> <en id="wh293540">heel</en>,
<en id="wh293545">and in his vigor</en> <en id="wh293546">he wrestled</en> <en id="wh293543">with</en> <en id="wh293548">God</en>.
<en id="wh293550">Yes, he struggled</en> ... <en id="wh293552">the angel</en>
<en id="wh293553">and</en> <en id="wh293554">prevailed</en>;
<en id="wh293555">he wept</en>
<en id="wh293556">and</en> <en id="wh293557">sought His favor</en>; ... <en id="wh293558">with Him</en>

<en id="wh294292">Has not</en> <en id="wh294295">the food</en> <en id="wh294296">been cut off</en> <en id="wh294293">before</en> <en id="wh294294">our very eyes</en>
— <en id="wh294300">joy</en> <en id="wh294301">and</en> <en id="wh294302">gladness</en> <en id="wh294297">from</en> <en id="wh294298">the house</en> <en id="wh294299">of our God</en>?
<en id="wh294304">The seeds</en> <en id="wh294303">lie shriveled</en> <en id="wh294305">beneath</en> <en id="wh294306">the clods</en>;

<en id="wh294324">Even</en> <en id="wh294326">the</en> <en id="wh294325">flocks</en> <en id="wh294327">of sheep</en> <en id="wh294328">are suffering</en>.
<en id="wh294329">To You</en>,
<en id="wh294330">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh294331">I call</en>,

<en id="wh294359">Blow</en> <en id="wh294360">the ram’s horn</en> <en id="wh294361">in</en> <en id="wh294362">Zion</en>;
<en id="wh294364">sound the alarm</en> <en id="wh294365">on</en> <en id="wh294367">My holy</en> <en id="wh294366">mountain</en>!
<en id="wh294369">Let all</en> <en id="wh294370">who dwell</en> <en id="wh294372">in the land</en> <en id="wh294368">tremble</en>, ... <en id="wh294371">the</en>

<en id="wh294387">Like</en> <en id="wh294388">the dawn</en>

<en id="wh294487">not</en> <en id="wh294488">swerving</en> <en id="wh294489">from the course</en>.
<en id="wh294491">one</en> <en id="wh294492">another</en>;
<en id="wh294493">They do not</en> <en id="wh294494">jostle</en>
<en id="wh294495">each</en> <en id="wh294498">proceeds</en> <en id="wh294496">in</en> <en id="wh294497">his path</en>.

<en id="wh294546">Indeed</en>, <en id="wh294549">His camp</en> <en id="wh294548">is very</en> <en id="wh294547">large</en>,

<en id="wh294754">And</en> <en id="wh294756">its stench</en> ... <en id="wh294755">will ascend</en>.

<en id="wh294760">For</en> ... <en id="wh294761">great things</en>.

<en id="wh294764">Do not</en> <en id="wh294765">be afraid</en>,
<en id="wh294766">O land</en>;
<en id="wh294767">be glad</en>,
<en id="wh294769">rejoice</en> <en id="wh294768">and</en>
<en id="wh294770">for</en> <en id="wh294772">the LORD</en> ... <en id="wh294771">great things</en>.
<en id="wh294774">has done</en>

<en id="wh294779">for</en> <en id="wh294782">the open</en> <en id="wh294781">pastures</en> <en id="wh294780">have turned green</en>,
<en id="wh294784">the trees</en> <en id="wh294785">bear</en> <en id="wh294786">their fruit</en>,

<en id="wh294796">and</en> <en id="wh294797">rejoice</en> <en id="wh294798">in</en> <en id="wh294799">the LORD</en> <en id="wh294800">your God</en>,

<en id="wh314279">For</en> <en id="wh314280">I</en> <en id="wh314283">have walked</en> <en id="wh314281">with</en> <en id="wh314282">integrity</en>;
<en id="wh314287">I have trusted</en> <en id="wh314285">in</en> <en id="wh314286">the LORD</en>
<en id="wh314288">without</en> <en id="wh314289">wavering</en>.
<en id="wh314290">Test me</en>,
<en id="wh314291">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314292">and</en> <en id="wh314293">try me</en>;
<en id="wh314294">examine</en> <en id="wh314297">my heart</en> <en id="wh314296">and</en> <en id="wh314295">mind</en>.
<en id="wh314298">For</en> <en id="wh314299">Your loving devotion</en> <en id="wh314301">is before</en> <en id="wh314302">my eyes</en>,
<en id="wh314303">and</en> <en id="wh314304">I have walked</en> <en id="wh314305">in</en> <en id="wh314306">Your truth</en>.
<en id="wh314307">I do not</en> <en id="wh314308">sit</en> <en id="wh314309">with</en> <en id="wh314311">deceitful</en> <en id="wh314310">men</en>,
<en id="wh314315">nor</en> <en id="wh314316">keep company</en> <en id="wh314313">with</en> <en id="wh314314">hypocrites</en>.
<en id="wh314317">I hate</en> <en id="wh314318">the mob</en> <en id="wh314319">of evildoers</en>,
<en id="wh314320">and</en> <en id="wh314323">refuse</en> <en id="wh314324">to sit</en> <en id="wh314321">with</en> <en id="wh314322">the wicked</en>.
<en id="wh314325">I wash</en> <en id="wh314328">my hands</en> <en id="wh314326">in</en> <en id="wh314327">innocence</en>
<en id="wh314330">that I may go about</en> <en id="wh314332">Your altar</en>,
<en id="wh314333">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314334">to</en> <en id="wh314335">raise</en> <en id="wh314337">my voice</en> <en id="wh314336">in</en> <en id="wh314338">thanksgiving</en>
<en id="wh314340">and</en> <en id="wh314341">declare</en> <en id="wh314342">all</en> <en id="wh314343">Your wonderful works</en>.
<en id="wh314344">O LORD</en>,

<en id="wh314345">I love</en> <en id="wh314347">the house</en> <en id="wh314346">where You dwell</en>, <en id="wh314349">the place</en> <en id="wh314351">where Your glory</en> <en id="wh314350">resides</en>.
<en id="wh314352">Do not</en> <en id="wh314353">take</en> <en id="wh314356">my soul</en> <en id="wh314354">away with</en> <en id="wh314355">sinners</en>,
<en id="wh314357">or</en> <en id="wh314361">my life</en> <en id="wh314358">with</en> <en id="wh314359">men</en> <en id="wh314360">of bloodshed</en>,
<en id="wh314363">in</en> <en id="wh314362">whose</en> <en id="wh314364">hands</en> <en id="wh314365">are wicked schemes</en>,
<en id="wh314367">whose right hands</en> <en id="wh314368">are full</en> <en id="wh314369">of bribes</en>.
<en id="wh314371">But I</en> <en id="wh314374">will walk</en> <en id="wh314372">with</en> <en id="wh314373">integrity</en>;
<en id="wh314375">redeem me</en>
<en id="wh314376">and</en> <en id="wh314377">be merciful to me</en>.
<en id="wh314378">My feet</en> <en id="wh314379">stand</en> <en id="wh314380">on</en> <en id="wh314381">level ground</en>;
<en id="wh314382">in</en> <en id="wh314383">the congregations</en> <en id="wh314384">I will bless</en> <en id="wh314385">the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh314388">The LORD</en> <en id="wh314389">is my light</en> <en id="wh314390">and</en> <en id="wh314391">my salvation</en>—
<en id="wh314393">whom</en> <en id="wh314394">shall I fear</en>?
<en id="wh314395">The LORD</en> <en id="wh314396">is the stronghold</en> <en id="wh314397">of my life</en>—
<en id="wh314399">whom</en> <en id="wh314400">shall I dread</en>?
<en id="wh314401">When</en> <en id="wh314404">the wicked</en> <en id="wh314402">came</en> <en id="wh314403">upon me</en>
<en id="wh314405">to</en> <en id="wh314406">devour</en> <en id="wh314408">my flesh</en>,
<en id="wh314411">my enemies</en> <en id="wh314410">and</en> <en id="wh314409">foes</en>
<en id="wh314414">stumbled</en>
<en id="wh314415">and</en> <en id="wh314416">fell</en>.
<en id="wh314417">Though</en> <en id="wh314420">an army</en> <en id="wh314418">encamps</en> <en id="wh314419">around me</en>,
<en id="wh314423">my heart</en> <en id="wh314421">will not</en> <en id="wh314422">fear</en>;
<en id="wh314424">though</en> <en id="wh314427">a war</en> <en id="wh314425">breaks out</en> <en id="wh314426">against me</en>,
<en id="wh314430">I</en> <en id="wh314431">will keep my trust</en>.
<en id="wh314432">One thing</en> <en id="wh314433">I have asked</en> <en id="wh314436">of the LORD</en>;
<en id="wh314438">this is what I desire</en>:

<en id="wh314439">to dwell</en> <en id="wh314440">in</en> <en id="wh314441">the house</en> <en id="wh314442">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh314443">all</en> <en id="wh314444">the days</en> <en id="wh314445">of my life</en>,
<en id="wh314446">to</en> <en id="wh314447">gaze</en> <en id="wh314448">on</en> <en id="wh314449">the beauty</en> <en id="wh314450">of the LORD</en>
<en id="wh314452">and</en> <en id="wh314453">seek Him</en> <en id="wh314454">in</en> <en id="wh314455">His temple</en>.

<en id="wh314456">For</en> <en id="wh314460">in</en> <en id="wh314461">the day</en> <en id="wh314462">of trouble</en> <en id="wh314457">He will hide me</en> <en id="wh314458">in</en> <en id="wh314459">His shelter</en>;
<en id="wh314463">He will conceal me</en> <en id="wh314465">under the cover</en> <en id="wh314466">of His tent</en>;
<en id="wh314469">He will set me high</en> <en id="wh314468">upon a rock</en>.
<en id="wh314471">Then</en> <en id="wh314473">my head</en> <en id="wh314472">will be held high</en> <en id="wh314474">above</en> <en id="wh314475">my enemies</en> <en id="wh314476">around me</en>.
<en id="wh314479">At</en> <en id="wh314480">His tabernacle</en> <en id="wh314478">I will offer</en> <en id="wh314481">sacrifices</en> <en id="wh314482">with shouts of joy</en>;
<en id="wh314483">I will sing</en>
<en id="wh314484">and</en> <en id="wh314485">make music</en> <en id="wh314486">to</en> <en id="wh314487">the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh314488">Hear</en>,
<en id="wh314489">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314490">my voice</en> <en id="wh314491">when I call</en>;
<en id="wh314493">be merciful</en>
<en id="wh314494">and</en> <en id="wh314495">answer me</en>.
<en id="wh314498">My heart</en> <en id="wh314497">said</en>,
“<en id="wh314499">Seek</en> <en id="wh314500">His face</en>.”
<en id="wh314502">Your face</en>,
<en id="wh314503">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314504">I will seek</en>.
<en id="wh314506">Hide</en> <en id="wh314505">not</en> <en id="wh314507">Your face</en> <en id="wh314508">from me</en>,
<en id="wh314509">nor</en> <en id="wh314510">turn away</en> <en id="wh314513">Your servant</en> <en id="wh314511">in</en> <en id="wh314512">anger</en>.
<en id="wh314515">You have been</en> <en id="wh314514">my helper</en>;
<en id="wh314516">do not</en> <en id="wh314517">leave me</en>
<en id="wh314518">or</en> <en id="wh314520">forsake me</en>,
<en id="wh314521">O God</en> <en id="wh314522">of my salvation</en>.
<en id="wh314523">Though</en> <en id="wh314524">my father</en> <en id="wh314525">and</en> <en id="wh314526">mother</en> <en id="wh314527">forsake me</en>,
<en id="wh314529">the LORD</en> <en id="wh314530">will receive me</en>.
<en id="wh314531">Teach me</en>
<en id="wh314532">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314533">Your way</en>,

<en id="wh314534">and</en> <en id="wh314535">lead me</en> <en id="wh314536">on</en> <en id="wh314538">a level</en> <en id="wh314537">path</en>, <en id="wh314539">because of</en> <en id="wh314540">my oppressors</en>.
<en id="wh314541">Do not</en> <en id="wh314542">hand me over</en> <en id="wh314544">to the will</en> <en id="wh314545">of my foes</en>,

<en id="wh314546">for</en> <en id="wh314550">false</en> <en id="wh314549">witnesses</en> <en id="wh314547">rise up</en> <en id="wh314548">against me</en>, <en id="wh314552">breathing out</en> <en id="wh314553">violence</en>.
<en id="wh314554">Still</en> <en id="wh314555">I am certain</en>

<en id="wh314556">to</en> <en id="wh314557">see</en> <en id="wh314559">the goodness</en> <en id="wh314560">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh314561">in</en> <en id="wh314562">the land</en> <en id="wh314563">of the living</en>.
<en id="wh314564">Wait patiently</en> <en id="wh314565">for</en> <en id="wh314566">the LORD</en>;
<en id="wh314567">be strong</en>
<en id="wh314568">and</en> <en id="wh314569">courageous</en>.
<en id="wh314572">Wait patiently</en> <en id="wh314573">for</en> <en id="wh314574">the LORD</en>!
<en id="wh314575">To</en>
<en id="wh314577">You</en>,
<en id="wh314578">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314579">I call</en>;
<en id="wh314580">O my Rock</en>.
<en id="wh314581">be not</en> <en id="wh314582">deaf</en> <en id="wh314583">to me</en>,
<en id="wh314584">For if</en> <en id="wh314585">You remain silent</en>,
<en id="wh314588">I will be</en>
<en id="wh314589">like</en> <en id="wh314590">those descending</en> <en id="wh314591">to the Pit</en>.
<en id="wh314592">Hear</en> <en id="wh314593">my cry</en> <en id="wh314594">for mercy</en>
<en id="wh314595">when</en> <en id="wh314596">I call</en> <en id="wh314597">to You for help</en>,
<en id="wh314598">when</en> <en id="wh314599">I lift up</en> <en id="wh314600">my hands</en> <en id="wh314601">toward</en> <en id="wh314603">Your holy</en> <en id="wh314602">sanctuary</en>.

<en id="wh314604">Do not</en> <en id="wh314605">drag me away</en> <en id="wh314606">with</en> <en id="wh314607">the wicked</en>, <en id="wh314608">and</en> <en id="wh314609">with</en> <en id="wh314610">the workers</en> <en id="wh314611">of iniquity</en>,
<en id="wh314612">who speak</en> <en id="wh314613">peace</en> <en id="wh314614">to</en> <en id="wh314615">their neighbors</en>
<en id="wh314617">while malice</en> <en id="wh314619">is in their hearts</en>.

<en id="wh314620">Repay</en> <en id="wh314621">them</en> <en id="wh314623">according to their deeds</en> <en id="wh314624">and</en> <en id="wh314627">for their works</en> <en id="wh314626">of evil</en>.
<en id="wh314631">Repay</en> <en id="wh314632">them</en> <en id="wh314630">for what their hands</en> <en id="wh314629">have done</en>;
<en id="wh314633">bring back</en> <en id="wh314635">on them</en> <en id="wh314634">what they deserve</en>.

<en id="wh314636">Since</en> <en id="wh314637">they show no</en> <en id="wh314638">regard</en> <en id="wh314640">for the works</en> <en id="wh314641">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh314642">or</en> <en id="wh314645">what His hands</en> <en id="wh314644">have done</en>,
<en id="wh314646">He will tear them down</en>
<en id="wh314647">and</en> <en id="wh314648">never</en> <en id="wh314649">rebuild them</en>.
<en id="wh314650">Blessed be</en> <en id="wh314651">the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314652">for</en> <en id="wh314653">He has heard</en> <en id="wh314654">my cry</en> <en id="wh314655">for mercy</en>.
<en id="wh314656">The LORD</en> <en id="wh314657">is my strength</en> <en id="wh314658">and</en> <en id="wh314659">my shield</en>;
<en id="wh314662">my heart</en> <en id="wh314661">trusts</en> <en id="wh314660">in Him</en>,
<en id="wh314663">and</en> <en id="wh314664">I am helped</en>.
<en id="wh314667">Therefore my heart</en> <en id="wh314666">rejoices</en>,
<en id="wh314668">and</en> <en id="wh314671">I give thanks to Him</en> <en id="wh314670">with my song</en>.
<en id="wh314672">The LORD</en> <en id="wh314673">is the strength of His people</en>,
<en id="wh314676">a stronghold</en> <en id="wh314677">of salvation</en> <en id="wh314678">for His anointed</en>.
<en id="wh314680">Save</en> <en id="wh314682">Your people</en>
<en id="wh314683">and</en> <en id="wh314684">bless</en> <en id="wh314686">Your inheritance</en>;
<en id="wh314688">shepherd them</en> <en id="wh314687">and</en>
<en id="wh314690">carry</en> <en id="wh314689">them</en> <en id="wh314693">forever</en>.
<en id="wh314697">Ascribe</en> <en id="wh314698">to</en> <en id="wh314699">the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314700">O heavenly beings</en>,
<en id="wh314702">ascribe</en> <en id="wh314703">to</en> <en id="wh314704">the LORD</en> <en id="wh314705">glory</en> <en id="wh314706">and</en> <en id="wh314707">strength</en>.
<en id="wh314708">Ascribe</en> <en id="wh314709">to</en> <en id="wh314710">the LORD</en> <en id="wh314711">the glory</en> <en id="wh314712">due His name</en>;
<en id="wh314713">worship</en> <en id="wh314715">the LORD</en> <en id="wh314716">in</en> <en id="wh314717">the splendor</en> <en id="wh314718">of His holiness</en>.
<en id="wh314719">The voice</en> <en id="wh314720">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh314721">is over</en> <en id="wh314722">the</en> <en id="wh314723">waters</en>;
<en id="wh314725">the</en> <en id="wh314724">God</en> <en id="wh314726">of glory</en> <en id="wh314727">thunders</en>;
<en id="wh314728">the LORD</en> <en id="wh314729">is heard over</en> <en id="wh314731">many</en> <en id="wh314730">waters</en>.
<en id="wh314732">The voice</en> <en id="wh314733">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh314736">is powerful</en>; <en id="wh314735">the</en>
<en id="wh314737">voice</en> <en id="wh314738">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh314741">is majestic</en>.
<en id="wh314742">The voice</en> <en id="wh314743">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh314744">breaks</en> <en id="wh314745">the cedars</en>;
<en id="wh314748">the LORD</en> <en id="wh314747">shatters</en> <en id="wh314751">the</en> <en id="wh314750">cedars</en> <en id="wh314752">of Lebanon</en>.
<en id="wh314754">skip</en> <en id="wh314755">like</en> <en id="wh314756">a calf</en>,
<en id="wh314757">He makes Lebanon</en> ... <en id="wh314758">and</en> <en id="wh314759">Sirion</en> <en id="wh314760">like</en> <en id="wh314761">a young</en> <en id="wh314762">wild ox</en>.
<en id="wh314763">The voice</en> <en id="wh314764">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh314765">strikes</en> <en id="wh314766">with flames</en> <en id="wh314767">of fire</en>.
<en id="wh314768">The voice</en> <en id="wh314769">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh314770">shakes</en> <en id="wh314771">the wilderness</en>;
<en id="wh314773">the LORD</en> <en id="wh314772">shakes</en> <en id="wh314774">the Wilderness</en> <en id="wh314775">of Kadesh</en>.
<en id="wh314776">The voice</en> <en id="wh314777">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh314778">twists</en> <en id="wh314779">the oaks</en>
<en id="wh314780">and</en> <en id="wh314782">strips the forests</en> <en id="wh314781">bare</en>.
<en id="wh314783">And</en> <en id="wh314784">in</en> <en id="wh314785">His temple</en> <en id="wh314786">all</en> <en id="wh314787">cry</en>, “<en id="wh314788">Glory</en>!”
<en id="wh314791">The</en> <en id="wh314789">LORD</en> <en id="wh314793">sits enthroned</en> <en id="wh314792">over the flood</en>;
<en id="wh314796">the LORD</en> <en id="wh314795">is enthroned</en> <en id="wh314794">as</en> <en id="wh314797">King</en> <en id="wh314799">forever</en>.
<en id="wh314800">The LORD</en> <en id="wh314804">gives</en> <en id="wh314803">His people</en> <en id="wh314801">strength</en>;
<en id="wh314805">the LORD</en> <en id="wh314806">blesses</en> <en id="wh314808">His people</en> <en id="wh314809">with</en> <en id="wh314811">peace</en>.
<en id="wh314814">to rejoice</en>
<en id="wh314819">I will exalt You</en>,
<en id="wh314820">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314821">for</en> <en id="wh314822">You have lifted me up</en>
<en id="wh314823">and</en> <en id="wh314824">have not</en> <en id="wh314826">allowed my foes</en> ... <en id="wh314825">over me</en>.
<en id="wh314828">O LORD</en> <en id="wh314829">my God</en>,
<en id="wh314831">I cried to You</en> ... <en id="wh314830">help</en>,
<en id="wh314832">for</en> ... <en id="wh314833">and You healed me</en>.
<en id="wh314834">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314838">You pulled me</en> <en id="wh314835">up</en> <en id="wh314836">from</en> <en id="wh314837">Sheol</en>;
<en id="wh314839">You spared me</en>
<en id="wh314840">from</en> <en id="wh314841">descending</en> <en id="wh314842">into the Pit</en>.
<en id="wh314843">Sing</en> <en id="wh314844">to</en> <en id="wh314845">the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314846">O you His saints</en>,
<en id="wh314847">and</en> <en id="wh314848">praise</en> <en id="wh314851">His holy</en> <en id="wh314850">name</en>.
<en id="wh314852">For</en> <en id="wh314855">His anger</en> <en id="wh314853">is fleeting</en>,
<en id="wh314858">but His favor</en> <en id="wh314856">lasts a lifetime</en>.
<en id="wh314863">Weeping</en> <en id="wh314862">may stay</en> <en id="wh314860">the</en> <en id="wh314861">night</en>,
<en id="wh314865">but</en> <en id="wh314868">joy comes</en> <en id="wh314867">in the morning</en>.
<en id="wh314872">In</en> <en id="wh314873">prosperity</en> <en id="wh314870">I</en> <en id="wh314871">said</en>,
“<en id="wh314874">I will never</en> <en id="wh314875">be shaken</en>.”
<en id="wh314878">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314880">You favored me</en>; <en id="wh314881">You made</en> <en id="wh314883">my mountain</en> <en id="wh314884">stand strong</en>.
<en id="wh314885">When You hid</en> <en id="wh314886">Your face</en>,
<en id="wh314887">I was</en> <en id="wh314888">dismayed</en>.
<en id="wh314889">To You</en>,
<en id="wh314890">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314891">I called</en>,
<en id="wh314892">and</en> <en id="wh314895">I begged</en> <en id="wh314894">my Lord for mercy</en>:
“<en id="wh314896">What</en> <en id="wh314897">gain is there</en> <en id="wh314898">in</en> <en id="wh314899">my bloodshed</en>,
<en id="wh314900">in</en> <en id="wh314901">my descent</en> <en id="wh314902">to</en> <en id="wh314903">the Pit</en>?
<en id="wh314906">Will the dust</en> <en id="wh314905">praise You</en>?
<en id="wh314908">Will it proclaim</en> <en id="wh314909">Your faithfulness</en>?
<en id="wh314910">Hear me</en>,
<en id="wh314911">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314912">and</en> <en id="wh314913">have mercy</en>;
<en id="wh314914">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314915">be</en> <en id="wh314916">my helper</en>.”
<en id="wh314918">You turned</en> <en id="wh314919">my mourning</en> <en id="wh314921">into dancing</en>;
<en id="wh314923">You peeled off</en> <en id="wh314924">my sackcloth</en>
<en id="wh314925">and</en> <en id="wh314926">clothed me</en> <en id="wh314927">with joy</en>,
<en id="wh314928">that my heart</en> <en id="wh314929">may sing</en> <en id="wh314930">Your praises</en>
<en id="wh314931">and</en> <en id="wh314932">not</en> <en id="wh314933">be silent</en>.
<en id="wh314934">O LORD</en> <en id="wh314935">my God</en>,
<en id="wh314938">I will give thanks</en> <en id="wh314937">forever</en>.
<en id="wh314943">In</en>
<en id="wh314945">You</en>,
<en id="wh314946">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh314947">I have taken refuge</en>;
<en id="wh314948">let me never</en> <en id="wh314949">be put to shame</en>;
<en id="wh314954">save me</en> <en id="wh314952">by</en> <en id="wh314953">Your righteousness</en>.

<en id="wh315362">all</en> <en id="wh315363">you upright</en> <en id="wh315364">in heart</en>.

<en id="wh315366">O righteous ones</en>;

<en id="wh315389">play</en> ... <en id="wh315390">with</en> <en id="wh315391">a shout of joy</en>.

<en id="wh315573">May Your loving devotion</en> <en id="wh315572">rest</en>
<en id="wh315574">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh315575">on us</en>,

<en id="wh315632">are radiant with joy</en>;

<en id="wh316293">Refrain</en> <en id="wh316294">from</en> <en id="wh316295">anger</en>

<en id="wh316353">The wicked</en> <en id="wh316352">have drawn</en> <en id="wh316351">the sword</en>

<en id="wh316366">But their swords</en> <en id="wh316367">will pierce</en> <en id="wh316369">their own hearts</en>,

<en id="wh316409">But</en> <en id="wh316410">the wicked</en> ... <en id="wh316411">will perish</en>

<en id="wh316424">The wicked</en> <en id="wh316423">borrow</en>
<en id="wh316425">and</en> <en id="wh316426">do not</en> <en id="wh316427">repay</en>,
<en id="wh316428">but</en> <en id="wh316429">the righteous</en> <en id="wh316430">are gracious</en>
