<en id="wh316433">Surely</en> <en id="wh316434">those He blesses</en> <en id="wh316435">will inherit</en> <en id="wh316436">the land</en>,
<en id="wh316437">but</en> <en id="wh316438">the cursed</en> <en id="wh316439">will be destroyed</en>.
<en id="wh316442">The steps</en> <en id="wh316443">of a man</en> <en id="wh316444">are ordered</en> <en id="wh316441">by the LORD</en>
<en id="wh316447">who takes delight</en> <en id="wh316446">in his journey</en>.
<en id="wh316448">Though</en> <en id="wh316449">he falls</en>,
<en id="wh316450">he will not</en> <en id="wh316451">be overwhelmed</en>,
<en id="wh316452">for</en> <en id="wh316453">the LORD</en> <en id="wh316454">is holding</en> <en id="wh316455">his hand</en>.
<en id="wh316457">I once was</en> <en id="wh316456">young</en>
<en id="wh316458">now</en> <en id="wh316459">am old</en>,
<en id="wh316460">and</en> ... <en id="wh316461">yet never</en> <en id="wh316462">have I seen</en>

<en id="wh316469">They are</en> <en id="wh316471">ever</en> <en id="wh316472">generous</en>
<en id="wh316473">and</en> <en id="wh316474">quick to lend</en>,
<en id="wh316475">and</en> <en id="wh316476">their children</en> <en id="wh316478">are a blessing</en>.
<en id="wh316479">Turn away</en> <en id="wh316480">from</en> <en id="wh316481">evil</en>

<en id="wh316485">so</en> <en id="wh316486">that you will abide</en> <en id="wh316488">forever</en>.
<en id="wh316489">For</en> <en id="wh316490">the LORD</en> <en id="wh316491">loves</en> <en id="wh316492">justice</en>
<en id="wh316493">and</en> <en id="wh316494">will not</en> <en id="wh316495">forsake</en> <en id="wh316497">His saints</en>.
<en id="wh316500">They are preserved</en> <en id="wh316499">forever</en>,
<en id="wh316501">but</en> <en id="wh316502">the offspring</en> <en id="wh316503">of the wicked</en> <en id="wh316504">will be cut off</en>.
<en id="wh316505">The righteous</en> <en id="wh316506">will inherit</en> <en id="wh316507">the land</en>
<en id="wh316510">and</en> <en id="wh316509">dwell</en> <en id="wh316508">in it</en> <en id="wh316511">forever</en>.
<en id="wh316513">The mouth</en> <en id="wh316514">of the righteous man</en> <en id="wh316515">utters</en> <en id="wh316516">wisdom</en>,
<en id="wh316517">and</en> <en id="wh316518">his tongue</en> <en id="wh316519">speaks</en> <en id="wh316520">justice</en>.
<en id="wh316521">The law</en> <en id="wh316522">of his God</en> <en id="wh316524">is in his heart</en>;
<en id="wh316527">his steps</en> <en id="wh316525">do not</en> <en id="wh316526">falter</en>.
<en id="wh316529">Though the wicked</en> <en id="wh316528">lie in wait</en> <en id="wh316532">for the righteous</en>,
<en id="wh316533">and</en> <en id="wh316534">seek</en>
<en id="wh316535">to</en> <en id="wh316536">slay them</en>,
<en id="wh316537">the LORD</en> <en id="wh316538">will not</en> <en id="wh316539">leave them</en> <en id="wh316540">in</en> <en id="wh316541">their power</en>
<en id="wh316542">or</en> <en id="wh316544">let them be condemned</en>
<en id="wh316546">under judgment</en>.
<en id="wh316547">Wait</en> <en id="wh316548">for</en> <en id="wh316549">the LORD</en>
<en id="wh316550">and</en> <en id="wh316551">keep</en> <en id="wh316552">His way</en>,
<en id="wh316553">and</en> <en id="wh316554">He will raise you up</en>
<en id="wh316555">to</en> <en id="wh316556">inherit</en> <en id="wh316557">the land</en>.
<en id="wh316558">When</en> <en id="wh316560">the wicked</en> <en id="wh316559">are cut off</en>,
<en id="wh316561">you will see it</en>.
<en id="wh316562">I have seen</en> <en id="wh316563">a wicked</en>,
<en id="wh316564">ruthless man</en>
<en id="wh316569">flourishing</en> <en id="wh316567">like</en> <en id="wh316566">a well-rooted</en> <en id="wh316568">native tree</en>,
<en id="wh316571">yet he passed away</en>
<en id="wh316572">and</en> <en id="wh316574">was no more</en>;
<en id="wh316576">though I searched</en>,
<en id="wh316578">he could not</en> <en id="wh316579">be found</en>.
<en id="wh316580">Consider</en> <en id="wh316581">the blameless</en>
<en id="wh316582">and</en> <en id="wh316583">observe</en> <en id="wh316584">the upright</en>,
<en id="wh316585">for</en> <en id="wh316586">posterity awaits</en> <en id="wh316588">the man</en> <en id="wh316589">of peace</en>.
<en id="wh316590">But</en> <en id="wh316591">the transgressors</en> <en id="wh316593">will all</en> <en id="wh316592">be destroyed</en>;
<en id="wh316594">the future</en> <en id="wh316595">of the wicked</en> <en id="wh316596">will be cut off</en>.
<en id="wh316598">The salvation</en> <en id="wh316599">of the righteous</en> <en id="wh316601">is from the LORD</en>;
<en id="wh316602">He is their stronghold</en> <en id="wh316603">in</en> <en id="wh316604">time</en> <en id="wh316605">of trouble</en>.
<en id="wh316608">The LORD</en> <en id="wh316607">helps</en>
<en id="wh316609">and</en> <en id="wh316610">delivers them</en>;
<en id="wh316611">He rescues</en> ... <en id="wh316612">from</en> <en id="wh316613">the wicked</en>,
<en id="wh316614">and</en> <en id="wh316615">saves them</en>
<en id="wh316616">because</en> <en id="wh316617">they take refuge</en> <en id="wh316618">in Him</en>.
<en id="wh316624">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh316625">do not</en> <en id="wh316628">rebuke me</en> <en id="wh316626">in</en> <en id="wh316627">Your anger</en>
<en id="wh316629">or</en> <en id="wh316632">discipline me</en> <en id="wh316630">in</en> <en id="wh316631">Your wrath</en>.
<en id="wh316633">For</en> <en id="wh316634">Your arrows</en> <en id="wh316635">have pierced me deeply</en>, ... <en id="wh316636">on me</en>.
<en id="wh316637">and</en> <en id="wh316640">Your hand</en> <en id="wh316638">has pressed down</en>
<en id="wh316641">There is no</en> <en id="wh316642">soundness</en> <en id="wh316643">in</en> <en id="wh316644">my body</en> <en id="wh316646">because of</en> <en id="wh316647">Your anger</en>;
<en id="wh316648">there is no</en> <en id="wh316649">rest</en> <en id="wh316650">in</en> <en id="wh316651">my bones</en> <en id="wh316653">because of</en> <en id="wh316654">my sin</en>.
<en id="wh316655">For</en> <en id="wh316656">my iniquities</en> <en id="wh316657">have overwhelmed</en>
<en id="wh316663">me</en>; <en id="wh316660">they are a burden</en> <en id="wh316661">too heavy</en> <en id="wh316662">to bear</en>.
<en id="wh316664">are foul</en>
<en id="wh316666">My wounds</en> ... <en id="wh316665">and festering</en> <en id="wh316668">because of</en> <en id="wh316669">my sinful folly</en>.
<en id="wh316670">I am bent</en>
<en id="wh316671">and brought low</en>;
<en id="wh316674">all day long</en> <en id="wh316678">I go about</en> <en id="wh316677">mourning</en>.
<en id="wh316679">For</en> <en id="wh316680">my loins</en> <en id="wh316681">are full of</en> <en id="wh316682">burning pain</en>,
<en id="wh316683">and</en> <en id="wh316684">no</en> <en id="wh316685">soundness</en> <en id="wh316687">remains in my body</en>.
<en id="wh316688">I am numb</en>
<en id="wh316689">and</en> <en id="wh316691">badly</en> <en id="wh316690">crushed</en>;
<en id="wh316693">I groan</en> <en id="wh316695">in anguish</en> <en id="wh316696">of heart</en>.
<en id="wh316697">O Lord</en>,
<en id="wh316699">my every</en> <en id="wh316700">desire</en> <en id="wh316698">is before You</en>;
<en id="wh316702">my groaning</en> <en id="wh316704">is not</en> <en id="wh316705">hidden</en> <en id="wh316703">from You</en>.
<en id="wh316706">My heart</en> <en id="wh316707">pounds</en>,
<en id="wh316709">my strength</en> <en id="wh316708">fails</en>,
<en id="wh316710">and</en> ... <en id="wh316711">the light</en> <en id="wh316712">of my eyes</en>
<en id="wh316713">even</en> ... <en id="wh316715">has faded</en>.
<en id="wh316717">My beloved</en> <en id="wh316718">and</en> <en id="wh316719">friends</en> <en id="wh316723">shun</en> <en id="wh316722">my disease</en>,
<en id="wh316724">and</en> <en id="wh316725">my kinsmen</en> <en id="wh316728">stand</en> <en id="wh316727">at a distance</en>.
<en id="wh316730">lay snares</en>;
<en id="wh316731">Those who seek</en> <en id="wh316732">my life</en>
<en id="wh316734">those who wish me</en> <en id="wh316735">harm</en>
<en id="wh316736">speak</en> <en id="wh316737">destruction</en>,
<en id="wh316743">plotting</en> <en id="wh316739">deceit</en> <en id="wh316740">all</en> <en id="wh316742">day long</en>.
<en id="wh316747">But like a deaf man</en>, <en id="wh316745">I</en>
<en id="wh316748">do not</en> <en id="wh316749">hear</en>;
<en id="wh316750">and</en> <en id="wh316751">like</en> <en id="wh316752">a mute man</en>,
<en id="wh316753">I do not</en> <en id="wh316754">open</en> <en id="wh316755">my mouth</en>.
<en id="wh316757">I am</en> <en id="wh316758">like</en> <en id="wh316759">a man</en>
<en id="wh316760">who</en> <en id="wh316761">cannot</en> <en id="wh316762">hear</en>,
<en id="wh316766">whose mouth</en> <en id="wh316767">offers no reply</en>.
<en id="wh316769">for You</en>,
<en id="wh316770">O LORD</en>;
<en id="wh316771">I wait</en>
<en id="wh316772">You</en> <en id="wh316773">will answer</en>,
<en id="wh316774">O Lord</en> <en id="wh316775">my God</en>.
<en id="wh316776">For</en> <en id="wh316777">I said</en>,
“<en id="wh316778">Let them not</en> <en id="wh316779">gloat</en> <en id="wh316780">over me</en>
<en id="wh316781">when</en> <en id="wh316783">my foot</en> <en id="wh316782">slips</en>.”
— <en id="wh316785">those who taunt</en> <en id="wh316784">me</en>
<en id="wh316786">For</en> <en id="wh316787">I</en> <en id="wh316790">am ready</en> <en id="wh316788">to</en> <en id="wh316789">fall</en>,
<en id="wh316791">and</en> <en id="wh316792">my pain</en> <en id="wh316794">is ever</en> <en id="wh316793">with me</en>.
<en id="wh316795">Yes</en>, <en id="wh316797">I confess</en> <en id="wh316796">my iniquity</en>;
<en id="wh316798">I am troubled</en> <en id="wh316800">by my sin</en>.
<en id="wh316802">Many are my enemies</en> <en id="wh316803">without cause</en>,
<en id="wh316805">and</en> <en id="wh316806">many</en>
<en id="wh316807">hate me</en> <en id="wh316808">without reason</en>.
<en id="wh316809">for</en>
<en id="wh316810">Those who repay</en> <en id="wh316813">my good</en> <en id="wh316812">with</en> <en id="wh316811">evil</en>
<en id="wh316814">attack me</en>
<en id="wh316816">pursuing</en> <en id="wh316817">the good</en>.
<en id="wh316818">Do not</en> <en id="wh316819">forsake me</en>,
<en id="wh316820">O LORD</en>; ... <en id="wh316821">O my God</en>.
<en id="wh316822">be not</en> <en id="wh316823">far</en> <en id="wh316824">from me</en>,
<en id="wh316825">Come quickly</en> <en id="wh316826">to</en> <en id="wh316827">help me</en>,
<en id="wh316828">O Lord</en> <en id="wh316829">my Savior</en>.
<en id="wh316838">I said</en>,
“<en id="wh316839">I will watch</en> <en id="wh316840">my ways</en>
<en id="wh316842">so that I will not sin</en> <en id="wh316843">with</en> <en id="wh316844">my tongue</en>;
<en id="wh316845">I will guard</en> <en id="wh316847">my mouth</en> ... <en id="wh316848">a muzzle</en>

<en id="wh316854">I was speechless</en> <en id="wh316855">and still</en>;
<en id="wh316856">I remained silent</en>, <en id="wh316858">even from speaking good</en>,
<en id="wh316859">and</en> <en id="wh316860">my sorrow</en> <en id="wh316861">was stirred</en>.
<en id="wh316863">My heart</en> <en id="wh316862">grew hot</en> <en id="wh316865">within me</en>;

<en id="wh316870">Then I spoke</en> <en id="wh316871">with</en> <en id="wh316872">my tongue</en>:
“<en id="wh316873">Show me</en>,
<en id="wh316874">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh316875">my end</en>
<en id="wh316876">and</en> <en id="wh316877">the measure</en> <en id="wh316878">of my days</en>.
<en id="wh316879">how</en>
<en id="wh316881">Let me know</en>
<en id="wh316883">fleeting</en> <en id="wh316884">my life is</en>.

<en id="wh316894">Truly</en> <en id="wh316895">each</en> <en id="wh316898">man</en> <en id="wh316899">at his best</en> <en id="wh316896">exists as but a breath</en>.
<en id="wh316900">Selah</en>
<en id="wh316901">Surely</en> <en id="wh316905">every man</en> <en id="wh316904">goes about</en> <en id="wh316903">like a phantom</en>;
<en id="wh316906">surely</en> <en id="wh316908">he bustles</en> <en id="wh316907">in vain</en>;
<en id="wh316909">he heaps up riches</en>
<en id="wh316911">not</en> <en id="wh316912">knowing</en>
<en id="wh316913">who</en> <en id="wh316914">will haul them away</en>.
<en id="wh316916">And now</en>, ... <en id="wh316915">in</en>
<en id="wh316917">for what</en> <en id="wh316918">do I wait</en>?
<en id="wh316919">O Lord</en>,
<en id="wh316920">My hope is</en>
<en id="wh316921">You</en>.
<en id="wh316926">Deliver me</en> <en id="wh316923">from</en> <en id="wh316924">all</en> <en id="wh316925">my transgressions</en>;
<en id="wh316929">do not</en> <en id="wh316930">make me</en> <en id="wh316927">the reproach</en> <en id="wh316928">of fools</en>.
<en id="wh316931">I have become mute</en>;
<en id="wh316932">I do not</en> <en id="wh316933">open</en> <en id="wh316934">my mouth</en>
<en id="wh316935">because of what</en> <en id="wh316936">You</en> <en id="wh316937">have done</en>.
<en id="wh316938">Remove</en> <en id="wh316941">Your scourge</en> <en id="wh316939">from</en> <en id="wh316940">me</en>;

<en id="wh317625">our fathers</en> <en id="wh317626">have told</en> <en id="wh317627">us</en> <en id="wh317628">the work</en>
<en id="wh317629">You did</en> <en id="wh317630">in</en> <en id="wh317631">their days</en>, <en id="wh317632">in</en> <en id="wh317633">the days</en> <en id="wh317634">of old</en>.
<en id="wh317636">With Your hand</en> <en id="wh317635">You</en> <en id="wh317638">drove out</en> <en id="wh317637">the nations</en>
<en id="wh317639">and</en> <en id="wh317640">planted our fathers there</en>;
<en id="wh317641">You crushed</en> <en id="wh317642">the peoples</en>
<en id="wh317643">and</en> <en id="wh317644">cast them out</en>.
<en id="wh317645">For</en> <en id="wh317646">it was not</en> <en id="wh317647">by</en> <en id="wh317648">their sword</en> <en id="wh317649">that they took</en> <en id="wh317650">the land</en>;
<en id="wh317652">their arm</en> <en id="wh317653">did not</en> <en id="wh317654">bring them victory</en>.

<en id="wh317656">It was</en> <en id="wh317657">by Your right hand</en>, <en id="wh317659">Your arm</en>, <en id="wh317660">and</en> <en id="wh317661">the light</en> <en id="wh317662">of Your face</en>,
<en id="wh317663">because</en> <en id="wh317664">You favored them</en>.
<en id="wh317665">You</en> <en id="wh317667">are my King</en>,
<en id="wh317668">O God</en>,
<en id="wh317669">who ordains</en> <en id="wh317670">victories</en> <en id="wh317671">for Jacob</en>.
<en id="wh317672">Through You</en> <en id="wh317674">we repel</en> <en id="wh317673">our foes</en>;
<en id="wh317676">through Your name</en> <en id="wh317677">we trample</en>
<en id="wh317678">our enemies</en>.
<en id="wh317679">For</en> <en id="wh317680">I do not</en> <en id="wh317683">trust</en> <en id="wh317681">in</en> <en id="wh317682">my bow</en>,
<en id="wh317685">nor does my sword</en> <en id="wh317687">save me</en>.
<en id="wh317688">For</en> <en id="wh317689">You save us</en> <en id="wh317690">from</en> <en id="wh317691">our enemies</en>;
<en id="wh317693">You put those who hate us</en> <en id="wh317694">to shame</en>.
<en id="wh317695">In</en> <en id="wh317696">God</en> <en id="wh317697">we have boasted</en> <en id="wh317698">all day long</en>,
<en id="wh317701">and</en> <en id="wh317702">Your name</en> <en id="wh317705">we will praise</en> <en id="wh317704">forever</en>.
<en id="wh317706">Selah</en>
<en id="wh317707">But</en> <en id="wh317708">You have rejected</en>
<en id="wh317709">and</en> <en id="wh317710">humbled us</en>;
<en id="wh317712">You no longer</en> <en id="wh317713">go forth</en> <en id="wh317714">with</en> <en id="wh317715">our armies</en>.
<en id="wh317716">You have made us retreat</en> <en id="wh317718">from</en> <en id="wh317719">the foe</en>,
<en id="wh317720">and</en> <en id="wh317721">those who hate us</en> <en id="wh317722">have plundered us</en>.
<en id="wh317724">You have given us up</en> <en id="wh317725">as</en> <en id="wh317726">sheep</en> <en id="wh317727">to be devoured</en>;
<en id="wh317732">You have scattered us</en> <en id="wh317729">among</en> <en id="wh317730">the</en> <en id="wh317731">nations</en>.
<en id="wh317733">You sell</en> <en id="wh317734">Your people</en> <en id="wh317736">for nothing</en>; ... <en id="wh317737">profit</en>
<en id="wh317739">no</en> ... <en id="wh317740">do You gain</en> <en id="wh317742">from their sale</en>.
<en id="wh317743">You have made us</en> <en id="wh317744">a reproach</en> <en id="wh317745">to</en> <en id="wh317746">our neighbors</en>,
<en id="wh317747">a mockery</en> <en id="wh317748">and</en> <en id="wh317749">derision</en> <en id="wh317750">to</en> <en id="wh317751">those around us</en>.
<en id="wh317752">You have made us</en> <en id="wh317753">a byword</en> <en id="wh317754">among</en> <en id="wh317755">the</en> <en id="wh317756">nations</en>,
<en id="wh317757">a laughingstock</en>
<en id="wh317759">among</en> <en id="wh317760">the peoples</en>.
<en id="wh317761">All day long</en> <en id="wh317764">my disgrace</en> <en id="wh317765">is before me</en>,
<en id="wh317766">and</en> <en id="wh317767">shame</en> <en id="wh317769">has covered</en> <en id="wh317768">my face</en>,
<en id="wh317771">at the voice</en> <en id="wh317772">of the scorner</en> <en id="wh317773">and</en> <en id="wh317774">reviler</en>,
<en id="wh317776">because of</en> <en id="wh317777">the enemy</en>, <en id="wh317779">bent on revenge</en>.
<en id="wh317780">All</en> <en id="wh317781">this</en> <en id="wh317782">has come upon us</en>,
<en id="wh317784">though we have not</en> <en id="wh317785">forgotten You</en>
<en id="wh317786">or</en> <en id="wh317788">betrayed</en> <en id="wh317790">Your covenant</en>.
<en id="wh317794">Our hearts</en> <en id="wh317791">have not</en> <en id="wh317792">turned back</en>;
<en id="wh317797">our steps</en> <en id="wh317796">have not strayed</en> <en id="wh317798">from</en> <en id="wh317799">Your path</en>.
<en id="wh317800">But</en> <en id="wh317801">You have crushed us</en> <en id="wh317802">in</en> <en id="wh317803">the lair</en> ... <en id="wh317804">jackals</en>;
<en id="wh317805">of</en> ... <en id="wh317806">You have covered</en> <en id="wh317807">us</en> <en id="wh317808">with</en> <en id="wh317809">deepest darkness</en>.
<en id="wh317810">If</en> <en id="wh317811">we had forgotten</en> <en id="wh317812">the name</en> ... <en id="wh317813">our God</en>
<en id="wh317814">of</en> ... <en id="wh317815">or spread out</en> <en id="wh317816">our hands</en> <en id="wh317817">to</en> <en id="wh317819">a foreign</en> <en id="wh317818">god</en>,
<en id="wh317821">would not</en> <en id="wh317822">God</en> <en id="wh317824">have discovered</en>,
<en id="wh317825">since</en> <en id="wh317826">He</en> <en id="wh317827">knows</en> <en id="wh317828">the secrets</en> <en id="wh317829">of the heart</en>?
<en id="wh317830">Yet</en> <en id="wh317831">for Your sake</en> <en id="wh317832">we face death</en> <en id="wh317833">all day long</en>;
<en id="wh317836">we are considered</en> <en id="wh317837">as</en> <en id="wh317838">sheep</en> <en id="wh317839">to be slaughtered</en>.
<en id="wh317840">Wake up</en>,
<en id="wh317841">Why</en> <en id="wh317842">are You sleeping</en>?
<en id="wh317843">O Lord</en>!
<en id="wh317844">Arise</en>!
<en id="wh317845">Do not</en> <en id="wh317846">reject us forever</en>.
<en id="wh317849">Why</en> <en id="wh317851">do You hide</en> <en id="wh317850">Your face</en>
<en id="wh317854">and</en> <en id="wh317852">forget</en> <en id="wh317853">our affliction</en> <en id="wh317855">and oppression</en>?
<en id="wh317856">For</en> <en id="wh317861">our soul</en> <en id="wh317857">has sunk</en> <en id="wh317858">to</en> <en id="wh317859">the</en> <en id="wh317860">dust</en>;
<en id="wh317866">our bodies</en> <en id="wh317862">cling</en> <en id="wh317863">to</en> <en id="wh317864">the</en> <en id="wh317865">earth</en>.
<en id="wh317867">Rise up</en>; <en id="wh317868">be our help</en>!
<en id="wh317871">Redeem us</en> <en id="wh317872">on account of</en> <en id="wh317873">Your loving devotion</en>.
<en id="wh317886">My heart</en> <en id="wh317885">is stirred</en> <en id="wh317888">by a noble</en> <en id="wh317887">theme</en>
<en id="wh317890">as I</en> <en id="wh317889">recite</en> <en id="wh317891">my verses</en> <en id="wh317892">to</en> <en id="wh317893">the king</en>;
<en id="wh317894">my tongue</en> <en id="wh317895">is the pen</en> <en id="wh317897">of a skillful</en> <en id="wh317896">writer</en>.
<en id="wh317898">You are the most handsome</en> <en id="wh317900">of</en> <en id="wh317901">men</en>;
<en id="wh317903">grace</en> <en id="wh317902">has anointed</en> <en id="wh317905">your lips</en>;
<en id="wh317907">therefore</en> <en id="wh317909">God</en> <en id="wh317908">has blessed you forever</en>.
<en id="wh317912">Strap</en> <en id="wh317913">your sword</en> <en id="wh317914">at</en> <en id="wh317915">your side</en>,
<en id="wh317916">O mighty warrior</en>;
<en id="wh317917">appear in your majesty</en> <en id="wh317918">and</en> <en id="wh317919">splendor</en>.
<en id="wh317920">In</en> <en id="wh317921">your splendor</en> ... <en id="wh317922">in victory</en>

<en id="wh317923">ride forth</en> ... <en id="wh317924">on</en> <en id="wh317925">behalf</en> <en id="wh317926">of truth</en> <en id="wh317927">and</en> <en id="wh317928">humility</en> ... <en id="wh317929">justice</en>;
<en id="wh317930">and</en> ... <en id="wh317933">may your right hand</en> <en id="wh317931">show</en> <en id="wh317932">your awesome deeds</en>.
<en id="wh317934">Your arrows</en> <en id="wh317935">pierce</en>
<en id="wh317936">the nations</en> <en id="wh317938">fall</en> <en id="wh317937">beneath your feet</en>.
<en id="wh317942">the</en> <en id="wh317940">hearts</en> <en id="wh317943">of the king’s</en> <en id="wh317941">foes</en>;
<en id="wh317944">Your throne</en>,
<en id="wh317945">O God</en>,
<en id="wh317946">endures forever</en> ... <en id="wh317948">ever</en>, <en id="wh317947">and</en>
<en id="wh317949">and</en> ... <en id="wh317950">justice</en> <en id="wh317951">is the scepter</en> <en id="wh317952">of Your kingdom</en>.
<en id="wh317953">You have loved</en> <en id="wh317954">righteousness</en>
<en id="wh317955">and</en> <en id="wh317956">hated</en> <en id="wh317957">wickedness</en>;

<en id="wh317959">therefore</en> <en id="wh317962">God</en>, <en id="wh317961">your God</en>, <en id="wh317960">has anointed you</en> <en id="wh317966">above your companions</en> <en id="wh317963">with the oil</en> <en id="wh317964">of joy</en>.

<en id="wh317971">All</en> <en id="wh317972">your garments are fragrant</en> <en id="wh317967">with myrrh</en> <en id="wh317968">and</en> <en id="wh317969">aloes</en> <en id="wh317970">and cassia</en>;
<en id="wh317973">from</en> <en id="wh317974">palaces</en> <en id="wh317975">of ivory</en> <en id="wh317976">the harps</en> <en id="wh317977">make you glad</en>.
<en id="wh317978">The daughters</en> <en id="wh317979">of kings</en> <en id="wh317981">are among your honored women</en>;

<en id="wh317983">the queen</en> <en id="wh317982">stands</en> <en id="wh317986">at</en> <en id="wh317985">your right hand</en>, <en id="wh317987">adorned with the gold</en> <en id="wh317988">of Ophir</en>.
<en id="wh317989">Listen</en>,
<en id="wh317990">O daughter</en>!
<en id="wh317992">Consider</en>
<en id="wh317993">and</en> <en id="wh317994">incline</en> <en id="wh317995">your ear</en>:
<en id="wh317997">Forget</en> <en id="wh317998">your people</en> <en id="wh317999">and</en> <en id="wh318001">your father’s</en> <en id="wh318000">house</en>,
<en id="wh318002">and</en> <en id="wh318004">the</en> <en id="wh318005">king</en> <en id="wh318003">will desire</en> <en id="wh318006">your beauty</en>;
<en id="wh318007">for</en> <en id="wh318008">he</en> <en id="wh318009">is your lord</en>.
<en id="wh318011">bow</en> <en id="wh318012">to him</en>,
<en id="wh318014">The Daughter</en> <en id="wh318015">of Tyre</en>
<en id="wh318017">will come with a gift</en>; <en id="wh318021">men</en> <en id="wh318020">of wealth</en> <en id="wh318019">will seek</en> <en id="wh318018">your favor</en>.
<en id="wh318022">All</en> <en id="wh318023">glorious</en> <en id="wh318024">is the princess</en> <en id="wh318026">in</en> <en id="wh318025">her chamber</en>;
<en id="wh318030">her gown</en> <en id="wh318027">is</en> <en id="wh318028">embroidered</en> <en id="wh318029">with gold</en>.
<en id="wh318032">In colorful garments</en> <en id="wh318033">she is led</en> <en id="wh318034">to</en> <en id="wh318035">the</en> <en id="wh318036">king</en>;
<en id="wh318037">her virgin</en>
<en id="wh318039">companions</en> <en id="wh318040">are brought</en> <en id="wh318041">before you</en>.
<en id="wh318042">They are led in</en> <en id="wh318043">with</en> <en id="wh318044">joy</en> <en id="wh318045">and</en> <en id="wh318046">gladness</en>;
<en id="wh318047">they enter</en> <en id="wh318049">the palace</en> <en id="wh318050">of the king</en>.
<en id="wh318054">Your sons</en> <en id="wh318051">will succeed</en> <en id="wh318052">your fathers</en>;
<en id="wh318055">you will make them</en> <en id="wh318057">princes</en> <en id="wh318059">throughout</en> <en id="wh318060">the</en> <en id="wh318061">land</en>.
<en id="wh318062">I will commemorate</en> <en id="wh318063">your name</en> <en id="wh318065">through all</en> <en id="wh318068">generations</en>;
<en id="wh318070">therefore</en> <en id="wh318071">the nations</en> <en id="wh318072">will praise you</en> <en id="wh318074">forever</en> <en id="wh318075">and</en> <en id="wh318076">ever</en>.
<en id="wh318084">is our</en>
<en id="wh318086">God</en> ... <en id="wh318088">refuge</en> <en id="wh318089">and</en> <en id="wh318090">strength</en>,
<en id="wh318094">an ever-present</en> <en id="wh318091">help</en> <en id="wh318092">in</en> <en id="wh318093">times of trouble</en>.
<en id="wh318097">Therefore</en> <en id="wh318098">we will not</en> <en id="wh318099">fear</en>,
<en id="wh318102">though the earth</en> <en id="wh318101">is transformed</en>
<en id="wh318103">and</en> <en id="wh318106">the mountains</en> <en id="wh318105">are toppled</en> <en id="wh318107">into</en> <en id="wh318108">the depths</en> <en id="wh318109">of the seas</en>,
<en id="wh318110">roar</en>
<en id="wh318112">though their waters</en> ... <en id="wh318111">and foam</en>
<en id="wh318114">and the mountains</en> <en id="wh318113">quake</en> <en id="wh318115">in</en> <en id="wh318116">the surge</en>.
<en id="wh318117">Selah</en>
<en id="wh318118">There is a river</en>

<en id="wh318119">whose streams</en> <en id="wh318120">delight</en> <en id="wh318121">the city</en> <en id="wh318122">of God</en>, <en id="wh318123">the holy place where</en> <en id="wh318125">the Most High</en> <en id="wh318124">dwells</en>.
<en id="wh318126">God</en> <en id="wh318128">is within her</en>;
<en id="wh318129">she will not</en> <en id="wh318130">be moved</en>.
<en id="wh318132">God</en> <en id="wh318131">will help her</en>
<en id="wh318135">when morning</en> <en id="wh318134">dawns</en>.
<en id="wh318137">Nations</en> <en id="wh318136">rage</en>,
<en id="wh318139">kingdoms</en> <en id="wh318138">crumble</en>;
<en id="wh318141">when</en> <en id="wh318140">He lifts</en> <en id="wh318142">His voice</en>.
<en id="wh318144">the earth</en> <en id="wh318143">melts</en>
<en id="wh318145">The LORD</en> <en id="wh318146">of Hosts</en> <en id="wh318147">is with us</en>;
<en id="wh318150">the God</en> <en id="wh318151">of Jacob</en> <en id="wh318148">is our fortress</en>.
<en id="wh318152">Selah</en>
<en id="wh318153">Come</en>,
<en id="wh318154">see</en> <en id="wh318155">the works</en> <en id="wh318156">of the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh318157">who</en> <en id="wh318158">brings</en> <en id="wh318159">devastation</en> <en id="wh318162">upon the earth</en>.
<en id="wh318164">He makes wars</en> <en id="wh318163">to cease</en> <en id="wh318165">throughout</en> <en id="wh318167">the</en> <en id="wh318168">earth</en>;
<en id="wh318170">He breaks</en> <en id="wh318169">the bow</en>
<en id="wh318171">and</en> <en id="wh318172">shatters</en> <en id="wh318173">the spear</en>;
<en id="wh318175">He burns</en> <en id="wh318174">the shields</en> <en id="wh318176">in</en> <en id="wh318177">the</en> <en id="wh318178">fire</en>.
“<en id="wh318179">Be still</en>
<en id="wh318180">and</en> <en id="wh318181">know</en>
<en id="wh318182">that</en> <en id="wh318183">I</en> <en id="wh318184">am God</en>;
<en id="wh318185">I will be exalted</en> <en id="wh318186">among</en> <en id="wh318187">the</en> <en id="wh318188">nations</en>,

<en id="wh318193">The LORD</en> <en id="wh318194">of Hosts</en> <en id="wh318195">is with us</en>;
<en id="wh318198">the God</en> <en id="wh318199">of Jacob</en> <en id="wh318196">is our fortress</en>.
<en id="wh318200">Selah</en>
<en id="wh318208">all you peoples</en>;
<en id="wh318211">Clap</en> <en id="wh318212">your hands</en>,
<en id="wh318213">shout</en> <en id="wh318215">unto God</en> <en id="wh318216">with</en> <en id="wh318217">a voice</en> <en id="wh318218">of triumph</en>.
<en id="wh318219">How</en> <en id="wh318222">awesome is</en> <en id="wh318220">the LORD</en> <en id="wh318221">Most High</en>,
<en id="wh318224">the great</en> <en id="wh318223">King</en> <en id="wh318225">over</en> <en id="wh318226">all</en> <en id="wh318227">the</en> <en id="wh318228">earth</en>!
<en id="wh318229">He subdues</en> <en id="wh318230">nations</en> <en id="wh318231">beneath us</en>,
<en id="wh318232">and</en> <en id="wh318233">peoples</en> <en id="wh318234">under</en> <en id="wh318235">our feet</en>.
<en id="wh318236">He chooses</en> <en id="wh318239">our inheritance</en> <en id="wh318237">for us</en>, <en id="wh318241">the pride</en> <en id="wh318242">of Jacob</en>,
<en id="wh318243">whom</en> <en id="wh318244">He loves</en>.
<en id="wh318245">Selah</en>
<en id="wh318247">God</en> <en id="wh318246">has ascended</en> <en id="wh318249">amid shouts of joy</en>,
<en id="wh318250">the LORD</en> <en id="wh318251">with</en> <en id="wh318252">the sound</en> <en id="wh318253">of the horn</en>.
<en id="wh318254">Sing praises</en> <en id="wh318255">to God</en>,
<en id="wh318256">sing praises</en>;
<en id="wh318257">sing praises</en> <en id="wh318258">to</en> <en id="wh318259">our King</en>,
<en id="wh318260">sing praises</en>!
<en id="wh318261">For</en> <en id="wh318266">God</en> <en id="wh318262">is King</en> <en id="wh318263">of all</en> <en id="wh318264">the</en> <en id="wh318265">earth</en>;
<en id="wh318267">sing</en> <en id="wh318268">to Him a psalm of praise</en>.
<en id="wh318270">God</en> <en id="wh318269">reigns</en> <en id="wh318271">over</en> <en id="wh318272">the nations</en>;
<en id="wh318273">God</en> <en id="wh318274">is seated</en> <en id="wh318275">on</en> <en id="wh318277">His holy</en> <en id="wh318276">throne</en>.

<en id="wh318278">The nobles</en> <en id="wh318279">of the nations</en> <en id="wh318280">have assembled</en> <en id="wh318281">as the people</en> <en id="wh318282">of the God</en> <en id="wh318283">of Abraham</en>;
<en id="wh318284">for</en> <en id="wh318287">the shields</en> <en id="wh318288">of the earth</en> <en id="wh318286">belong to God</en>;
<en id="wh318289">He is highly</en> <en id="wh318290">exalted</en>.
<en id="wh318294">the</en>
<en id="wh318296">Great is</en> ... <en id="wh318297">LORD</en>,

<en id="wh318298">and</en> <en id="wh318300">greatly</en> <en id="wh318299">to be praised</en> <en id="wh318301">in</en> <en id="wh318302">the city</en> <en id="wh318303">of our God</en>, <en id="wh318305">His holy</en> <en id="wh318304">mountain</en>.
<en id="wh318306">Beautiful</en> <en id="wh318307">in loftiness</en>,

<en id="wh318310">the</en> <en id="wh318308">joy</en> <en id="wh318309">of all</en> <en id="wh318311">the earth</en>, <en id="wh318314">like the peaks</en> <en id="wh318315">of Zaphon</en> <en id="wh318312">is Mount</en> <en id="wh318313">Zion</en>, <en id="wh318316">the city</en> <en id="wh318318">of the great</en> <en id="wh318317">King</en>.

<en id="wh318319">God</en> <en id="wh318321">is in her citadels</en>; <en id="wh318322">He has shown Himself</en> <en id="wh318323">to</en> <en id="wh318322">be</en> <en id="wh318324">a fortress</en>.
<en id="wh318325">For</en> <en id="wh318326">behold</en>, <en id="wh318327">the</en> <en id="wh318328">kings</en> <en id="wh318329">assembled</en>;
<en id="wh318330">they all advanced</en> <en id="wh318331">together</en>.
<en id="wh318332">They</en> <en id="wh318333">saw</en>
<en id="wh318334">and</en> <en id="wh318335">were astounded</en>;
<en id="wh318336">in terror</en>.
<en id="wh318337">they fled</en>
<en id="wh318338">Trembling</en> <en id="wh318339">seized them</en> <en id="wh318340">there</en>,
<en id="wh318341">anguish</en> <en id="wh318342">like</en> <en id="wh318344">a woman in labor</en>.
<en id="wh318345">With</en> <en id="wh318346">a wind</en> <en id="wh318347">from the east</en> <en id="wh318348">You wrecked</en> <en id="wh318349">the ships</en> <en id="wh318350">of Tarshish</en>.
<en id="wh318351">As</en> <en id="wh318353">we have heard</en>,

<en id="wh318354">so</en> <en id="wh318355">we have seen</en> <en id="wh318356">in</en> <en id="wh318357">the city</en> <en id="wh318358">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh318359">of Hosts</en>, <en id="wh318360">in</en> <en id="wh318361">the city</en> <en id="wh318362">of our God</en>:
<en id="wh318363">God</en> <en id="wh318364">will establish her</en> <en id="wh318366">forever</en>.
<en id="wh318367">Selah</en>
<en id="wh318368">we contemplate</en>
<en id="wh318369">O God</en>,
<en id="wh318372">Within</en> <en id="wh318373">Your temple</en>, ... <en id="wh318370">Your loving devotion</en>.
<en id="wh318375">Your name</en>, ... <en id="wh318374">like</en>
<en id="wh318376">O God</en>,
<en id="wh318378">Your praise</en>, <en id="wh318379">reaches to</en> <en id="wh318380">the ends</en> <en id="wh318381">of the earth</en>;
<en id="wh318384">Your right hand</en> <en id="wh318383">is full</en> <en id="wh318382">of righteousness</en>.
<en id="wh318386">Mount</en> <en id="wh318387">Zion</en> ... <en id="wh318385">rejoice</en>,
<en id="wh318388">is glad</en>, <en id="wh318389">the daughters</en> <en id="wh318390">of Judah</en> ... <en id="wh318391">on account of</en> <en id="wh318392">Your judgments</en>.
<en id="wh318393">March around</en> <en id="wh318394">Zion</en>,
<en id="wh318396">encircle her</en>,
<en id="wh318397">count</en> <en id="wh318398">her towers</en>,
<en id="wh318399">consider</en> <en id="wh318402">her ramparts</en>,
<en id="wh318403">tour</en> <en id="wh318404">her citadels</en>,
<en id="wh318407">that</en> <en id="wh318406">you may tell</en> <en id="wh318409">the next</en> <en id="wh318408">generation</en>.

<en id="wh318410">For</en> <en id="wh318411">this</en> <en id="wh318412">God</en> <en id="wh318413">is our God</en> <en id="wh318414">forever</en> <en id="wh318415">and</en> <en id="wh318416">ever</en>;
<en id="wh318417">He</en> <en id="wh318418">will be our guide</en>
<en id="wh318419">even till</en> <en id="wh318420">death</en>.
<en id="wh318428">Hear</en> <en id="wh318429">this</en>,
<en id="wh318430">all you peoples</en>;
<en id="wh318433">listen</en>,
<en id="wh318434">all</en> <en id="wh318435">inhabitants</en> <en id="wh318436">of the world</en>,
<en id="wh318437">both</en> <en id="wh318438">low and high</en>,
<en id="wh318444">rich</en> <en id="wh318445">and</en> <en id="wh318446">poor</en> <en id="wh318443">alike</en>.
<en id="wh318447">My mouth</en> <en id="wh318448">will impart</en> <en id="wh318449">wisdom</en>,
<en id="wh318450">and</en> <en id="wh318451">the meditation</en> <en id="wh318452">of my heart</en> <en id="wh318453">will bring understanding</en>.
<en id="wh318454">I will incline</en> <en id="wh318457">my ear</en> <en id="wh318455">to</en> <en id="wh318456">a proverb</en>;
<en id="wh318458">I will express</en> <en id="wh318461">my riddle</en> <en id="wh318459">with</en> <en id="wh318460">the harp</en>:
<en id="wh318462">Why</en> <en id="wh318463">should I fear</en> <en id="wh318464">in</en> <en id="wh318465">times</en> <en id="wh318466">of trouble</en>,
<en id="wh318467">when wicked</en> <en id="wh318468">usurpers</en> <en id="wh318469">surround me</en>?
<en id="wh318471">They trust</en> ... <en id="wh318473">their wealth</en> ... <en id="wh318472">in</en>
<en id="wh318475">in</en> ... <en id="wh318474">and</en> <en id="wh318478">boast</en> ... <en id="wh318476">their great</en> <en id="wh318477">riches</en>.
<en id="wh318480">No</en> <en id="wh318483">man</en> <en id="wh318481">can possibly</en> <en id="wh318482">redeem</en> <en id="wh318479">his brother</en>
<en id="wh318484">or</en> <en id="wh318485">pay</en> <en id="wh318488">his ransom</en> <en id="wh318486">to</en> <en id="wh318487">God</en>.
<en id="wh318491">For the redemption</en> <en id="wh318492">of his soul</en> <en id="wh318490">is costly</en>,
<en id="wh318495">and</en> <en id="wh318496">never</en> <en id="wh318494">can payment suffice</en>,
<en id="wh318498">that he should live on</en> <en id="wh318501">forever</en> <en id="wh318500">and</en>
<en id="wh318502">not</en> <en id="wh318503">see</en> <en id="wh318505">decay</en>.
<en id="wh318506">For</en> <en id="wh318507">it is clear</en>
<en id="wh318508">that wise</en> <en id="wh318509">men die</en>,
<en id="wh318512">and</en> <en id="wh318511">the foolish</en> ... <en id="wh318513">the senseless</en> <en id="wh318510">both</en> <en id="wh318514">perish</en>
<en id="wh318515">and</en> ... <en id="wh318517">and</en> <en id="wh318516">leave</en> <en id="wh318519">their wealth</en> <en id="wh318518">to others</en>.
<en id="wh318520">Their graves</en>
<en id="wh318523">are their eternal</en> <en id="wh318521">homes</en>
— <en id="wh318524">their dwellings</en> <en id="wh318526">for endless generations</en>
— <en id="wh318532">even though</en> <en id="wh318533">their lands</en> <en id="wh318529">were their namesakes</en>.
<en id="wh318534">But</en> <en id="wh318535">a man</en>, <en id="wh318537">despite his wealth</en>, <en id="wh318538">cannot</en> <en id="wh318539">endure</en>;
<en id="wh318540">he is like</en> <en id="wh318542">the</en> <en id="wh318543">beasts</en>
<en id="wh318544">that perish</en>.
<en id="wh318545">This</en> <en id="wh318546">is the fate</en>
<en id="wh318547">of the foolish</en>
<en id="wh318549">and</en> <en id="wh318550">their followers</en> <en id="wh318553">who endorse</en> <en id="wh318552">their sayings</en>.
<en id="wh318554">Selah</en>
<en id="wh318555">Like</en> <en id="wh318557">sheep</en> <en id="wh318560">they are destined</en> <en id="wh318559">for Sheol</en>.
<en id="wh318561">Death</en> <en id="wh318562">will be their shepherd</en>.
<en id="wh318568">The</en> <en id="wh318566">upright</en> <en id="wh318564">will rule them</en> <en id="wh318565">in</en> <en id="wh318569">the morning</en>,
<en id="wh318570">and</en> <en id="wh318571">their form</en>
<en id="wh318573">will decay</en> <en id="wh318574">in Sheol</en>, <en id="wh318576">far from their lofty abode</en>.
<en id="wh318578">But</en> <en id="wh318579">God</en> <en id="wh318580">will redeem</en> <en id="wh318581">my life</en> <en id="wh318582">from</en> <en id="wh318584">Sheol</en>,
<en id="wh318585">for</en> <en id="wh318586">He will surely take me to Himself</en>.
<en id="wh318587">Selah</en>
<en id="wh318588">Do not</en> <en id="wh318589">be afraid</en>
<en id="wh318590">when</en> <en id="wh318592">a man</en> <en id="wh318591">grows rich</en>,
<en id="wh318593">when</en> <en id="wh318595">the splendor</en> <en id="wh318596">of his house</en> <en id="wh318594">increases</en>.
<en id="wh318597">For</en> <en id="wh318599">when</en> <en id="wh318600">he dies</en>, <en id="wh318601">he will carry</en> <en id="wh318598">nothing away</en>;
<en id="wh318607">his abundance</en> <en id="wh318604">will not</en> <en id="wh318606">follow him</en> <en id="wh318605">down</en>.
<en id="wh318608">Though</en> <en id="wh318610">in</en> <en id="wh318611">his lifetime</en> <en id="wh318612">he blesses</en> <en id="wh318609">his soul</en>
— <en id="wh318613">and</en> <en id="wh318614">men praise</en>
<en id="wh318615">you when</en> <en id="wh318616">you prosper</en> —
<en id="wh318618">he will join</en> <en id="wh318620">the generation</en> <en id="wh318621">of his fathers</en>,
<en id="wh318622">who will never</en> <en id="wh318625">see</en> <en id="wh318626">the light of day</en>.
<en id="wh318627">A man</en> <en id="wh318629">who has riches</en>
<en id="wh318631">without</en> <en id="wh318632">understanding</en>
<en id="wh318633">is like</en> <en id="wh318635">the</en> <en id="wh318636">beasts</en>
<en id="wh318637">that perish</en>.
<en id="wh318639">to</en>
<en id="wh318641">The Mighty One</en>, <en id="wh318642">God</en> <en id="wh318643">the LORD</en>, <en id="wh318644">speaks</en>

<en id="wh318645">and</en> <en id="wh318646">summons</en> <en id="wh318647">the earth</en> <en id="wh318648">from</en> <en id="wh318649">where the</en> <en id="wh318650">sun</en> <en id="wh318649">rises</en> ... <en id="wh318652">where it sets</en>.
<en id="wh318653">From</en> <en id="wh318654">Zion</en>, <en id="wh318655">perfect</en> <en id="wh318656">in beauty</en>, <en id="wh318657">God</en> <en id="wh318658">shines forth</en>.
<en id="wh318660">Our God</en> <en id="wh318659">approaches</en>
<en id="wh318661">and</en> <en id="wh318662">will not</en> <en id="wh318663">be silent</en>!
<en id="wh318667">Consuming</en> <en id="wh318664">fire</en> <en id="wh318666">precedes Him</en>,
<en id="wh318668">and</en> <en id="wh318670">a tempest</en> <en id="wh318669">rages around Him</en>.

<en id="wh318672">He summons</en> <en id="wh318674">the</en> <en id="wh318675">heavens</en> <en id="wh318677">above</en>, <en id="wh318678">and</en> <en id="wh318680">the</en> <en id="wh318681">earth</en>,
<en id="wh318683">that He may judge</en> <en id="wh318684">His people</en>:
“<en id="wh318685">Gather</en> <en id="wh318686">to Me</en> <en id="wh318687">My saints</en>,
<en id="wh318688">who made</en> <en id="wh318689">a covenant</en> <en id="wh318690">with Me</en> <en id="wh318691">by sacrifice</en>.”
<en id="wh318692">And</en> <en id="wh318694">the heavens</en> <en id="wh318693">proclaim</en> <en id="wh318695">His righteousness</en>,
<en id="wh318696">for</en> <en id="wh318697">God</en>
<en id="wh318699">Himself</en> <en id="wh318698">is Judge</en>.
<en id="wh318700">Selah</en>
“<en id="wh318701">Hear</en>,
<en id="wh318702">O My people</en>,
<en id="wh318703">and</en> <en id="wh318704">I will speak</en>,
<en id="wh318705">O Israel</en>,
<en id="wh318706">and</en> <en id="wh318707">I will testify</en> <en id="wh318708">against you</en>:
<en id="wh318711">I</en> <en id="wh318709">am God</en>, <en id="wh318710">your God</en>.
<en id="wh318712">I do not</en> <en id="wh318715">rebuke</en> <en id="wh318713">you for</en> <en id="wh318714">your sacrifices</en>,
<en id="wh318716">and</en> <en id="wh318717">your burnt offerings</en> <en id="wh318720">are ever</en> <en id="wh318719">before Me</en>.
<en id="wh318721">I have no</en> <en id="wh318722">need</en> <en id="wh318725">for a bull</en> <en id="wh318723">from</en> <en id="wh318724">your stall</en>
<en id="wh318728">or goats</en> <en id="wh318726">from</en> <en id="wh318727">your pens</en>,
<en id="wh318729">for</en> <en id="wh318731">every</en> <en id="wh318732">beast</en> <en id="wh318733">of the forest</en> <en id="wh318730">is Mine</en>
— <en id="wh318734">the cattle</en> <en id="wh318735">on</en> <en id="wh318737">a thousand</en> <en id="wh318736">hills</en>.
<en id="wh318738">I know</en> <en id="wh318739">every</en> <en id="wh318740">bird</en> <en id="wh318741">in the mountains</en>,
<en id="wh318742">and</en> <en id="wh318743">the creatures</en> <en id="wh318744">of the field</en> <en id="wh318745">are Mine</en>.
<en id="wh318746">If</en> <en id="wh318747">I were hungry</en>,
<en id="wh318748">I would not</en> <en id="wh318749">tell</en> <en id="wh318750">you</en>,
<en id="wh318751">for</en> <en id="wh318753">the world</en> <en id="wh318752">is Mine</en>, <en id="wh318754">and</en> <en id="wh318755">the fullness thereof</en>.
<en id="wh318757">Do I eat</en> <en id="wh318758">the flesh</en> <en id="wh318759">of bulls</en>,
<en id="wh318760">or</en> <en id="wh318763">drink</en> <en id="wh318761">the blood</en> <en id="wh318762">of goats</en>?
<en id="wh318764">Sacrifice</en> <en id="wh318767">a thank offering</en> <en id="wh318765">to</en> <en id="wh318766">God</en>,
<en id="wh318768">and</en> <en id="wh318769">fulfill</en> <en id="wh318772">your vows</en> <en id="wh318770">to</en> <en id="wh318771">the Most High</en>.
<en id="wh318774">Call upon Me</en> <en id="wh318775">in</en> <en id="wh318776">the day</en> <en id="wh318777">of trouble</en>;
<en id="wh318778">I will deliver you</en>,
<en id="wh318779">and</en> <en id="wh318780">you will honor Me</en>.”
<en id="wh318782">To</en> <en id="wh318783">the</en> <en id="wh318784">wicked, however</en>, <en id="wh318786">God</en> <en id="wh318785">says</en>,
“<en id="wh318787">What right</en> <en id="wh318788">have you</en>
<en id="wh318789">to</en> <en id="wh318790">recite</en> <en id="wh318791">My statutes</en>
<en id="wh318792">and</en> <en id="wh318793">to bear</en> <en id="wh318794">My covenant</en> <en id="wh318795">on</en> <en id="wh318796">your lips</en>?
<en id="wh318798">For you</en> <en id="wh318799">hate</en> <en id="wh318800">My instruction</en>
<en id="wh318801">and</en> <en id="wh318802">cast</en> <en id="wh318803">My words</en> <en id="wh318804">behind you</en>.
<en id="wh318805">When</en> <en id="wh318806">you see</en> <en id="wh318807">a thief</en>,
<en id="wh318809">you befriend</en> <en id="wh318810">him</en>,
<en id="wh318811">and</en> <en id="wh318814">throw in your lot</en> <en id="wh318812">with</en> <en id="wh318813">adulterers</en>.
<en id="wh318816">You unleash</en> <en id="wh318815">your mouth</en> <en id="wh318818">for evil</en>
<en id="wh318819">and</en> <en id="wh318821">harness</en> <en id="wh318820">your tongue</en> <en id="wh318822">to deceit</en>.
<en id="wh318823">You sit</en>
<en id="wh318826">and malign</en> <en id="wh318825">your brother</en>;
<en id="wh318830">you</en> <en id="wh318831">slander</en> <en id="wh318829">your own mother’s</en> <en id="wh318828">son</en>.
<en id="wh318833">You have done</en> <en id="wh318832">these things</en>,
<en id="wh318834">and</en> <en id="wh318835">I kept silent</en>;
<en id="wh318836">you thought</en>
<en id="wh318837">I was</en> <en id="wh318839">just like you</en>.
<en id="wh318840">now I rebuke you</en>
<en id="wh318841">But</en> ... <en id="wh318843">and</en> <en id="wh318842">accuse you</en> <en id="wh318844">to your face</en>.
<en id="wh318846">Now</en> <en id="wh318845">consider</en> <en id="wh318847">this</en>,
<en id="wh318848">you who forget</en> <en id="wh318849">God</en>,
<en id="wh318850">lest</en> <en id="wh318851">I tear you to pieces</en>,
<en id="wh318853">with no one</en> <en id="wh318854">to rescue you</en>:
<en id="wh318855">He who sacrifices</en> <en id="wh318856">a thank offering</en>
<en id="wh318857">honors Me</en>,
<en id="wh318858">and</en> <en id="wh318859">to him who rightly orders</en> <en id="wh318860">his way</en>,
<en id="wh318861">I will show</en> <en id="wh318863">the salvation</en> <en id="wh318864">of God</en>.”
<en id="wh318882">Have mercy on me</en>,
<en id="wh318883">O God</en>,
<en id="wh318885">according to Your loving devotion</en>;
<en id="wh318887">according to Your great</en> <en id="wh318888">compassion</en>, <en id="wh318889">blot out</en> <en id="wh318890">my transgressions</en>.
<en id="wh318891">clean</en>
<en id="wh318892">Wash me</en> ... <en id="wh318894">of my iniquity</en>
<en id="wh318895">and</en> <en id="wh318898">cleanse me</en> <en id="wh318896">from</en> <en id="wh318897">my sin</en>.
<en id="wh318899">For</en> <en id="wh318901">I</en> <en id="wh318902">know</en> <en id="wh318900">my transgressions</en>,
<en id="wh318903">and</en> <en id="wh318904">my sin</en> <en id="wh318906">is always</en> <en id="wh318905">before me</en>.
<en id="wh318907">Against You</en>, <en id="wh318909">You only</en>, <en id="wh318910">have I sinned</en>
<en id="wh318913">what is evil</en> <en id="wh318914">in</en> <en id="wh318915">Your sight</en>,
<en id="wh318916">and done</en>
<en id="wh318917">so that</en> <en id="wh318918">You may be proved right</en>
<en id="wh318919">when</en> <en id="wh318920">You speak</en>
<en id="wh318921">and blameless</en>
<en id="wh318922">when</en> <en id="wh318923">You judge</en>.
<en id="wh318924">Surely</en> <en id="wh318927">I was brought forth</en> <en id="wh318925">in</en> <en id="wh318926">iniquity</en>;
<en id="wh318930">I was sinful</en> <en id="wh318929">when</en> <en id="wh318932">my mother</en> <en id="wh318931">conceived me</en>.
<en id="wh318933">Surely</en> <en id="wh318935">You desire</en> <en id="wh318934">truth</en> <en id="wh318936">in</en> <en id="wh318937">the</en> <en id="wh318938">inmost being</en>;
<en id="wh318943">You teach me</en> <en id="wh318942">wisdom</en> <en id="wh318940">in</en> <en id="wh318941">the inmost place</en>.
<en id="wh318944">Purify me</en> <en id="wh318945">with</en> <en id="wh318946">hyssop</en>,
<en id="wh318947">and</en> <en id="wh318948">I will be clean</en>;
<en id="wh318949">wash me</en>,
<en id="wh318950">and</en> <en id="wh318953">I will be whiter</en> <en id="wh318952">than snow</en>.
<en id="wh318954">Let me hear</en> <en id="wh318957">joy</en> <en id="wh318956">and</en> <en id="wh318955">gladness</en>;
<en id="wh318959">let the bones</en> ... <en id="wh318958">rejoice</en>.
<en id="wh318960">You have crushed</en>
<en id="wh318961">Hide</en> <en id="wh318962">Your face</en> <en id="wh318963">from</en> <en id="wh318964">my sins</en>
<en id="wh318965">and</en> <en id="wh318968">blot out</en> <en id="wh318966">all</en> <en id="wh318967">my iniquities</en>.
<en id="wh318971">Create</en> <en id="wh318972">in me</en> <en id="wh318970">a clean</en> <en id="wh318969">heart</en>,
<en id="wh318973">O God</en>,
<en id="wh318974">and</en> <en id="wh318977">renew</en> <en id="wh318976">a right</en> <en id="wh318975">spirit</en> <en id="wh318979">within me</en>.

<en id="wh319031">The sacrifices</en> <en id="wh319032">of God</en> <en id="wh319034">are a broken</en> <en id="wh319033">spirit</en>;

<en id="wh319039">O God</en>,

<en id="wh319050">Then</en> <en id="wh319051">You will delight</en> <en id="wh319053">in righteous</en> <en id="wh319052">sacrifices</en>, <en id="wh319056">in whole</en> <en id="wh319054">burnt offerings</en>;
<en id="wh319057">then</en> <en id="wh319061">bulls</en> <en id="wh319058">will be offered</en> <en id="wh319059">on</en> <en id="wh319060">Your altar</en>.
<en id="wh319084">of</en>
<en id="wh319085">Why</en> <en id="wh319086">do you boast</en> ... <en id="wh319088">evil</en>,
<en id="wh319090">O mighty man</en>? <en id="wh319089">The</en>
<en id="wh319091">loving devotion</en> <en id="wh319092">of God</en> <en id="wh319093">endures all</en> <en id="wh319095">day long</en>.
<en id="wh319097">devises</en> <en id="wh319096">destruction</en>
<en id="wh319098">Your tongue</en> ... <en id="wh319099">like</en> <en id="wh319101">a sharpened</en> <en id="wh319100">razor</en>,
<en id="wh319102">O worker</en> <en id="wh319103">of deceit</en>.
<en id="wh319104">You love</en> <en id="wh319105">evil</en> <en id="wh319107">more than good</en>,
<en id="wh319108">falsehood</en>

<en id="wh319112">Selah</en>
<en id="wh319113">You love</en> <en id="wh319114">every</en> <en id="wh319115">word</en> <en id="wh319116">that devours</en>,

<en id="wh319119">Surely</en> <en id="wh319120">God</en> <en id="wh319121">will bring you down</en> <en id="wh319122">to</en> <en id="wh319123">everlasting ruin</en>;

<en id="wh319134">Selah</en>
<en id="wh319137">The righteous</en> <en id="wh319136">will see</en>
<en id="wh319138">and</en> <en id="wh319139">fear</en>;
<en id="wh319142">they will mock the evildoer, saying</en>,
“<en id="wh319143">Look at</en> <en id="wh319144">the</en> <en id="wh319145">man</en>
<en id="wh319146">who did not</en> <en id="wh319147">make</en> <en id="wh319148">God</en> <en id="wh319149">his refuge</en>,
<en id="wh319151">but trusted</en> <en id="wh319152">in</en> <en id="wh319153">the abundance</en> <en id="wh319150">of</en> <en id="wh319154">his wealth</en>
<en id="wh319155">and strengthened himself</en> <en id="wh319156">by</en> <en id="wh319157">destruction</en>.”
<en id="wh319159">But I</en> <en id="wh319161">am like an olive tree</en> <en id="wh319162">flourishing</en> <en id="wh319163">in</en> <en id="wh319164">the house</en> <en id="wh319165">of God</en>;

<en id="wh319166">I trust</en> <en id="wh319167">in</en> <en id="wh319168">the loving devotion</en> <en id="wh319169">of God</en> <en id="wh319170">forever</en> <en id="wh319171">and</en> <en id="wh319172">ever</en>.
<en id="wh319173">I will praise You</en> <en id="wh319175">forever</en>,
<en id="wh319176">because</en> <en id="wh319177">You have done it</en>.
<en id="wh319179">I will wait on</en> <en id="wh319180">Your name</en>
— <en id="wh319181">for</en> <en id="wh319182">it is good</en> — <en id="wh319183">in the presence</en> <en id="wh319184">of Your saints</en>.
<en id="wh319194">The fool</en> <en id="wh319193">says</en> <en id="wh319195">in</en> <en id="wh319196">his heart</en>,
“<en id="wh319197">There is no</en> <en id="wh319198">God</en>.”
<en id="wh319199">They are corrupt</en>;
<en id="wh319201">their ways</en> <en id="wh319202">are vile</en>.
<en id="wh319203">There is no</en> <en id="wh319204">one who does</en> <en id="wh319205">good</en>.

<en id="wh319206">God</en> <en id="wh319209">looks down</en> <en id="wh319207">from</en> <en id="wh319208">heaven</en> <en id="wh319210">upon</en> <en id="wh319211">the sons</en> <en id="wh319212">of men</en>
<en id="wh319213">to</en> <en id="wh319214">see</en>
<en id="wh319216">if any</en> <en id="wh319217">understand</en>,
<en id="wh319218">if any seek</en> <en id="wh319220">God</en>.
<en id="wh319221">All</en> <en id="wh319222">have turned away</en>,
<en id="wh319223">they have together</en> <en id="wh319224">become corrupt</en>;
<en id="wh319225">there is no</en> <en id="wh319226">one who does</en> <en id="wh319227">good</en>,
<en id="wh319228">not</en> <en id="wh319229">even</en> <en id="wh319230">one</en>.
<en id="wh319234">Will the workers</en> <en id="wh319235">of iniquity</en> <en id="wh319232">never</en> <en id="wh319233">learn</en>?
<en id="wh319236">They devour</en> <en id="wh319237">my people</en> <en id="wh319238">like</en> <en id="wh319239">bread</en>;
<en id="wh319241">they refuse</en> <en id="wh319242">to call</en> <en id="wh319240">upon God</en>.
<en id="wh319243">There they are</en>, <en id="wh319244">overwhelmed</en> <en id="wh319245">with dread</en>,
<en id="wh319247">where there was</en> <en id="wh319246">nothing</en> <en id="wh319248">to fear</en>.
<en id="wh319249">For</en> <en id="wh319250">God</en> <en id="wh319251">has scattered</en> <en id="wh319252">the bones</en> <en id="wh319253">of those who besieged you</en>.
<en id="wh319254">You put them to shame</en>,
<en id="wh319255">for</en> <en id="wh319256">God</en> <en id="wh319257">has despised them</en>.
<en id="wh319258">Oh, that</en> ... <en id="wh319259">would come</en>
<en id="wh319262">the salvation</en> <en id="wh319263">of Israel</en> ... <en id="wh319260">from</en> <en id="wh319261">Zion</en>!
<en id="wh319264">When</en> <en id="wh319266">God</en> <en id="wh319265">restores</en> <en id="wh319267">His captive</en> <en id="wh319268">people</en>,
<en id="wh319270">let Jacob</en> ... <en id="wh319269">be glad</en>!
<en id="wh319271">rejoice</en>, <en id="wh319272">let Israel</en>
<en id="wh319294">O God</en>,
<en id="wh319297">Save me</en>, ... <en id="wh319295">by</en> <en id="wh319296">Your name</en>,
<en id="wh319298">and</en> <en id="wh319301">vindicate me</en> <en id="wh319299">by</en> <en id="wh319300">Your might</en>!
<en id="wh319302">O God</en>;
<en id="wh319303">Hear</en> <en id="wh319304">my prayer</en>,
<en id="wh319305">listen</en> <en id="wh319306">to</en> <en id="wh319307">the words</en> <en id="wh319308">of my mouth</en>.
<en id="wh319309">For</en> <en id="wh319310">strangers</en> <en id="wh319311">rise up</en> <en id="wh319312">against me</en>,
<en id="wh319313">and</en> <en id="wh319314">ruthless</en> <en id="wh319315">men seek</en> <en id="wh319316">my life</en>
— <en id="wh319317">men with no</en> <en id="wh319318">regard</en> <en id="wh319319">for God</en>.
<en id="wh319322">Selah</en>
<en id="wh319323">Surely</en> <en id="wh319324">God</en> <en id="wh319325">is my helper</en>;
<en id="wh319327">the Lord</en> <en id="wh319329">is the sustainer</en> <en id="wh319330">of my soul</en>.
<en id="wh319331">He will reward</en> <en id="wh319335">my enemies</en> <en id="wh319333">with evil</en>.

<en id="wh319340">Freely</en> <en id="wh319341">I will sacrifice</en> <en id="wh319342">to You</en>;
<en id="wh319343">I will praise</en> <en id="wh319344">Your name</en>,
<en id="wh319345">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh319346">for</en> <en id="wh319347">it is good</en>.
<en id="wh319348">For</en> <en id="wh319352">He has delivered me</en> <en id="wh319349">from</en> <en id="wh319350">every</en> <en id="wh319351">trouble</en>,
<en id="wh319353">and</en> <en id="wh319357">my eyes</en> <en id="wh319356">have looked</en> <en id="wh319354">in</en> <en id="wh319356">triumph on</en> <en id="wh319355">my foes</en>.
<en id="wh319364">to</en>
<en id="wh319366">Listen</en>
<en id="wh319367">O God</en>,
<en id="wh319368">my prayer</en>,
<en id="wh319369">and</en> <en id="wh319370">do not</en> <en id="wh319371">ignore</en> <en id="wh319373">my plea</en>.
<en id="wh319374">Attend</en> ... <en id="wh319375">me</en>
<en id="wh319376">to</en> ... <en id="wh319377">and answer me</en>.
<en id="wh319378">I am restless</en> <en id="wh319379">in</en> <en id="wh319380">my complaint</en>,
<en id="wh319381">and</en> <en id="wh319382">distraught</en>
<en id="wh319384">at the voice</en> <en id="wh319385">of the enemy</en>,
<en id="wh319386">at</en> <en id="wh319388">the pressure</en> <en id="wh319389">of the wicked</en>.
<en id="wh319390">For</en> <en id="wh319391">they bring down</en> <en id="wh319393">disaster</en> <en id="wh319392">upon me</en>

<en id="wh319398">My heart</en> <en id="wh319399">pounds</en> <en id="wh319401">within me</en>,

<en id="wh319407">Fear</en> <en id="wh319408">and</en> <en id="wh319409">trembling</en> <en id="wh319410">grip</en> <en id="wh319411">me</en>,
<en id="wh319412">and</en> <en id="wh319414">horror</en> <en id="wh319413">has overwhelmed me</en>.
<en id="wh319416">I said</en>, ... <en id="wh319415">that</en>
<en id="wh319420">I had</en> wings <en id="wh319421">like</en> <en id="wh319423">a dove</en>!
<en id="wh319424">I would fly away</en>

<en id="wh319521">But I</en> <en id="wh319524">call</en> <en id="wh319522">to</en> <en id="wh319523">God</en>,

<en id="wh319539">He redeems</en> <en id="wh319542">my soul</en> <en id="wh319540">in</en> <en id="wh319541">peace</en> <en id="wh319543">from</en> <en id="wh319544">the battle</en> ... <en id="wh319545">me</en>.

<en id="wh319552">God</en> <en id="wh319551">will hear</en>
<en id="wh319553">and</en> <en id="wh319554">humiliate them</en>
— <en id="wh319556">the One enthroned</en> <en id="wh319557">for the ages</en>
— <en id="wh319558">Selah</en>
<en id="wh319559">because</en> <en id="wh319560">they do not</en> <en id="wh319561">change</en>

<en id="wh319567">My companion attacks</en> <en id="wh319570">his friends</en>;
<en id="wh319571">he violates</en> <en id="wh319572">his covenant</en>.
<en id="wh319575">His speech</en> <en id="wh319573">is smooth</en> <en id="wh319574">as butter</en>,
<en id="wh319576">but</en> <en id="wh319577">war</en> <en id="wh319578">is in his heart</en>.
<en id="wh319580">His words</en> <en id="wh319579">are softer</en> <en id="wh319582">than oil</en>,
<en id="wh319584">yet they are</en> <en id="wh319585">swords unsheathed</en>.
<en id="wh319586">Cast</en> <en id="wh319589">your burden</en> <en id="wh319587">upon</en> <en id="wh319588">the LORD</en>
<en id="wh319590">and</en> <en id="wh319591">He</en> <en id="wh319592">will sustain you</en>;
<en id="wh319593">He will never</en> <en id="wh319594">let</en> <en id="wh319599">the</en> <en id="wh319600">righteous</en> <en id="wh319597">be shaken</en>.
<en id="wh319601">But</en> <en id="wh319602">You</en>,
<en id="wh319603">O God</en>,
<en id="wh319604">will bring them down</en> <en id="wh319605">to</en> <en id="wh319606">the</en> <en id="wh319607">Pit</en>

of destruction; <en id="wh319608">men</en> <en id="wh319609">of bloodshed</en> <en id="wh319610">and</en> <en id="wh319611">deceit</en> <en id="wh319612">will not</en> <en id="wh319613">live out half</en> <en id="wh319614">their days</en>.
<en id="wh319616">But I</en> <en id="wh319617">will trust</en> <en id="wh319615">in</en> <en id="wh319618">You</en>.
<en id="wh319635">Be merciful to me</en>,
<en id="wh319636">O God</en>,
<en id="wh319637">for</en> <en id="wh319639">men</en> <en id="wh319638">are hounding me</en>;

<en id="wh319646">My enemies</en> <en id="wh319645">pursue me</en> <en id="wh319647">all</en> <en id="wh319649">day long</en>,
<en id="wh319650">for</en> <en id="wh319651">many</en> <en id="wh319654">proudly</en> <en id="wh319652">assail</en> <en id="wh319653">me</en>.
<en id="wh319655">When</en>
<en id="wh319656">I am afraid</en>,
<en id="wh319657">I</en> <en id="wh319659">put my trust</en> <en id="wh319658">in You</en>.
<en id="wh319660">In</en> <en id="wh319661">God</en>, <en id="wh319663">whose word</en> <en id="wh319662">I praise</en>
— <en id="wh319664">in</en> <en id="wh319665">God</en> <en id="wh319666">I trust</en>.
<en id="wh319667">I will not</en> <en id="wh319668">be afraid</en>.

<en id="wh330473">His descendants</en> <en id="wh330472">will be</en> <en id="wh330468">mighty</en> <en id="wh330469">in</en> <en id="wh330471">the land</en>; <en id="wh330470">the</en>

<en id="wh330491">Light</en> <en id="wh330487">dawns</en> <en id="wh330488">in</en> <en id="wh330489">the</en> <en id="wh330490">darkness</en> <en id="wh330494">for the upright</en>
— <en id="wh330495">for the gracious</en>, <en id="wh330497">compassionate</en>, <en id="wh330498">and</en> <en id="wh330499">righteous</en>.

<en id="wh330526">trusting</en> <en id="wh330527">in</en> <en id="wh330528">the LORD</en>.

<en id="wh330531">he does not</en> <en id="wh330532">fear</en>,

<en id="wh330580">From</en> <en id="wh330581">where the sun rises</en> <en id="wh330583">to</en> <en id="wh330584">where it sets</en>, <en id="wh330582">the</en> <en id="wh330586">name</en> <en id="wh330587">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh330585">is praised</en>.

<en id="wh330606">He humbles Himself</en>
<en id="wh330607">to</en> <en id="wh330608">behold</en> <en id="wh330610">the</en> <en id="wh330611">heavens</en> <en id="wh330612">and</en> <en id="wh330614">the</en> <en id="wh330615">earth</en>.

<en id="wh330657">The</en> <en id="wh330658">sea</en> <en id="wh330659">observed</en>
<en id="wh330660">and</en> <en id="wh330661">fled</en>;
<en id="wh330662">the</en> <en id="wh330663">Jordan</en> <en id="wh330664">turned</en> <en id="wh330666">back</en>;

<en id="wh330676">Why was it</en>,
<en id="wh330679">O sea</en>,

<en id="wh330717">Not</en> <en id="wh330718">to us</en>,

<en id="wh332229">therefore</en> <en id="wh332230">I love</en> <en id="wh332231">Your testimonies</en>.
