<en id="wh332239">I stand in fear</en> <en id="wh332238">of Your judgments</en>.
<en id="wh332240">I have done</en> <en id="wh332241">what is just</en> <en id="wh332242">and</en> <en id="wh332243">right</en>;
<en id="wh332244">do not</en> <en id="wh332245">leave me</en> <en id="wh332246">to</en> <en id="wh332247">my oppressors</en>.
<en id="wh332248">Ensure</en> <en id="wh332249">Your servant’s</en> <en id="wh332251">well-being</en>;
<en id="wh332252">do not</en> <en id="wh332254">let the arrogant</en> <en id="wh332253">oppress me</en>.

<en id="wh332255">My eyes</en> <en id="wh332256">fail</en>, <en id="wh332258">looking for Your salvation</en>, <en id="wh332260">and</en> <en id="wh332262">for Your righteous</en> <en id="wh332261">promise</en>.
<en id="wh332263">Deal</en> <en id="wh332264">with</en> <en id="wh332265">Your servant</en> <en id="wh332267">according to Your loving devotion</en>,
<en id="wh332268">and</en> <en id="wh332270">teach me</en> <en id="wh332269">Your statutes</en>.
<en id="wh332272">I</en> <en id="wh332271">am Your servant</en>;
<en id="wh332273">give me understanding</en>,
<en id="wh332275">that I may know</en> <en id="wh332276">Your testimonies</en>.
<en id="wh332277">It is time</en>
<en id="wh332278">to</en> <en id="wh332279">act</en>,
<en id="wh332281">for the LORD</en>
<en id="wh332282">for they have broken</en> <en id="wh332283">Your law</en>.
<en id="wh332285">Therefore</en> <en id="wh332286">I love</en> <en id="wh332287">Your commandments</en> <en id="wh332289">more than gold</en>, <en id="wh332292">even the purest gold</en>.
<en id="wh332294">Therefore</en> <en id="wh332298">I admire</en> <en id="wh332295">all</en> <en id="wh332296">Your precepts</en>
<en id="wh332302">and hate</en> <en id="wh332299">every</en> <en id="wh332301">false</en> <en id="wh332300">way</en>.
<en id="wh332303">Wonderful are</en> <en id="wh332304">Your testimonies</en>;
<en id="wh332306">therefore</en> <en id="wh332308">I</en> <en id="wh332307">obey them</en>.
<en id="wh332309">The unfolding</en> <en id="wh332310">of Your words</en> <en id="wh332311">gives light</en>;
<en id="wh332312">it informs</en> <en id="wh332313">the simple</en>.
<en id="wh332315">I open</en> <en id="wh332314">my mouth</en>
<en id="wh332316">and</en> <en id="wh332317">pant</en>,
<en id="wh332321">longing</en> <en id="wh332320">for Your commandments</en>.
<en id="wh332322">Turn</en> <en id="wh332323">to me</en>

<en id="wh332324">and</en> <en id="wh332325">show me mercy</en>, <en id="wh332326">as</en> <en id="wh332327">You do</en> <en id="wh332328">to</en> <en id="wh332329">those who love</en> <en id="wh332330">Your name</en>.
<en id="wh332332">Order</en> <en id="wh332331">my steps</en> <en id="wh332333">in</en> <en id="wh332334">Your word</en>;
<en id="wh332336">let no</en> <en id="wh332340">sin</en> <en id="wh332337">rule</en> <en id="wh332338">over me</en>.
<en id="wh332341">Redeem me</en> <en id="wh332342">from</en> <en id="wh332343">the oppression</en> <en id="wh332344">of man</en>,
<en id="wh332346">that I may keep</en> <en id="wh332347">Your precepts</en>.
<en id="wh332348">Make Your face</en> <en id="wh332349">shine</en> <en id="wh332351">upon Your servant</en>, ... <en id="wh332350">me</en>
<en id="wh332352">and</en> <en id="wh332353">teach</en> ... <en id="wh332355">Your statutes</en>.
<en id="wh332359">My eyes</en> <en id="wh332358">shed</en> <en id="wh332356">streams</en> <en id="wh332357">of tears</en>
<en id="wh332360">because</en> <en id="wh332363">Your law</en> <en id="wh332361">is not</en> <en id="wh332362">obeyed</en>.
<en id="wh332364">Righteous</en> <en id="wh332365">are You</en>,
<en id="wh332366">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh332367">and</en> <en id="wh332368">upright</en> <en id="wh332369">are Your judgments</en>.

<en id="wh332372">The testimonies</en> <en id="wh332370">You have laid down</en> <en id="wh332371">are righteous</en> <en id="wh332373">and</en> <en id="wh332375">altogether</en> <en id="wh332374">faithful</en>.
<en id="wh332377">My zeal</en> <en id="wh332376">has consumed me</en>
<en id="wh332378">because</en> <en id="wh332381">my foes</en> <en id="wh332379">forget</en> <en id="wh332380">Your words</en>.
<en id="wh332383">Your promise</en> <en id="wh332384">is completely</en> <en id="wh332382">pure</en>;
<en id="wh332386">therefore Your servant</en> <en id="wh332387">loves it</en>.
<en id="wh332389">I</en> <en id="wh332388">am lowly</en>
<en id="wh332390">and</en> <en id="wh332391">despised</en>,
<en id="wh332393">but I do not</en> <en id="wh332394">forget</en> <en id="wh332392">Your precepts</en>.
<en id="wh332395">Your righteousness</en> <en id="wh332398">is everlasting</en>
<en id="wh332399">and</en> <en id="wh332400">Your law</en> <en id="wh332401">is true</en>.
<en id="wh332402">Trouble</en> <en id="wh332403">and</en> <en id="wh332404">distress</en> <en id="wh332405">have found me</en>,
<en id="wh332406">but Your commandments</en> <en id="wh332407">are my delight</en>.
<en id="wh332409">Your testimonies</en> <en id="wh332408">are righteous</en> <en id="wh332411">forever</en>.
<en id="wh332412">Give me understanding</en>,
<en id="wh332414">that I may live</en>.
<en id="wh332415">I call</en> <en id="wh332416">with</en> <en id="wh332417">all</en> <en id="wh332418">my heart</en>;
<en id="wh332419">answer me</en>,
<en id="wh332420">O LORD</en>!
<en id="wh332422">I will obey</en> <en id="wh332421">Your statutes</en>.
<en id="wh332423">I call to You</en>;
<en id="wh332424">save me</en>,
<en id="wh332426">that I may keep</en> <en id="wh332427">Your testimonies</en>.
<en id="wh332428">I rise</en> <en id="wh332431">before dawn</en>
<en id="wh332432">and</en> <en id="wh332433">cry for help</en>;
<en id="wh332434">in</en> <en id="wh332435">Your word</en> <en id="wh332436">I have put my hope</en>.
<en id="wh332438">My eyes</en> <en id="wh332437">anticipate</en> <en id="wh332439">the watches of night</en>,
<en id="wh332441">that I may meditate</en> <en id="wh332442">on</en> <en id="wh332443">Your word</en>.
<en id="wh332445">Hear</en> <en id="wh332444">my voice</en>, ... <en id="wh332447">according to Your loving devotion</en>;
<en id="wh332448">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh332451">give me life</en> <en id="wh332450">according to Your justice</en>.
<en id="wh332453">Those who follow</en> <en id="wh332454">after wickedness</en> <en id="wh332452">draw near</en>;
<en id="wh332457">they are far</en> <en id="wh332455">from</en> <en id="wh332456">Your law</en>.
<en id="wh332459">You</en> <en id="wh332458">are near</en>,
<en id="wh332460">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh332461">and</en> <en id="wh332462">all</en> <en id="wh332463">Your commandments</en> <en id="wh332464">are true</en>.
<en id="wh332465">Long ago</en> <en id="wh332466">I learned</en> <en id="wh332467">from</en> <en id="wh332468">Your testimonies</en>
<en id="wh332469">that</en> <en id="wh332472">You have established them</en> <en id="wh332471">forever</en>.
<en id="wh332473">Look</en> <en id="wh332474">upon my affliction</en>
<en id="wh332475">and</en> <en id="wh332476">rescue me</en>,
<en id="wh332477">for</en> <en id="wh332479">I have not</en> <en id="wh332480">forgotten</en> <en id="wh332478">Your law</en>.
<en id="wh332481">Defend</en> <en id="wh332482">my cause</en>
<en id="wh332483">and</en> <en id="wh332484">redeem me</en>;
<en id="wh332487">revive me</en> <en id="wh332486">according to Your word</en>.
<en id="wh332491">Salvation</en> <en id="wh332488">is far</en> <en id="wh332489">from</en> <en id="wh332490">the wicked</en>
<en id="wh332492">because</en> <en id="wh332494">they do not</en> <en id="wh332495">seek</en> <en id="wh332493">Your statutes</en>.
<en id="wh332497">Great</en> <en id="wh332496">are Your mercies</en>,
<en id="wh332498">O LORD</en>;
<en id="wh332501">revive me</en> <en id="wh332500">according to Your ordinances</en>.
<en id="wh332503">Though my persecutors</en> <en id="wh332504">and</en> <en id="wh332505">foes</en> <en id="wh332502">are many</en>,
<en id="wh332508">I have not</en> <en id="wh332509">turned</en> <en id="wh332506">from</en> <en id="wh332507">Your testimonies</en>.
<en id="wh332510">I look on</en> <en id="wh332511">the faithless</en>
<en id="wh332513">with loathing</en>
<en id="wh332514">because</en> <en id="wh332516">they do not</en> <en id="wh332517">keep</en> <en id="wh332515">Your word</en>.
<en id="wh332518">Consider</en>
<en id="wh332519">how</en> <en id="wh332521">I love</en> <en id="wh332520">Your precepts</en>,
<en id="wh332522">O LORD</en>;
<en id="wh332525">give me life</en> <en id="wh332524">according to Your loving devotion</en>.
<en id="wh332526">The entirety</en> <en id="wh332527">of Your word</en> ... <en id="wh332528">truth</en>,
<en id="wh332529">is</en> ... <en id="wh332530">and</en> <en id="wh332532">all</en> <en id="wh332534">Your righteous</en> <en id="wh332533">judgments</en> <en id="wh332531">endure forever</en>.
<en id="wh332535">Rulers</en> <en id="wh332536">persecute me</en> <en id="wh332537">without cause</en>,
<en id="wh332538">but</en> <en id="wh332542">my heart</en> <en id="wh332541">fears only</en> <en id="wh332540">Your word</en>.
<en id="wh332544">I</en> <en id="wh332543">rejoice</en> <en id="wh332545">in</en> <en id="wh332546">Your promise</en>
<en id="wh332547">like</en> <en id="wh332548">one who finds</en> <en id="wh332550">great</en> <en id="wh332549">spoil</en>.
<en id="wh332552">I hate</en> ... <en id="wh332551">falsehood</en>,
<en id="wh332553">and</en> <en id="wh332554">abhor</en>
<en id="wh332555">but Your law</en> <en id="wh332556">I love</en>.
<en id="wh332557">Seven times</en> <en id="wh332560">a day</en> <en id="wh332561">I praise You</en> <en id="wh332558">for</en> <en id="wh332564">Your righteous</en> <en id="wh332563">judgments</en>.
<en id="wh332566">Abundant</en> <en id="wh332565">peace belongs</en> <en id="wh332567">to</en> <en id="wh332568">those who love</en> <en id="wh332569">Your law</en>;
<en id="wh332571">nothing</en> <en id="wh332573">can make them stumble</en>.
<en id="wh332574">I wait</en> <en id="wh332576">for Your salvation</en>,
<en id="wh332577">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh332578">and</en> <en id="wh332580">I carry out</en> <en id="wh332579">Your commandments</en>.
<en id="wh332582">I</en> <en id="wh332581">obey</en> <en id="wh332583">Your testimonies</en>
<en id="wh332584">and</en> <en id="wh332585">love them</en> <en id="wh332586">greatly</en>.
<en id="wh332587">I obey</en> <en id="wh332588">Your precepts</en> <en id="wh332589">and</en> <en id="wh332590">Your testimonies</en>,
<en id="wh332591">for</en> <en id="wh332592">all</en> <en id="wh332593">my ways</en> <en id="wh332594">are before You</en>.
<en id="wh332596">May my cry</en> <en id="wh332595">come</en> <en id="wh332598">before You</en>,
<en id="wh332599">O LORD</en>;
<en id="wh332602">give me understanding</en> <en id="wh332601">according to Your word</en>.
<en id="wh332604">May my plea</en> <en id="wh332603">come</en> <en id="wh332606">before You</en>;
<en id="wh332609">rescue me</en> <en id="wh332608">according to Your promise</en>.
<en id="wh332611">My lips</en> <en id="wh332610">pour forth</en> <en id="wh332612">praise</en>,
<en id="wh332613">for</en> <en id="wh332614">You teach me</en> <en id="wh332615">Your statutes</en>.
<en id="wh332617">My tongue</en> <en id="wh332616">sings</en> <en id="wh332618">of Your word</en>,
<en id="wh332619">for</en> <en id="wh332620">all</en> <en id="wh332621">Your commandments</en> <en id="wh332622">are righteous</en>.
<en id="wh332624">May Your hand</en> <en id="wh332623">be ready</en>
<en id="wh332625">to</en> <en id="wh332626">help me</en>,
<en id="wh332627">for</en> <en id="wh332629">I have chosen</en> <en id="wh332628">Your precepts</en>.
<en id="wh332630">I long</en> <en id="wh332632">for Your salvation</en>,
<en id="wh332633">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh332634">and</en> <en id="wh332635">Your law</en> <en id="wh332636">is my delight</en>.
<en id="wh332638">Let me</en> <en id="wh332637">live</en>
<en id="wh332640">to praise You</en>;
<en id="wh332642">may Your judgments</en> <en id="wh332643">sustain me</en>.
<en id="wh332644">I have strayed</en> <en id="wh332645">like</en> <en id="wh332647">a lost</en> <en id="wh332646">sheep</en>;
<en id="wh332648">seek</en> <en id="wh332649">Your servant</en>,
<en id="wh332650">for</en> <en id="wh332652">I have not</en> <en id="wh332653">forgotten</en> <en id="wh332651">Your commandments</en>.
<en id="wh332655">the</en>
<en id="wh332659">In</en> <en id="wh332661">my distress</en> <en id="wh332663">I cried</en> <en id="wh332657">to</en> ... <en id="wh332658">LORD</en>,
<en id="wh332664">and</en> <en id="wh332665">He answered me</en>.
<en id="wh332666">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh332667">Deliver</en> <en id="wh332668">my soul</en>, ... <en id="wh332669">from</en> <en id="wh332671">lying</en> <en id="wh332670">lips</en>
<en id="wh332674">and a deceitful</en> <en id="wh332673">tongue</en>.
<en id="wh332675">What</en> <en id="wh332676">will He do</en> <en id="wh332677">to you</en>,
<en id="wh332678">and</en> <en id="wh332679">what</en> <en id="wh332680">will be added</en> <en id="wh332681">to you</en>,
<en id="wh332683">O deceitful</en> <en id="wh332682">tongue</en>?
<en id="wh332684">arrows will come</en> <en id="wh332685">from the warrior</en>,
<en id="wh332686">Sharp</en>
<en id="wh332687">with</en> <en id="wh332688">burning coals</en> <en id="wh332689">of the broom tree</en>!
<en id="wh332690">Woe</en> <en id="wh332691">to me</en>
<en id="wh332692">that</en> <en id="wh332693">I dwell</en> <en id="wh332694">in Meshech</en>,
<en id="wh332695">that I live</en> <en id="wh332696">among</en> <en id="wh332697">the tents</en> <en id="wh332698">of Kedar</en>!
<en id="wh332699">Too long</en> <en id="wh332702">have I</en> <en id="wh332700">dwelt</en> <en id="wh332703">among</en> <en id="wh332704">those who hate</en> <en id="wh332705">peace</en>.
<en id="wh332706">I</en> <en id="wh332707">am in favor of peace</en>;
<en id="wh332708">but</en>
<en id="wh332709">when</en> <en id="wh332710">I speak</en>,
<en id="wh332711">they</en> <en id="wh332714">want war</en>.
<en id="wh332719">I lift up</en> <en id="wh332720">my eyes</en> <en id="wh332721">to</en> <en id="wh332722">the</en> <en id="wh332723">hills</en>.
<en id="wh332724">From</en> <en id="wh332725">where</en> <en id="wh332727">does my help</en> <en id="wh332726">come</en>?

<en id="wh332728">My help</en> <en id="wh332730">comes from</en> <en id="wh332731">the LORD</en>, <en id="wh332732">the Maker</en> <en id="wh332733">of heaven</en> <en id="wh332734">and</en> <en id="wh332735">earth</en>.
<en id="wh332736">He will not</en> <en id="wh332737">allow</en> <en id="wh332741">your foot</en> <en id="wh332738">to</en> <en id="wh332740">slip</en>;
<en id="wh332744">your Protector</en> <en id="wh332742">will not</en> <en id="wh332743">slumber</en>.
<en id="wh332745">Behold</en>, ... <en id="wh332746">will neither</en> <en id="wh332747">slumber</en>
<en id="wh332751">the Protector</en> <en id="wh332752">of Israel</en> ... <en id="wh332749">nor</en> <en id="wh332750">sleep</en>.
<en id="wh332753">The LORD</en> <en id="wh332754">is your keeper</en>;
<en id="wh332755">the LORD</en> <en id="wh332756">is the shade</en> <en id="wh332757">on</en> <en id="wh332759">your right</en> <en id="wh332758">hand</en>.
<en id="wh332761">The</en> <en id="wh332762">sun</en> <en id="wh332763">will not</en> <en id="wh332764">strike</en> <en id="wh332760">you by day</en>,
<en id="wh332766">nor the moon</en> <en id="wh332767">by</en> <en id="wh332769">night</en>.
<en id="wh332770">The LORD</en> <en id="wh332771">will guard you</en> <en id="wh332772">from</en> <en id="wh332773">all</en> <en id="wh332774">evil</en>;
<en id="wh332775">He will preserve</en> <en id="wh332777">your soul</en>.
<en id="wh332778">The LORD</en> <en id="wh332779">will watch over</en>
<en id="wh332780">going</en>,
<en id="wh332782">your coming</en> <en id="wh332781">and</en>
<en id="wh332784">both now</en> <en id="wh332785">and</en> <en id="wh332786">forevermore</en>.
<en id="wh332793">I was glad</en>
<en id="wh332794">when</en> <en id="wh332795">they said</en> <en id="wh332796">to me</en>,
“<en id="wh332799">Let us go</en> <en id="wh332797">to the house</en> <en id="wh332798">of the LORD</en>.”
<en id="wh332802">Our feet</en> <en id="wh332800">are standing</en> <en id="wh332803">in</en> <en id="wh332804">your gates</en>,
<en id="wh332805">O Jerusalem</en>.
<en id="wh332806">Jerusalem</en>
<en id="wh332808">is built up</en> <en id="wh332809">as</en> <en id="wh332810">a city</en>
<en id="wh332812">united</en> <en id="wh332814">together</en>,
<en id="wh332816">where</en> <en id="wh332818">the tribes</en> <en id="wh332817">go up</en>, <en id="wh332819">the tribes</en> <en id="wh332820">of the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh332821">as a testimony</en> <en id="wh332823">for Israel</en>,
<en id="wh332824">to</en> <en id="wh332825">give thanks</en> <en id="wh332826">to</en> <en id="wh332827">the name</en> <en id="wh332828">of the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh332829">For</en> <en id="wh332830">there</en> <en id="wh332832">the thrones</en> <en id="wh332834">of judgment</en> <en id="wh332831">stand</en>,
<en id="wh332835">the thrones</en> <en id="wh332837">of the house</en> <en id="wh332838">of David</en>.
<en id="wh332839">Pray</en> <en id="wh332840">for the peace</en> <en id="wh332841">of Jerusalem</en>:
“<en id="wh332843">May those who love you</en> <en id="wh332842">prosper</en>.
<en id="wh332844">May there be</en> <en id="wh332845">peace</en> <en id="wh332847">within your walls</en>,
<en id="wh332848">and prosperity</en> <en id="wh332850">inside your fortresses</en>.”
<en id="wh332851">For the sake</en> <en id="wh332852">of my brothers</en> <en id="wh332853">and</en> <en id="wh332854">friends</en>, <en id="wh332855">I will say</en>,
“<en id="wh332857">Peace</en> <en id="wh332858">be within you</en>.”

<en id="wh332859">For the sake</en> <en id="wh332860">of the house</en> <en id="wh332861">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh332862">our God</en>, <en id="wh332863">I will seek</en> <en id="wh332864">your prosperity</en>.
<en id="wh332870">I lift up</en> <en id="wh332872">my eyes</en> <en id="wh332869">to You</en>,
<en id="wh332873">the</en> <en id="wh332874">One enthroned</en> <en id="wh332875">in</en> <en id="wh332877">heaven</en>.

<en id="wh333100">Restore</en>

<en id="wh333154">early</en>

<en id="wh333184">Blessed</en> <en id="wh333186">is the man</en>

<en id="wh341177">Then Job</en> <en id="wh341176">answered</en>:

<en id="wh348299">Walk in the manner of</en> <en id="wh348301">the ant</en>,
<en id="wh348302">O slacker</en>;
<en id="wh348303">observe</en> <en id="wh348304">its ways</en>
<en id="wh348305">and</en> <en id="wh348306">become wise</en>.
<en id="wh348308">Without</en> <en id="wh348310">a commander</en>, <en id="wh348311">without an overseer</en> <en id="wh348312">or</en> <en id="wh348313">ruler</en>,
<en id="wh348314">it prepares</en> <en id="wh348318">its provisions</en> <en id="wh348315">in</en> <en id="wh348317">summer</en>;
<en id="wh348319">it gathers</en> <en id="wh348323">its food</en> <en id="wh348320">at</en> <en id="wh348322">harvest</en>.
<en id="wh348325">How</en> <en id="wh348324">long</en>
<en id="wh348326">O slacker</en>?
<en id="wh348327">will you lie there</en>,
<en id="wh348328">When</en> <en id="wh348329">will you get up</en> <en id="wh348330">from</en> <en id="wh348331">your sleep</en>?

<en id="wh348332">A little</en> <en id="wh348333">sleep</en>, <en id="wh348334">a little</en> <en id="wh348335">slumber</en>, <en id="wh348336">a little</en> <en id="wh348337">folding</en> <en id="wh348338">of the hands</en>
<en id="wh348339">to</en> <en id="wh348340">rest</en>,
<en id="wh348341">and</en> <en id="wh348345">poverty</en> <en id="wh348342">will come upon you</en> <en id="wh348343">like</en> <en id="wh348344">a robber</en>,
<en id="wh348346">and</en> <en id="wh348347">need</en> <en id="wh348348">like</en> <en id="wh348349">a bandit</en>.
<en id="wh348352">A worthless</en> <en id="wh348351">person</en>, <en id="wh348354">a wicked</en> <en id="wh348353">man</en>,
<en id="wh348355">walks</en> <en id="wh348356">with a perverse</en> <en id="wh348357">mouth</en>,
<en id="wh348358">winking</en> <en id="wh348360">his eyes</en>,
<en id="wh348361">speaking</en> <en id="wh348362">with</en> <en id="wh348363">his feet</en>,
<en id="wh348364">and pointing</en> <en id="wh348365">with</en> <en id="wh348366">his fingers</en>.
<en id="wh348368">With</en> <en id="wh348367">deceit</en> <en id="wh348369">in his heart</en>
<en id="wh348370">he devises</en> <en id="wh348371">evil</en>; <en id="wh348373">he continually</en>
<en id="wh348376">sows</en> <en id="wh348375">discord</en>.
<en id="wh348378">Therefore</en> <en id="wh348381">calamity</en> <en id="wh348380">will come upon him</en> <en id="wh348379">suddenly</en>;
<en id="wh348382">in an instant</en> <en id="wh348383">he will be shattered</en>
<en id="wh348385">beyond</en> <en id="wh348386">recovery</en>.
<en id="wh348388">There are</en> <en id="wh348387">six things that</en>
<en id="wh348390">the LORD</en> <en id="wh348389">hates</en>,
<en id="wh348392">seven</en> <en id="wh348393">that are detestable</en> <en id="wh348391">to Him</en>:
<en id="wh348396">haughty</en> <en id="wh348395">eyes</en>, <en id="wh348398">a lying</en> <en id="wh348397">tongue</en>, <en id="wh348400">hands</en>
<en id="wh348401">that shed</en> <en id="wh348403">innocent</en> <en id="wh348402">blood</en>,
<en id="wh348404">a heart</en>
<en id="wh348405">that devises</en> <en id="wh348407">wicked</en> <en id="wh348406">schemes</en>,
<en id="wh348408">feet</en>
<en id="wh348409">swiftly</en>
<en id="wh348411">that run</en> ... <en id="wh348412">to</en> <en id="wh348414">evil</en>,
<en id="wh348418">a false</en> <en id="wh348417">witness</en> <en id="wh348416">who gives false</en> <en id="wh348415">testimony</en>,
<en id="wh348419">and</en> <en id="wh348420">one who stirs up</en> <en id="wh348421">discord</en> <en id="wh348422">among</en> <en id="wh348423">brothers</en>.
<en id="wh348424">keep</en>
<en id="wh348425">My son</en>,
<en id="wh348427">your father’s</en> <en id="wh348426">commandment</en>,
<en id="wh348428">and</en> <en id="wh348429">do not</en> <en id="wh348430">forsake</en> <en id="wh348432">your mother’s</en> <en id="wh348431">teaching</en>.
<en id="wh348436">always</en> <en id="wh348434">upon</en> <en id="wh348435">your heart</en>; <en id="wh348433">tie them</en>
<en id="wh348437">Bind them</en> ... <en id="wh348438">around</en> <en id="wh348439">your neck</en>.
<en id="wh348440">When</en> <en id="wh348441">you walk</en>,
<en id="wh348442">they will guide you</en>; ... <en id="wh348443">you</en>
<en id="wh348444">when</en> ... <en id="wh348445">lie down</en>,
<en id="wh348446">they will watch</en> <en id="wh348447">over you</en>;
<en id="wh348449">when you awake</en>,
<en id="wh348450">they</en> <en id="wh348451">will speak to you</en>.
<en id="wh348452">For</en> <en id="wh348454">this commandment</en> <en id="wh348453">is a lamp</en>,
<en id="wh348456">this teaching</en> <en id="wh348457">is a light</en>,
<en id="wh348458">and</en> <en id="wh348461">the reproofs</en> <en id="wh348462">of discipline</en> <en id="wh348459">are the way</en> <en id="wh348460">to life</en>,
<en id="wh348463">to</en> <en id="wh348464">keep you</en> <en id="wh348465">from</en> <en id="wh348467">the evil</en> <en id="wh348466">woman</en>,
<en id="wh348468">from</en> <en id="wh348469">the smooth</en> <en id="wh348470">tongue</en> <en id="wh348471">of the adulteress</en>.
<en id="wh348472">Do not</en> <en id="wh348473">lust</en> <en id="wh348475">in</en> <en id="wh348476">your heart</en> <en id="wh348474">for her beauty</en>
<en id="wh348477">or</en> <en id="wh348479">let her captivate you</en> <en id="wh348480">with</en> <en id="wh348481">her eyes</en>.
<en id="wh348482">For</en> <en id="wh348483">the levy</en> <en id="wh348485">of the prostitute</en> <en id="wh348487">is poverty</en>,
<en id="wh348489">and</en> <en id="wh348490">the adulteress</en> <en id="wh348494">preys upon</en> <en id="wh348493">your very</en> <en id="wh348492">life</en>.
<en id="wh348497">Can a man</en> <en id="wh348496">embrace</en> <en id="wh348498">fire</en>
<en id="wh348501">and</en> <en id="wh348502">his clothes</en> <en id="wh348503">not</en> <en id="wh348504">be burned</en>?
<en id="wh348505">Can</en> <en id="wh348507">a man</en> <en id="wh348506">walk</en> <en id="wh348508">on</en> <en id="wh348510">hot coals</en>
<en id="wh348513">without</en> <en id="wh348514">scorching</en> <en id="wh348512">his feet</en>?
<en id="wh348515">So</en>
<en id="wh348517">is he who sleeps with</en> <en id="wh348520">another man’s</en> <en id="wh348519">wife</en>;
<en id="wh348521">no one</en> ... <en id="wh348522">will go unpunished</en>.
<en id="wh348525">who touches</en> <en id="wh348526">her</en>
<en id="wh348527">Men do not</en> <en id="wh348528">despise</en> <en id="wh348530">the</en> <en id="wh348531">thief</en>
<en id="wh348532">if</en> <en id="wh348533">he steals</en>
<en id="wh348535">to satisfy</en> <en id="wh348534">his</en>
<en id="wh348538">hunger</en>.
<en id="wh348540">Yet if caught</en>,
<en id="wh348541">he must pay</en> <en id="wh348542">sevenfold</en>;
<en id="wh348547">he must give up</en> <en id="wh348544">all</en> <en id="wh348545">the wealth</en> <en id="wh348546">of his house</en>.
<en id="wh348548">He who commits adultery</en>
<en id="wh348550">lacks</en> <en id="wh348551">judgment</en>;
<en id="wh348552">destroys</en> <en id="wh348553">himself</en>.
<en id="wh348554">whoever</en> <en id="wh348555">does so</en>
<en id="wh348556">Wounds</en> <en id="wh348557">and</en> <en id="wh348558">dishonor</en> <en id="wh348559">will befall him</en>,
<en id="wh348560">and</en> <en id="wh348561">his reproach</en> <en id="wh348562">will never</en> <en id="wh348563">be wiped away</en>.
<en id="wh348564">For</en> <en id="wh348565">jealousy</en> <en id="wh348566">enrages a husband</en>,
<en id="wh348568">and</en> <en id="wh348569">he will show no</en> <en id="wh348570">mercy</en> <en id="wh348571">in</en> <en id="wh348572">the day</en> <en id="wh348573">of vengeance</en>.
<en id="wh348574">He will not</en> <en id="wh348575">be appeased</en> <en id="wh348577">by any</en> <en id="wh348578">ransom</en>,
<en id="wh348579">or</en> <en id="wh348581">persuaded</en>
<en id="wh348583">by lavish</en> <en id="wh348584">gifts</en>.
<en id="wh348585">My son</en>,
<en id="wh348586">keep</en> <en id="wh348587">my words</en>
<en id="wh348588">and</en> <en id="wh348590">treasure</en> <en id="wh348589">my commandments</en> <en id="wh348591">within you</en>.
<en id="wh348592">Keep</en> <en id="wh348593">my commandments</en>
<en id="wh348594">and</en> <en id="wh348595">live</en>;
<en id="wh348597">guard my teachings</en> <en id="wh348598">as</en> <en id="wh348599">the apple</en> <en id="wh348600">of your eye</en>.
<en id="wh348601">Tie them</en> <en id="wh348602">to</en> <en id="wh348603">your fingers</en>;
<en id="wh348604">write them</en> <en id="wh348605">on</en> <en id="wh348606">the tablet</en> <en id="wh348607">of your heart</en>.
<en id="wh348608">Say</en> <en id="wh348609">to</en> <en id="wh348611">wisdom</en>,
“<en id="wh348613">You</en> <en id="wh348612">are my sister</en>,”
<en id="wh348616">and</en> <en id="wh348619">call</en> <en id="wh348618">understanding</en> <en id="wh348615">your kinsman</en>,
<en id="wh348621">that they may keep you</en> <en id="wh348622">from</en> <en id="wh348624">the adulteress</en>,
<en id="wh348625">from</en> <en id="wh348626">the stranger</en>
<en id="wh348628">with seductive</en> <en id="wh348627">words</en>.

<en id="wh348629">For</en> <en id="wh348630">at</en> <en id="wh348631">the window</en> <en id="wh348632">of my house</en> <en id="wh348635">I looked</en> <en id="wh348633">through</en> <en id="wh348634">the lattice</en>.
<en id="wh348637">I saw</en> <en id="wh348638">among</en> <en id="wh348639">the</en> <en id="wh348640">simple</en>,

<en id="wh348641">I noticed</en> <en id="wh348642">among</en> <en id="wh348643">the</en> <en id="wh348644">youths</en>, <en id="wh348645">a young man</en> <en id="wh348646">lacking</en> <en id="wh348647">judgment</en>,
<en id="wh348648">crossing</en> <en id="wh348650">the</en> <en id="wh348651">street</en> <en id="wh348652">near</en> <en id="wh348653">her corner</en>,
<en id="wh348657">strolling</en> <en id="wh348655">down the road</en> <en id="wh348656">to her house</en>,

<en id="wh348658">at</en> <en id="wh348659">twilight</en>, <en id="wh348661">as the day was fading</en> <en id="wh348663">into</en> <en id="wh348667">the dark</en> <en id="wh348664">of</en> <en id="wh348665">the night</en>.
<en id="wh348668">Then</en> <en id="wh348670">a woman</en>
<en id="wh348672">came out to meet him</en>,
<en id="wh348673">with the attire</en> <en id="wh348674">of a harlot</en>
<en id="wh348675">and</en> <en id="wh348676">cunning</en> <en id="wh348677">of heart</en>.
<en id="wh348679">She</en> <en id="wh348678">is loud</en>
<en id="wh348680">and</en> <en id="wh348681">defiant</en>;
<en id="wh348686">her feet</en> <en id="wh348684">do not</en> <en id="wh348685">remain</en> <en id="wh348682">at</en> <en id="wh348683">home</en>.
<en id="wh348687">Now</en> <en id="wh348688">in</en> <en id="wh348689">the</en> <en id="wh348690">street</en>,
<en id="wh348691">now</en> <en id="wh348692">in</en> <en id="wh348693">the</en> <en id="wh348694">squares</en>,
<en id="wh348699">she lurks</en> <en id="wh348695">at</en> <en id="wh348697">every</en> <en id="wh348698">corner</en>.
<en id="wh348701">She seizes</en> <en id="wh348702">him</en>
<en id="wh348703">and</en> <en id="wh348704">kisses</en> <en id="wh348705">him</en>;
<en id="wh348706">she brazenly</en>
<en id="wh348709">says</en> <en id="wh348708">to</en> <en id="wh348710">him</en>:
“<en id="wh348712">I have made my peace</en> <en id="wh348711">offerings</en>;
<en id="wh348715">today</en> <en id="wh348716">I have paid</en> <en id="wh348717">my vows</en>.
<en id="wh348718">So</en> <en id="wh348720">I came out</en>
<en id="wh348721">to</en> <en id="wh348722">meet you</en>;
<en id="wh348724">I sought you</en>,
<en id="wh348726">and</en> <en id="wh348727">I have found you</en>.
<en id="wh348729">I have decked</en> <en id="wh348730">my bed</en> <en id="wh348728">with coverings</en>,

<en id="wh348734">I have perfumed</en> <en id="wh348735">my bed</en> <en id="wh348736">with myrrh</en>, <en id="wh348737">with aloes</en>, <en id="wh348738">and</en> <en id="wh348739">with cinnamon</en>.
<en id="wh348740">Come</en>,
<en id="wh348741">let us take our fill</en> <en id="wh348742">of love</en> <en id="wh348743">till</en> <en id="wh348745">morning</en>.
<en id="wh348746">Let us delight</en> <en id="wh348747">in</en> <en id="wh348748">loving caresses</en>!
<en id="wh348749">For</en> <en id="wh348752">my husband</en> <en id="wh348750">is not</en> <en id="wh348753">at</en> <en id="wh348754">home</en>;
<en id="wh348755">he has gone</en> <en id="wh348756">on</en> <en id="wh348759">a long</en> <en id="wh348757">journey</en>.
<en id="wh348763">He took</en> <en id="wh348764">with</en> <en id="wh348765">him</en> <en id="wh348760">a bag</en> <en id="wh348762">of money</en>
<en id="wh348766">and</en> <en id="wh348770">will not return</en> <en id="wh348767">till</en> <en id="wh348768">the</en> <en id="wh348769">moon is full</en>.”
<en id="wh348773">With</en> <en id="wh348774">her great</en> <en id="wh348775">persuasion</en> <en id="wh348772">she entices him</en>;
<en id="wh348776">with</en> <en id="wh348777">her flattering</en> <en id="wh348778">lips</en> <en id="wh348779">she lures him</en>.
<en id="wh348780">He follows her</en> <en id="wh348782">on impulse</en>,
<en id="wh348783">like</en> <en id="wh348784">an ox</en> <en id="wh348787">going</en> <en id="wh348785">to</en> <en id="wh348786">the slaughter</en>,
<en id="wh348789">like</en> <en id="wh348793">a deer</en> <en id="wh348790">bounding</en> <en id="wh348791">into</en> <en id="wh348792">a trap</en>,

<en id="wh348798">like</en> <en id="wh348800">a bird</en> <en id="wh348799">darting</en> <en id="wh348801">into</en> <en id="wh348802">a snare</en>—
<en id="wh348804">not</en> <en id="wh348805">knowing</en>
<en id="wh348809">it</en> <en id="wh348808">will cost him his life</en>.
<en id="wh348811">Now</en>,
<en id="wh348812">my sons</en>,
<en id="wh348813">listen</en> <en id="wh348814">to me</en>,
<en id="wh348815">and</en> <en id="wh348816">attend</en> <en id="wh348817">to</en> <en id="wh348818">the words</en> <en id="wh348819">of my mouth</en>.
<en id="wh348820">Do not</en> <en id="wh348824">let your heart</en> <en id="wh348821">turn aside</en> <en id="wh348822">to</en> <en id="wh348823">her ways</en>;

<en id="wh348829">For</en> <en id="wh348830">she has brought many</en> <en id="wh348832">down</en> ... <en id="wh348831">death</en>;
<en id="wh348833">to</en> ... <en id="wh348836">her slain</en> <en id="wh348834">are many</en> <en id="wh348835">in number</en>.
<en id="wh348839">Her house</en> <en id="wh348837">is the road</en> <en id="wh348838">to Sheol</en>,
<en id="wh348840">descending</en> <en id="wh348841">to</en> <en id="wh348842">the chambers</en> <en id="wh348843">of death</en>.
<en id="wh348845">Does not</en> <en id="wh348846">wisdom</en> <en id="wh348847">call out</en>,
<en id="wh348848">and</en> <en id="wh348849">understanding</en> <en id="wh348850">raise</en> <en id="wh348851">her voice</en>?

<en id="wh348852">On</en> <en id="wh348853">the heights</en> <en id="wh348855">overlooking</en> <en id="wh348856">the road</en>, <en id="wh348857">at the crossroads</en> <en id="wh348859">she takes her stand</en>.
<en id="wh348861">Beside</en> <en id="wh348862">the gates</en> <en id="wh348863">to</en> <en id="wh348865">the city</en>, <en id="wh348866">at the entrances</en> <en id="wh348868">she cries out</en>:
“<en id="wh348869">To you</en>,
<en id="wh348870">O men</en>,
<en id="wh348871">I call out</en>,
<en id="wh348872">and</en> <en id="wh348873">my cry</en> <en id="wh348874">is to</en> <en id="wh348875">the sons</en> <en id="wh348876">of men</en>.
<en id="wh348877">learn</en>
<en id="wh348878">O simple ones</en>,
<en id="wh348879">to be shrewd</en>;
<en id="wh348881">O fools</en>,
<en id="wh348882">gain understanding</en>.
<en id="wh348884">Listen</en>,
<en id="wh348885">for</en> <en id="wh348887">I speak</en> <en id="wh348886">of noble things</en>,
<en id="wh348888">and</en> <en id="wh348889">the opening</en> <en id="wh348890">of my lips</en> <en id="wh348891">will reveal right</en>.
<en id="wh348892">For</en> <en id="wh348895">my mouth</en> <en id="wh348894">will speak</en> <en id="wh348893">the truth</en>,
<en id="wh348896">and</en> <en id="wh348899">wickedness</en> <en id="wh348897">is detestable</en> <en id="wh348898">to my lips</en>.
<en id="wh348902">All</en> <en id="wh348903">the words</en> <en id="wh348904">of my mouth</en> <en id="wh348901">are righteous</en>;
<en id="wh348905">none</en> <en id="wh348909">are crooked</en> <en id="wh348908">or</en> <en id="wh348907">perverse</en>.
<en id="wh348910">They are</en> <en id="wh348911">all plain</en> <en id="wh348912">to</en> <en id="wh348913">the</en> <en id="wh348914">discerning</en>,
<en id="wh348915">and</en> <en id="wh348916">upright</en> <en id="wh348917">to</en> <en id="wh348918">those who find</en> <en id="wh348919">knowledge</en>.
<en id="wh348920">Receive</en> <en id="wh348921">my instruction</en>
<en id="wh348923">instead of</en> <en id="wh348924">silver</en>,
<en id="wh348925">and</en> <en id="wh348926">knowledge</en> <en id="wh348929">rather than pure</en> <en id="wh348928">gold</en>.
<en id="wh348930">For</en> <en id="wh348932">wisdom</en> <en id="wh348931">is more precious</en> <en id="wh348934">than rubies</en>,

<en id="wh352117">Judgments</en> <en id="wh352113">are prepared</en> <en id="wh352116">for mockers</en>,

<en id="wh352292">Set</en> <en id="wh352289">plans</en> <en id="wh352290">by</en> <en id="wh352291">consultation</en>,

<en id="wh352307">avoid</en>
<en id="wh352308">Whoever curses</en> <en id="wh352309">his father</en> <en id="wh352310">or</en> <en id="wh352311">mother</en>,

<en id="wh352317">An inheritance</en> <en id="wh352318">gained</en> <en id="wh352321">quickly</en> ... <en id="wh352319">in</en> <en id="wh352320">the</en>

<en id="wh352326">Do not</en> <en id="wh352327">say</en>,

<en id="wh352686">makes</en> <en id="wh352687">his way sure</en>.
<en id="wh352688">There is no</en> <en id="wh352689">wisdom</en>,
<en id="wh352691">no</en> <en id="wh352692">understanding</en>,
<en id="wh352694">no</en> <en id="wh352695">counsel</en> <en id="wh352697">that can prevail against</en> <en id="wh352698">the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh352699">A horse</en> <en id="wh352700">is prepared</en> <en id="wh352702">for the day</en> <en id="wh352703">of battle</en>,
<en id="wh352705">but</en> <en id="wh352708">victory</en> <en id="wh352706">is of the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh352710">A good name</en> <en id="wh352709">is more desirable</en> <en id="wh352713">than great</en> <en id="wh352712">riches</en>;
<en id="wh352719">favor</en> <en id="wh352720">is better</en> <en id="wh352715">than silver</en> <en id="wh352716">and</en> <en id="wh352718">gold</en>.
<en id="wh352721">The rich</en> <en id="wh352722">and</en> <en id="wh352723">the poor</en> <en id="wh352724">have this in common</en>:
<en id="wh352727">The LORD</en> <en id="wh352725">is Maker</en> <en id="wh352726">of them all</en>.
<en id="wh352728">The prudent</en> <en id="wh352729">see</en> <en id="wh352730">danger</en>
<en id="wh352731">and</en> <en id="wh352732">take cover</en>,
<en id="wh352733">but</en> <en id="wh352734">the simple</en> <en id="wh352735">keep going</en>
<en id="wh352736">and</en> <en id="wh352737">suffer the consequences</en>.

<en id="wh352738">The rewards</en> <en id="wh352739">of humility</en> <en id="wh352740">and the fear</en> <en id="wh352741">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh352742">are wealth</en> <en id="wh352743">and</en> <en id="wh352744">honor</en> <en id="wh352745">and</en> <en id="wh352746">life</en>.
<en id="wh352747">Thorns</en> <en id="wh352748">and snares</en> <en id="wh352750">lie on the path</en> <en id="wh352751">of the perverse</en>;
<en id="wh352752">he who guards</en> <en id="wh352753">his soul</en> <en id="wh352754">stays far</en> <en id="wh352755">from them</en>.
<en id="wh352756">Train up</en> <en id="wh352759">a child</en> <en id="wh352760">in</en> <en id="wh352758">the</en> <en id="wh352762">way</en> <en id="wh352761">he should go</en>,
<en id="wh352763">and</en> <en id="wh352764">when</en> <en id="wh352765">he is old</en>
<en id="wh352766">he will not</en> <en id="wh352767">depart</en> <en id="wh352768">from it</en>.
<en id="wh352769">The rich</en> <en id="wh352772">rule</en> <en id="wh352771">over the poor</en>,
<en id="wh352773">and</en> <en id="wh352775">the borrower</en> <en id="wh352774">is slave</en> <en id="wh352776">to</en> <en id="wh352778">the lender</en>.
<en id="wh352779">He who sows</en> <en id="wh352780">injustice</en> <en id="wh352781">will reap disaster</en>,
<en id="wh352783">and</en> <en id="wh352784">the rod</en> <en id="wh352785">of his fury</en> <en id="wh352786">will be destroyed</en>.
<en id="wh352787">A generous man</en>
<en id="wh352790">will be blessed</en>,
<en id="wh352791">for</en> <en id="wh352792">he shares</en> <en id="wh352794">his bread</en> <en id="wh352797">with the poor</en>.
<en id="wh352798">Drive out</en> <en id="wh352799">the mocker</en>,
<en id="wh352800">and</en> <en id="wh352802">conflict</en> <en id="wh352801">will depart</en>;
<en id="wh352805">even quarreling</en> <en id="wh352806">and</en> <en id="wh352807">insults</en> <en id="wh352804">will cease</en>.
<en id="wh352808">He who loves</en> <en id="wh352809">a pure heart</en>
<en id="wh352811">and gracious</en> <en id="wh352812">lips</en>
<en id="wh352814">will have the king</en> <en id="wh352813">for a friend</en>.
<en id="wh352816">The LORD’s</en> <en id="wh352815">eyes</en> <en id="wh352817">keep watch over</en> <en id="wh352818">knowledge</en>,
<en id="wh352820">but He frustrates</en> <en id="wh352821">the words</en> <en id="wh352819">of</en> <en id="wh352822">the faithless</en>.
<en id="wh352824">The slacker</en> <en id="wh352823">says</en>,
“<en id="wh352825">There is a lion</en> <en id="wh352828">outside</en>! ... <en id="wh352827">the</en>
<en id="wh352832">I will be slain</en> <en id="wh352829">in</en> ... <en id="wh352831">streets</en>!”
<en id="wh352835">The mouth</en> <en id="wh352836">of an adulteress</en> <en id="wh352834">is a deep</en> <en id="wh352833">pit</en>;
<en id="wh352837">he who is under the wrath</en> <en id="wh352838">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh352839">will fall</en> <en id="wh352840">into it</en>.
<en id="wh352841">Foolishness</en> <en id="wh352842">is bound up</en> <en id="wh352843">in</en> <en id="wh352844">the heart</en> <en id="wh352845">of a child</en>,
<en id="wh352846">but the rod</en> <en id="wh352847">of discipline</en> <en id="wh352848">drives it far</en> <en id="wh352849">from him</en>.
<en id="wh352850">Oppressing</en> <en id="wh352851">the poor</en>
<en id="wh352852">to</en> <en id="wh352853">enrich</en>
oneself <en id="wh352855">or giving gifts</en> <en id="wh352856">to</en> <en id="wh352857">the rich</en>
<en id="wh352858">will surely lead</en> <en id="wh352859">to</en> <en id="wh352860">poverty</en>.
<en id="wh352861">Incline</en> <en id="wh352862">your ear</en>
<en id="wh352863">and</en> <en id="wh352864">hear</en> <en id="wh352865">the words</en> <en id="wh352866">of the wise</en>
— <en id="wh352869">apply</en> <en id="wh352868">your mind</en> <en id="wh352870">to</en> <en id="wh352871">my knowledge</en> —
<en id="wh352872">for</en> <en id="wh352873">it is pleasing</en>
<en id="wh352874">when</en> <en id="wh352875">you keep them</en> <en id="wh352877">within you</en>
<en id="wh352879">and they are constantly</en> <en id="wh352880">on</en> <en id="wh352881">your lips</en>.
<en id="wh352882">So</en> <en id="wh352886">that your trust</en> <en id="wh352883">may be</en> <en id="wh352884">in</en> <en id="wh352885">the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh352887">I instruct you</en> <en id="wh352889">today</en> — <en id="wh352890">yes</en>, <en id="wh352891">you</en>.

<en id="wh352893">Have I not</en> <en id="wh352894">written</en> <en id="wh352895">for you</en> <en id="wh352896">thirty sayings</en> <en id="wh352898">about counsel</en> <en id="wh352899">and</en> <en id="wh352900">knowledge</en>,
<en id="wh352901">to</en> <en id="wh352902">show you</en> <en id="wh352903">true</en> ... <en id="wh352905">reliable</en> <en id="wh352904">words</en>,
<en id="wh352906">and</en> ... <en id="wh352907">that you may</en> <en id="wh352909">soundly</en> <en id="wh352908">answer</en> <en id="wh352911">those who sent you</en>?
<en id="wh352912">Do not</en> <en id="wh352913">rob</en> <en id="wh352914">a poor</en>
<en id="wh352915">man because</en> <en id="wh352917">he</en> <en id="wh352916">is poor</en>,

<en id="wh352918">and</en> <en id="wh352919">do not</en> <en id="wh352920">crush</en> <en id="wh352923">the</en> <en id="wh352921">afflicted</en> <en id="wh352922">at</en> <en id="wh352924">the gate</en>,
<en id="wh352925">for</en> <en id="wh352926">the LORD</en> <en id="wh352927">will take up</en> <en id="wh352928">their case</en>
<en id="wh352929">and</en> <en id="wh352930">will plunder</en> <en id="wh352932">those who rob them</en>.
<en id="wh352934">Do not</en> <en id="wh352935">make friends</en> <en id="wh352936">with</en> <en id="wh352938">an angry</en> ... <en id="wh352937">man</en>,
<en id="wh352941">man</en>, <en id="wh352939">and</en> <en id="wh352943">do not</en> <en id="wh352944">associate</en> <en id="wh352940">with</en> <en id="wh352942">a hot-tempered</en>
<en id="wh352945">or</en> <en id="wh352946">you may learn</en> <en id="wh352947">his ways</en>
<en id="wh352948">and</en> <en id="wh352949">entangle</en> <en id="wh352952">yourself</en> <en id="wh352950">in a snare</en>.
<en id="wh352953">Do not</en> <en id="wh352954">be</en> <en id="wh352956">one who gives pledges</en>,
<en id="wh352960">who puts up security</en> <en id="wh352961">for debts</en>.
<en id="wh352962">If</en> <en id="wh352963">you have nothing</en> <en id="wh352964">with which</en>
<en id="wh352965">to</en> <en id="wh352966">pay</en>,
<en id="wh352967">why</en> <en id="wh352969">should your bed</en> <en id="wh352968">be taken</en> <en id="wh352970">from</en> <en id="wh352971">under you</en>?
<en id="wh352972">Do not</en> <en id="wh352973">move</en> <en id="wh352975">an ancient</en> <en id="wh352974">boundary stone</en>
<en id="wh352976">which</en> <en id="wh352978">your fathers</en> <en id="wh352977">have placed</en>.
<en id="wh352979">Do you see</en> <en id="wh352980">a man</en> <en id="wh352981">skilled</en> <en id="wh352982">in</en> <en id="wh352983">his work</en>?
<en id="wh352987">He will be stationed</en> <en id="wh352985">in the presence</en> <en id="wh352986">of kings</en>;
<en id="wh352988">he will not</en> <en id="wh352989">stand</en> <en id="wh352991">before</en> <en id="wh352992">obscure men</en>.
<en id="wh352993">When</en> <en id="wh352994">you sit down</en>
<en id="wh352995">to</en> <en id="wh352996">dine</en> <en id="wh352997">with</en> <en id="wh352998">a ruler</en>,
<en id="wh352999">consider</en> <en id="wh353000">carefully</en>
<en id="wh353002">what</en> <en id="wh353004">is set before you</en>,
<en id="wh353005">and</en> <en id="wh353006">put</en> <en id="wh353007">a knife</en> <en id="wh353009">to your throat</en>
<en id="wh353010">if</en> <en id="wh353013">you</en> <en id="wh353011">possess</en> <en id="wh353012">a great appetite</en>.
<en id="wh353014">Do not</en> <en id="wh353015">crave</en> <en id="wh353017">his delicacies</en>,
<en id="wh353019">for that</en> <en id="wh353020">food</en> <en id="wh353021">is deceptive</en>.
<en id="wh353022">Do not</en> <en id="wh353023">wear yourself out</en>
<en id="wh353024">to</en> <en id="wh353025">get rich</en>;
<en id="wh353027">be wise enough</en> <en id="wh353028">to restrain yourself</en>.
<en id="wh353032">When</en> <en id="wh353030">you glance</en>
at wealth, <en id="wh353034">it disappears</en>,
<en id="wh353035">for</en> <en id="wh353036">it makes</en> <en id="wh353039">wings for itself</en> <en id="wh353038">and</en>
<en id="wh353042">flies</en> <en id="wh353040">like</en> <en id="wh353041">an eagle</en> <en id="wh353044">to the sky</en>.
<en id="wh353045">Do not</en> <en id="wh353046">eat</en> <en id="wh353048">the bread</en> <en id="wh353049">of a stingy man</en>,
<en id="wh353051">and</en> <en id="wh353052">do not</en> <en id="wh353053">crave</en> <en id="wh353055">his delicacies</en>;
<en id="wh353056">for</en>
<en id="wh353058">he is keeping track</en>, <en id="wh353060">inwardly</en>
<en id="wh353061">counting the cost</en>.
“<en id="wh353063">Eat</en>
<en id="wh353064">and</en> <en id="wh353065">drink</en>,”
<en id="wh353066">he says</en> <en id="wh353067">to you</en>,
<en id="wh353068">but</en> <en id="wh353069">his heart</en> <en id="wh353070">is not</en> <en id="wh353071">with you</en>.
<en id="wh353072">what little</en> <en id="wh353073">you have eaten</en>
<en id="wh353074">You will vomit up</en>
<en id="wh353075">and</en> <en id="wh353076">waste</en> <en id="wh353079">your pleasant</en> <en id="wh353077">words</en>.
<en id="wh353083">Do not</en> <en id="wh353084">speak</en> <en id="wh353082">to a fool</en>,
<en id="wh353085">for</en> <en id="wh353086">he will despise</en> <en id="wh353088">the wisdom</en> <en id="wh353089">of your words</en>.
<en id="wh353090">Do not</en> <en id="wh353091">move</en> <en id="wh353093">an ancient</en> <en id="wh353092">boundary stone</en>
<en id="wh353094">or</en> <en id="wh353099">encroach</en> <en id="wh353095">on</en> <en id="wh353096">the fields</en> <en id="wh353097">of the fatherless</en>,
<en id="wh353100">for</en> <en id="wh353101">their Redeemer</en> <en id="wh353102">is strong</en>;
<en id="wh353103">He</en> <en id="wh353104">will take up</en> <en id="wh353106">their case</en> <en id="wh353107">against you</en>.
<en id="wh353108">Apply</en> <en id="wh353112">your heart</en> <en id="wh353109">to</en> <en id="wh353111">instruction</en>
<en id="wh353113">and</en> <en id="wh353114">your ears</en> <en id="wh353115">to</en> <en id="wh353116">words</en> <en id="wh353117">of knowledge</en>.
<en id="wh353118">Do not</en> <en id="wh353119">withhold</en> <en id="wh353122">discipline</en> <en id="wh353120">from</en> <en id="wh353121">a child</en>;
<en id="wh353123">although</en> <en id="wh353124">you strike him</en> <en id="wh353125">with</en> <en id="wh353127">a rod</en>,
<en id="wh353128">he will not</en> <en id="wh353129">die</en>.
<en id="wh353134">Strike him</en> <en id="wh353131">with</en> <en id="wh353133">a rod</en>,
<en id="wh353135">and</en> <en id="wh353139">you will deliver</en> <en id="wh353136">his soul</en> <en id="wh353137">from</en> <en id="wh353138">Sheol</en>.
<en id="wh353140">My son</en>,
<en id="wh353141">if</en> <en id="wh353143">your heart</en> <en id="wh353142">is wise</en>,
<en id="wh353145">my own heart</en> ... <en id="wh353144">rejoice</en>.
<en id="wh353146">will indeed</en>
<en id="wh353150">My inmost being</en> <en id="wh353149">will rejoice</en>
<en id="wh353151">when</en> <en id="wh353153">your lips</en> <en id="wh353152">speak</en> <en id="wh353154">what is right</en>.
<en id="wh353155">Do not</en> <en id="wh353157">let your heart</en> <en id="wh353156">envy</en> <en id="wh353160">sinners</en>,
<en id="wh353161">but</en> <en id="wh353166">always continue</en> <en id="wh353163">in</en> <en id="wh353164">the fear</en> <en id="wh353165">of the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh353169">For</en> <en id="wh353170">surely</en> <en id="wh353171">there is</en> <en id="wh353172">a future</en>,
<en id="wh353173">and</en> <en id="wh353174">your hope</en> <en id="wh353175">will not</en> <en id="wh353176">be cut off</en>.
<en id="wh353177">Listen</en>,
<en id="wh353179">my son</en>,
<en id="wh353180">and</en> <en id="wh353181">be wise</en>,
<en id="wh353182">and</en> <en id="wh353183">guide</en> <en id="wh353187">your heart</en> <en id="wh353184">on</en> <en id="wh353185">the</en> <en id="wh353186">right course</en>.
<en id="wh353188">Do not</en> <en id="wh353189">join</en> <en id="wh353191">those who drink too much</en> <en id="wh353192">wine</en>
<en id="wh353194">or gorge</en> <en id="wh353195">themselves on meat</en>.
<en id="wh353197">For</en> <en id="wh353198">the drunkard</en> <en id="wh353199">and</en> <en id="wh353200">the glutton</en> <en id="wh353201">will come to poverty</en>,
<en id="wh353202">and</en> <en id="wh353205">drowsiness</en> <en id="wh353204">will clothe them</en> <en id="wh353203">in rags</en>.
<en id="wh353206">Listen</en> <en id="wh353207">to</en> <en id="wh353208">your father</en>
<en id="wh353209">who</en> <en id="wh353210">gave you life</en>,
<en id="wh353211">and</en> <en id="wh353212">do not</en> <en id="wh353213">despise</en>
<en id="wh353216">your mother</en> <en id="wh353214">when</en> <en id="wh353215">she is old</en>.
<en id="wh353218">Invest in</en> <en id="wh353217">truth</en>

<en id="wh353219">and</en> <en id="wh353220">never</en> <en id="wh353221">sell it</en>— <en id="wh353222">in wisdom</en> <en id="wh353223">and</en> <en id="wh353224">instruction</en> <en id="wh353225">and</en> <en id="wh353226">understanding</en>.
<en id="wh353229">The father</en> <en id="wh353230">of a righteous man</en> <en id="wh353227">will greatly rejoice</en>,
<en id="wh353231">and</en> <en id="wh353232">he who fathers</en> <en id="wh353233">a wise son</en> <en id="wh353234">will delight in him</en>.
<en id="wh353237">May your father</en> <en id="wh353238">and</en> <en id="wh353239">mother</en> ... <en id="wh353236">rejoice</en>!
<en id="wh353241">be glad</en>, <en id="wh353240">and</en> <en id="wh353242">may she who gave you birth</en>
<en id="wh353243">give</en>
<en id="wh353244">My son</en>,
<en id="wh353246">me</en> <en id="wh353245">your heart</en>,
<en id="wh353247">and</en> <en id="wh353248">let your eyes</en> <en id="wh353250">delight</en> <en id="wh353249">in my ways</en>.
<en id="wh353251">For</en> <en id="wh353254">a prostitute</en> <en id="wh353253">is a deep</en> <en id="wh353252">pit</en>,
<en id="wh353255">and</en> <en id="wh353258">an adulteress</en> <en id="wh353257">is a narrow</en> <en id="wh353256">well</en>.
<en id="wh353261">Like</en> <en id="wh353262">a robber</en> <en id="wh353260">she</en> <en id="wh353263">lies in wait</en>
<en id="wh353264">and</en> <en id="wh353268">multiplies</en> <en id="wh353265">the faithless</en> <en id="wh353266">among</en> <en id="wh353267">men</en>.
<en id="wh353270">Who</en> <en id="wh353271">has woe</en>?
<en id="wh353273">Who</en> <en id="wh353274">has sorrow</en>?
<en id="wh353276">Who</en> <en id="wh353277">has contentions</en>?
<en id="wh353279">Who</en> <en id="wh353280">has complaints</en>?
<en id="wh353282">Who</en> <en id="wh353284">has needless</en> <en id="wh353283">wounds</en>?
<en id="wh353286">Who</en> <en id="wh353287">has bloodshot</en> <en id="wh353288">eyes</en>?
<en id="wh353291">Those who linger</en> <en id="wh353292">over</en> <en id="wh353294">wine</en>,
<en id="wh353297">who go</en>
<en id="wh353298">to</en> <en id="wh353299">taste</en> <en id="wh353300">mixed drinks</en>.
<en id="wh353301">Do not</en> <en id="wh353302">gaze at</en> <en id="wh353303">wine</en>
<en id="wh353304">while</en> <en id="wh353305">it is red</en>,
<en id="wh353306">when</en> <en id="wh353307">it sparkles</en> <en id="wh353308">in</en> <en id="wh353309">the</en> <en id="wh353310">cup</en>
<en id="wh353312">and goes down smoothly</en>.
<en id="wh353315">In the end</en> <en id="wh353318">it bites</en> <en id="wh353316">like</en> <en id="wh353317">a snake</en>
<en id="wh353319">and</en> <en id="wh353322">stings</en> <en id="wh353320">like</en> <en id="wh353321">a viper</en>.
<en id="wh353323">Your eyes</en> <en id="wh353324">will see</en> <en id="wh353325">strange things</en>,
<en id="wh353326">and</en> <en id="wh353327">your mind</en> <en id="wh353328">will utter</en> <en id="wh353329">perversities</en>.
<en id="wh353331">You will be</en> <en id="wh353332">like</en> <en id="wh353333">one sleeping</en> <en id="wh353334">on</en> <en id="wh353336">the high seas</en>
<en id="wh353337">or</en> <en id="wh353339">lying</en> <en id="wh353340">on</en> <en id="wh353341">the top</en> <en id="wh353342">of a mast</en>:
“<en id="wh353343">They struck me</en>,
<en id="wh353344">but I feel no</en> <en id="wh353345">pain</en>!
<en id="wh353346">They beat me</en>,
<en id="wh353347">but I did not</en> <en id="wh353348">know it</en>!
<en id="wh353349">When</en> <en id="wh353350">can I wake up</en>
<en id="wh353351">another</en>

<en id="wh353568">My son</en>,

<en id="wh354660">Whoever turns</en> <en id="wh354661">his ear away</en>
<en id="wh354662">from</en> <en id="wh354663">hearing</en> <en id="wh354664">the law</en>,
<en id="wh354665">even</en> <en id="wh354666">his prayer</en> <en id="wh354667">is detestable</en>.
<en id="wh354668">He who leads</en> <en id="wh354669">the upright</en> <en id="wh354671">along the path</en> <en id="wh354672">of evil</en>
<en id="wh354676">will fall</en> <en id="wh354673">into</en> <en id="wh354675">his own</en> <en id="wh354674">pit</en>,
<en id="wh354677">but</en> <en id="wh354678">the blameless</en> <en id="wh354679">will inherit</en> <en id="wh354680">what is good</en>.
<en id="wh354685">A rich</en> <en id="wh354684">man</en> <en id="wh354681">is wise</en> <en id="wh354682">in</en> <en id="wh354683">his own eyes</en>,
<en id="wh354686">but</en> <en id="wh354687">a poor man</en> <en id="wh354688">with discernment</en> <en id="wh354689">sees through him</en>.
<en id="wh354690">When</en> <en id="wh354692">the righteous</en> <en id="wh354691">triumph</en>,
<en id="wh354693">there is great</en> <en id="wh354694">glory</en>,
<en id="wh354695">but</en>
<en id="wh354696">when</en> <en id="wh354698">the wicked</en> <en id="wh354697">rise</en>,
<en id="wh354700">men</en> <en id="wh354699">hide themselves</en>.
<en id="wh354701">He who conceals</en> <en id="wh354702">his sins</en>
<en id="wh354703">will not</en> <en id="wh354704">prosper</en>,
<en id="wh354705">but</en>
<en id="wh354706">whoever confesses</en>
<en id="wh354707">and</en> <en id="wh354708">renounces them</en>
<en id="wh354709">will find mercy</en>.
<en id="wh354710">Blessed</en> <en id="wh354711">is the man</en>
<en id="wh354713">who is always</en> <en id="wh354712">reverent</en>,
<en id="wh354714">but</en>
<en id="wh354715">he who hardens</en> <en id="wh354716">his heart</en>
<en id="wh354717">falls</en> <en id="wh354718">into</en> <en id="wh354719">trouble</en>.

<en id="wh354721">Like a roaring</en> <en id="wh354720">lion</en> <en id="wh354722">or</en> <en id="wh354724">a charging</en> <en id="wh354723">bear</en> <en id="wh354726">is a wicked</en> <en id="wh354725">ruler</en> <en id="wh354727">over</en> <en id="wh354729">a helpless</en> <en id="wh354728">people</en>.
<en id="wh354730">A leader</en> <en id="wh354731">who lacks</en> <en id="wh354732">judgment</en>
<en id="wh354734">is also a great</en> <en id="wh354735">oppressor</en>, <en id="wh354733">but</en>
<en id="wh354736">he who hates</en> <en id="wh354737">dishonest profit</en> <en id="wh354738">will prolong</en> <en id="wh354739">his days</en>.
<en id="wh354740">A man</en>
<en id="wh354741">burdened</en> <en id="wh354742">by</en> <en id="wh354743">bloodguilt</en>
<en id="wh354747">will flee</en> <en id="wh354745">into</en> <en id="wh354746">the Pit</en>;
<en id="wh354748">let no one</en> <en id="wh354749">support</en> <en id="wh354750">him</en>.
<en id="wh354751">He who walks</en> <en id="wh354752">with integrity</en>
<en id="wh354753">will be kept safe</en>,
<en id="wh354754">but</en> <en id="wh354755">whoever is perverse</en> <en id="wh354758">in</en> <en id="wh354756">his ways</en> <en id="wh354759">will suddenly</en> <en id="wh354757">fall</en>.
<en id="wh354760">The one who works</en> <en id="wh354761">his land</en> <en id="wh354762">will have plenty of</en> <en id="wh354763">food</en>,
<en id="wh354764">but</en> <en id="wh354765">whoever chases</en> <en id="wh354766">fantasies</en> <en id="wh354767">will have his fill</en> <en id="wh354768">of poverty</en>.
<en id="wh354770">A faithful</en> <en id="wh354769">man</en> <en id="wh354771">will abound</en> <en id="wh354772">with blessings</en>,
<en id="wh354773">but</en>
<en id="wh354774">one eager</en>
<en id="wh354775">to</en> <en id="wh354776">be rich</en>
<en id="wh354777">will not</en> <en id="wh354778">go unpunished</en>.
<en id="wh354779">To show partiality</en>
<en id="wh354781">is not</en> <en id="wh354782">good</en>,
<en id="wh354788">yet a man</en> <en id="wh354787">will do wrong</en> <en id="wh354783">for</en> <en id="wh354785">a piece</en> <en id="wh354786">of bread</en>.
<en id="wh354794">A stingy</en> <en id="wh354793">man</en> <en id="wh354789">hastens</en> <en id="wh354792">after wealth</en>
<en id="wh354796">and</en> <en id="wh354797">does not</en> <en id="wh354798">know</en>
<en id="wh354799">that</en> <en id="wh354800">poverty</en> <en id="wh354801">awaits him</en>.

<en id="wh354802">He who rebukes</en> <en id="wh354803">a man</en> <en id="wh354804">will later</en> <en id="wh354806">find</en> <en id="wh354805">more favor</en> <en id="wh354808">than one who flatters</en> <en id="wh354809">with his tongue</en>.
<en id="wh354810">He who robs</en> <en id="wh354811">his father</en> <en id="wh354812">or</en> <en id="wh354813">mother</en>,
<en id="wh354815">saying</en>,
“<en id="wh354816">It is not</en> <en id="wh354817">wrong</en>,”
<en id="wh354818">is a companion</en> <en id="wh354820">to</en> <en id="wh354821">the man</en> <en id="wh354822">who destroys</en>.
<en id="wh354823">A greedy man</en> <en id="wh354825">stirs up</en> <en id="wh354826">strife</en>,
<en id="wh354827">but</en>
<en id="wh354828">he who trusts</en> <en id="wh354829">in</en> <en id="wh354830">the LORD</en>
<en id="wh354831">will prosper</en>.
<en id="wh354832">He who trusts</en> <en id="wh354833">in</en> <en id="wh354834">himself</en>
<en id="wh354836">is a fool</en>,
<en id="wh354837">but</en> <en id="wh354838">one who walks</en> <en id="wh354839">in</en> <en id="wh354840">wisdom</en>
<en id="wh354842">will be safe</en>.
<en id="wh354843">Whoever gives</en> <en id="wh354844">to</en> <en id="wh354845">the</en> <en id="wh354846">poor</en>
<en id="wh354847">will not</en> <en id="wh354848">be in need</en>,
<en id="wh354849">but</en> <en id="wh354850">he who hides</en> <en id="wh354851">his eyes</en> <en id="wh354852">will receive many</en> <en id="wh354853">curses</en>.
<en id="wh354854">When</en> <en id="wh354856">the wicked</en> <en id="wh354855">come to power</en>,
<en id="wh354858">people</en> <en id="wh354857">hide themselves</en>;
<en id="wh354859">but</en>
<en id="wh354860">when</en> <en id="wh354861">they perish</en>,
<en id="wh354863">the righteous</en> <en id="wh354862">flourish</en>.
<en id="wh354864">A man who</en> ... <en id="wh354865">after much reproof</en>
<en id="wh354866">remains stiff-necked</en>
<en id="wh354868">will suddenly</en> <en id="wh354869">be shattered</en>
<en id="wh354872">beyond recovery</en>.
<en id="wh354873">When</en> <en id="wh354875">the righteous</en> <en id="wh354874">flourish</en>,
<en id="wh354877">the</en> <en id="wh354878">people</en> <en id="wh354876">rejoice</en>,
<en id="wh354879">but</en>
<en id="wh354880">when</en> <en id="wh354882">the wicked</en> <en id="wh354881">rule</en>,
<en id="wh354884">the people</en> <en id="wh354883">groan</en>.
<en id="wh354885">A man</en>
<en id="wh354886">who loves</en> <en id="wh354887">wisdom</en>
<en id="wh354888">brings joy</en> <en id="wh354889">to his father</en>,
<en id="wh354890">but</en>
<en id="wh354891">a companion</en> <en id="wh354892">of prostitutes</en>
<en id="wh354893">squanders</en> <en id="wh354894">his wealth</en>.
<en id="wh354896">By</en> <en id="wh354897">justice</en> <en id="wh354895">a king</en> <en id="wh354898">brings stability</en> <en id="wh354899">to the land</en>,
<en id="wh354900">but</en> <en id="wh354901">a man</en> <en id="wh354902">who exacts tribute</en> <en id="wh354903">demolishes it</en>.
<en id="wh354904">A man</en>
<en id="wh354905">who flatters</en> <en id="wh354907">his neighbor</en>
<en id="wh354909">spreads</en> <en id="wh354908">a net</en> <en id="wh354910">for</en> <en id="wh354911">his feet</en>.
<en id="wh354915">An evil</en> <en id="wh354914">man</en> <en id="wh354916">is caught</en> <en id="wh354912">by</en> <en id="wh354913">his own sin</en>,
<en id="wh354917">but</en> <en id="wh354918">a righteous one</en> <en id="wh354919">sings</en>
<en id="wh354920">and</en> <en id="wh354921">rejoices</en>.
<en id="wh354923">The righteous</en> <en id="wh354922">consider</en> <en id="wh354924">the cause</en> <en id="wh354925">of the poor</en>,
<en id="wh354926">but the wicked</en> <en id="wh354927">have no</en> <en id="wh354928">regard</en> <en id="wh354929">for such concerns</en>.
<en id="wh354930">Mockers</en> <en id="wh354932">inflame</en> <en id="wh354933">a city</en>,
<en id="wh354935">but the wise</en> <en id="wh354936">turn away</en> <en id="wh354937">anger</en>.
<en id="wh354939">If a wise</en> <en id="wh354938">man</en> <en id="wh354940">goes to court</en> <en id="wh354941">with</en> <en id="wh354943">a fool</en>,
<en id="wh354945">there will be raving</en>
<en id="wh354946">and</en> <en id="wh354947">laughing</en>
<en id="wh354949">with no</en> <en id="wh354950">resolution</en>.
<en id="wh354951">Men</en> <en id="wh354952">of bloodshed</en> <en id="wh354953">hate</en> <en id="wh354954">a blameless man</en>,
<en id="wh354955">but</en> <en id="wh354956">the upright</en> <en id="wh354957">care for</en> <en id="wh354958">his life</en>.
<en id="wh354962">A fool</en> <en id="wh354961">vents</en> <en id="wh354959">all</en> <en id="wh354960">his anger</en>,
<en id="wh354963">but</en> <en id="wh354964">a wise man</en> <en id="wh354967">holds</en> <en id="wh354966">it back</en>.
<en id="wh354968">If a ruler</en>
<en id="wh354969">listens</en> <en id="wh354970">to</en> <en id="wh354972">lies</en>,
<en id="wh354973">all</en> <en id="wh354974">his officials</en> <en id="wh354975">will be wicked</en>.
<en id="wh354976">The poor man</en> <en id="wh354977">and</en> <en id="wh354978">the oppressor</en> <en id="wh354980">have this in common</en>:
<en id="wh354984">The LORD</en> <en id="wh354981">gives light</en> <en id="wh354982">to the eyes</en> <en id="wh354983">of both</en>.
<en id="wh354985">A king</en>
<en id="wh354986">who judges</en> <en id="wh354989">the poor</en> <en id="wh354987">with</en> <en id="wh354988">fairness</en>—
<en id="wh354990">his throne</en> <en id="wh354993">will be established</en> <en id="wh354992">forever</en>.
<en id="wh354994">A rod</en> <en id="wh354996">of correction</en> <en id="wh354997">imparts</en> <en id="wh354998">wisdom</en>,
<en id="wh354999">but</en> <en id="wh355000">a child</en> <en id="wh355001">left to himself</en> <en id="wh355002">disgraces</en> <en id="wh355003">his mother</en>.
<en id="wh355004">When</en> <en id="wh355006">the wicked</en> <en id="wh355005">thrive</en>,
<en id="wh355008">rebellion</en> <en id="wh355007">increases</en>;
<en id="wh355009">but</en> <en id="wh355010">the righteous</en> <en id="wh355013">will see</en> <en id="wh355012">their downfall</en>.
<en id="wh355014">Discipline</en> <en id="wh355015">your son</en>,
<en id="wh355016">and</en> <en id="wh355017">he will give you rest</en>;
<en id="wh355019">he will bring</en> <en id="wh355020">delight</en> <en id="wh355021">to</en> <en id="wh355022">your soul</en>.
<en id="wh355024">Where there is no</en> <en id="wh355025">vision</en>, <en id="wh355027">the people</en> <en id="wh355026">cast off restraint</en>;
<en id="wh355028">but</en> ... <en id="wh355029">he who keeps</en> <en id="wh355030">the Law</en>.
<en id="wh355031">blessed is</en>
<en id="wh355036">A servant</en> <en id="wh355034">cannot</en> <en id="wh355035">be corrected</en> <en id="wh355032">by</en> <en id="wh355033">words alone</en>;
<en id="wh355037">though</en> <en id="wh355038">he understands</en>,
<en id="wh355040">he will not</en> <en id="wh355041">respond</en>.
<en id="wh355042">Do you see</en> <en id="wh355043">a man</en>
<en id="wh355046">who speaks</en> <en id="wh355045">in</en> <en id="wh355044">haste</en>?
<en id="wh355047">There is more hope</en> <en id="wh355049">for a fool</en> <en id="wh355050">than for him</en>.
<en id="wh355054">A servant</en> <en id="wh355051">pampered</en> <en id="wh355052">from</en> <en id="wh355053">his youth</en>
<en id="wh355057">will bring</en> <en id="wh355058">grief</en> <en id="wh355056">in the end</en>.
<en id="wh355060">An angry</en> <en id="wh355059">man</en> <en id="wh355061">stirs up</en> <en id="wh355062">dissension</en>,
<en id="wh355063">and</en> <en id="wh355065">a hot-tempered</en> <en id="wh355064">man</en> <en id="wh355066">abounds</en> <en id="wh355067">in transgression</en>.
<en id="wh355069">A man’s</en> <en id="wh355068">pride</en> <en id="wh355070">will bring him low</en>,
<en id="wh355071">but</en> <en id="wh355072">a humble</en> <en id="wh355073">spirit</en> <en id="wh355074">will obtain</en> <en id="wh355075">honor</en>.
<en id="wh355076">A partner</en> <en id="wh355077">to</en> <en id="wh355078">a thief</en>
<en id="wh355079">hates</en> <en id="wh355080">his own soul</en>;
<en id="wh355082">he receives</en> <en id="wh355081">the oath</en>
<en id="wh355083">but</en> <en id="wh355084">does not</en> <en id="wh355085">testify</en>.
<en id="wh355086">The fear</en> <en id="wh355087">of man</en> <en id="wh355088">is</en> <en id="wh355089">a snare</en>,
<en id="wh355090">but</en>
<en id="wh355091">whoever trusts</en> <en id="wh355092">in</en> <en id="wh355093">the LORD</en>
<en id="wh355094">is set securely on high</en>.
<en id="wh355095">Many</en> <en id="wh355096">seek</en> <en id="wh355098">the ruler’s</en> <en id="wh355097">favor</en>,
<en id="wh355099">but</en> <en id="wh355103">a man</en> <en id="wh355102">receives justice</en> <en id="wh355100">from</en> <en id="wh355101">the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh355107">An unjust</en> <en id="wh355106">man</en> <en id="wh355104">is detestable</en> <en id="wh355105">to the righteous</en>,
<en id="wh355108">and</en> <en id="wh355112">one whose way</en> <en id="wh355111">is upright</en> <en id="wh355109">is detestable</en> <en id="wh355110">to the wicked</en>.
<en id="wh355113">These are the words</en> <en id="wh355114">of Agur</en> <en id="wh355115">son</en> <en id="wh355116">of Jakeh</en>
— <en id="wh355117">the</en> <en id="wh355118">burden</en>

<en id="wh355121">that this man</en> <en id="wh355119">declared</en> <en id="wh355122">to</en> <en id="wh355123">Ithiel</en>: “<en id="wh355127">I am weary, O God</en>, <en id="wh355124">and</en> <en id="wh355125">worn out</en>.
<en id="wh355128">Surely</en> <en id="wh355130">I am</en> <en id="wh355129">the most ignorant</en> ... <en id="wh355132">of a man</en>.
<en id="wh355136">of men</en>, <en id="wh355133">and</en> <en id="wh355134">I lack</en> <en id="wh355135">the understanding</en>
<en id="wh355139">I have not</en> <en id="wh355140">learned</en> <en id="wh355141">wisdom</en>,
<en id="wh355142">and</en> <en id="wh355143">I have no knowledge</en> <en id="wh355144">of the Holy One</en>.
<en id="wh355146">Who</en> <en id="wh355147">has ascended</en> ... <en id="wh355148">heaven</en>
<en id="wh355149">to</en> ... <en id="wh355150">and come down</en>?
<en id="wh355151">Who</en> <en id="wh355152">has gathered</en> <en id="wh355153">the wind</en> <en id="wh355154">in</en> <en id="wh355155">His hands</en>?
<en id="wh355156">Who</en> <en id="wh355157">has bound up</en> <en id="wh355160">the</en> <en id="wh355158">waters</en> <en id="wh355159">in</en> <en id="wh355161">His cloak</en>?
<en id="wh355162">Who</en> <en id="wh355163">has established</en> <en id="wh355164">all</en> <en id="wh355165">the ends</en> <en id="wh355166">of the earth</en>?
<en id="wh355167">What</en> <en id="wh355168">is His name</en>,
<en id="wh355169">and</en> <en id="wh355170">what</en> <en id="wh355171">is the name</en> <en id="wh355172">of His Son</en>—
<en id="wh355173">surely</en> <en id="wh355174">you know</en>!
<en id="wh355175">Every</en> <en id="wh355176">word</en> <en id="wh355177">of God</en> <en id="wh355178">is flawless</en>;
<en id="wh355180">He</en> <en id="wh355179">is a shield</en>
<en id="wh355181">to</en> <en id="wh355183">those who take refuge</en> <en id="wh355184">in Him</en>.
<en id="wh355185">Do not</en> <en id="wh355186">add</en> ... <en id="wh355188">His words</en>,
<en id="wh355189">lest</en> <en id="wh355190">He rebuke</en> <en id="wh355191">you</en>
<en id="wh355192">to</en> ... <en id="wh355193">and prove you a liar</en>.
<en id="wh355194">Two</en> <en id="wh355195">things I ask</en> <en id="wh355196">of You</en>
— <en id="wh355198">do not</en> <en id="wh355199">refuse me</en>
<en id="wh355202">before</en> <en id="wh355203">I die</en>:
<en id="wh355204">Keep falsehood</en> <en id="wh355205">and</en> <en id="wh355207">deceitful</en> <en id="wh355206">words</en> <en id="wh355208">far</en> <en id="wh355209">from me</en>.
<en id="wh355214">Give</en> <en id="wh355215">me</en> <en id="wh355213">neither</en> <en id="wh355210">poverty</en> <en id="wh355212">nor riches</en>;
<en id="wh355216">feed me</en> <en id="wh355217">with the bread</en> <en id="wh355218">that is my portion</en>.
<en id="wh355219">Otherwise</en>, <en id="wh355220">I may have too much</en>
<en id="wh355221">and</en> <en id="wh355222">deny You</en>,
<en id="wh355224">saying</en>,
‘<en id="wh355225">Who</en>
<en id="wh355228">is the LORD</en>?’ <en id="wh355227">Or</en> <en id="wh355229">I may become poor</en>
<en id="wh355230">and</en> <en id="wh355231">steal</en>,
<en id="wh355233">profaning</en> <en id="wh355234">the name</en> <en id="wh355235">of my God</en>.
<en id="wh355236">Do not</en> <en id="wh355237">slander</en> <en id="wh355238">a servant</en> <en id="wh355239">to</en> <en id="wh355240">his master</en>,
<en id="wh355241">or</en> <en id="wh355242">he will curse you</en>,
<en id="wh355243">and</en> <en id="wh355244">you will bear the guilt</en>.
<en id="wh355245">There is a generation</en> <en id="wh355247">of those who curse</en> <en id="wh355246">their fathers</en>
<en id="wh355248">and</en> <en id="wh355251">do not</en> <en id="wh355252">bless</en> <en id="wh355250">their mothers</en>.
<en id="wh355253">There is a generation</en> <en id="wh355254">of those who are pure</en> <en id="wh355255">in</en> <en id="wh355256">their own eyes</en>
<en id="wh355257">and</en> <en id="wh355261">yet unwashed</en> <en id="wh355259">of their filth</en>.

<en id="wh358857">O Shulammite</en>!

<en id="wh358863">Why</en> <en id="wh358864">do you look</en> <en id="wh358865">at</en> <en id="wh358866">the</en> <en id="wh358867">Shulammite</en>, <en id="wh358868">as</en> <en id="wh358869">on the dance</en> <en id="wh358871">of Mahanaim</en>?
<en id="wh358872">How</en> <en id="wh358873">beautiful</en> <en id="wh358877">are your sandaled</en> <en id="wh358874">feet</en>, ... <en id="wh358876">The</en>
<en id="wh358878">O daughter</en> <en id="wh358879">of the prince</en>!

<en id="wh358880">curves</en> <en id="wh358881">of your thighs</en> <en id="wh358882">are like</en> <en id="wh358883">jewels</en>, <en id="wh358884">the handiwork</en> <en id="wh358886">of a master</en>.
<en id="wh358887">Your navel</en> <en id="wh358890">is a rounded</en> <en id="wh358888">goblet</en>;

<en id="wh358973">May your breasts</en> <en id="wh358971">be</en> <en id="wh358974">like</en> <en id="wh358975">clusters</en> <en id="wh358977">of the vine</en>, <en id="wh358976">the</en>

<en id="wh358990">May it flow</en> <en id="wh358994">smoothly</en> <en id="wh358991">to</en> <en id="wh358992">my beloved</en>, ... <en id="wh358993">and</en>
<en id="wh358995">gliding gently over</en> <en id="wh358996">lips</en> ... <en id="wh358997">teeth</en>.

<en id="wh359004">Come</en>,

<en id="wh359046">that I have treasured up</en> <en id="wh359047">for you</en>,
<en id="wh359048">O</en> <en id="wh359050">that</en> <en id="wh359052">you were to me</en> <en id="wh359051">like a brother</en>

<en id="wh359275">These are the words</en> <en id="wh359276">of the Teacher</en>, <en id="wh359277">the son</en> <en id="wh359278">of David</en>, <en id="wh359279">king</en> <en id="wh359280">in</en> <en id="wh359281">Jerusalem</en>:

<en id="wh359337">round</en>

<en id="wh359340">The</en> <en id="wh359341">wind</en> ... <en id="wh359339">it swirls</en>,

<en id="wh361645">Who</en> <en id="wh361646">can</en>
<en id="wh361648">straighten</en>

<en id="wh361671">God</en> <en id="wh361669">has made</en> <en id="wh361665">one of these</en> <en id="wh361667">along with</en> <en id="wh361670">the</en> <en id="wh361668">other</en>, <en id="wh361672">so that</en>

<en id="wh361685">In</en> <en id="wh361687">my futile</en> <en id="wh361686">life</en> <en id="wh361684">I have seen</en> <en id="wh361683">both of these</en>:
<en id="wh361689">A righteous man</en>
<en id="wh361690">perishing</en> <en id="wh361691">in</en> <en id="wh361692">his righteousness</en>,

<en id="wh361782">cursing you</en>.
<en id="wh361783">For</en> <en id="wh361787">you know</en> <en id="wh361788">in your heart</en> ... <en id="wh361786">many</en> <en id="wh361785">times</en>
<en id="wh361789">that</en> ... <en id="wh361791">you yourself</en> <en id="wh361792">have cursed</en> <en id="wh361793">others</en>.
<en id="wh361794">All</en> <en id="wh361795">this</en> <en id="wh361796">I tested</en> <en id="wh361797">by</en> <en id="wh361799">wisdom, saying</en>,
“<en id="wh361800">I resolve</en>

<en id="wh361802">But</en> <en id="wh361803">it</en> <en id="wh361804">was beyond</en> <en id="wh361805">me</en>.
<en id="wh361806">is out of reach</en>
<en id="wh361807">What</en>
<en id="wh361808">exists</en>
<en id="wh361810">and</en> <en id="wh361811">very deep</en>.
<en id="wh361813">Who</en> <en id="wh361814">can fathom it</en>?
<en id="wh361816">I</en> <en id="wh361815">directed</en> <en id="wh361818">my mind</en>
<en id="wh361819">to</en> <en id="wh361820">understand</en>,
<en id="wh361822">to</en> <en id="wh361823">explore</en>,
<en id="wh361825">to search out</en> <en id="wh361826">wisdom</en> <en id="wh361827">and</en> <en id="wh361828">explanations</en>,
<en id="wh361830">and</en> <en id="wh361831">to understand</en>
<en id="wh361833">stupidity</en> <en id="wh361832">of wickedness</en>
<en id="wh361835">the</en> ... <en id="wh361834">and</en> <en id="wh361836">the folly</en> <en id="wh361837">of madness</en>.
<en id="wh361838">And</en> <en id="wh361840">I</en> <en id="wh361839">find</en>
<en id="wh361841">more bitter</en> <en id="wh361842">than</en> <en id="wh361843">death</en>
<en id="wh361845">the</en> <en id="wh361846">woman</en>
<en id="wh361847">who</en>

<en id="wh361865">her</en>, <en id="wh361862">but</en> <en id="wh361863">the sinner</en> <en id="wh361864">is ensnared</en>.
“<en id="wh361866">Behold</en>,”
“<en id="wh361868">I have discovered</en> <en id="wh361867">this</en>

<en id="wh361877">While</en> <en id="wh361880">my soul</en> <en id="wh361878">was still</en> <en id="wh361879">searching</en>

<en id="wh361909">but</en> <en id="wh361910">they</en> <en id="wh361911">have sought out</en> <en id="wh361913">many</en> <en id="wh361912">schemes</en>.”

<en id="wh361924">A man’s</en> <en id="wh361923">wisdom</en> <en id="wh361925">brightens</en> <en id="wh361926">his face</en>,

<en id="wh361954">he will do</en>
<en id="wh361958">the king’s</en> <en id="wh361957">word</en> <en id="wh361959">is supreme</en>,
<en id="wh361960">For</en> ... <en id="wh361961">and who</en> <en id="wh361962">can say</en> <en id="wh361963">to him</en>,

<en id="wh361987">though</en> <en id="wh361990">a man’s</en> <en id="wh361988">misery</en> <en id="wh361991">weighs heavily</en> <en id="wh361992">upon him</en>.

<en id="wh361996">what</en>

<en id="wh362052">there is a time</en>

<en id="wh362062">Then</en> <en id="wh362064">too</en>, <en id="wh362065">I saw</en>

<en id="wh363254">before</en> <en id="wh363261">the</en> <en id="wh363262">light</en> <en id="wh363259">of the sun</en>, <en id="wh363265">moon</en>, <en id="wh363266">and</en> <en id="wh363268">stars</en> <en id="wh363257">is darkened</en>,
<en id="wh363269">and</en> <en id="wh363271">the</en> <en id="wh363272">clouds</en> <en id="wh363270">return</en> <en id="wh363273">after</en> <en id="wh363274">the</en> <en id="wh363275">rain</en>,
<en id="wh363276">on</en> <en id="wh363278">the day</en> <en id="wh363277">the</en>
<en id="wh363281">keepers</en> <en id="wh363283">of the house</en> <en id="wh363280">tremble</en>

<en id="wh363295">and</en> ... <en id="wh363296">see dimly</en>,
<en id="wh363298">those watching</en> <en id="wh363301">through windows</en>
<en id="wh363305">when</en> <en id="wh363306">the</en> <en id="wh363304">doors</en> <en id="wh363307">to the street</en> <en id="wh363303">are shut</en>
<en id="wh363310">and the sound</en> <en id="wh363312">of the mill</en> <en id="wh363309">fades away</en>,

<en id="wh363319">and</en> <en id="wh363321">all</en> <en id="wh363323">the</en> <en id="wh363322">daughters</en> <en id="wh363324">of song</en> <en id="wh363320">grow faint</en>,

— <en id="wh363346">for then</en> <en id="wh363349">man</en> goes <en id="wh363350">to</en> <en id="wh363352">his eternal</en> <en id="wh363351">home</en> ... <en id="wh363347">walk</en>

<en id="wh363677">and</en> <en id="wh363678">turns</en> <en id="wh363679">away</en>.

<en id="wh363692">Look</en>,
<en id="wh363693">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh363695">on my affliction</en>,

<en id="wh363731">O LORD</en>,
<en id="wh363733">Look</en>,

<en id="wh363737">Is this nothing</en> <en id="wh363738">to you</en>,

<en id="wh364391">of the Lord</en>?
