<en id="wh364408">O LORD</en>, ... <en id="wh364409">Should priests</en> <en id="wh364410">and</en> <en id="wh364411">prophets</en> <en id="wh364405">be killed</en> <en id="wh364406">in</en> <en id="wh364407">the sanctuary</en>
<en id="wh364417">Both young</en> <en id="wh364418">and</en> <en id="wh364419">old</en> <en id="wh364412">lie together</en> <en id="wh364415">in the dust</en> <en id="wh364416">of the streets</en>.

<en id="wh364422">My young men</en> <en id="wh364421">and</en> <en id="wh364420">maidens</en> <en id="wh364423">have fallen</en> <en id="wh364424">by</en> <en id="wh364425">the</en> <en id="wh364426">sword</en>.

<en id="wh364434">You summoned</en> <en id="wh364438">my terrors</en> <en id="wh364440">on every side</en>, <en id="wh364435">as</en> <en id="wh364436">for the day</en> <en id="wh364437">of an appointed feast</en>.

<en id="wh364444">In</en> <en id="wh364445">the day</en> <en id="wh364447">of the LORD’s</en> <en id="wh364446">anger</en> <en id="wh364442">no</en> <en id="wh364448">one escaped</en> <en id="wh364449">or</en> <en id="wh364450">survived</en>;
<en id="wh364451">those</en> <en id="wh364452">I nurtured</en>

<en id="wh364455">my enemy</en> <en id="wh364456">has destroyed</en>

<en id="wh364473">Indeed</en>, ... <en id="wh364475">keeps</en> ... <en id="wh364474">against me</en>

<en id="wh364481">He has worn away</en> <en id="wh364482">my flesh</en> <en id="wh364483">and</en> <en id="wh364484">skin</en>;

<en id="wh364496">He has made me dwell</en> <en id="wh364494">in</en> <en id="wh364495">darkness</en> <en id="wh364497">like</en> <en id="wh364498">those dead</en> <en id="wh364499">for ages</en>.
<en id="wh364500">He has walled me in</en>

<en id="wh364543">He pierced</en> <en id="wh364545">my kidneys</en> <en id="wh364544">with</en> <en id="wh364546">His arrows</en>.
<en id="wh364548">I am</en> <en id="wh364549">a laughingstock</en> <en id="wh364550">to</en> <en id="wh364551">all</en> <en id="wh364552">my people</en>;

<en id="wh364557">He has filled me</en> <en id="wh364558">with</en> <en id="wh364560">bitterness</en>;
<en id="wh364561">He has intoxicated me</en> <en id="wh364562">with wormwood</en>.
<en id="wh364564">He has ground</en> <en id="wh364568">my teeth</en> <en id="wh364565">with</en> <en id="wh364567">gravel</en>
<en id="wh364569">and trampled me</en> <en id="wh364570">in</en> <en id="wh364571">the</en> <en id="wh364572">dust</en>.
<en id="wh364577">My soul</en> <en id="wh364574">has been deprived</en> <en id="wh364573">of</en> <en id="wh364576">peace</en>;
<en id="wh364578">I have forgotten</en> <en id="wh364579">what prosperity is</en>.
<en id="wh364580">So</en> <en id="wh364581">I say</en>,

<en id="wh364588">Remember</en> <en id="wh364589">my affliction</en> <en id="wh364590">and</en> <en id="wh364591">wandering</en>, <en id="wh364592">the wormwood</en> <en id="wh364593">and</en> <en id="wh364594">the gall</en>.
<en id="wh364595">Surely</en> ... <en id="wh364596">remembers</en>

<en id="wh364602">Yet I call</en> <en id="wh364601">this</en> <en id="wh364603">to</en> <en id="wh364604">mind</en>,
<en id="wh364605">and therefore</en> <en id="wh364607">I have hope</en>:
<en id="wh364608">the loving devotion</en> <en id="wh364609">of the LORD</en>
<en id="wh364610">Because of</en> ... <en id="wh364611">we are not</en> <en id="wh364612">consumed</en>,
<en id="wh364613">for</en> <en id="wh364616">His mercies</en> <en id="wh364614">never</en> <en id="wh364615">fail</en>.
<en id="wh364617">They are new every morning</en>;
<en id="wh364621">great</en> <en id="wh364622">is Your faithfulness</en>!
“<en id="wh364624">The LORD</en> <en id="wh364623">is my portion</en>,”
<en id="wh364625">says</en> <en id="wh364626">my soul</en>,

<en id="wh364632">The LORD</en> <en id="wh364631">is good</en> <en id="wh364633">to</en> <en id="wh364634">those who wait for Him</en>,
<en id="wh364635">to</en> <en id="wh364636">the soul</en>

<en id="wh364638">It is good</en> <en id="wh364640">to wait</en> <en id="wh364642">quietly</en> <en id="wh364644">for the salvation</en> <en id="wh364645">of the LORD</en>.
<en id="wh364646">It is good</en> <en id="wh364649">for a man</en> <en id="wh364647">to</en> ... <en id="wh364648">the</en>
<en id="wh364651">bear</en> ... <en id="wh364652">yoke</en> <en id="wh364654">while he is still young</en>.
<en id="wh364655">Let him sit</en> <en id="wh364656">alone</en>
<en id="wh364658">in silence</en>, ... <en id="wh364657">it</en>
<en id="wh364659">for</en> <en id="wh364660">the LORD has laid</en> ... <en id="wh364661">upon him</en>.
<en id="wh364662">Let him bury</en> <en id="wh364666">his face</en> <en id="wh364663">in</en> <en id="wh364664">the</en> <en id="wh364665">dust</en>—
<en id="wh364667">perhaps</en> <en id="wh364668">there is</en> <en id="wh364669">still hope</en>.
<en id="wh364670">Let him offer</en> <en id="wh364673">his cheek</en> <en id="wh364671">to</en> <en id="wh364672">the one who would strike him</en>;

<en id="wh364677">For</en> <en id="wh364682">the Lord</en> <en id="wh364678">will not</en> <en id="wh364679">cast us off</en> <en id="wh364681">forever</en>.
<en id="wh364683">Even</en> <en id="wh364684">if</en> <en id="wh364685">He causes grief</en>,

<en id="wh364691">For</en> <en id="wh364692">He does not</en> <en id="wh364695">willingly</en> <en id="wh364693">afflict</en>
<en id="wh364697">or grieve</en> <en id="wh364698">the sons</en> <en id="wh364696">of</en> <en id="wh364699">men</en>.
<en id="wh364700">To</en> <en id="wh364701">crush</en> <en id="wh364702">underfoot</en> <en id="wh364704">all</en> <en id="wh364705">the prisoners</en> <en id="wh364706">of the land</en>,
<en id="wh364707">to</en> <en id="wh364708">deny</en> <en id="wh364710">a man</en> <en id="wh364709">justice</en> <en id="wh364712">before</en> <en id="wh364713">the Most High</en>,
<en id="wh364714">to</en> <en id="wh364715">subvert</en> <en id="wh364716">a man</en> <en id="wh364717">in</en> <en id="wh364718">his lawsuit</en>—

<en id="wh364722">Who</en> <en id="wh364724">has spoken</en>

<en id="wh364733">Do not</en> <en id="wh364736">both adversity</en> <en id="wh364737">and</en> <en id="wh364739">good</en> <en id="wh364734">come</en> <en id="wh364730">from</en> <en id="wh364731">the mouth</en> <en id="wh364732">of the Most High</en>?
<en id="wh364740">Why</en> <en id="wh364743">should any mortal</en> <en id="wh364742">man</en> <en id="wh364741">complain</en>,

upon us — <en id="wh364807">devastation</en> <en id="wh364808">and</en> <en id="wh364810">destruction</en>.

<en id="wh364811">Streams</en> <en id="wh364812">of tears</en> <en id="wh364813">flow</en> <en id="wh364814">from my eyes</en> <en id="wh364815">over</en> <en id="wh364816">the destruction</en> <en id="wh364817">of the daughter</en> <en id="wh364818">of my people</en>.

<en id="wh364831">the LORD</en> ... <en id="wh364832">from</en> <en id="wh364833">heaven</en> <en id="wh364829">and</en> <en id="wh364830">sees</en>.

<en id="wh364834">My eyes</en> <en id="wh364835">bring grief</en> <en id="wh364836">to</en> <en id="wh364837">my soul</en> <en id="wh364839">because of all</en> <en id="wh364840">the daughters</en> <en id="wh364841">of my city</en>.
<en id="wh364848">Without cause</en> <en id="wh364847">my enemies</en> <en id="wh364842">hunted</en> <en id="wh364843">me</en> <en id="wh364844">like</en> <en id="wh364846">a bird</en>.

<en id="wh364866">O LORD</en>,

<en id="wh364886">You defend</en>
<en id="wh364887">O Lord</en>;
<en id="wh364888">cause</en>, ... <en id="wh364889">my life</en>.
<en id="wh364891">my</en> ... <en id="wh364890">You redeem</en>
<en id="wh364892">You have seen</en>,

<en id="wh364905">O LORD</en>,

<en id="wh364909">the slander</en> <en id="wh364911">and</en> <en id="wh364912">murmuring</en> <en id="wh364910">of my assailants</en> <en id="wh364913">against me</en> <en id="wh364914">all</en> <en id="wh364916">day long</en>.

<en id="wh368754">to</en> <en id="wh368755">revoke</en> <en id="wh368757">the</en> <en id="wh368758">letters</en> <en id="wh368759">that the scheming</en> <en id="wh368760">Haman</en> <en id="wh368761">son</en> <en id="wh368762">of Hammedatha</en>, <en id="wh368763">the</en> <en id="wh368764">Agagite</en>,

<en id="wh368767">to</en> <en id="wh368768">destroy</en> <en id="wh368770">the</en> <en id="wh368771">Jews</en>

<en id="wh368803">So</en> <en id="wh368801">King</en> <en id="wh368802">Xerxes</en> <en id="wh368799">said</en> <en id="wh368804">to Esther</en> <en id="wh368805">the</en> <en id="wh368806">Queen</en> <en id="wh368808">and</en> <en id="wh368809">Mordecai</en> <en id="wh368810">the</en> <en id="wh368811">Jew</en>,
“<en id="wh368812">Behold</en>, <en id="wh368815">I have given</en> <en id="wh368814">Haman’s</en> <en id="wh368813">estate</en> <en id="wh368816">to</en> <en id="wh368817">Esther</en>,
<en id="wh368818">and</en> <en id="wh368820">he was hanged</en> <en id="wh368821">on</en> <en id="wh368822">the</en> <en id="wh368823">gallows</en>
<en id="wh368824">because</en> <en id="wh368826">he attacked</en> <en id="wh368829">the</en> <en id="wh368830">Jews</en>.

<en id="wh368831">Now</en> <en id="wh368832">you</en> <en id="wh368833">may write</en> <en id="wh368842">in</en> <en id="wh368844">the</en> <en id="wh368845">king’s</en> <en id="wh368843">name</en> <en id="wh368837">as</en> <en id="wh368841">you please</en> <en id="wh368834">regarding</en> <en id="wh368835">the</en> <en id="wh368836">Jews</en>,

<en id="wh368853">For a decree</en> <en id="wh368852">that</en>
<en id="wh368855">is written</en> <en id="wh368856">in</en> <en id="wh368858">the</en> <en id="wh368857">name</en> <en id="wh368859">of the king</en>
<en id="wh368860">and</en> <en id="wh368861">sealed</en> <en id="wh368862">with</en> <en id="wh368864">the</en> <en id="wh368865">royal</en> <en id="wh368863">signet ring</en>
<en id="wh368866">cannot</en>
<en id="wh368868">be revoked</en>.”

<en id="wh368874">At</en> <en id="wh368876">once</en> <en id="wh368872">the</en> <en id="wh368873">royal</en> <en id="wh368871">scribes</en> <en id="wh368870">were summoned</en>, ... <en id="wh368883">of the third</en> ... (<en id="wh368880">the</en> <en id="wh368881">month</en>
<en id="wh368885">month</en> ... <en id="wh368886">of Sivan</en>),
<en id="wh368889">and</en> <en id="wh368887">on</en> <en id="wh368888">the twenty-third day</en>
<en id="wh368893">they recorded</en> <en id="wh368895">all of</en>
<en id="wh368898">Mordecai’s</en> <en id="wh368897">orders</en>

<en id="wh368899">to</en> <en id="wh368900">the</en> <en id="wh368901">Jews</en> <en id="wh368902">and</en> <en id="wh368903">to</en> <en id="wh368904">the</en> <en id="wh368905">satraps</en>, <en id="wh368908">governors</en>, <en id="wh368909">and</en> <en id="wh368910">princes</en> <en id="wh368911">of the 127</en> <en id="wh368912">provinces</en>
<en id="wh368914">from</en> <en id="wh368915">India</en> ... <en id="wh368918">Cush</en>
— <en id="wh368924">writing to each province</en>
<en id="wh368927">in its own script</en>,
<en id="wh368933">to every people</en> <en id="wh368935">in their own language</en>, <en id="wh368932">and</en>

<en id="wh368937">to</en> ... <en id="wh368936">to</en> <en id="wh368938">the</en> <en id="wh368939">Jews</en> <en id="wh368941">in their own script</en> <en id="wh368942">and</en> <en id="wh368944">language</en>.
<en id="wh368946">Mordecai wrote</en> <en id="wh368947">in</en> <en id="wh368949">the</en> <en id="wh368948">name</en> ... <en id="wh368950">King</en> <en id="wh368951">Xerxes</en>
<en id="wh368952">of</en> ... <en id="wh368953">and sealed it</en> <en id="wh368954">with</en> <en id="wh368957">the royal</en> <en id="wh368955">signet ring</en>. ... <en id="wh368956">the</en>
<en id="wh368959">He sent</en> ... <en id="wh368960">documents</en> <en id="wh368961">by</en> <en id="wh368967">mounted</en> <en id="wh368964">couriers</en>
<en id="wh368968">riding on</en> <en id="wh368970">swift horses</en> <en id="wh368973">bred</en> <en id="wh368972">from the royal</en> <en id="wh368975">mares</en>.
<en id="wh368976">By these letters</en> <en id="wh368978">the</en> <en id="wh368979">king</en> <en id="wh368977">permitted</en> <en id="wh368981">the</en> <en id="wh368982">Jews</en>
<en id="wh368984">in</en> <en id="wh368985">each</en> <en id="wh368987">and</en> <en id="wh368986">every city</en>
<en id="wh368990">the right to assemble</en>
<en id="wh368992">and</en> <en id="wh368994">defend</en> <en id="wh368995">themselves</en>,
<en id="wh368996">to</en> <en id="wh368997">destroy</en>,
<en id="wh369000">kill</en>,

<en id="wh369002">and</en> <en id="wh369003">annihilate</en> <en id="wh369005">all</en> <en id="wh369006">the forces</en> <en id="wh369007">of any people</en> <en id="wh369008">or</en> <en id="wh369009">province</en>
<en id="wh369011">hostile to them</en>,

<en id="wh369016">and</en> ... <en id="wh369017">plunder</en>
<en id="wh369018">to</en> ... <en id="wh369019">their possessions</en>.

<en id="wh369022">The single</en> <en id="wh369021">day appointed</en> <en id="wh369024">throughout all</en> <en id="wh369026">the</en> <en id="wh369025">provinces</en> <en id="wh369027">of King</en> <en id="wh369028">Xerxes</en> <en id="wh369030">was the thirteenth</en> <en id="wh369034">day of the twelfth</en> <en id="wh369033">month</en>,

<en id="wh369039">A copy</en> <en id="wh369041">of the text</en>

<en id="wh369050">published</en> <en id="wh369051">to</en> <en id="wh369052">all</en> <en id="wh369053">the</en> <en id="wh369054">people</en>,

<en id="wh369070">The</en> <en id="wh369071">couriers</en> <en id="wh369072">rode</en> <en id="wh369077">out</en> ... <en id="wh369076">on their royal</en> <en id="wh369074">horses</en>,

<en id="wh369085">And</en> <en id="wh369086">the</en> <en id="wh369087">edict</en> <en id="wh369088">was also issued</en> <en id="wh369089">in</en> <en id="wh369091">the</en> <en id="wh369092">citadel</en> <en id="wh369090">of Susa</en>.

<en id="wh369094">Mordecai</en> <en id="wh369095">went out</en> <en id="wh369096">from</en> <en id="wh369099">the</en> <en id="wh369098">presence</en> <en id="wh369100">of the king</en> <en id="wh369101">in</en> <en id="wh369103">royal garments</en> <en id="wh369104">of blue</en> <en id="wh369105">and</en> <en id="wh369106">white</en>, <en id="wh369110">with a large</en> <en id="wh369109">gold</en> <en id="wh369108">crown</en> <en id="wh369114">and</en> <en id="wh369115">a purple</en> <en id="wh369112">robe</en> <en id="wh369113">of fine linen</en>.

<en id="wh369141">In</en> <en id="wh369142">every</en> <en id="wh369137">province</en> <en id="wh369134">and</en> <en id="wh369136">every</en> <en id="wh369143">city</en>, <en id="wh369146">wherever</en>
<en id="wh369149">the</en> <en id="wh369150">king’s</en> <en id="wh369148">edict</en> <en id="wh369151">and</en> <en id="wh369152">decree</en> <en id="wh369153">reached</en>,
<en id="wh369154">there was joy</en> <en id="wh369155">and</en> <en id="wh369156">gladness</en> <en id="wh369159">among the Jews</en>,
<en id="wh369160">with feasting</en> <en id="wh369161">and</en> <en id="wh369162">celebrating</en>.
<en id="wh369164">And</en> <en id="wh369165">many</en> <en id="wh369167">of the people</en> <en id="wh369169">of the land</en> <en id="wh369170">themselves became Jews</en>,
<en id="wh369171">because</en> <en id="wh369174">the</en> <en id="wh369173">fear</en> <en id="wh369175">of the Jews</en> <en id="wh369172">had fallen</en> <en id="wh369176">upon them</en>.
<en id="wh369179">of the twelfth</en> ... <en id="wh369181">the month</en>
<en id="wh369183">month</en>, ... <en id="wh369184">of Adar</en>,
<en id="wh369185">On</en> <en id="wh369186">the thirteenth</en> <en id="wh369188">day</en>
<en id="wh369193">the</en> <en id="wh369194">king’s</en> <en id="wh369192">command</en> <en id="wh369195">and</en> <en id="wh369196">edict</en>
<en id="wh369198">were to be executed</en>.
<en id="wh369199">On</en> <en id="wh369201">this day</en> <en id="wh369200">the</en>
<en id="wh369204">enemies</en> <en id="wh369206">of the Jews</en> <en id="wh369203">had hoped</en>

<en id="wh369216">and the Jews</en> <en id="wh369214">overpowered</en> <en id="wh369217">those</en> <en id="wh369219">who hated them</en>.

<en id="wh369225">In</en> <en id="wh369226">each</en> <en id="wh369227">of the provinces</en> <en id="wh369229">of King</en> <en id="wh369230">Xerxes</en>, <en id="wh369221">the</en> <en id="wh369222">Jews</en> <en id="wh369220">assembled</en> <en id="wh369223">in</en> <en id="wh369224">their cities</en>

<en id="wh369378">On</en> <en id="wh369382">that</en> <en id="wh369380">day</en> <en id="wh369381">the</en> <en id="wh369384">number</en> <en id="wh369386">of those killed</en> <en id="wh369387">in</en> <en id="wh369389">the</en> <en id="wh369390">citadel</en> <en id="wh369388">of Susa</en> <en id="wh369392">was reported to</en> <en id="wh369393">the</en> <en id="wh369394">king</en>,

<en id="wh369420">in</en> <en id="wh369423">the</en> <en id="wh369421">rest</en> <en id="wh369424">of the royal</en> <en id="wh369422">provinces</en>?

<en id="wh369438">It will be fulfilled</en>.”
<en id="wh369441">Esther</en> <en id="wh369440">replied</en>,

<en id="wh369454">in</en> <en id="wh369455">Susa</en>

<en id="wh369475">So</en> ... <en id="wh369477">that this</en> <en id="wh369476">be done</en>.

<en id="wh369494">in</en> <en id="wh369495">Susa</en>

<en id="wh369497">On</en> <en id="wh369499">the fourteenth</en> <en id="wh369498">day</en> ... <en id="wh369502">the month</en> <en id="wh369503">of Adar</en>, ... <en id="wh369496">again</en> <en id="wh369501">and</en>
<en id="wh369504">of</en> ... <en id="wh369505">put to death</en> <en id="wh369508">three</en> <en id="wh369509">hundred</en> <en id="wh369510">men</en> <en id="wh369507">there</en>,

<en id="wh369511">but</en> <en id="wh369515">they did not</en> <en id="wh369516">lay</en> <en id="wh369518">a hand</en> <en id="wh369512">on</en> <en id="wh369513">the</en> <en id="wh369514">plunder</en>.
<en id="wh369521">The</en> <en id="wh369520">rest</en> <en id="wh369522">of the Jews</en>
<en id="wh369524">in</en> <en id="wh369526">the</en> <en id="wh369527">royal</en> <en id="wh369525">provinces</en>
<en id="wh369528">also assembled</en>

<en id="wh385685">who</en> <en id="wh385686">does not</en> <en id="wh385687">keep</en> <en id="wh385692">this</en> <en id="wh385690">promise</en>.
<en id="wh385694">out of his house</en> <en id="wh385695">and</en> <en id="wh385697">possessions</en>

<en id="wh385811">and all</en> <en id="wh385812">my servants</en> <en id="wh385813">were gathered</en> <en id="wh385814">there</en> <en id="wh385810">for</en> <en id="wh385816">the</en> <en id="wh385817">work</en>;

<en id="wh392627">David’s other sons were Ibhar</en>, <en id="wh392629">Elishua</en>, <en id="wh392631">Eliphelet</en>,

<en id="wh392664">Jehoshaphat</en> <en id="wh392665">his son</en>,

<en id="wh392689">sons</en> <en id="wh392690">of Josiah</en>:

<en id="wh410529">I will make it</en> <en id="wh410531">an object of scorn</en> <en id="wh410533">and</en> <en id="wh410534">ridicule</en> <en id="wh410535">among</en> <en id="wh410536">all</en> <en id="wh410537">the</en> <en id="wh410538">peoples</en>.

<en id="wh410571">And others will answer</en>, ... <en id="wh410570">this</en>,

<en id="wh410579">who</en> brought them <en id="wh410582">out of the land</en> ... <en id="wh410583">Egypt</en>,
<en id="wh410584">of</en> ... <en id="wh410585">and have embraced</en> <en id="wh410588">other</en> <en id="wh410587">gods</en>,
<en id="wh410590">worshiping</en>
<en id="wh410592">and</en> <en id="wh410593">serving them</en>—
<en id="wh410594">because of</en> ... <en id="wh410596">He has brought</en> <en id="wh410599">all</en> <en id="wh410603">this</en> <en id="wh410601">disaster</en> <en id="wh410597">upon them</en>.’”
<en id="wh410604">Now</en> <en id="wh410607">at the end</en> <en id="wh410608">of the twenty</en> <en id="wh410609">years</en>

<en id="wh410610">during which</en> <en id="wh410612">Solomon</en> <en id="wh410611">had built</en> <en id="wh410614">the house</en> <en id="wh410615">of the LORD</en> <en id="wh410616">and</en> <en id="wh410618">his own palace</en>,
<en id="wh410620">the</en> <en id="wh410621">cities</en>
<en id="wh410626">Solomon</en> ... <en id="wh410624">Hiram</en> <en id="wh410623">had given</en>
<en id="wh410627">rebuilt</en>
<en id="wh410630">him</en> <en id="wh410631">and settled</en> <en id="wh410634">Israelites</en> <en id="wh410632">there</en>.
<en id="wh410638">Then Solomon</en> <en id="wh410637">went</en> <en id="wh410636">to</en> <en id="wh410639">Hamath-zobah</en>
<en id="wh410641">and captured</en> <en id="wh410640">it</en>.

in addition <en id="wh410652">to all</en> <en id="wh410654">the</en> <en id="wh410655">store</en> <en id="wh410653">cities</en>

<en id="wh410686">that</en> <en id="wh410687">belonged to</en> <en id="wh410689">Solomon</en>,

<en id="wh410690">and</en> <en id="wh410692">all</en> <en id="wh410694">the</en> <en id="wh410693">cities</en> <en id="wh410695">for his chariots</en> <en id="wh410701">and</en> <en id="wh410700">horses</en>

<en id="wh410748">who</en> <en id="wh410749">remained</en> <en id="wh410751">in</en> <en id="wh410752">the</en> <en id="wh410753">land</en>,

<en id="wh410769">But</en> ... <en id="wh410771">any of the Israelites</en>

<en id="wh410816">Solomon</en> <en id="wh410815">brought</en> <en id="wh410813">the daughter</en> <en id="wh410814">of Pharaoh</en> <en id="wh410818">up from the City</en> <en id="wh410819">of David</en> <en id="wh410820">to</en> <en id="wh410821">the</en> <en id="wh410822">palace</en>

<en id="wh410901">In</en> <en id="wh410904">keeping with the ordinances</en> <en id="wh410906">of his father</en> <en id="wh410905">David</en>, <en id="wh410902">Solomon appointed</en> <en id="wh410909">the</en> <en id="wh410908">divisions</en> <en id="wh410910">of the priests</en> <en id="wh410911">over</en> <en id="wh410912">their service</en>,

<en id="wh410933">He also appointed gatekeepers</en> <en id="wh410934">by</en> <en id="wh410935">their divisions</en> <en id="wh410937">at each gate</en>, ... <en id="wh410938">this</en>
<en id="wh410940">for</en> ... <en id="wh410942">had been the command</en> <en id="wh410943">of David</en>, <en id="wh410945">the</en> <en id="wh410944">man</en> <en id="wh410946">of God</en>.

<en id="wh410968">Thus all</en> <en id="wh410969">the work</en> <en id="wh410966">of</en> <en id="wh410970">Solomon</en> <en id="wh410967">was carried out</en>, ... <en id="wh410972">the</en> <en id="wh410973">day</en> <en id="wh410974">the foundation was laid</en> <en id="wh410975">for the house</en> <en id="wh410976">of the LORD</en>

<en id="wh411001">So Hiram</en> <en id="wh410999">sent</en> <en id="wh411000">him</en> <en id="wh411005">ships</en> <en id="wh411003">captained by</en> <en id="wh411004">his servants</en>, <en id="wh411007">along with crews</en> <en id="wh411006">of</en>

<en id="wh411048">She arrived in Jerusalem</en> <en id="wh411049">with</en> <en id="wh411052">a very</en> <en id="wh411051">large</en> <en id="wh411050">caravan</en>— <en id="wh411054">with camels</en>

<en id="wh411124">he presented</en> <en id="wh411125">at the house</en> <en id="wh411126">of the LORD</en>,
<en id="wh411132">it took her breath away</en>.

“<en id="wh411139">The</en> <en id="wh411140">report</en> ... <en id="wh411138">is true</en>.

<en id="wh411142">I heard</en> <en id="wh411143">in</en> <en id="wh411144">my own country</en> <en id="wh411145">about</en> <en id="wh411146">your words</en> <en id="wh411147">and</en> <en id="wh411149">wisdom</en>
<en id="wh411150">But</en> <en id="wh411151">I did not</en> <en id="wh411152">believe</en> <en id="wh411154">the reports</en>
<en id="wh411155">until</en> <en id="wh411157">I came</en>
<en id="wh411158">and</en> <en id="wh411159">saw</en> <en id="wh411160">with my own eyes</en>.

<en id="wh411163">not</en> <en id="wh411166">half</en> <en id="wh411167">of the greatness</en> <en id="wh411168">of your wisdom</en> <en id="wh411164">was told</en> <en id="wh411165">to me</en>.

<en id="wh411174">I heard</en>.

<en id="wh411186">and</en> <en id="wh411187">hear</en> <en id="wh411189">your wisdom</en>!

<en id="wh411197">to</en> <en id="wh411198">set you</en> <en id="wh411199">on</en> <en id="wh411200">His throne</en> <en id="wh411201">to</en> <en id="wh411202">be king</en> <en id="wh411204">for the LORD</en> <en id="wh411205">your God</en>.

<en id="wh411212">enough to establish them</en> <en id="wh411214">forever</en>,

<en id="wh411220">to</en> <en id="wh411221">carry out</en> <en id="wh411222">justice</en> <en id="wh411223">and</en> <en id="wh411224">righteousness</en>.”

<en id="wh411227">Then</en> <en id="wh411226">she gave</en> <en id="wh411228">the</en> <en id="wh411229">king</en> <en id="wh411232">120</en> <en id="wh411233">talents</en> <en id="wh411234">of gold</en>, <en id="wh411238">a great quantity of</en> <en id="wh411236">spices</en>, <en id="wh411240">and</en> <en id="wh411242">precious</en> <en id="wh411241">stones</en>.
<en id="wh411245">There had never been</en> <en id="wh411250">such</en> <en id="wh411248">spices</en> <en id="wh411246">as those</en> <en id="wh411249">the</en>
<en id="wh411253">queen</en> <en id="wh411254">of Sheba</en> <en id="wh411252">gave</en> <en id="wh411255">to</en> <en id="wh411257">King</en> <en id="wh411258">Solomon</en>.
(<en id="wh411261">The servants</en> <en id="wh411262">of Hiram</en> <en id="wh411263">and</en> <en id="wh411265">of Solomon</en> ... <en id="wh411260">also</en>
